# 📘 PKO-Native Procedural Knowledge Rulebook — RuleSpeak®

_A canonical Effortless Rulebook profile aligned to the Procedural Knowledge Ontology (PKO) 2.0.0. It represents procedure specifications separately from executions and includes versioning, status changes, steps, transitions, actions, software functions, tools, requirements, verifications, resources, agents, roles in time, issues, errors, questions, feedback, FAQs, explanations, governance, tacit/implicit/explicit knowledge capture, operational data bindings, learning, and communication policy projections. PKO-native terms are mapped exactly; enterprise knowledge-governance additions are explicitly identified as ERB-PKO extensions._

> Declarative business rules rendered from the rulebook. Every statement
> below expresses truth in the business domain — it is neither a procedure
> nor an imperative. The rulebook's formulas are the single source of truth;
> this document is their plain-language reading.

## 1 Business Vocabulary

_Example data is not shown: the formula simulator failed to run: timed out. No value is displayed rather than a possibly-incorrect one._

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Rulebook Releas** | Version ledger for the canonical ERB-PKO rulebook itself. This is distinct from PKO Procedure versioning. | — |
| Name | Computed as the rulebook version, followed by “ / PKO ”, followed by the pko core version iri. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the RulebookReleases row._ |
| Rulebook Version | A defined attribute. | _Semantic version of this canonical rulebook release._ |
| Profile Version | A defined attribute. | _Version of the ERB-PKO profile schema._ |
| Profile Schema Path | A defined attribute. | _Repository-relative path to the ERB-PKO JSON profile schema._ |
| Pko Core Version Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact version IRI of the PKO core ontology used by this release._ |
| Pko Industry Version Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact version IRI of the PKO industry module used by this release._ |
| Issued At | A defined attribute. | _Timestamp at which this rulebook release was issued._ |
| Status | A defined attribute. | _Release status such as Draft, Candidate, or Published._ |
| Changelog | A defined attribute. | _Human-readable semantic changelog for this release._ |
| Is Current | True when an empty string. | _TRUE only for the current rulebook release._ |
| Governed Model | A defined attribute. | _Model this release versions._ |
| Previous Release | A defined attribute. | _Prior version (owl:priorVersion)._ |
| Declared Scale | A defined attribute. | _Initial, Patch, Minor or Major as decided._ |
| Version Major | A defined attribute. | _Major number._ |
| Version Minor | A defined attribute. | _Minor number._ |
| Version Patch | A defined attribute. | _Patch number._ |
| Migration Plan | A defined attribute. | _Migration plan for a breaking release._ |
| Version Decision Rationale | A defined attribute. | _Why this version increment was chosen._ |
| Version Decided by Agent | A defined attribute. | _Who made the versioning decision._ |
| Approved by Agent | A defined attribute. | _Who approved publication._ |
| Rulebook Commit | A defined attribute. | _Version-control tag or commit of the release._ |
| License | A defined attribute. | _Licence the release is published under._ |
| Permanent Iri | A defined attribute. | _Permanent identifier of the release._ |
| Namespace Prefix | A defined attribute. | _Preferred namespace prefix (vann:preferredNamespacePrefix)._ |
| Funding Note | A defined attribute. | _Funding acknowledgement (schema:funding)._ |
| Prev Major | The version major of the rulebook releas's previous release. | _Previous major number._ |
| Prev Minor | The version minor of the rulebook releas's previous release. | _Previous minor number._ |
| Prev Patch | The version patch of the rulebook releas's previous release. | _Previous patch number._ |
| Prev Issued At | Taken from the linked previous release. | _When the previous release was issued._ |
| Model Current Release | Taken from the linked governed model. | _Release the model is declared at now._ |
| Expected Major | Determined by priority: the prev major plus 1 if the declared scale is “Major”; in all other cases, the prev major. | _Major number the declared scale calls for._ |
| Expected Minor | Determined by priority: 0 if the declared scale is “Major”; the prev minor plus 1 if the declared scale is “Minor”; in all other cases, the prev minor. | _Minor number the declared scale calls for._ |
| Expected Patch | Determined by priority: the prev patch plus 1 if the declared scale is “Patch”; in all other cases, 0. | _Patch number the declared scale calls for._ |
| Is Increment Inconsistent With Scale | True when all of the following hold: the previous release has a value and at least one of the following holds: the version major is not the expected major; the version minor is not the expected minor; or the version patch is not the expected patch. | _TRUE when the version number does not follow from the previous one and the declared patch, minor or major scale._ |
| Days Since Previous Release | Determined by priority: 0 if the previous release is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the prev issued at to the issued at. | _Length of the release cycle._ |
| Is Long Release Cycle | True when the days since previous release is greater than 60. | _TRUE when more than sixty days passed since the previous release instead of a short repeated cycle._ |
| Is Declared Current Release | True when all of the following hold: the model current release has a value and the rulebook release ID is the model current release. | _TRUE for the release the model is currently declared at._ |
| Log Entry Count | The number of model change log entries related to the rulebook releas. | _Change log entries shipped in the release._ |
| Logical Change Count | The number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that alter a logical model. | _Entries that alter the logical model._ |
| Non Additive Change Count | The number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that are backward-incompatible. | _Entries that break backward compatibility._ |
| Class Removal or Rename Count | The number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that are class removal or renames. | _Classes removed or renamed._ |
| Invalidating Domain Range Count | The number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that are invalidating domain range changes. | _Domain or range changes invalidating instance assertions._ |
| Inconsistent Disjointness Count | The number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that are inconsistent disjointnesses. | _Disjointness axioms making individuals inconsistent._ |
| Schema Addition Count | The number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that are additive schema changes. | _Additive schema changes._ |
| Suite Update Count | The number of the rulebook releas's steward activities that have a duty kind of “ValidationSuiteUpdate”. | _Steward updates to the validation suite made for this release._ |
| Consumer Count | The number of model consumers related to the rulebook releas. | _Consumers depending on the model._ |
| Notified Consumer Count | The number of the rulebook releas's consumer revalidations that have been notified. | _Consumers told of the release._ |
| Revalidated Consumer Count | The number of the rulebook releas's consumer revalidations that are passed revalidation. | _Consumers re-validated against the release._ |
| Validation Run Count | The number of change validation runs related to the rulebook releas. | _Validation runs for changes shipped in the release._ |
| Validation Failure Total | The total failure count across the rulebook releas's change validation runs that have a run purpose of “Acceptance”. | _Acceptance-run failures for changes in the release._ |
| Consistent Run Count | The number of the rulebook releas's change validation runs that have a consistency check outcome of “Consistent”. | _Runs whose machine consistency check confirmed no inconsistency._ |
| Cq Run Count | The number of competency question runs related to the rulebook releas. | _Competency questions run as tasks against the release._ |
| Answerable Cq Run Count | The number of the rulebook releas's competency question runs that have been answerable. | _Questions the release could answer._ |
| Regressed Baseline Count | The number of the rulebook releas's competency question runs that are baseline regressions. | _Original questions that regressed in the release._ |
| Cq Coverage Percent | Determined by priority: 0 if the cq run count is 0; in all other cases, 100 times the answerable cq run count divided by the cq run count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). | _Share of the question runs the release could answer._ |
| Prev Cq Coverage Percent | Taken from the linked previous release. | _Question coverage of the previous release._ |
| Prev Cq Run Count | Taken from the linked previous release. | _Question runs against the previous release._ |
| Scored Criterion Count | The number of quality assessments related to the rulebook releas. | _Quality criteria the release was scored against._ |
| Stated Criterion Count | The number of quality criteria related to the rulebook releas. | _Stated quality criteria._ |
| Patch Alters Logical Model | True when all of the following hold: the declared scale is “Patch” and the logical change count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a patch release changed the logical model instead of only documentation, labels and comments._ |
| Minor is Not Backward Compatible | True when all of the following hold: the declared scale is “Minor” and the non additive change count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a minor release contains a change that is not additive and backward compatible._ |
| Class Removal Without Major | True when all of the following hold: the declared scale is not “Major” and the class removal or rename count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a class was removed or renamed in a release that is not major._ |
| Invalidating Domain Range Without Major | True when all of the following hold: the declared scale is not “Major” and the invalidating domain range count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a domain or range change invalidating instance assertions shipped in a release that is not major._ |
| Inconsistent Disjointness Without Major | True when all of the following hold: the declared scale is not “Major” and the inconsistent disjointness count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a disjointness axiom making individuals inconsistent shipped in a release that is not major._ |
| Is Breaking Release | True when at least one of the following holds: the declared scale is “Major” or the non additive change count is greater than 0. | _TRUE for a major release or any release containing a breaking change._ |
| Breaking Release With Unrevalidated Consumers | True when all of the following hold: the breaking release flag is set and the revalidated consumer count is less than the consumer count. | _TRUE when a breaking release left consumers that were never updated and re-validated._ |
| Breaking Release Without Migration Plan | True when all of the following hold: the breaking release flag is set and the migration plan is blank. | _TRUE when a breaking release shipped with no migration plan._ |
| Is Undocumented Version Decision | True when all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and at least one of the following holds: the version decision rationale is blank or the version decided by agent is blank. | _TRUE when a governed release records no rationale or no decider for its version increment._ |
| Is Unannounced to Dependents | True when the notified consumer count is less than the consumer count. | _TRUE when some consumer that depends on the model was not told of the release._ |
| Is Release Without Recorded Changes | True when all of the following hold: the previous release has a value and the log entry count is 0. | _TRUE when a release after the first records no change log entries, so what changed is not on record._ |
| Suite Lags Release | True when all of the following hold: the schema addition count is greater than 0 and the suite update count is 0. | _TRUE when a release added schema but the steward made no matching validation-suite update._ |
| Is Untagged Release | True when all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and the rulebook commit is blank. | _TRUE when a governed release has no version-control tag or commit._ |
| Published Without Approval | True when all of the following hold: the status is “Released” and the approved by agent is blank. | _TRUE when a release was published without a recorded publication approval._ |
| Released Despite Failed Validation | True when the validation failure total is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a release shipped changes whose acceptance validation failed._ |
| Released Without Consistency Check | True when all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and the consistent run count is 0. | _TRUE when no machine consistency check confirmed a governed release consistent._ |
| Passed Validation At Release | True when all of the following hold: the validation run count is greater than 0 and the validation failure total is 0. | _TRUE when every acceptance run for the release passed._ |
| Cq Coverage Declined | True when all of the following hold: the previous release has a value; the prev cq run count is greater than 0; the cq run count is greater than 0; and the cq coverage percent is less than the prev cq coverage percent. | _TRUE when the release answers a smaller share of its questions than the previous release did._ |
| Has Baseline Regression | True when the regressed baseline count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the release can no longer answer at least one original question._ |
| Released Without Cq Task Test | True when all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and the cq run count is 0. | _TRUE when a governed release was never tested by running its competency questions as tasks._ |
| Well Formed But Requirements Unshown | True when all of the following hold: the validation run count is greater than 0 and the cq run count is 0. | _TRUE when a release passed validation runs but was never shown to answer its requirement questions._ |
| Is Not Scored Against Criteria | True when all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and the scored criterion count is less than the stated criterion count. | _TRUE when a governed release was not scored against every stated quality criterion._ |
| Is Released Without Licence or Permanent ID | True when all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and at least one of the following holds: the license is blank or the permanent iri is blank. | _TRUE when a governed release carries no licence or no permanent identifier._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Ontology Profile** | Versioned ontology and vocabulary dependencies. PKO mappings always identify the exact profile and version. | — |
| Name | Computed as the label, followed by a space, followed by the version. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the OntologyProfiles row._ |
| Label | A defined attribute. | _Human-readable ontology or vocabulary name._ |
| Version | A defined attribute. | _Referenced release or specification version._ |
| Version Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact version IRI or normative specification URI._ |
| Namespace Iri | A defined attribute. | _Namespace used for class/property IRIs._ |
| License | A defined attribute. | _License or standards body attribution._ |
| Scope | A defined attribute. | _How the profile is used in this rulebook._ |
| Mapping Count | The number of semantic mappings related to the ontology profile. | _Semantic mappings that use this ontology profile._ |
| Evaluation Context | A defined attribute. | _Instant the dependency is judged against._ |
| As of Instant | Taken from the linked evaluation context. | _Judgment instant._ |
| Last Revised At | A defined attribute. | _When the standard last published any revision._ |
| Last Major Revision At | A defined attribute. | _When the standard last published a major revision._ |
| Dependency Reviewed At | A defined attribute. | _When we last reviewed our dependency on it._ |
| Days Since Last Revision | Determined by priority: 0 if the last revised at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the last revised at to the as of instant. | _Days since any revision._ |
| Days Since Major Revision | Determined by priority: 0 if the last major revision at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the last major revision at to the as of instant. | _Days since the last major revision._ |
| Days Since Dependency Reviewed | Determined by priority: 0 if the dependency reviewed at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the dependency reviewed at to the as of instant. | _Days since our dependency review._ |
| Recent Deprecation Count | The number of the ontology profile's external standard terms that are recent deprecations. | _Adopted terms the standard deprecated in the last two years._ |
| Requires Frequent Review | True when at least one of the following holds: the recent deprecation count is at least 2 or all of the following hold: the last major revision at has a value and the days since major revision is less than 730. | _TRUE when the standard deprecates often or went through a major revision in the last two years._ |
| Change Rate Profile | Determined by priority: “FrequentDeprecation” if the recent deprecation count is at least 2; “RecentMajorRevision” if all of the following hold: the last major revision at has a value and the days since major revision is less than 730; “Dormant” if all of the following hold: the last revised at has a value and the days since last revision is greater than 3650; in all other cases, “Unassessed”. | _How fast the standard changes: FrequentDeprecation, RecentMajorRevision, Dormant, or Unassessed._ |
| Is Review Overdue for Change Rate | True when all of the following hold: the requires frequent review flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the dependency reviewed at is blank or the days since dependency reviewed is greater than 180. | _TRUE when a fast-changing standard has not had its dependency reviewed in 180 days._ |
| Adoption Stage | A defined attribute. | _1 vocabulary, 2 lightweight ontology, 3 process and decision modeling._ |
| Adopted At | A defined attribute. | _When the model adopted the standard._ |
| Prerequisite Profile | A defined attribute. | _Earlier-stage standard this one builds on._ |
| Prerequisite Adopted At | Taken from the linked prerequisite profile. | _When that standard was adopted._ |
| Skips Adoption Path | True when all of the following hold: the adoption stage is greater than 1 and at least one of the following holds: the prerequisite profile is blank; the prerequisite adopted at is blank; or the prerequisite adopted at is greater than the adopted at. | _TRUE when a later-stage standard was adopted before the earlier-stage standard it builds on, or with none._ |
| Supporting Programme | A defined attribute. | _The funded programme that produced or supported this vocabulary._ |
| Namespace Checked At | A defined attribute. | _When the namespace was last fetched by tools/check_namespace_resolution.py._ |
| Namespace Http Status | A defined attribute. | _HTTP status the namespace returned when last fetched._ |
| Namespace Serves Rdf | True when an empty string. | _Whether fetching the namespace with an RDF Accept header returned RDF._ |
| Namespace is Http | True when at least one of the following holds: the first 7 character(s) of the namespace iri is “http://” or the first 8 character(s) of the namespace iri is “https://”. | _Whether the namespace is an HTTP(S) URI, the first Linked Data requirement, rather than a urn: or other non-resolvable identifier._ |
| Namespace Dereferences | True when all of the following hold: the namespace is http flag is set and the namespace http status is 200. | _The namespace is an HTTP URI and fetching it actually returned a document._ |
| Publishes Following Linked Data Principles | True when all of the following hold: the namespace dereferences flag is set; the namespace serves rdf flag is set; and the mapping count is greater than 0. | _The vocabulary is published the way Linked Data requires: an HTTP URI that resolves, serves RDF when asked for it, and carries links to other terms._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Evaluation Context** | The instant this rulebook's time-dependent witnesses are evaluated against. Modeled as data rather than wall-clock so every freshness, overdue, and validity answer is reproducible and auditable: asking the same question tomorrow yields the same answer. Exactly one row carries IsCurrent. | — |
| Name | Computed as the label, followed by “ @ ”, followed by the as of instant. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the EvaluationContexts row._ |
| Label | A defined attribute. | _What this evaluation instant represents._ |
| As of Instant | A defined attribute. | _The instant all time-dependent witnesses are evaluated against._ |
| Is Current | True when an empty string. | _TRUE for the single active evaluation context._ |
| Rationale | A defined attribute. | _Why this instant was chosen._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Extension class IRI._ |
| Explicit Fragment Count | The number of knowledge fragments related to the evaluation context. | _Pieces of knowledge on record, judged at this instant, that are written down._ |
| Tacit Fragment Count | The number of knowledge fragments related to the evaluation context. | _Pieces of knowledge on record that live in practiced hands and were drawn out of a person._ |
| Implicit Fragment Count | The number of knowledge fragments related to the evaluation context. | _Pieces of knowledge on record that everybody acts on and nobody had ever stated._ |
| Situated Judgment Fragment Count | The number of knowledge fragments related to the evaluation context. | _Pieces of knowledge on record that are a judgment call for one situation._ |
| Model Reasoned Answer Count | The number of assistant answers related to the evaluation context. | _Assistant answers on record where the language model did the reasoning itself._ |
| Otherwise Reasoned Answer Count | The number of assistant answers related to the evaluation context. | _Assistant answers on record where the reasoning was done by a query or a reasoner, or none was needed._ |
| Assistant Answer Count | Computed as the model reasoned answer count plus the otherwise reasoned answer count. | _Every assistant answer on record._ |
| Model Reasoned Failed Answer Count | The number of assistant answers related to the evaluation context. | _Of the answers the language model reasoned out itself, how many of the tasks failed._ |
| Out of Order Step Execution Count | The number of step executions related to the evaluation context. | _Step executions on record that were carried out of the order the procedure specifies._ |
| In Order Step Execution Count | The number of step executions related to the evaluation context. | _Step executions on record that followed the order the procedure specifies._ |
| Step Execution Count | Computed as the out of order step execution count plus the in order step execution count. | _Every step execution on record._ |
| Early Start Step Execution Count | The number of step executions related to the evaluation context. | _Step executions on record that began before the step they depend on had finished._ |
| Exact Mapping Count | The number of semantic mappings related to the evaluation context. | _Concepts of this book that map exactly onto a term PKO itself defines._ |
| Aligned Mapping Count | The number of semantic mappings related to the evaluation context. | _Concepts of this book that map onto one of the older standards PKO reuses._ |
| Extension Mapping Count | The number of semantic mappings related to the evaluation context. | _Concepts of this book that PKO does not define: the book's own extensions, labelled as such._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Organization** | Organizations that own, adopt, govern, or execute procedures. Maps to prov:Organization. | — |
| Name | The same as its display name. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the Organizations row._ |
| Display Name | A defined attribute. | _Organization's human-readable name._ |
| Organization Type | A defined attribute. | _Type such as Company, Department, Vendor, or Regulator._ |
| External Identifier | A defined attribute. | _Identifier in an operational directory or master-data system._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact RDF class IRI for the organization._ |
| Failed Ai Initiative Count | The number of the organization's ai adoption initiatives that have a outcome of “Failed”. | _AI initiatives that failed._ |
| Owned Procedure Count | The number of procedures related to the organization. | _Procedures the organization has captured._ |
| Ai Fails for Lack of Captured Knowledge | True when all of the following hold: the failed ai initiative count is greater than 0 and the owned procedure count is 0. | _TRUE for an organization with a failed AI initiative that has captured no procedures._ |
| Product Delivery Function Count | The number of the organization's sourcing functions that deliver an own product. | _Functions that deliver the organization's own products._ |
| Provider Held Delivery Method Count | The number of the organization's sourcing functions that deliver an own product and are method knowledge held outsides. | _Of those, functions whose method knowledge a provider holds._ |
| Is Hollowed Out Firm | True when all of the following hold: the product delivery function count is greater than 0 and the provider held delivery method count is the product delivery function count. | _TRUE when every function that delivers the organization's own products depends on method knowledge a provider holds._ |
| Audit Finding Count | The number of the organization's knowledge audit items that have an internal shortfall. | _Audit items where the organization holds less knowledge than it needs._ |
| Filled Knowledge Position Count | The number of the organization's knowledge workforce positions that have a status of “Filled”. | _Filled knowledge engineering, information architecture and ontology positions._ |
| Has Knowledge Findings Without Knowledge Staff | True when all of the following hold: the audit finding count is greater than 0 and the filled knowledge position count is 0. | _TRUE when audits found knowledge shortfalls and the organization employs no knowledge engineer, information architect or ontologist to address them._ |
| Departed Holder Know How Count | The number of the organization's know how carriers that are held by departed holders. | _Know-how whose carrier has left._ |
| Lost Departed Know How Count | The number of the organization's know how carriers that are held-only-by-departed. | _Know-how that left with its carrier, neither transferred nor captured._ |
| Retained Departed Know How Percent | Determined by priority: 100 if the departed holder know how count is 0; in all other cases, 100 times the departed holder know how count minus the lost departed know how count divided by the departed holder know how count rounded to 0 decimal place(s). | _Share of departed carriers' know-how the organization kept._ |
| Memory Leaves With Staff | True when all of the following hold: the departed holder know how count is greater than 0 and the retained departed know how percent is less than 100. | _TRUE when some know-how of people who left was not retained._ |
| Captured Own Know How Count | The number of the organization's know how carriers that are captured. | _The organization's own know-how captured in its repository._ |
| Documentation Entry Count | The number of knowledge repository entries related to the organization. | _Repository entries for the organization's procedures._ |
| Unallocated Documentation Count | The number of the organization's knowledge repository entries that are not authored on allocated time. | _Entries written outside allotted time._ |
| Transfer Given Count | The number of knowledge transfers related to the organization. | _Transfers given by the organization's people._ |
| Unallocated Transfer Count | The number of the organization's knowledge transfers that are not on allocated time. | _Transfers given outside allotted time._ |
| Treats Knowledge Work As Unvalued | True when all of the following hold: the documentation entry count plus the transfer given count is greater than 0 and 2 times the unallocated documentation count plus the unallocated transfer count is greater than the documentation entry count plus the transfer given count. | _TRUE when most documentation and knowledge transfer happens outside the time the organization allots._ |
| Person Carried Know How Count | The number of the organization's know how carriers that have a carrier kind of “Person”. | _Know-how carried by people._ |
| Facility Carried Know How Count | The number of the organization's know how carriers that have a carrier kind of “Facility”. | _Know-how carried by plants._ |
| System Carried Know How Count | The number of the organization's know how carriers that have a carrier kind of “System”. | _Know-how carried by systems._ |
| Holds Know How in People Plants and Systems | True when all of the following hold: the person carried know how count is greater than 0; the facility carried know how count is greater than 0; and the system carried know how count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the organization's how-to-build knowledge is carried at once by people, plants and systems._ |
| Staged Decline Count | The number of the organization's capability declines that follow a preceding stage decline. | _Capability declines that followed the decline of the preceding stage._ |
| Eroded in Stages | True when the staged decline count is at least 2. | _TRUE when facility investment, then engineer training, then how-to-make upkeep declined in sequence._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Agent** | Human and software agents that create, modify, approve, or execute procedural knowledge. Maps to prov:Agent. | — |
| Name | The same as its display name. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the Agents row._ |
| Display Name | A defined attribute. | _Agent's human-readable name._ |
| Agent Kind | A defined attribute. | _Human, AIAgent, AutomatedPipeline, Organization, or another explicit agent category._ |
| Organization | A defined attribute. | _Organization to which the agent belongs._ |
| Contact Address | A defined attribute. | _Contact address when applicable._ |
| Version or Employment Key | A defined attribute. | _Model version, pipeline release, or employment assignment key._ |
| Count of Current Role Assignments | The number of role assignments related to the agent. | _How many role assignments this agent currently holds. Counts only CURRENT assignments via the CurrentAgentKey echo — counting all assignments would report a departed agent as engaged forever._ |
| Is Still Engaged | True when the count of current role assignments is greater than 0. | _TRUE when this agent currently holds at least one role in the organization._ |
| Decision Count | The number of agent decision records related to the agent. | _Total decisions this agent has recorded._ |
| Overridden Decision Count | The number of agent decision records related to the agent. | _Decisions by this agent that a human corrected or reversed._ |
| Override Rate Percent | Determined by priority: 0 if the decision count is 0; in all other cases, the overridden decision count times 100 divided by the decision count. | _Percentage of this agent's decisions that were overridden by a human._ |
| Is Non Human | True when it is not the case that the agent kind is “Human”. | _TRUE when this agent is an AI agent or an automated pipeline._ |
| Boundary Violation Count | The number of agent decision records related to the agent. | _Number of decisions by this agent that violated an authority boundary._ |
| Is Operating Outside Boundary | True when the boundary violation count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when this agent has made at least one decision an authority boundary forbids._ |
| Draft Decision Count | The number of agent decision records related to the agent. | _Number of drafting decisions this agent has made._ |
| Overridden Draft Count | The number of agent decision records related to the agent. | _Number of this agent's drafting decisions a human corrected or reversed._ |
| Draft Rewrite Rate Percent | Determined by priority: 0 if the draft decision count is 0; in all other cases, the overridden draft count times 100 divided by the draft decision count. | _Percentage of this agent's drafting output that a human rewrote._ |
| Times Named As Broker | The number of knowledge broker links related to the agent. | _How many active informal-reliance links name this agent as the one actually consulted._ |
| Is Recognized Broker | True when the times named as broker is at least 3. | _TRUE when at least three people actively rely on this agent as an informal knowledge broker._ |
| At Risk Reliance Count | The number of knowledge broker links related to the agent. | _How many active informal-reliance links name this agent while this agent holds no current role._ |
| Has At Risk Knowledge Reliance | True when the at risk reliance count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when people are actively relying on this agent even though they have already left every role._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact semantic type IRI used when projecting the agent._ |
| Represents Organization | A defined attribute. | _For an organization acting as an agent, the organization._ |
| Is Organization Agent | True when the represents organization has a value. | _TRUE for an organization acting as an agent._ |
| Answer Count | The number of assistant answers related to the agent. | _Assistant answers this agent delivered._ |
| Ai Task Completed Count | The number of the agent's assistant answers that have a task outcome of “Completed”. | _Answers whose task completed._ |
| Ai Task Completion Percent | Determined by priority: 0 if the answer count is 0; in all other cases, 100 times the ai task completed count divided by the answer count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). | _Share of the agent's tasks that completed._ |
| Is Below Task Completion Target | True when all of the following hold: the answer count is greater than 0 and the ai task completion percent is less than 80. | _TRUE for an AI agent completing fewer than 80% of its tasks._ |
| Runtime Integration Count | The number of the agent's agent integrations that have a delivery mode of “Runtime”. | _Integrations delivering knowledge to the agent at run time._ |
| Lacks Runtime Knowledge Integration | True when all of the following hold: the agent kind is “AIAgent”; the answer count is greater than 0; and the runtime integration count is 0. | _TRUE for an AI agent that answers people but receives no knowledge at run time._ |
| Search Event Count | The number of knowledge search events related to the agent. | _Searches and retrievals logged for the agent._ |
| Is Untracked Ai Consumer | True when all of the following hold: the agent kind is “AIAgent”; the answer count is greater than 0; and the search event count is 0. | _TRUE for an AI agent that consumes knowledge but whose retrievals are never logged._ |
| Accountability Assertion Count | The number of the agent's snapshot assertions that are not inferred. | _Served, explicitly stated assertions about this agent._ |
| Inferred Category Count | The number of the agent's snapshot assertions that are inferred. | _Served assertions the reasoner inferred about this agent's category._ |
| Category Not Available As Inference | True when all of the following hold: the accountability assertion count is greater than 0 and the inferred category count is 0. | _TRUE for an agent named in accountability assertions whose category the graph never infers._ |
| Is Unclassified Agent | True when all of the following hold: the agent kind is not “Human”; the agent kind is not “AIAgent”; the agent kind is not “AutomatedPipeline”; and the agent kind is not “Organization”. | _TRUE when an agent is not classified as a person, AI agent, automated pipeline or organization._ |
| Is Ai Agent Without Model Version | True when all of the following hold: the agent kind is “AIAgent” and the version or employment key is blank. | _TRUE for an AI agent carrying no model version identifier._ |
| Attributed Artifact Count | The number of execution entities related to the agent. | _Artifacts attributed to the agent._ |
| Has Produced Artifacts | True when the attributed artifact count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when some artifact is attributed to the agent._ |
| Has Artifact Blast Radius | True when the artifact blast radius step count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when moving the agent to another version affects steps downstream of its artifacts._ |
| Registry Version Match Count | The number of ai registry model versions related to the agent. | _Registry records whose Dublin Core identifier and version match this agent individual._ |
| Is Ai Agent Not Filled From Registry | True when all of the following hold: the agent kind is “AIAgent” and the registry version match count is 0. | _TRUE for an AI agent individual that no registry record supplies, or whose version disagrees with the registry._ |
| Current Accountable Human Count | The number of the agent's ai agent accountabilities that are current-human-accountability. | _Human persons currently accountable for the agent._ |
| Is Ai Agent Without Accountable Human | True when all of the following hold: the agent kind is “AIAgent”; the count of current role assignments is greater than 0; and the current accountable human count is 0. | _TRUE for an AI agent currently filling a role with no human person accountable for it._ |
| Service Started At | A defined attribute. | _When the person began practising in the organization._ |
| Departure At | A defined attribute. | _The person's planned or actual departure._ |
| Protected Mentoring Hours Per Week | A defined attribute. | _Weekly hours protected from production work for mentoring._ |
| Community Count | The number of community memberships related to the agent. | _Communities of practice the agent belongs to._ |
| Is Boundary Spanner | True when the community count is at least 2. | _TRUE when the agent belongs to two or more communities of practice._ |
| Sna Identification Count | The number of method applications related to the agent. | _Network analyses that identified the agent as a connector._ |
| Is Unidentified Boundary Spanner | True when all of the following hold: the boundary spanner flag is set and the sna identification count is 0. | _TRUE when a person connecting communities was never found by a network analysis._ |
| Located Know How Count | The number of the agent's knowledge broker links that locate an other holder. | _Know-how held by someone else that the agent, as broker, can point seekers to._ |
| Required Mentoring Hours Per Week | The total expected weekly hours across the agent's mentorships that are active. | _Weekly hours the agent's active mentorships need._ |
| Lacks Time to Mentor | True when all of the following hold: the required mentoring hours per week is greater than 0 and the protected mentoring hours per week is less than the required mentoring hours per week. | _TRUE when a mentor's protected hours fall short of what their active mentorships need._ |
| Transfers Given Count | The number of knowledge transfers related to the agent. | _Times the agent passed know-how on._ |
| Recognition Count | The number of sharing recognitions related to the agent. | _Recognitions the agent received for sharing._ |
| Is Unrewarded Sharer | True when all of the following hold: the transfers given count is at least 2 and the recognition count is 0. | _TRUE when someone who repeatedly passes know-how on has never been recognized for it._ |
| Downstream of Held Steps Count | The total downstream artifact step count across the steps related to the agent. | _Steps reachable along artifact hand-offs from the steps whose role this agent currently holds._ |
| Artifact Blast Radius Step Count | Determined by priority: the downstream of held steps count if the agent kind is “AIAgent”; in all other cases, 0. | _For an AI agent, the steps downstream of the steps it holds, found by traversing the artifact hand-off closure._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Role** | Stable organizational functions separated from the agents that currently fill them. Maps to pro:Role. | — |
| Name | The same as its label. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the Roles row._ |
| Label | A defined attribute. | _Human-readable role label._ |
| Organization | A defined attribute. | _Organization that owns the role._ |
| Current Agent | A defined attribute. | _Current agent filling the role; history is retained in RoleAssignments._ |
| Current Agent Kind | Taken from the linked current agent. | _Agent category of the current role filler._ |
| Responsibility | A defined attribute. | _Accountability and responsibility assigned to the role._ |
| Active Assignment Count | The number of role assignments related to the role. | _Total number of assignment rows ever recorded against this role._ |
| Currently Covered Assignment Count | The number of role assignments related to the role. | _Number of assignment rows for this role that are in force right now._ |
| Has No Current Holder | True when the currently covered assignment count is 0. | _TRUE when no assignment currently covers this role — the role is uncovered._ |
| Count of Awaited Decisions | The number of change requests related to the role. | _How many change requests name this role as the deciding authority._ |
| Current Assignment | A defined attribute. | _The RoleAssignments id of the assignment by which this role is currently held. Deliberately a raw identifier, not a relationship: RoleAssignments already points at Roles, so an FK back would make the two mutually dependent and this rulebook must stay acyclic._ |
| Current Assignment Valid From | Taken from the linked current assignment. | _Start of the currently-in-force assignment for this role._ |
| Is Non Human Held | True when it is not the case that the current agent kind is “Human”. | _TRUE when the role's current agent is an AI agent or automated pipeline._ |
| Is Ungoverned Non Human Role | True when all of the following hold: the non human held flag is set and the no current holder flag is set. | _TRUE when a role is pointed at a non-human agent but has no assignment row granting it._ |
| Departed Assignment Count | The number of role assignments related to the role. | _How many assignments to this role have ended._ |
| Has Lost a Holder | True when the departed assignment count is greater than 0. | _Whether anyone has ever departed this role._ |
| Is Vacated Role | True when all of the following hold: the lost a holder flag is set and the no current holder flag is set. | _A role somebody departed and that nobody currently covers._ |
| Ungrounded Boundary Count | The number of authority boundaries related to the role. | _How many boundaries constrain this role on lapsed authority._ |
| Is Governed by Lapsed Authority | True when the ungrounded boundary count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when at least one constraint on this role rests on knowledge that is no longer valid._ |
| Unescalated Refusal Count | The number of send intents related to the role. | _How many refusals this role should have been told about and was not._ |
| Unauthorized Enforcement Assignment Count | The number of role assignments related to the role. | _How many current assignments of this role are unauthorized enforcement assignments._ |
| Is Ungoverned Enforcement Role | True when the unauthorized enforcement assignment count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a role that enforces controls on others is held with no recorded authorization._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact semantic type IRI for the role._ |
| Specializes Role | A defined attribute. | _Role this one specializes._ |
| Seniority Level | A defined attribute. | _Senior, Deputy, or blank._ |
| Role Family | A defined attribute. | _Family of roles doing the same kind of work._ |
| Specialized Role Family | Taken from the linked specializes role. | _Family of the specialized role._ |
| Specialization Count | The number of roles related to the role. | _Roles that specialize this one._ |
| Has Specializations | True when the specialization count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when another role specializes this one._ |
| Is Senior Variant Not Specialization | True when all of the following hold: the seniority level is “Senior” and at least one of the following holds: the specializes role is blank or the specialized role family is not the role family. | _TRUE when a senior version of a role is not recorded as a specialization of a role in its own family._ |
| Organization Type | Taken from the linked organization. | _Kind of organization the role sits in._ |
| Is Not Housed in Department | True when the organization type is not “Department”. | _TRUE when the role sits directly in a company or division rather than a department._ |
| Capability Tag Count | The number of role capability tags related to the role. | _Capability tags._ |
| Compliance Review Tag Count | The number of the role's role capability tags that have a capability term of “vt-cap-compliance-review”. | _Compliance-review capability tags._ |
| Has Compliance Review Capability | True when the compliance review tag count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the role carries the compliance-review capability._ |
| Role Mention Count | The number of source term mentions related to the role. | _Source mentions judged to mean this role._ |
| Unresolved Role Mention Count | The number of source term mentions related to the role. | _Such mentions whose wording the role vocabulary does not resolve._ |
| Is Missed by Phrase Query | True when the unresolved role mention count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a query for this role through the role vocabulary misses a process that mentions it in other words._ |
| Preferred Knowledge Form | A defined attribute. | _Whether people in the role prefer knowledge as Prose or as a Diagram._ |
| Escalation Backup Role | A defined attribute. | _Role that backs this one up on escalation._ |
| Current Holder Name | The display name of the role's current agent. | _Name of the person or system holding the role._ |
| Backup Role Holder | The current agent of the role's escalation backup role. | _Agent holding the escalation backup role._ |
| Has Escalation Backup | True when the escalation backup role has a value. | _TRUE when the role names an escalation backup role._ |
| Has Unfilled Escalation Backup | True when all of the following hold: the escalation backup role has a value and the backup role holder is blank. | _TRUE when the escalation backup role has nobody in it._ |
| Release Approval Step Count | The number of the role's steps that are release approval gates. | _Production release approval gates assigned to the role._ |
| Is Production Release Approver | True when the release approval step count is greater than 0. | _TRUE for the role that approves production releases._ |
| Approval Step Count | The number of the role's steps that have a control kind of “Approval”. | _Approval steps assigned to the role._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Role Assignment** | Time-bounded records of agents holding roles. Maps to pro:RoleInTime and preserves assignment history instead of overwriting it. | — |
| Name | Computed as the role, followed by “ @ ”, followed by the valid from. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the RoleAssignments row._ |
| Role | A defined attribute. | _Role held during the assignment._ |
| Agent | A defined attribute. | _Agent holding the role._ |
| Valid From | A defined attribute. | _Start of the assignment's valid-time interval._ |
| Valid to | A defined attribute. | _End of the assignment's valid-time interval; null means open-ended._ |
| Reason | A defined attribute. | _Rationale for the assignment or reassignment._ |
| Status | A defined attribute. | _Active, Superseded, Planned, or Revoked._ |
| Evaluation Context | A defined attribute. | _The evaluation context this assignment's currency is judged under._ |
| As of Instant | Taken from the linked evaluation context. | _The evaluation instant this assignment's currency is judged against._ |
| Is Current | True when all of the following hold: the valid from is at most the as of instant and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. | _TRUE when the assignment is valid now._ |
| Current Agent Key | Determined by priority: the agent if the current flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Echoes the Agent id only while this assignment is current; empty otherwise. Lets a parent count CURRENT assignments with a single-criterion COUNTIFS, which is the only shape this transpiler translates correctly._ |
| Is Currently Valid | True when all of the following hold: the status is “Active” and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. | _TRUE when this role assignment is active and has not lapsed._ |
| Agent Role Key | Determined by priority: the agent, followed by “|”, followed by the role if the currently valid flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Composite agent+role key, emitted only for currently-valid assignments._ |
| Has Departed | True when all of the following hold: the valid to has a value and the valid to is at most the as of instant. | _TRUE when this role assignment has ended — the agent no longer holds the role._ |
| Covers Now | True when all of the following hold: the status is “Active”; the valid from is at most the as of instant; and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. | _TRUE when this assignment is both status-Active and inside its valid-time window right now._ |
| Role When Covering | Determined by priority: the role if the covers now flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Echoes the role id when this assignment is currently in force, blank otherwise._ |
| Agent Kind | Taken from the linked agent. | _Whether the agent holding this assignment is Human, AIAgent, or AutomatedPipeline._ |
| Is Non Human Assignment | True when it is not the case that the agent kind is “Human”. | _TRUE when this assignment places a non-human agent into the role._ |
| Supersedes Assignment | A defined attribute. | _The assignment this one replaced, if any._ |
| Predecessor Agent Kind | Taken from the linked supersedes assignment. | _Agent kind of the assignment this one superseded._ |
| Is Human to Non Human Handover | True when all of the following hold: the predecessor agent kind is “Human” and the non human assignment flag is set. | _TRUE when this assignment handed a role from a human to a non-human agent._ |
| Approving Authority Role | A defined attribute. | _Role that approved this assignment._ |
| Authorizing Change Request | A defined attribute. | _Change request under which this assignment was approved._ |
| Is Unauthorized Non Human Assignment | True when all of the following hold: the non human assignment flag is set and the approving authority flag is not set. | _TRUE when a non-human agent holds this role with no approving authority recorded at all. An authority named without a change request is still an authority; the separate WasAuthorizedByChangeRequest column carries that weaker distinction._ |
| Was Authorized by Change Request | True when all of the following hold: the approving authority flag is set and the authorizing change request has a value. | _TRUE when this assignment's authorization is traceable to a change request, not merely to a named role. The stronger form of authorization, kept separate so the weaker one is not silently reported as unauthorized._ |
| Decision Count | The number of agent decision records related to the role assignment. | _Decisions made under this assignment._ |
| Overridden Decision Count | The number of agent decision records related to the role assignment. | _Decisions made under this assignment that a human corrected or reversed._ |
| Override Rate Percent | Determined by priority: 0 if the decision count is 0; in all other cases, the overridden decision count times 100 divided by the decision count. | _Percentage of decisions under this assignment that a human overrode._ |
| Predecessor Override Rate Percent | Taken from the linked supersedes assignment. | _Override rate of the assignment this one superseded._ |
| Quality Regressed Vs Predecessor | True when all of the following hold: the supersedes assignment has a value and the override rate percent is greater than the predecessor override rate percent. | _TRUE when this assignment is overridden by humans more often than the assignment it replaced._ |
| Departed Role Key | Determined by priority: the role if the departed flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Composite-key echo: the role this assignment covered when the assignment has ended, blank otherwise._ |
| Minimum Decisions for Comparison | A defined attribute. | _The number of decisions below which an override-rate comparison is not considered evidentially meaningful for this role._ |
| Predecessor Decision Count | Taken from the linked supersedes assignment. | _How many decisions the superseded assignment produced._ |
| Has Sufficient Sample | True when the decision count is at least the minimum decisions for comparison. | _TRUE when this assignment has produced enough decisions for its override rate to mean anything._ |
| Predecessor Has Sufficient Sample | True when the predecessor decision count is at least the minimum decisions for comparison. | _TRUE when the predecessor assignment produced enough decisions to compare against._ |
| Comparison is Evidentially Sound | True when all of the following hold: the sufficient sample flag is set and the predecessor has sufficient sample flag is set. | _TRUE when both sides of the override-rate comparison rest on adequate samples._ |
| Single Override Swing Percent | Determined by priority: 100 divided by the decision count if the decision count is greater than 0; in all other cases, 0. | _How many percentage points one additional override would move this assignment's rate. The fragility of the number._ |
| Quality Verdict is Unsupported | True when all of the following hold: the comparison is evidentially sound flag is not set and the quality regressed vs predecessor flag is not set. | _TRUE when a quality verdict is being reported for this assignment on a sample too small to support it._ |
| Is Unmeasured Automation Handover | True when all of the following hold: the human to non human handover flag is set and the comparison is evidentially sound flag is not set. | _TRUE when a human-to-machine handover is operating without a statistically meaningful quality comparison behind it._ |
| Error Correction Count | The number of agent decision records related to the role assignment. | _How many of this assignment's decisions were overridden because they were wrong._ |
| Error Rate Percent | Determined by priority: the error correction count times 100 divided by the decision count if the decision count is greater than 0; in all other cases, 0. | _Percentage of this assignment's decisions overridden as errors -- the override rate with reserved-judgment overrides removed._ |
| Authorization Decided At | A defined attribute. | _When the approving authority actually granted this assignment. Empty when no authorization was ever recorded._ |
| Authorization Reviewed At | A defined attribute. | _When the authorization for this assignment was last re-examined._ |
| Authorization Review Cadence Days | A defined attribute. | _How often this assignment's authorization is promised to be re-examined._ |
| Has Dated Authorization | True when all of the following hold: the approving authority role has a value and the authorization decided at has a value. | _TRUE when this assignment carries both a named approving authority and the date they granted it._ |
| Days Since Authorization Review | Determined by priority: the number of days from the authorization reviewed at to the as of instant if the authorization reviewed at has a value; in all other cases, the number of days from the valid from to the as of instant. | _How long since this assignment's authorization was last re-examined._ |
| Authorization is Overdue for Review | True when all of the following hold: the authorization review cadence days is greater than 0 and the days since authorization review is greater than the authorization review cadence days. | _TRUE when the promised re-examination interval has elapsed without a review._ |
| Is Standing Unreviewed Automation | True when all of the following hold: the covers now flag is set and all of the following hold: the non human assignment flag is set and the authorization is overdue for review flag is set. | _TRUE when a currently-active non-human assignment has been running past its authorization review date._ |
| Is Unconditioned Automation Handover | True when all of the following hold: the human to non human handover flag is set and the authorization review cadence days is 0. | _TRUE when a human-to-machine handover was authorized with no promised review cadence at all -- granted once, permanently._ |
| Max Tolerable Error Rate Percent | A defined attribute. | _The error rate at or above which this assignment must stop making decisions unaided._ |
| Exceeds Tolerable Error Rate | True when all of the following hold: the max tolerable error rate percent is greater than 0 and the error rate percent is at least the max tolerable error rate percent. | _TRUE when this assignment's error rate has reached the threshold set when it was authorized._ |
| Boundary Violation Count for Assignment | The number of agent decision records related to the role assignment. | _How many decisions under this assignment violated an authority boundary._ |
| Has Any Boundary Violation | True when the boundary violation count for assignment is greater than 0. | _TRUE when any decision under this assignment crossed a boundary it was forbidden to cross._ |
| Has Ungrounded Governing Boundary | True when the role assignment's role is a governed by lapsed authority. | _TRUE when at least one boundary constraining this assignment's role rests on lapsed knowledge._ |
| Suspension Condition Met | True when at least one of the following holds: the exceeds tolerable error rate flag is set or at least one of the following holds: the any boundary violation flag is set or the ungrounded governing boundary flag is set. | _TRUE when any pre-declared condition requiring this assignment to stop deciding unaided has been met._ |
| Is Operating Under Met Suspension Condition | True when all of the following hold: the suspension condition met flag is set and all of the following hold: the covers now flag is set and the non human assignment flag is set. | _TRUE when a suspension condition has been met and the assignment is nonetheless still active and still deciding._ |
| Has Declared Suspension Condition | True when the max tolerable error rate percent is greater than 0. | _TRUE when this assignment has any pre-declared condition under which it must stop at all._ |
| Has Approving Authority | True when the approving authority role has a value. | _TRUE when a role is recorded as having approved this assignment._ |
| Has Authorizing Change Request | True when the authorizing change request has a value. | _TRUE when a change request is recorded as the governance vehicle for this assignment._ |
| Is Enforcement Role | True when an empty string. | _Whether this role's function is to enforce controls on other agents' actions._ |
| Is Unauthorized Enforcement Agent | True when all of the following hold: the enforcement role flag is set and the unauthorized non human assignment flag is set. | _TRUE when a non-human agent enforces controls on others while holding no recorded authorization of its own._ |
| Governance Evidence Count | Computed as the count of the following that hold: the approving authority flag is set and the authorizing change request flag is set. | _How many independent governance artifacts back this assignment: an approving role, an authorizing change request._ |
| Unauthorized Enforcement Role Key | Determined by priority: the role if the unauthorized non human assignment flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Echoes the role only for non-human assignments nobody authorized; empty otherwise._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact class IRI for the assignment event._ |
| For Procedure Version | A defined attribute. | _Procedure version the role is held for (pro:relatesTo)._ |
| Scoped Version Status | Taken from the linked for procedure version. | _Status of that version._ |
| Is Scoped to Retired Version | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the scoped version status is “Deprecated” or the scoped version status is “Archived”. | _TRUE when a current assignment is held for a version that is deprecated or archived._ |
| Predecessor Valid to | Taken from the linked supersedes assignment. | _When the superseded assignment ended._ |
| Predecessor Lacks Validity End | True when all of the following hold: the supersedes assignment has a value and the predecessor valid to is blank. | _TRUE when an assignment supersedes one whose validity period was never closed._ |
| Agent Version Key | The version or employment key of the role assignment's agent. | _Model version or employment key of the assigned agent._ |
| Agent Role Pair Key | Computed as the agent, followed by “|”, followed by the role. | _Agent and role, as one key, regardless of validity._ |
| Is Open Ended | True when the valid to is blank. | _TRUE when the assignment has no end._ |
| Role Approval Step Count | Taken from the linked role. | _Approval steps assigned to the role._ |
| Receives Approval Notices Now | True when all of the following hold: the covers now flag is set and the role approval step count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the assignment currently covers a role that approval steps are assigned to, so its agent is who approval notices go to._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Community of Practice** | Socio-technical communities that transmit and maintain procedural knowledge. Explicit ERB-PKO extension. | — |
| Name | The same as its label. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the CommunitiesOfPractice row._ |
| Label | A defined attribute. | _Community's human-readable name._ |
| Organization | A defined attribute. | _Organization hosting the community._ |
| Steward Role | A defined attribute. | _Role accountable for convening and maintaining the community._ |
| Purpose | A defined attribute. | _Shared practice and knowledge-transfer purpose._ |
| Cadence | A defined attribute. | _Meeting or practice cadence._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Extension class IRI._ |
| Own Vocabulary | A defined attribute. | _The vocabulary the community speaks._ |
| Norms | A defined attribute. | _The community's working norms._ |
| Origin | A defined attribute. | _Grassroots, Mandated or PurchasedPlatform._ |
| Open Apprenticeship Places | A defined attribute. | _Apprenticeship places on offer._ |
| Is Colocated Trade | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when the trade is concentrated in one place._ |
| Has Own Vocabulary and Norms | True when all of the following hold: the own vocabulary has a value and the norms has a value. | _TRUE when the community has its own vocabulary and stated norms._ |
| Sharing Event Count | The number of knowledge transfers related to the community of practice. | _Know-how transfers inside the community._ |
| Is Mandated Without Sharing Norm | True when all of the following hold: the origin has a value; the origin is not “Grassroots”; and the sharing event count is 0. | _TRUE when a community was mandated or bought and no sharing happens in it._ |
| Interconnected Know How Count | The number of the community of practice's know how carriers that build on same community know how. | _Know-how in the community that builds on related know-how in the same community._ |
| Physical Know How Count | The number of the community of practice's know how carriers that have a work medium of “Physical”. | _Know-how about physical work._ |
| Digital Know How Count | The number of the community of practice's know how carriers that have a work medium of “Digital”. | _Know-how about digital work._ |
| Person Carried Know How Count | The number of the community of practice's know how carriers that have a carrier kind of “Person”. | _Know-how carried by people._ |
| Spans Physical and Digital With Humans | True when all of the following hold: the physical know how count is greater than 0; the digital know how count is greater than 0; and the person carried know how count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the community's know-how spans physical and digital work and people still carry it._ |
| External Member Count | The number of the community of practice's community memberships that are external members. | _Members from other organizations._ |
| Specialist Member Count | The number of the community of practice's community memberships that are specialists. | _Specialists among the members._ |
| Employer Move Count | The number of the community of practice's knowledge transfers that have a channel of “EmployerChange”. | _Know-how carried by people changing employers inside the community._ |
| Is Cross Firm Practice Cluster | True when all of the following hold: the external member count is at least 2; the employer move count is at least 1; and the specialist member count is at least 1. | _TRUE when members from several firms share practice, people move between firms, and specialists are at hand._ |
| Recent Apprenticeship Count | The number of the community of practice's mentorships that are recent apprenticeships. | _Apprenticeships started in the community within three years._ |
| Is Circulation Ending for Lack of Apprentices | True when all of the following hold: the employer move count is at least 1; the open apprenticeship places is greater than 0; and the recent apprenticeship count is 0. | _TRUE when know-how circulates by people moving between firms but offered apprenticeships go unfilled._ |
| Ambient Absorption Count | The number of the community of practice's knowledge transfers that are ambient absorption by non practitioners. | _Know-how absorbed by non-practitioners living among the trade._ |
| Has Ambient Trade Know How | True when all of the following hold: the colocated trade flag is set and the ambient absorption count is at least 1. | _TRUE when a trade concentrated in one place passes know-how even to people who do not practise it._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Mentorship** | Time-bounded apprenticeship relationships that intentionally transfer situated procedural knowledge. Explicit ERB-PKO extension. | — |
| Name | Computed as the mentor agent, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the learner agent. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the Mentorships row._ |
| Community of Practice | A defined attribute. | _Community in which the mentorship operates._ |
| Mentor Agent | A defined attribute. | _Experienced practitioner serving as mentor._ |
| Learner Agent | A defined attribute. | _Practitioner learning the procedure._ |
| Valid From | A defined attribute. | _Mentorship start._ |
| Valid to | A defined attribute. | _Mentorship end._ |
| Learning Objective | A defined attribute. | _Procedural capability to be transferred._ |
| Evidence of Completion | A defined attribute. | _Evidence showing completion or competence._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Extension class IRI._ |
| Evaluation Context | A defined attribute. | _The instant the row is judged against._ |
| As of Instant | Taken from the linked evaluation context. | _The modeled evaluation instant._ |
| Mentorship Form | A defined attribute. | _Mentoring or Apprenticeship._ |
| Employer Worker Obligation | A defined attribute. | _The obligations between employer and worker that make the training worth investing in._ |
| Expected Weekly Hours | A defined attribute. | _Weekly mentor hours the mentorship needs._ |
| Is Active | True when all of the following hold: the valid from has a value; the valid from is at most the as of instant; and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is at least the as of instant. | _TRUE when the mentorship runs at the evaluation instant._ |
| Days Since Started | Determined by priority: 99999 if the valid from is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the valid from to the as of instant. | _Days since the mentorship began._ |
| Is Recent Apprenticeship | True when all of the following hold: the mentorship form is “Apprenticeship”; the days since started is at least 0; and the days since started is at most 1095. | _TRUE for an apprenticeship started within three years._ |
| Community Label | Taken from the linked community of practice. | _The name of the community of practice this mentorship belongs to._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Procedure Type** | Controlled values used by pko:hasProcedureType. | — |
| Name | The same as its label. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the ProcedureTypes row._ |
| Label | A defined attribute. | _Procedure type label._ |
| Definition | A defined attribute. | _Definition and scope of the procedure type._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact class IRI for procedure types._ |
| Broader Procedure Type | A defined attribute. | _Broader node of the process taxonomy._ |
| Taxonomy Rank | A defined attribute. | _FunctionalDomain, ProcessGroup or ProcessType._ |
| Distinguishing Facet | A defined attribute. | _Facet whose value distinguishes members of this grouping._ |
| Distinguishing Value | A defined attribute. | _The value members share._ |
| Narrower Type Count | The number of procedure types related to the procedure type. | _Narrower taxonomy nodes._ |
| Has Narrower Types | True when the narrower type count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when narrower process types fall under the node._ |
| Is Detached From Taxonomy | True when all of the following hold: the taxonomy rank is not “FunctionalDomain” and the broader procedure type is blank. | _TRUE when a node below domain rank has no broader node._ |
| Broader is Detached | True when the procedure type's broader procedure type is detached from taxonomy. | _Whether the broader node is detached._ |
| Is Unreachable by Navigation | True when at least one of the following holds: the detached from taxonomy flag is set or all of the following hold: the broader procedure type has a value and the broader is detached is true. | _TRUE when navigating down from the functional domains never reaches this node._ |
| Member Count | The number of procedures related to the procedure type. | _Procedures classified here._ |
| Members Lacking Distinction Count | The number of procedures related to the procedure type. | _Members that do not have the distinguishing value._ |
| Is Arbitrary Grouping | True when all of the following hold: the member count is greater than 0 and at least one of the following holds: the distinguishing facet is blank or the members lacking distinction count is the member count. | _TRUE when a grouping has members but names no distinction, or none of its members has the distinction it names._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Procedure** | Abstract, discoverable procedures. Each version is represented separately in ProcedureVersions. Maps to pko:Procedure and dcat:Resource. | — |
| Name | The same as its title. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the Procedures row._ |
| Title | A defined attribute. | _Human-readable title; maps to dcterms:title._ |
| Procedure Type | A defined attribute. | _Procedure type; maps to pko:hasProcedureType._ |
| Owner Organization | A defined attribute. | _Organization that owns the procedure._ |
| Adopted by Organization | A defined attribute. | _Organization that adopts the procedure; maps to pko:isAdoptedBy._ |
| Purpose | A defined attribute. | _Desired outcome and scope of the procedure._ |
| Target | A defined attribute. | _Thing or population on which the procedure acts; maps to pko:hasProcedureTarget._ |
| Is Template | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when the procedure is a reusable template; maps to pko:isTemplate._ |
| Current Version Key | A defined attribute. | _Current version identifier, mirrored structurally by ProcedureVersions.IsCurrent._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact PKO class IRI._ |
| Execution Count | The total execution count across the procedure versions related to the procedure. | _Recorded executions across every version of this procedure._ |
| Template Procedure | A defined attribute. | _Template this procedure instantiates (pko:hasTemplate)._ |
| Required by Regulation | A defined attribute. | _Regulation that makes this procedure mandatory._ |
| Is Template Instance | True when the template procedure has a value. | _TRUE when the procedure instantiates a template._ |
| Target Count | The number of procedure targets related to the procedure. | _Targets the procedure is about._ |
| Adoption Count | The number of procedure adoptions related to the procedure. | _Organizations that adopted the procedure._ |
| Specified Step Total | The total count of steps across the procedure versions related to the procedure. | _Steps specified across every version of the procedure._ |
| Has No Explicit Steps | True when the specified step total is 0. | _TRUE for a procedure that exists only as a title and documents: no version specifies a single step._ |
| Called by Step Count | The number of steps related to the procedure. | _Steps of other procedures that invoke this one as a sub-procedure._ |
| Is Nested Procedure | True when the called by step count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the procedure runs inside a larger procedure._ |
| Failure Criterion Count | The number of procedure outcome criteria related to the procedure. | _Failure criteria._ |
| Has No Failure Criterion | True when the failure criterion count is 0. | _TRUE when nothing says what outcome counts as failure._ |
| Lens View Count | The number of procedure lens views related to the procedure. | _Stakeholder views of the procedure._ |
| Privileges Single Stakeholder View | True when the lens view count is 1. | _TRUE when the procedure is organized for exactly one stakeholder lens._ |
| Step Level View Count | The number of procedure lens views related to the procedure. | _Views whose lens needs step-level detail._ |
| Category Level View Count | The number of procedure lens views related to the procedure. | _Views whose lens needs only the category._ |
| Procedure Type Rank | The taxonomy rank of the procedure's procedure type. | _Taxonomy rank of the procedure's type._ |
| Procedure Type Definition | Taken from the linked procedure type. | _Definition of the procedure's type._ |
| Has Step and Category Resolutions | True when all of the following hold: the specified step total is greater than 0 and the procedure type rank is “ProcessType”. | _TRUE when the procedure can be shown both at step level and at its process-type category._ |
| Is Missing Demanded Resolution | True when at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the step level view count is greater than 0 and the no explicit steps flag is set or all of the following hold: the category level view count is greater than 0 and at least one of the following holds: the procedure type is blank or the procedure type rank is not “ProcessType”. | _TRUE when a lens needs step-level detail the procedure does not have, or a category the procedure is not classified into._ |
| Is Inconsistently Categorized | True when at least one of the following holds: the procedure type is blank; the procedure type rank is not “ProcessType”; or the procedure type definition is blank. | _TRUE when a procedure has no type, is filed at a domain or group rank instead of a process type, or its type has no definition._ |
| Strategic Alignment Count | The number of process strategic alignments related to the procedure. | _Strategic alignments stated for the procedure._ |
| Has No Stated Reason for Existing | True when the strategic alignment count is 0. | _TRUE when nothing ties the procedure to a mission, rationale or value._ |
| Outcome Measure Count | The number of process outcome measures related to the procedure. | _Outcome measures._ |
| Unlinked Measure Count | The number of the procedure's process outcome measures that are unlinked to business outcomes. | _Outcome measures tied to no business outcome._ |
| Measures Performance Without Business Link | True when all of the following hold: the outcome measure count is greater than 0 and the unlinked measure count is the outcome measure count. | _TRUE when the procedure is measured but no measure connects to a business outcome._ |
| Hindered by Count | The number of process interdependencies related to the procedure. | _Operations that work against this one._ |
| Is Hindered by Another Operation | True when the hindered by count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when another operation works against this one._ |
| Type Distinguishing Facet | Taken from the linked procedure type. | _Facet the procedure's type claims to distinguish by._ |
| Type Distinguishing Value | Taken from the linked procedure type. | _Value the procedure's type claims its members share._ |
| Matching Distinction Count | The number of procedure facet assignments related to the procedure. | _Facet assignments giving the procedure the value its type claims._ |
| Lacks Type Distinction | True when all of the following hold: the procedure type has a value and the matching distinction count is 0. | _TRUE when the procedure does not have the distinguishing value its grouping claims._ |
| Lacks Distinction Type Key | Determined by priority: the procedure type if the lacks type distinction flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Type key when the procedure lacks its type's distinction._ |
