| Managed Vocabulary Count | The number of vocabularies related to the procedure. | _Controlled vocabularies governing the procedure that have a governing role and an establishment date._ |
| Lacks Managed Controlled Vocabulary | True when all of the following hold: the specified step total is greater than 0 and the managed vocabulary count is 0. | _TRUE when a procedure with steps has no controlled vocabulary whose metadata is managed._ |
| Compliance Review Step Count | The number of steps related to the procedure. | _Steps performed by a role carrying the compliance-review capability._ |
| Involves Compliance Review Role | True when the compliance review step count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a compliance-review role takes part in the procedure._ |
| Is Regulated But Unformalized | True when all of the following hold: the required by regulation has a value and the no explicit steps flag is set. | _TRUE for a procedure a regulation requires that exists only as a title and documents._ |
| Agent Intended Count | The number of the procedure's ai adoption initiatives that are agentic. | _Agentic AI initiatives aimed at the procedure._ |
| Is Tacit Only Agent Target | True when all of the following hold: the agent intended count is greater than 0 and the no explicit steps flag is set. | _TRUE for a procedure intended for agent execution that exists only as tacit knowledge._ |
| Repository Entry Count | The number of knowledge repository entries related to the procedure. | _Repository entries documenting the procedure._ |
| Stale Entry Count | The number of the procedure's knowledge repository entries that are stales. | _Repository entries past their review interval._ |
| Departed Only Know How Count | The number of the procedure's know how carriers that are held-only-by-departed. | _Know-how of the procedure held only by people who left._ |
| Has Decayed Transfer Channel | True when at least one of the following holds: the stale entry count is greater than 0 or the departed only know how count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the procedure's documentation has gone stale or some of its know-how is held only by people who left._ |
| Execution Feedback Entry Count | The number of the procedure's knowledge repository entries that are execution feedbacks. | _Repository entries that wrote back what an execution taught._ |
| Is Executed Without Feedback Loop | True when all of the following hold: the execution count is greater than 0 and the execution feedback entry count is 0. | _TRUE when the procedure is executed and nothing from execution was written back into its documentation._ |
| Machine Authored Entry Count | The number of the procedure's knowledge repository entries that are machine-authored. | _Repository entries written by AI agents or pipelines._ |
| Practitioner Relationship Count | The number of source relationships related to the procedure. | _Collection relationships with practitioners on the procedure._ |
| Is Captured by Automation Alone | True when all of the following hold: the machine authored entry count is greater than 0 and the practitioner relationship count is 0. | _TRUE when the procedure's knowledge was captured by machines and no practitioner was engaged._ |
| Unengaged Stakeholder Count | The number of the procedure's department process accounts that are awaiting-engagement. | _Stakeholder departments never engaged in shaping the procedure's knowledge._ |
| Has Unengaged Stakeholder | True when the unengaged stakeholder count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a stakeholder department of the procedure has not been engaged._ |
| Recent Starter Count | The number of the procedure's onboarding records that are recent starts. | _New starters on the procedure within 180 days._ |
| Untransferred Veteran Know How Count | The number of the procedure's know how carriers that are untransferred veteran know hows. | _Veteran know-how never transferred or captured._ |
| Departing Veteran Know How Count | The number of the procedure's know how carriers that are at-risk-of-imminent-loss. | _Untransferred veteran know-how whose holder leaves soon._ |
| Has Transfer Shortfall Exposure | True when at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the recent starter count is at least 3 and the untransferred veteran know how count is greater than 0 or the departing veteran know how count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a wave of three or more new starters meets untransferred veteran know-how, or a departing veteran leaves know-how untransferred._ |
| Proficient With Capture Count | The number of the procedure's onboarding records that are proficient and are used captured knowledge. | _Proficient starters who learned from captured knowledge._ |
| Proficient Without Capture Count | The number of the procedure's onboarding records that are proficient and are not used captured knowledge. | _Proficient starters who learned without captured knowledge._ |
| Days With Capture Total | The total days to proficiency across the procedure's onboarding records that are proficient and are used captured knowledge. | _Total days to proficiency with captured knowledge._ |
| Days Without Capture Total | The total days to proficiency across the procedure's onboarding records that are proficient and are not used captured knowledge. | _Total days to proficiency without captured knowledge._ |
| Avg Days to Proficiency With Capture | Determined by priority: 0 if the proficient with capture count is 0; in all other cases, the days with capture total divided by the proficient with capture count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). | _Average days to proficiency with captured knowledge._ |
| Avg Days to Proficiency Without Capture | Determined by priority: 0 if the proficient without capture count is 0; in all other cases, the days without capture total divided by the proficient without capture count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). | _Average days to proficiency without captured knowledge._ |
| Formalization Does Not Ease Onboarding | True when all of the following hold: the proficient with capture count is greater than 0; the proficient without capture count is greater than 0; and the avg days to proficiency with capture is at least the avg days to proficiency without capture. | _TRUE when starters who learned from captured knowledge took at least as long as those who did not._ |
| Collected Material Count | The number of collected source materials related to the procedure. | _Materials collected about the procedure._ |
| In Work Capture Count | The number of the procedure's collected source materials that are captured in flow of works. | _Of those, materials captured in the course of executing the work._ |
| Is Capture Separate From Work | True when all of the following hold: the collected material count is greater than 0 and the in work capture count is 0. | _TRUE when knowledge about the procedure is collected, but never in the course of the work._ |
| Expert Acquisition Hours | The total expert effort hours across the collected source materials related to the procedure. | _Expert hours spent capturing knowledge about the procedure._ |
| Compliance Document Count | The number of resources related to the procedure. | _Documents kept for compliance with this procedure, separate from how the work is done._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Procedure Version** | Versioned procedure specifications. Maps to pko:Procedure plus DCAT version relations and PKO versionNumber/newVersionMotivation/changelogDescription. | — |
| Name | The same as its title. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the ProcedureVersions row._ |
| Procedure | A defined attribute. | _Abstract procedure of which this is a version._ |
| Version Number | A defined attribute. | _Version number; maps to pko:versionNumber._ |
| Title | A defined attribute. | _Version-specific title._ |
| Status | A defined attribute. | _PKO procedure status individual: Draft, Validation, Approval, Approved, Deprecated, or Archived._ |
| Issued At | A defined attribute. | _Issue timestamp; maps to dcterms:issued._ |
| Modified At | A defined attribute. | _Last semantic modification; maps to dcterms:modified._ |
| Created by Agent | A defined attribute. | _Agent that created the version; maps to dcterms:creator._ |
| Modified by Agent | A defined attribute. | _Agent that last modified the version; maps to pko:wasModifiedBy._ |
| New Version Motivation | A defined attribute. | _Reason for the new version; maps to pko:newVersionMotivation._ |
| Changelog Description | A defined attribute. | _Semantic change description; maps to pko:changelogDescription._ |
| Is Current | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when this is the current version._ |
| Count of Steps | The number of steps related to the procedure version. | _Number of steps in this version._ |
| Count of Open Knowledge Gaps | The number of the procedure version's knowledge gaps that have a status of “Open”. | _Open knowledge gaps for this version._ |
| Is Ready for Execution | True when all of the following hold: the status is “Approved”; the count of steps is greater than 0; and the count of open knowledge gaps is 0. | _TRUE when approved, populated, and free of blocking knowledge gaps._ |
| Specified Step Count | The number of steps related to the procedure version. | _How many steps the specification defines for this version._ |
| Overdue Review Count | The number of review events related to the procedure version. | _How many reviews of this procedure version are past due._ |
| Open Change Request Count | The number of change requests related to the procedure version. | _How many change requests are open against this version._ |
| Open High Severity Gap Count | The number of knowledge gaps related to the procedure version. | _How many high-severity knowledge gaps are open against this version._ |
| Is Fit to Execute | True when all of the following hold: the status is “Approved”; the overdue review count is 0; the open change request count is 0; and the open high severity gap count is 0. | _TRUE when this version is approved, current on review, and carries no open change request or high-severity gap._ |
| Steward Review Cadence Days | The total review cadence days across the stewardship assignments related to the procedure version. | _The review cadence promised by this version's stewardship assignment, in days. Summed because a version has at most one active steward; this is the hop that lets ReviewEvents resolve the promise via a primary-key match._ |
| Count of Stewardship Assignments | The number of stewardship assignments related to the procedure version. | _How many stewardship assignments of any vintage point at this version._ |
| Has Any Steward | True when the count of stewardship assignments is greater than 0. | _TRUE if any stewardship assignment has ever named this version._ |
| Is Live | True when at least one of the following holds: the status is “Approved” or the status is “Published”. | _TRUE when this version is in a state where somebody could execute it._ |
| Is Unstewarded | True when the any steward flag is not set. | _TRUE when no stewardship assignment names this version._ |
| Is Live and Unstewarded | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the unstewarded flag is set. | _TRUE when an executable version has nobody accountable for keeping it healthy._ |
| Count of Open Blocking Gaps | The number of knowledge gaps related to the procedure version. | _How many open blocking gaps stand against this version._ |
| Has Open Blocking Gap | True when the count of open blocking gaps is greater than 0. | _TRUE when at least one open blocking gap stands against this version._ |
| Is Live With Blocking Gap | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the open blocking gap flag is set. | _TRUE when an executable version carries an unresolved blocking knowledge gap._ |
| Should Not Be Executable | True when all of the following hold: the ready for execution flag is set and the open blocking gap flag is set. | _TRUE when the model says this version is ready to execute while a blocking gap is open against it._ |
| Count of Unapproved Reliance Fragments | The number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. | _How many unapproved claims this version is relying on._ |
| Runs on Unapproved Knowledge | True when the count of unapproved reliance fragments is greater than 0. | _TRUE when this version depends on at least one claim the knowledge authority has not approved._ |
| Count of Overdue Gaps | The number of knowledge gaps related to the procedure version. | _How many acknowledged unknowns against this version have outlived their tolerance._ |
| Count of Change Requests | The number of change requests related to the procedure version. | _How many change requests have ever been raised against this version._ |
| Count of Review Events | The number of review events related to the procedure version. | _How many review events have ever been recorded against this version._ |
| Has Governance Record | True when at least one of the following holds: the count of change requests is greater than 0 or the count of review events is greater than 0. | _TRUE when at least one change request or review event exists for this version._ |
| Evaluation Context | A defined attribute. | _The evaluation context this row's time-dependent witnesses are judged under._ |
| As of Instant | Taken from the linked evaluation context. | _The evaluation instant this row's time-dependent witnesses are judged against._ |
| Days Since Modified | Computed as the number of days from the modified at to the as of instant. | _Days since this version's content was last changed._ |
| Days Since Last Review | An aggregated value computed across the procedure version's related records. | _Days since the most recent review of this version._ |
| Was Modified Since Last Review | True when the days since modified is less than the days since last review. | _TRUE when the version was edited more recently than it was reviewed._ |
| Modifier is Authority | The agent kind of the procedure version's modified by agent. | _The kind of agent that last modified this version._ |
| Has Unwitnessed Change | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the was modified since last review flag is set. | _TRUE when a live version's current content postdates every review it has had._ |
| Count of Stale Fragments | The number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. | _How many supporting claims have outlived this version's review cadence._ |
| Knowledge is Staler Than Cadence | True when the count of stale fragments is greater than 0. | _TRUE when this version rests on at least one claim older than its own review cadence._ |
| Compound Fragile Fragment Count | The number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. | _How many compound-fragile knowledge fragments this version rests on._ |
| Rests on Compound Fragile Knowledge | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the compound fragile fragment count is greater than 0. | _A live procedure version resting on at least one knowledge fragment that carries three or more decay signals._ |
| Concentrated Witness Session Count | The number of elicitation sessions related to the procedure version. | _How many concentrated single-witness sessions underwrite this version's knowledge base._ |
| Knowledge Base is Concentrated | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the concentrated witness session count is greater than 0. | _A live version where at least one single-witness session alone underwrites three or more of its live claims._ |
| Machine Consumed Unapproved Count | The number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. | _How many unapproved claims this version feeds directly to software-assigned steps._ |
| Feeds Unapproved Knowledge to Machines | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the machine consumed unapproved count is greater than 0. | _A live version that hands unapproved knowledge to a step no human is positioned to review._ |
| Genuinely Overdue Fragment Count | The number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. | _How many of this version's claims are overdue by actual review record rather than by inference._ |
| Awaited Decision Count | The number of change requests related to the procedure version. | _How many decisions are pending against this live version._ |
| Scoped Open Blocking Gap Count | The number of knowledge gaps related to the procedure version. | _How many open blocking gaps belong to THIS version, correctly scoped._ |
| Is Blocked on Pending Decision | True when all of the following hold: the awaited decision count is greater than 0 and the scoped open blocking gap count is greater than 0. | _A live version carrying both an undecided change request and an open blocking gap — the gap cannot close until the decision lands._ |
| Unexercised Human Gate Count | The number of steps related to the procedure version. | _How many of this version's human-only gates have never been approached by software._ |
| Ai Boundary is Unevidenced | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the unexercised human gate count is greater than 0. | _A live version whose human-only gates rest on assertion rather than on any observed attempt by software._ |
| Load Bearing Unapproved Count | The number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. | _How many high-blast-radius unapproved claims this version rests on._ |
| Unlanded Decision Count | The number of change requests related to the procedure version. | _How many decided-but-unimplemented change requests hold this version's fitness down._ |
| Unrehearsed Control Entry Count | The number of step transitions related to the procedure version. | _How many unrehearsed control entries exist in this procedure version._ |
| Has Unrehearsed Control Entry | True when the unrehearsed control entry count is greater than 0. | _Whether this live version has at least one blocking control that is only reachable by a path nobody has ever walked._ |
| Is Live With Unrehearsed Control | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the unrehearsed control entry flag is set. | _A version that is live for execution while carrying at least one never-rehearsed blocking control entry._ |
| Cadence Breach Count | The number of review events related to the procedure version. | _How many review events on this version are past their promised cadence._ |
| Is in Cadence Breach | True when the cadence breach count is greater than 0. | _Whether this version currently has at least one review event past the cadence its steward promised._ |
| Has Decision in Flight | True when the open change request count is greater than 0. | _Whether this version has at least one change request that is still open._ |
| Is Unremediated Cadence Breach | True when all of the following hold: the in cadence breach flag is set and the decision in flight flag is not set. | _A cadence breach with no open change request against the version — a broken promise with no response in motion._ |
| Is Managed Cadence Breach | True when all of the following hold: the in cadence breach flag is set and the decision in flight flag is set. | _A cadence breach where a change request is at least open against the version._ |
| Governance is Silent | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the governance record flag is not set. | _A live version with neither a change request nor a review event ever recorded against it._ |
| Valid Fragment Count | The number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. | _How many currently-valid knowledge fragments are attached to this version._ |
| Still Owns Valid Knowledge | True when the valid fragment count is greater than 0. | _Whether this version still holds at least one knowledge fragment that is currently valid._ |
| Incoming Supersession Count | The number of procedure version links related to the procedure version. | _How many other versions declare that they supersede this one._ |
| Is Still Referenced | True when the incoming supersession count is greater than 0. | _Whether any other version points at this one through a supersession link._ |
| Is Load Bearing Orphan | True when all of the following hold: the unstewarded flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the still owns valid knowledge flag is set or the still referenced flag is set. | _An unstewarded version that is still referenced by a supersession link or still owns currently-valid knowledge — nobody is accountable for it and something still depends on it._ |
| Is Cleanly Retired | True when all of the following hold: the unstewarded flag is set; the still owns valid knowledge flag is not set; and the still referenced flag is not set. | _An unstewarded version that nothing depends on — a genuine, safe retirement._ |
| Stalled Implementation Count | The number of change requests related to the procedure version. | _How many approved-but-unimplemented change requests are stalled against this version._ |
| Is Held Unfit by Landed Decisions | True when all of the following hold: the fit to execute flag is not set and the stalled implementation count is greater than 0. | _A version reading unfit to execute specifically because approved changes have not been marked implemented._ |
| Undeclared Control Kind Count | The number of steps related to the procedure version. | _How many steps in this version have not declared a control kind._ |
| Control Taxonomy is Incomplete | True when the undeclared control kind count is greater than 0. | _Whether this version contains any step whose control kind is unstated — meaning role-based and id-based control predicates cannot be trusted to cover it._ |
| Has Approved Change Request | True when the approved change request count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when at least one change request against this version has been approved._ |
| Approved Change Request Count | The number of change requests related to the procedure version. | _How many change requests against this version have been approved._ |
| Unwatched Unowned Control Count | The number of requirements related to the procedure version. | _How many blocking controls in the model are neither computed nor owned._ |
| Mining Run Count | The number of process mining runs related to the procedure version. | _How many process-mining conformance runs exist for this procedure version._ |
| Drifted Mining Run Count | The number of process mining runs related to the procedure version. | _How many mining runs found major, real drift while this version was live._ |
| Has Unresolved Mining Drift | True when the drifted mining run count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when mined operational evidence contradicts this live version's documented path._ |
| Entry Step ID | The largest entry step key across the steps related to the procedure version. | _The step this procedure version starts at: the one step no transition leads into._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact PKO class IRI._ |
| Execution Count | The number of procedure executions related to the procedure version. | _Recorded executions of this procedure version._ |
| Expected Duration Value | A defined attribute. | _Expected duration, numeric part (time:numericDuration)._ |
| Expected Duration Unit | A defined attribute. | _Expected duration unit (time:unitType)._ |
| Status is Pko | True when the linked status is a pko status. | _Whether the version's status is a PKO 2.0.0 procedure status._ |
| Uses Non Pko Status | True when the status is pko is false. | _TRUE when the version holds a status PKO does not define._ |
| Exception Count | The number of exceptions related to the procedure version. | _Documented exceptions._ |
| Fallback Transition Count | The number of the procedure version's step transitions that have a transition kind of “Fallback”. | _Fallback transitions._ |
| Alternative Transition Count | The number of the procedure version's step transitions that have a transition kind of “Alternative”. | _Alternative transitions._ |
| Has No Exception Handling | True when all of the following hold: the count of steps is greater than 0; the exception count is 0; the fallback transition count is 0; and the alternative transition count is 0. | _TRUE when a version with steps captures only the normative path: no exception, fallback or alternative._ |
| Latest Source Document Modified At | The largest resource modified at across the procedure resources related to the procedure version. | _Most recent modification of any document the version references._ |
| Days Document Trails Version | Determined by priority: 0 if the latest source document modified at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the latest source document modified at to the modified at. | _Days by which the referenced documents trail the version's own last change._ |
| Document Lags Practice | True when all of the following hold: the latest source document modified at has a value and the days document trails version is greater than 60. | _TRUE when the documents a version rests on have not changed for more than sixty days of changes to the version itself._ |
| Human Step Count | The number of the procedure version's steps that have a assigned agent kind of “Human”. | _Steps whose role is held by a person._ |
| Non Human Step Count | Computed as the count of steps minus the human step count. | _Steps whose role is held by software or AI._ |
| Mixes Human and Software Steps | True when all of the following hold: the human step count is greater than 0 and the non human step count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when one version mixes human steps with software or AI steps._ |
| Day Run Count | The number of the procedure version's procedure executions that have a shift of “Day”. | _Executions on the day shift._ |
| Night Run Count | The number of the procedure version's procedure executions that have a shift of “Night”. | _Executions on the night shift._ |
| Day Deviating Run Count | The number of procedure executions related to the procedure version. | _Day-shift executions with a step deviation._ |
| Night Deviating Run Count | The number of procedure executions related to the procedure version. | _Night-shift executions with a step deviation._ |
| Is Inconsistent Across Shifts | True when all of the following hold: the day run count is greater than 0; the night run count is greater than 0; and at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the day deviating run count is 0 and the night deviating run count is greater than 0 or all of the following hold: the day deviating run count is greater than 0 and the night deviating run count is 0. | _TRUE when one shift runs the version cleanly and the other deviates._ |
| Overlaps Relation Count | The number of activity relations related to the procedure version. | _Overlaps relations among the version's steps._ |
| Enables Relation Count | The number of activity relations related to the procedure version. | _Enables relations among the version's steps._ |
| Prevents Relation Count | The number of activity relations related to the procedure version. | _Prevents relations among the version's steps._ |
| Steps Without Ontology Type Count | The number of steps related to the procedure version. | _Steps carried over from a notation with no ontology type._ |
| Rests on Notation Only | True when the steps without ontology type count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when some steps of the version carry no ontology type, so they mean nothing outside the diagram they came from._ |
| Is Current Without Motivation | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set and the new version motivation is blank. | _TRUE for a current version that never recorded why it was created._ |
| Conditionless Step Count | The number of steps related to the procedure version. | _Steps with no precondition._ |
| Is Under Specified for Execution | True when at least one of the following holds: the count of steps is 0; the conditionless step count is the count of steps; or the no exception handling flag is set. | _TRUE when a version cannot tell an executor what must hold, or what to do when things go wrong: no steps, no step with a precondition, or no exception handling._ |
| Coarse Top Level Step Count | The number of steps related to the procedure version. | _Top-level steps written at Activity detail._ |
| Fine Top Level Step Count | The number of steps related to the procedure version. | _Top-level steps written at Action detail._ |
| Mixes Granularity At One Level | True when all of the following hold: the coarse top level step count is greater than 0 and the fine top level step count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when one level of a version mixes whole activities with single actions, so detail is weighted unevenly._ |
| Procedure Type of Version | Taken from the linked procedure. | _Procedure type._ |
| Created by Agent Kind | Taken from the linked created by agent. | _Kind of agent that created the version._ |
| Elicitation Session Count | The number of elicitation sessions related to the procedure version. | _Elicitation sessions behind the version._ |
| Expert Capture Count | The number of the procedure version's authoring submissions that have a submitter expertise of “DomainExpert”. | _Capture-form submissions authored by domain experts._ |
| Elicitation Evidence Count | Computed as the elicitation session count plus the expert capture count. | _Sessions plus expert captures: evidence tacit knowledge was elicited._ |
| Indexed Segment Count | The number of the procedure version's retrieval segments that are indexed. | _Retrieval segments served from the version: how rich it is for AI._ |
| Search Count | The number of knowledge search events related to the procedure version. | _Searches made while working with the version._ |
| Successful Search Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge search events that are not found nothing useful. | _Searches that found something useful._ |
| Search Success Percent | Determined by priority: 0 if the search count is 0; in all other cases, 100 times the successful search count divided by the search count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). | _How findable the version is._ |
| Open Question Annotation Count | The number of the procedure version's model annotations that have a annotation kind of “Question” and have a status of “Open”. | _Open clarifying questions practitioners attached: how unclear it is._ |
| Is Inadequate for Use | True when at least one of the following holds: the indexed segment count is 0; all of the following hold: the search count is greater than 0 and the search success percent is less than 50; or the open question annotation count is at least 2. | _TRUE when a version is too thin to guide AI, hard to find, or unclear to collaborators._ |
| Served Assertion Count | The number of snapshot assertions related to the procedure version. | _Graph assertions served from the version._ |
| Lacks Machine Interpretable Encoding | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the indexed segment count is 0 or the served assertion count is 0. | _TRUE for a current version with no retrieval segments for search or no graph assertions for reasoning and AI._ |
| Structured Query Count | The number of knowledge query definitions related to the procedure version. | _Structured queries over the version._ |
| Profile Validated Submission Count | The number of the procedure version's authoring submissions that are profile validation passed. | _Submissions of the version that validated against the PKO profile._ |
| Reasoned Assertion Count | The number of the procedure version's snapshot assertions that are snapshot is reasoned. | _Served assertions of the version in a snapshot a reasoner found consistent._ |
| Is Not Query Validate Reason Ready | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the structured query count is 0; the profile validated submission count is 0; or the reasoned assertion count is 0. | _TRUE for a current version that no structured query reads, no profile validation passed, or no reasoner has checked._ |
| Published Projection Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge projections that are published. | _Published documents and diagrams of the version._ |
| Consumer Sync Count | The number of consumer system syncs related to the procedure version. | _Consuming systems holding the version._ |
| Is Unreachable Knowledge | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set; the published projection count is 0; and the consumer sync count is 0. | _TRUE for a current version nobody can reach: no published projection and no consuming system._ |
| Human Sync Count | The number of the procedure version's consumer system syncs that reache a humans. | _Systems read by people that hold the version._ |
| Machine Sync Count | The number of the procedure version's consumer system syncs that reache a machines. | _Systems read by AI that hold the version._ |
| Human Channel Count | Computed as the published projection count plus the human sync count. | _Ways people receive the version._ |
| Machine Channel Count | Computed as the machine sync count plus the served assertion count. | _Ways machines receive the version._ |
| Serves Only Humans or Only Machines | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set; the human channel count plus the machine channel count is greater than 0; and at least one of the following holds: the human channel count is 0 or the machine channel count is 0. | _TRUE for a current version conveyed to people or to machines, but not both._ |
| Fresh Mining Run Count | The number of the procedure version's process mining runs that are not stale mining evidences. | _Process-mining conformance runs within the freshness window._ |
| Lacks Continuous Drift Detection | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set; the execution count is greater than 0; and the fresh mining run count is 0. | _TRUE for a current, executed version with no recent automated check of enacted against documented process._ |
| Outcome Measurement Count | The number of knowledge outcome measurements related to the procedure version. | _Operational outcome measurements linked to the version._ |
| Is Disconnected From Outcomes | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set; the execution count is greater than 0; and the outcome measurement count is 0. | _TRUE for a current, executed version no operational outcome is linked to._ |
| Ai Contribution Count | The number of ai insight proposals related to the procedure version. | _AI insights proposed about the version._ |
| Ai Consumption Count | Computed as the served assertion count plus the indexed segment count. | _Assertions and segments of the version served to AI._ |
| Uses Ai in One Direction Only | True when at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the ai contribution count is greater than 0 and the ai consumption count is 0 or all of the following hold: the ai contribution count is 0 and the ai consumption count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when AI only consumes the version and never contributes to it, or only contributes and never consumes it._ |
| Is Unmodified for Twelve Months | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set and the days since modified is greater than 365. | _TRUE for a current workflow not modified in more than twelve months._ |
| Design Decision Count | The number of process design decisions related to the procedure version. | _Design decisions recorded with the version._ |
| Is Live Without Recorded Decisions | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the design decision count is 0. | _TRUE for a live version with no design decision recorded alongside it._ |
| Ai Artifact Consuming Input Count | The number of the procedure version's step variables that are input from ai artifacts. | _Inputs of the version's steps fed by an AI agent's artifact._ |
| Contains Steps Affected by Ai Agent Change | True when the ai artifact consuming input count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the workflow contains a step that consumes an AI agent's artifact, so changing that agent affects it._ |
| Interview Session Count | The number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that have a elicitation mode of “Interview”. | _Interview sessions for the version._ |
| Observation Session Count | The number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that have a elicitation mode of “Observation”. | _Observation sessions for the version._ |
| Workshop Session Count | The number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that have a elicitation mode of “Workshop”. | _Workshop sessions for the version._ |
| Protocol Session Count | The number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that have a elicitation mode of “Protocol”. | _Think-aloud, retrospective, laddering and grid sessions for the version._ |
| Incident Session Count | The number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that have a elicitation mode of “Incident”. | _Critical incident sessions for the version._ |
| Reconciled Divergence Count | The number of the procedure version's workflow view divergences that are reconciled. | _Workflow disagreements settled for the version._ |
| Complementary Method Count | Computed as the count of the following that hold: the interview session count is greater than 0; the observation session count is greater than 0; the workshop session count is greater than 0; the protocol session count is greater than 0; and the incident session count is greater than 0. | _Distinct families of elicitation used for the version._ |
| Relies on Single Method | True when the complementary method count is 1. | _TRUE when the version's knowledge was elicited with one family of method only._ |
| Misses a Required Elicitation Mode | True when all of the following hold: the complementary method count is greater than 0 and at least one of the following holds: the workshop session count is 0; the interview session count is 0; the observation session count is 0; or the reconciled divergence count is 0. | _TRUE for an elicited version lacking a workshop, a structured interview, observation, or a session that settled a disagreement._ |
| Critical Incident Count | The number of critical incidents related to the procedure version. | _Critical incidents collected for the version._ |
| Judgment Unprobed by Incidents | True when all of the following hold: the tacit judgment fragment count is greater than 0 and the critical incident count is 0. | _TRUE when a version relies on tacit or situated judgment yet no critical incident was collected to surface it._ |
| Sme Approval Count | The number of the procedure version's representation reviews that are reviewer is affected sme; have a review purpose of “RepresentationApproval”; and have a decision of “Approved”. | _Approvals of the representation by subject matter experts it affects._ |
| Sme Ai Evaluation Count | The number of the procedure version's representation reviews that are reviewer is affected sme and have a review purpose of “AiEvaluation”. | _Evaluations of AI output on this version by affected subject matter experts._ |
| Is Approved Without Sme Signoff | True when all of the following hold: the status is “Approved” and the sme approval count is 0. | _TRUE for an approved version no affected subject matter expert approved the representation of._ |
| Experts Evaluate Ai Not Representation | True when all of the following hold: the sme ai evaluation count is greater than 0 and the sme approval count is 0. | _TRUE when experts were recruited to evaluate AI output on a version but none to approve the representation it rests on._ |
| Ke Session Count | The number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that are facilitator is knowledge engineer. | _Sessions the knowledge engineer ran for the version._ |
| Ke Field Session Count | The number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that are ke field sessions. | _Sessions the knowledge engineer ran where the work is done._ |
| Is Studied Only From the Desk | True when all of the following hold: the ke session count is greater than 0 and the ke field session count is 0. | _TRUE when the knowledge engineer elicited the version but never went where the work happens._ |
| Judgment Held Outside Sop Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge holdings that are judgment outside documents. | _Unformalized knowledge of the version its SOP says nothing about._ |
| Tacit Holding Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge holdings that have a knowledge form of “Tacit”. | _Holdings of the version in tacit form._ |
| Explicit Holding Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge holdings that have a knowledge form of “Explicit”. | _Holdings of the version in explicit form._ |
| Tacit Share Exceeds Explicit | True when the tacit holding count is greater than the explicit holding count. | _TRUE when more of the version's knowledge is held tacitly than in explicit carriers._ |
| Hands Held Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge holdings that are unformalized process knowledges and have a carrier of “OperatorMemory”. | _Unformalized knowledge held only in operators' memory._ |
| Negotiated Practice Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge holdings that are unformalized process knowledges and have a carrier of “UnspokenCrewAgreement”. | _Unformalized knowledge held as unspoken crew agreements._ |
| Lives in Hands Silence and Negotiation | True when all of the following hold: the hands held count is greater than 0; the judgment held outside sop count is greater than 0; and the negotiated practice count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the version's knowledge lives at once in experienced hands, in what its SOP leaves unsaid, and in unspoken crew agreements._ |
| Process Model Trace Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge traces that have a target kind of “ProcessModel” and have a trace role of “Origin”. | _Origin traces of the version as a process model._ |
| Is Live Model Untraced | True when all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the process model trace count is 0. | _TRUE when an executable process model traces to no collection activity._ |
| Trailing Practice Trace Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge traces that are document trailing practices. | _Contradictions showing a document of this version trailing practice._ |
| Is Documented Behind Practice | True when the trailing practice trace count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the version's documentation trails how the work is performed._ |
| Standardization Driver | A defined attribute. | _Why the version was standardized: Compliance or Practice._ |
| Tacit Fragment Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge fragments that have a knowledge form of “Tacit”. | _Tacit knowledge fragments captured for the version._ |
| Is Standardized Without Tacit Capture | True when all of the following hold: the standardization driver is “Compliance” and the tacit fragment count is 0. | _TRUE when a version standardized for compliance has no tacit knowledge captured behind it._ |
| Tacit Form Fragment Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge fragments that have a knowledge form of “Tacit”. | _Tacit fragments attached to the version._ |
| Situated Judgment Fragment Count | The number of the procedure version's knowledge fragments that have a knowledge form of “SituatedJudgment”. | _Situated-judgment fragments attached to the version._ |
| Tacit Judgment Fragment Count | Computed as the tacit form fragment count plus the situated judgment fragment count. | _Tacit or situated-judgment fragments attached to the version._ |
| First Step | The largest declared first step key across the steps related to the procedure version. | _Declared first step (pko:hasFirstStep), read from the step that declares itself first._ |
| Fallback Step | The largest declared fallback step key across the steps related to the procedure version. | _Declared fallback step (pko:hasFallbackStep), read from the step that declares itself the fallback._ |
| First Step Disagrees With Graph | True when all of the following hold: the declared first step count is greater than 0; the graph entry step count is greater than 0; and the first step is not the entry step ID. | _TRUE when the transition graph has an entry step and the declared first step is a different one. A graph whose first step also receives a loop-back has no entry step, and is not a disagreement._ |
| Declared First Step Count | The number of the procedure version's steps that are declared first steps. | _Steps of the version that declare themselves its first step._ |
| Graph Entry Step Count | The number of the procedure version's steps that are entry steps. | _Steps of the version with no incoming transition._ |
| Owner Organization | Taken from the linked procedure. | _The organization that owns the procedure this row belongs to, one hop at a time from Procedures.OwnerOrganization. A row policy compares it to the caller's organization, so a plant sign-in never sees the finance close._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Procedure Version Link** | Directed links between versioned procedures. Maps to dcat:previousVersion/dcat:hasVersion and pko:nextVersion. | — |
| Name | Computed as the previous procedure version, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the next procedure version. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the ProcedureVersionLinks row._ |
| Previous Procedure Version | A defined attribute. | _Earlier version._ |
| Next Procedure Version | A defined attribute. | _Later version._ |
| Relation Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact version relation IRI._ |
| Change Summary | A defined attribute. | _Summary of semantic change across the edge._ |
| Superseded Version Key | Determined by priority: the previous procedure version if the relation iri is “https://w3id.org/pko#nextVersion”; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Echoes the superseded (previous) version id for rows that express a next-version relation. Supersession is carried by RelationIri here, not by a separate link-kind column._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Procedure Status Change** | Lifecycle events that move a procedure version between PKO statuses. Maps to pko:ChangeOfStatus, fromStatus, toStatus, and prov:atTime. | — |
| Name | Computed as the procedure version, followed by “: ”, followed by the from status, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the to status. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the ProcedureStatusChanges row._ |
| Procedure Version | A defined attribute. | _Procedure version whose status changed._ |
| From Status | A defined attribute. | _Previous PKO status._ |
| To Status | A defined attribute. | _New PKO status._ |
| Changed At | A defined attribute. | _Time of change; maps to prov:atTime._ |
| Changed by Agent | A defined attribute. | _Agent responsible for the change._ |
| Motivation | A defined attribute. | _Reason for changing status._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact PKO class IRI._ |
| Change Kind | A defined attribute. | _Create, Modify, Extract, Validate, Approve or Archive._ |
| Procedure Execution | A defined attribute. | _Execution the change applies to, when it is not a version change._ |
| Is Unattributed Change | True when the changed by agent is blank. | _TRUE when nobody is recorded as making the change._ |
| Change Kind Contradicts Target | True when at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the change kind is “Approve” and the to status is not “Approved”; all of the following hold: the change kind is “Validate” and the to status is not “Validation”; or all of the following hold: the change kind is “Archive”; the to status is not “Archived”; and the to status is not “Deprecated”. | _TRUE when the kind of change does not match the status it moved to._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Step** | Version-scoped units of work. Atomic steps map to pplan:Step; composite steps map to pplan:MultiStep. The specification is never conflated with execution. | — |
| Name | Computed as the step number, followed by “. ”, followed by the title. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the Steps row._ |
| Procedure Version | A defined attribute. | _Procedure version containing the step; maps to pko:hasStep/pplan:isStepOfPlan._ |
| Step Number | A defined attribute. | _Stable sequence label; maps to pko:stepNumber._ |
| Title | A defined attribute. | _Human-readable step title._ |
| Step Kind | A defined attribute. | _Atomic or MultiStep._ |
| Assigned Role | A defined attribute. | _Role responsible for the step._ |
| Assigned Role Label | Taken from the linked assigned role. | _Resolved role label._ |
| Assigned Agent Kind | The current agent kind of the step's assigned role. | _Current role-filler category._ |
| Instruction | A defined attribute. | _Normative step instruction._ |
| Expected Duration Minutes | A defined attribute. | _Expected duration represented as an OWL-Time duration in semantic projections._ |
| Expertise Level | A defined attribute. | _PKO expertise level: Junior, Senior, Expert, or Master._ |
| Requires Human Confirmation | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when a human must confirm the step; maps to pko:wasConfirmedBy at execution._ |
| Blocking Requirement Count | The number of step requirements related to the step. | _How many blocking requirements the specification attaches to this step._ |
| Stale Binding Count | The number of operational bindings related to the step. | _How many operational bindings for this step are currently outside their freshness SLA._ |
| Authoritative Stale Count | The number of operational bindings related to the step. | _How many authoritative bindings for this step are currently stale._ |
| Available Exception Count | The number of exceptions related to the step. | _How many active exceptions the specification defines for this step._ |
| Declared Verification Count | The number of step verifications related to the step. | _How many verifications the specification declares for this step._ |
| Is Preparation Step | True when at least one of the following holds: the assigned role is “finance-analyst” or the assigned role is “variance-review-agent”. | _TRUE for steps whose assigned role produces the work product rather than reviewing it._ |
| Is Approval Step | True when at least one of the following holds: the assigned role is “controller” or the assigned role is “cfo”. | _TRUE for steps whose assigned role is an approval authority._ |
| Stale Authoritative Binding Count | The number of operational bindings related to the step. | _Number of authoritative bindings for this step that are past their freshness SLA._ |
| Inputs are Fresh | True when the stale authoritative binding count is 0. | _TRUE when no authoritative binding for this step is stale._ |
| Is Software Assigned | True when at least one of the following holds: the assigned agent kind is “AIAgent” or the assigned agent kind is “AutomatedPipeline”. | _TRUE when this step is specified to be performed by software rather than a person._ |
| Is Human Approval Gate | True when all of the following hold: the software assigned flag is not set and at least one of the following holds: the step ID is “policy-05” or the step ID is “close-06”. | _TRUE for the steps that exist specifically to place a human commitment between drafting and delivery._ |
| Gate Held by Human | True when all of the following hold: the human approval gate flag is set and the assigned agent kind is “Human”. | _TRUE when a designated approval gate is in fact assigned to a human role._ |
| Binding Boundary Count | The number of authority boundaries related to the step. | _Number of authority boundaries currently binding at this step._ |
| Assigned Role is Ungoverned | True when the step's assigned role is an ungoverned non human role. | _Whether this step's assigned role is a non-human role with no governing assignment._ |
| Unusable Binding Count | The number of operational bindings related to the step. | _Number of bindings at this step that are unapproved or stale._ |
| All Sources Usable | True when the unusable binding count is 0. | _TRUE when every binding at this step is an approved, fresh source._ |
| Control Kind | A defined attribute. | _What kind of control this step is: Preparation, Approval, LegalReview, Verification, Extraction, Publication, Retrospective, or None. That policy-04 is a legal review is a property OF policy-04, not of a formula that happens to name it; storing it as data makes downstream predicates portable to procedures that do not exist yet._ |
| Unwarranted Boundary Count | The number of authority boundaries related to the step. | _How many boundaries governing this step are being enforced without a valid ratifying claim._ |
| Is Governed by Unwarranted Boundary | True when the unwarranted boundary count is greater than 0. | _Whether this step's constraints on machine authority rest on a claim that is no longer valid._ |
| Software Execution Count | The number of step executions related to the step. | _How many times a software agent has actually executed this step._ |
| Has Been Approached by Software | True when the software execution count is greater than 0. | _Whether any software agent has ever executed this step._ |
| Is Unexercised Human Gate | True when all of the following hold: the human approval gate flag is set and the been approached by software flag is not set. | _A human-only approval gate that no software agent has ever attempted — the control is asserted, not demonstrated._ |
| Is Demonstrated Human Gate | True when all of the following hold: the human approval gate flag is set; the been approached by software flag is set; and the gate held by human flag is set. | _A human gate that software has actually reached and that a human nevertheless held._ |
| Unexercised Gate Version Key | Determined by priority: the procedure version if the unexercised human gate flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Composite-key echo: this step's procedure version when the step is an unexercised human gate, blank otherwise._ |
| Has Declared Control Kind | True when the control kind has a value. | _Whether this step declares what kind of control it is._ |
| Undeclared Control Version Key | Determined by priority: an empty string if the declared control kind flag is set; in all other cases, the procedure version. | _Composite-key echo: this step's procedure version when the step has no declared control kind, blank otherwise._ |
| Approval Step is Software Assigned | True when all of the following hold: the control kind is “Approval” and the software assigned flag is set. | _An approval-kind step whose assigned role is currently held by an AI agent or automated pipeline._ |
| Unwitnessed Blocking Count | The number of step requirements related to the step. | _How many blocking controls bound to this step have no computed witness._ |
| Reachable Step Count | The number of vw step transitions closure related to the step. | _Number of steps this step can lead to through one or more transitions, including itself when it lies on a rework loop._ |
| Reached From Step Count | The number of vw step transitions closure related to the step. | _Number of steps that can lead to this step through one or more transitions, including itself when it lies on a rework loop._ |
| Self Reach Count | The number of vw step transitions closure related to the step. | _1 when the closure contains the pair (this step, this step), i.e. some path of one or more transitions returns to this step; otherwise 0._ |
| Is on Rework Loop | True when the self reach count is greater than 0. | _The procedure can send work back to this step after it has run: the step lies on a cycle of the step graph._ |
| Is Blocking Control on Rework Loop | True when all of the following hold: the on rework loop flag is set and the blocking requirement count is greater than 0. | _A step carrying at least one blocking requirement can be re-entered, so that control must hold on every pass, not only the first._ |
| Incoming Transition Count | The number of step transitions related to the step. | _Number of transitions, of any kind, that lead into this step._ |
| Is Entry Step | True when the incoming transition count is 0. | _No transition leads into this step: the procedure version starts here._ |
| Entry Step Key | Determined by priority: the step ID if the entry step flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Composite-key echo: this step's id when it is its procedure version's entry step, blank otherwise._ |
| Version Entry Step ID | Taken from the linked procedure version. | _The entry step of this step's procedure version._ |
| Gate Free Reach From Entry Count | The number of vw step transitions closure where avoids human approval gate related to the step. | _1 when some route of one or more gate-free transitions leads from the procedure version's entry step to this step; otherwise 0._ |
| Is Reachable From Entry Without Human Gate | True when the gate free reach from entry count is greater than 0. | _Work can arrive at this step from the start of the procedure without passing any human approval gate._ |
| Is Gate Bypassed Publication | True when all of the following hold: the control kind is “Publication” and the reachable from entry without human gate flag is set. | _A publication step the procedure can reach without human sign-off: the approval gate is structurally bypassable._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact P-Plan class IRI._ |
| Parent Step | A defined attribute. | _The multi-step this step sits in (pko:isStepOfMultiStep)._ |
| First Child Step | A defined attribute. | _For a multi-step, its first sub-step (pko:hasFirstStep)._ |
| Verifies Step | A defined attribute. | _For a verification step, the step it checks (pko:isStepVerificationOf)._ |
| Remedy for Error | A defined attribute. | _Error this step remedies (pko:addressesError)._ |
| Calls Procedure | A defined attribute. | _Sub-procedure this step invokes._ |
| Isolates Energy Source | A defined attribute. | _Energy source this step isolates._ |
| Prerequisite Step | A defined attribute. | _Step whose completion this step requires first (the requires relation)._ |
| Min Repetitions | A defined attribute. | _Minimum times the step runs in one execution (pko:minRepetitions)._ |
| Max Repetitions | A defined attribute. | _Maximum times the step may run in one execution (pko:maxRepetitions)._ |
| Description | A defined attribute. | _Longer description of the step (dct:description)._ |
| Child Step Count | The number of steps related to the step. | _Sub-steps of this step._ |
| Parent Step Kind | Taken from the linked parent step. | _Kind of the parent step._ |
| Is Composite Without Children | True when all of the following hold: the step kind is “MultiStep” and the child step count is 0. | _TRUE for a step declared MultiStep that has no sub-steps._ |
| Precondition Count | The number of step conditions related to the step. | _Preconditions._ |
| Postcondition Count | The number of step conditions related to the step. | _Postconditions._ |
| Invariant Count | The number of step conditions related to the step. | _Invariants._ |
| Safety Critical Condition Count | The number of step conditions related to the step. | _Safety-critical conditions._ |
| Failure Mode Count | The number of failure modes related to the step. | _Documented failure modes._ |
| Cue Count | The number of step cues related to the step. | _Cues a practitioner reads during the step._ |
| Danger Cue Count | The number of step cues related to the step. | _Danger cues that call for escalation._ |
| Decision Point Count | The number of decision points related to the step. | _Decision points._ |
| Knowledge Fragment Count | The number of knowledge fragments related to the step. | _Knowledge fragments attached to the step._ |
| Has Instruction Only | True when all of the following hold: the precondition count plus the postcondition count plus the invariant count is 0; the cue count is 0; the failure mode count is 0; the decision point count is 0; and the knowledge fragment count is 0. | _TRUE for a step that carries only its one-line instruction: no condition, cue, failure mode, decision or captured knowledge._ |
| Input Variable Count | The number of step variables related to the step. | _Declared input variables._ |
| Output Variable Count | The number of step variables related to the step. | _Declared output variables (what the step produces)._ |
| Required Lock Count | The number of step lock requirements related to the step. | _Locks the step requires._ |
| Required Protective Equipment Count | The number of step protective equipment related to the step. | _Protective equipment the step requires._ |
| Is Isolation Without Lock | True when all of the following hold: the isolates energy source has a value and the required lock count is 0. | _TRUE when a step isolates an energy source but requires no lock to hold the isolation._ |
| Referenced Resource Count | The number of step resources related to the step. | _Resources the step references._ |
| Untyped Version Key | Determined by priority: the procedure version if the semantic type iri is blank; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Version key for a step with no ontology type._ |
| Is Accountable to Software | True when all of the following hold: the assigned agent kind has a value and the assigned agent kind is not “Human”. | _TRUE when the role accountable for the step is held by software or an AI agent._ |
| Has Downstream Steps | True when the reachable step count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when any step follows this one anywhere along the ordering chain._ |
| Incompleteness Cue Count | The number of step cues related to the step. | _Cues that show the step did not fully take effect._ |
| Has Incompleteness Cue | True when the incompleteness cue count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the step documents a cue that shows it did not fully take effect._ |
| Has Postcondition | True when the postcondition count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the step states what must hold after it._ |
| Accountable Agent | The current agent of the step's assigned role. | _Agent currently holding the step's role._ |
| Has No Accountable Agent | True when the accountable agent is blank. | _TRUE when nobody currently holds the role accountable for the step._ |
| Conditionless Version Key | Determined by priority: the procedure version if the precondition count is 0; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Version key for a step with no precondition._ |
| Prerequisite Downstream Count | The number of vw step transitions closure related to the step. | _Closure pairs showing the step's prerequisite comes after it in the specified order._ |
| Prerequisite is Downstream | True when all of the following hold: the prerequisite step has a value and the prerequisite downstream count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the specification orders a step before the step it requires, so following the order is unsafe._ |
| States Operational Knowledge | True when all of the following hold: the prerequisite step has a value; the precondition count is greater than 0; and the reached from step count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the step states all three things the operational level needs: what it follows, what it depends on, and what must hold first._ |
| Bottleneck Allocation Count | The number of the step's tactical resource allocations that are bottlenecks. | _Resources allocated to the step whose demand exceeds capacity._ |
| Is Bottleneck Step | True when the bottleneck allocation count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the step waits on a resource whose demand exceeds its capacity._ |
| Stage | A defined attribute. | _Stage the step is grouped in._ |
| Detail Level | A defined attribute. | _Activity (bundles many actions), Task, or Action (a single physical or system action)._ |
| Coarse Top Level Version Key | Determined by priority: the procedure version if all of the following hold: the parent step is blank and the detail level is “Activity”; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Version key for a top-level step at Activity detail._ |
| Fine Top Level Version Key | Determined by priority: the procedure version if all of the following hold: the parent step is blank and the detail level is “Action”; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Version key for a top-level step at Action detail._ |
| Context Sensitivity Count | The number of step context sensitivities related to the step. | _Recorded ways the step's significance depends on context._ |
| Unscoped Sensitivity Count | The number of step context sensitivities related to the step. | _Context dependencies with no applicability scope._ |
| Is Context Sensitive But Unscoped | True when all of the following hold: the context sensitivity count is greater than 0 and the unscoped sensitivity count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the step's significance depends on context and some such dependency says nowhere where it holds._ |
| Version Procedure | Taken from the linked procedure version. | _Procedure the step's version belongs to._ |
| Assigned Role Does Compliance Review | True when the step's assigned role has compliance review capability. | _Whether the step's role carries the compliance-review capability._ |
| Compliance Review Procedure Key | Determined by priority: the version procedure if the assigned role does compliance review flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Procedure key for a step performed by a compliance-review role._ |
| Step Procedure Type | The procedure type of version of the step's procedure version. | _Procedure type of the step's version._ |
| Is Release Approval Gate | True when all of the following hold: the control kind is “Approval” and the step procedure type is “software-release”. | _TRUE for an approval gate in a software release procedure._ |
| Regulatory Requirement Count | The number of the step's step requirements that are requirement is regulatory. | _Requirements on the step that a regulation imposes._ |
| Tool Function Count | The number of step functions related to the step. | _Functions an agent may invoke at the step._ |
| Parseable Condition Count | The number of the step's step conditions that are machine-parseable. | _Conditions stored as machine-parseable expressions._ |
| Dmn Decision Count | The number of the step's decision points that are dmn-encoded. | _Decision points encoded as DMN decisions._ |
| Tool Use Rules Only in Prose | True when all of the following hold: the tool function count is greater than 0; the parseable condition count is 0; and the dmn decision count is 0. | _TRUE for a step where an agent uses tools but no condition or decision is stored in parseable form._ |
| Open Outdated Flag Count | The number of the step's model annotations that are open outdated flags. | _Open practitioner flags that the step's guidance is outdated._ |
| Has Reported Reality Mismatch | True when the open outdated flag count is greater than 0. | _TRUE for a step practitioners' feedback says no longer matches how the work is done._ |
| Deviated Run Count | The number of the step's step executions that have a deviation. | _Executions of the step that recorded a deviation._ |
| Is Drifted From Practice | True when at least one of the following holds: the deviated run count is at least 2 or all of the following hold: the deviated run count is greater than 0 and the open outdated flag count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when practice deviates from the step repeatedly, or deviates where practitioners flagged the guidance outdated._ |
| Ai Failure Count | The number of the step's assistant answers that have a task outcome of “Failed”. | _Failed AI assistant tasks during this step._ |
| Is Ai Failure Point | True when the ai failure count is greater than 0. | _TRUE for a step where an AI assistant has failed a task._ |
| Ai Artifact Input Count | The number of the step's step variables that are input from ai artifacts. | _Inputs fed by an artifact an AI agent's step produces._ |
| Consumes Ai Agent Artifact | True when the ai artifact input count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the step takes an AI agent's artifact as an input._ |
| Collection Evidence Count | The number of knowledge traces related to the step. | _Traces from this step to collected material, in any role._ |
| Has Collection Evidence | True when the collection evidence count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the step traces to at least one collected material._ |
| Activity Origin Trace Count | The number of the step's knowledge traces that have a target kind of “ActivityDefinition” and have a trace role of “Origin”. | _Origin traces of this step as an activity definition._ |
| Version Model Trace Count | The process model trace count of the step's procedure version. | _Origin traces of the step's process model._ |
| Is Untraced Activity in Traced Model | True when all of the following hold: the version model trace count is greater than 0 and the activity origin trace count is 0. | _TRUE when the step belongs to a traced process model but its own definition traces to no collection._ |
| Elicited Validation Count | The number of the step's knowledge traces that are source is people capture and have a trace role of “Validates”. | _Validations of this step captured from people._ |
| Elicited Extension Count | The number of the step's knowledge traces that are source is people capture and have a trace role of “Extends”. | _Extensions of this step captured from people._ |
| Downstream Artifact Step Count | The number of vw artifact handoffs closure related to the step. | _Steps reachable from this step along artifact hand-offs._ |
| Is Declared First Step | True when an empty string. | _TRUE for the step its version declares as its first step._ |
| Is Declared Fallback Step | True when an empty string. | _TRUE for the step its version declares as its fallback step._ |
| Declared First Step Key | Determined by priority: the step ID if the declared first step flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Step key when declared first._ |
| Declared Fallback Step Key | Determined by priority: the step ID if the declared fallback step flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Step key when declared the fallback._ |
| Owner Organization | Taken from the linked procedure version. | _The organization that owns the procedure this row belongs to, one hop at a time from Procedures.OwnerOrganization. A row policy compares it to the caller's organization, so a plant sign-in never sees the finance close._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Step Transition** | Directed control-flow edges represented as first-class pko:Transition instances with fromStep/toStep and next/alternative/fallback semantics. | — |
| Name | Computed as the from step, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the to step. | _Human-readable calculated display alias for the StepTransitions row._ |
| Procedure Version | A defined attribute. | _Procedure version whose control flow owns the transition._ |
| From Step | A defined attribute. | _Source step; maps to pko:fromStep._ |
| To Step | A defined attribute. | _Destination step; maps to pko:toStep._ |
| Transition Kind | A defined attribute. | _Next, Alternative, or Fallback._ |
| Condition | A defined attribute. | _Condition under which the edge is taken._ |
| Priority | A defined attribute. | _Evaluation priority when several outgoing edges exist._ |
| Is Recovery Path | True when at least one of the following holds: the transition kind is “Fallback” or the transition kind is “Alternative”. | _TRUE when this transition is a non-default path taken because something went wrong._ |
| Count of From Step Executions | The number of step executions related to the step transition. | _How many times the step this transition leaves from has actually been executed._ |
| Count of to Step Executions | The number of step executions related to the step transition. | _How many times the step this transition arrives at has actually been executed._ |
| Has Reachable Origin | True when the count of from step executions is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the origin step of this transition has been executed at least once._ |
| Has Reachable Target | True when the count of to step executions is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the destination step of this transition has been executed at least once._ |
| Is Never Exercised | True when it is not the case that all of the following hold: the reachable origin flag is set and the reachable target flag is set. | _TRUE when at least one end of this transition has never appeared in any step execution._ |
| Is Untested Recovery Path | True when all of the following hold: the recovery path flag is set and the never exercised flag is set. | _TRUE for a Fallback or Alternative transition whose endpoints show no execution evidence._ |
| Count of Observed Traversals | The number of observed transitions related to the step transition. | _How many times this exact transition has actually been traversed._ |
| Has Been Traversed | True when the count of observed traversals is greater than 0. | _TRUE when this transition has been walked at least once._ |
| Is Unwalked Recovery Path | True when all of the following hold: the recovery path flag is set and the been traversed flag is not set. | _TRUE for a Fallback/Alternative transition with zero recorded traversals._ |
| Target Blocking Requirement Count | Taken from the linked to step. | _How many blocking requirements are attached to the step this transition lands on._ |
| Target Carries Blocking Control | True when the target blocking requirement count is greater than 0. | _Whether the destination step of this transition carries at least one blocking control._ |
| Is Unrehearsed Control Entry | True when all of the following hold: the unwalked recovery path flag is set and the target carries blocking control flag is set. | _A recovery path that has never been traversed and that leads into a step carrying a blocking control._ |
| Unrehearsed Control Version Key | Determined by priority: the procedure version if the unrehearsed control entry flag is set; in all other cases, an empty string. | _Composite-key echo: this transition's procedure version when it is an unrehearsed control entry, blank otherwise._ |
| Leads to Closure | A defined attribute. | _Transitive closure of the step graph (FromStep -> ToStep over every transition kind), materialized by each substrate as vw_step_transitions_closure: every (from, to) pair a procedure can lead to in one or more transitions. A step that lies on a cycle reaches itself._ |
| From Step is Human Approval Gate | True when the linked from step is a human approval gate. | _This transition leaves a human approval gate._ |
| To Step is Human Approval Gate | True when the linked to step is a human approval gate. | _This transition enters a human approval gate._ |
| Avoids Human Approval Gate | True when all of the following hold: the from step is human approval gate flag is not set and the to step is human approval gate flag is not set. | _Neither end of this transition is a human approval gate, so a route made only of such transitions never passes a gate._ |
| Leads Without Human Gate Closure | A defined attribute. | _Transitive closure of the step graph over only the transitions that avoid every human approval gate, materialized as vw_step_transitions_closure_where_avoids_human_approval_gate: every (from, to) pair a procedure can reach without passing a gate._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Exact PKO class IRI._ |
| Decision Point Count | The number of decision points related to the step transition. | _Decision points that select this transition._ |
| Is Undocumented Branch | True when all of the following hold: the transition kind is not “Next” and the decision point count is 0. | _TRUE for an alternative or fallback branch no decision point explains._ |
