| Dc Title | A defined attribute. | _dcterms:title of the subject._ |
| Dc Description | A defined attribute. | _dcterms:description of the subject._ |
| Presented Status | A defined attribute. | _Status the assertion presents the subject as: Current or Deprecated._ |
| Source Version Status | Taken from the linked source procedure version. | _Status of the source version._ |
| Source Assignment is Current | True when the linked source role assignment is current. | _Whether the source role assignment is current._ |
| Snapshot Consistent Run Count | The consistent reasoner run count of the snapshot assertion's snapshot. | _Consistent reasoner runs over the snapshot._ |
| Snapshot is Reasoned | True when the snapshot consistent run count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the assertion sits in a snapshot a reasoner found consistent._ |
| Is Stale Role Assertion | True when all of the following hold: the source role assignment has a value and the source assignment is current is false. | _TRUE when the assertion rests on a role assignment that is no longer current._ |
| Presents Deprecated As Current | True when all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the source version status is “Deprecated” or the source version status is “Archived” and the presented status is “Current”. | _TRUE when the assertion presents a deprecated or archived version as current._ |
| Lacks Provenance | True when all of the following hold: the provenance uri is blank; the source procedure version is blank; the source step is blank; and the source role assignment is blank. | _TRUE when a served assertion links back to nothing: no provenance URI, version, step or assignment._ |
| Has Opaque Identifier | True when at least one of the following holds: the first 9 character(s) of the subject identifier is “urn:uuid:” or the first 2 character(s) of the subject identifier is “_:”. | _TRUE when the subject identifier is a UUID URN or blank node a person or model cannot read or cite._ |
| Lacks Dublin Core | True when at least one of the following holds: the dc title is blank or the dc description is blank. | _TRUE when the subject carries no Dublin Core title or no description._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Answering Agent | A defined attribute. | _AI agent that answered._ |

| Answered At | A defined attribute. | _When answered._ |
| Answer Kind | A defined attribute. | _Guidance, Recommendation or Lookup._ |
| Question Topic | A defined attribute. | _Authority, Safety, Sequence, Scheduling or General._ |
| Question Text | A defined attribute. | _The question._ |
| Answer Text | A defined attribute. | _The answer._ |
| Retrieval Mode | A defined attribute. | _StructuredQuery, DocumentPassage or None._ |
| Derivation Performed by | A defined attribute. | _Reasoner, StructuredQuery or LanguageModel: what produced the logic of the answer._ |
| Needs Inference | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when the answer requires deriving something not stated outright._ |
| Assumed Current Step | A defined attribute. | _Step the assistant believed the execution was at._ |
| Asserted Next Step | A defined attribute. | _Step the assistant said comes next._ |
| Recommended Step | A defined attribute. | _Step a recommendation acts on._ |
| Raised Safety Concern | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when the answer raised a possible safety problem._ |
| Delivery Disposition | A defined attribute. | _Delivered or Withheld._ |
| Was Acted on | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when someone acted on the answer._ |
| Human Reviewed by | A defined attribute. | _Expert who reviewed the answer before it was used._ |
| Reviewed for Initiative | A defined attribute. | _Automation pilot whose output this expert review belongs to._ |
| Was Correct | True when an empty string. | _Expert verdict on the answer._ |
| Documented Inaccuracy | A defined attribute. | _What was wrong, as documented._ |
| Task Outcome | A defined attribute. | _Completed, Failed or Abandoned._ |
| Grounding Count | The number of answer groundings related to the assistant answer. | _Groundings of the answer._ |
| Own Knowledge Grounding Count | The number of the assistant answer's answer groundings that are from own knowledges. | _Groundings in the organization's own assertions or segments._ |
| Cited Grounding Count | The number of the assistant answer's answer groundings that are cited to user. | _Groundings shown to the person as citations._ |
| Stale Grounding Count | The number of the assistant answer's answer groundings that ground on stale assertion. | _Groundings on stale or deprecated assertions._ |
| Is Not From Own Knowledge | True when all of the following hold: the delivery disposition is “Delivered” and the own knowledge grounding count is 0. | _TRUE when a delivered answer rests on nothing from the organization's own procedural knowledge._ |
| Is Untraceable to Source | True when all of the following hold: the delivery disposition is “Delivered”; the grounding count is greater than 0; and the cited grounding count is 0. | _TRUE when a delivered answer was grounded but showed the person none of its sources._ |
| Context Unescalated Danger Cue Count | Taken from the linked step execution. | _Danger cues seen and not escalated on the step under way._ |
| Stayed Silent on Safety Problem | True when all of the following hold: the context unescalated danger cue count is greater than 0 and the raised safety concern is false. | _TRUE when an unescalated danger cue was on record for the step and the answer raised no safety concern._ |
| Context Step Ended At | Taken from the linked step execution. | _When the step under way ended._ |
| Arrived After Step Ended | True when all of the following hold: the answer kind is “Guidance”; the context step ended at has a value; and the answered at is greater than the context step ended at. | _TRUE when guidance for a step arrived after the step had already ended._ |
| Execution of Context | The procedure execution of the assistant answer's step execution. | _Procedure execution under way._ |
| Context Step | Taken from the linked step execution. | _Step under way._ |
| Assumed Step Completed Count | The number of step executions related to the assistant answer. | _Completed runs, in the same execution, of the step the assistant believed it was at._ |
| Lost Track of State | True when all of the following hold: the assumed current step has a value; the execution of context has a value; and the assumed step completed count is 0. | _TRUE when the assistant acted as if a step were done that the execution record shows never completed._ |
| Specified Transition Count | The number of step transitions related to the assistant answer. | _Transitions the model allows from the assumed step to the asserted next step._ |
| Contradicts Shared Model | True when all of the following hold: the asserted next step has a value and the specified transition count is 0. | _TRUE when the assistant asserted a next step the procedure's transition graph does not allow._ |
| Is Explicitly Grounded Recommendation | True when all of the following hold: the answer kind is “Recommendation” and the own knowledge grounding count is greater than 0. | _TRUE for a recommendation that names at least one piece of the organization's explicit process knowledge._ |
| Recommendation Rests on Nothing Explicit | True when all of the following hold: the answer kind is “Recommendation” and the own knowledge grounding count is 0. | _TRUE for a recommendation traceable to no explicit process knowledge._ |
| Recommended Step Regulatory Count | The regulatory requirement count of the assistant answer's recommended step. | _Regulatory requirements on the recommended step._ |
| Requirement Check Count | The number of answer requirement checks related to the assistant answer. | _Requirement checks run on the answer._ |
| Conflict Count | The number of the assistant answer's answer requirement checks that have a verdict of “Conflicts”. | _Checks that found a conflict._ |
| Conflicts With Regulation | True when the conflict count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a check found the recommended action conflicts with an applicable requirement._ |
| Is Unchecked Regulated Recommendation | True when all of the following hold: the answer kind is “Recommendation”; the recommended step regulatory count is greater than 0; and the requirement check count is 0. | _TRUE for a recommendation on a regulated step that was never checked against its requirements._ |
| Delivered Despite Conflict | True when all of the following hold: the conflict count is greater than 0 and the delivery disposition is “Delivered”. | _TRUE when the check found a regulatory conflict and the recommendation was delivered anyway._ |
| Recommended Step Needs Human | True when the assistant answer's recommended step requires human confirmation. | _Whether the recommended step requires human confirmation._ |
| Acted on Without Human Judgment | True when all of the following hold: the recommended step needs human flag is set; the was acted on flag is set; and the human reviewed by is blank. | _TRUE when an AI recommendation on a step that requires human judgment was acted on with no expert review._ |
| Answered Compliance Question From Documents | True when all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the question topic is “Authority” or the question topic is “Safety” and the retrieval mode is “DocumentPassage”. | _TRUE when an authority or safety question was answered from document passages rather than a structured query._ |
| Document Interpretation Erred | True when all of the following hold: the retrieval mode is “DocumentPassage”; the question topic is “Authority”; and the was correct is false. | _TRUE when an authority question answered by interpreting a document passage came back wrong._ |
| Model Did the Reasoning | True when all of the following hold: the needs inference flag is set and the derivation performed by is “LanguageModel”. | _TRUE when an answer that needed inference had its logic produced by the language model, not a reasoner or query._ |
| Wrong Because Graph Was Stale | True when all of the following hold: the retrieval mode is “StructuredQuery”; the was correct is false; and the stale grounding count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a graph-grounded answer was wrong and rested on a stale or deprecated assertion._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |
| Owner Organization | Taken from the linked step execution. | _The organization that owns the procedure this row belongs to, one hop at a time from Procedures.OwnerOrganization. A row policy compares it to the caller's organization, so a plant sign-in never sees the finance close._ |
| Model Reasoned and Task Failed | True when all of the following hold: the model did the reasoning flag is set and the task outcome is “Failed”. | _The language model did the reasoning for this answer itself, and the task it was asked about ended in failure._ |

| Child Template Count | The number of prompt templates related to the prompt template. | _Detail layers pulled into this one._ |
| Is Disconnected Prompt Knowledge | True when all of the following hold: the carries procedure instructions flag is set and the source procedure version is blank. | _TRUE when a prompt carries procedure instructions that exist in no procedure version of the model._ |
| Is Unmanaged Prompt in Use | True when all of the following hold: the used by agent has a value and at least one of the following holds: the library status is not “Maintained” or the maintained by role is blank. | _TRUE when an agent uses a prompt nobody maintains in the library._ |
| Spends Budget on Rare Detail | True when all of the following hold: the includes rare detail flag is set and the estimated tokens is greater than the token budget. | _TRUE when a prompt inlines rarely needed detail and so exceeds its token budget._ |
| Condensation Percent | Determined by priority: 0 if the source token count is 0; in all other cases, 100 times the estimated tokens divided by the source token count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). | _Prompt size as a share of the source knowledge._ |
| Is Verbatim Dump | True when all of the following hold: the source token count is greater than 0 and the condensation percent is at least 90. | _TRUE when a prompt pastes its source at 90% or more of its size instead of codifying and condensing it._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| **Ai Adoption Initiative** | AI initiatives: the agent, the process and procedure it works on, the automation level, and what came of it. | — |
| Name | The same as its label. | _Display name._ |
| Label | A defined attribute. | _Initiative._ |
| Organization | A defined attribute. | _Sponsoring organization._ |
| Agent | A defined attribute. | _AI agent._ |

| Target Version | A defined attribute. | _Version the AI works from._ |
| Approach | A defined attribute. | _GroundedAgent, Assistant or PromptOnly._ |
| Automation Level | A defined attribute. | _Assist, Partial or Full._ |
| Is Agentic | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when the AI takes actions in the workflow, not just answers._ |
| Task is Multi Step | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when the AI's task follows ordered steps._ |
| Depends on Organizational Knowledge | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when the task depends on this organization's own knowledge._ |
| Preceding Initiative | A defined attribute. | _The partial-automation stage this initiative follows._ |
| Status | A defined attribute. | _Proposed, Pilot, InProduction or Retired._ |
| Outcome | A defined attribute. | _Succeeded, Failed, Pending or NoMeasurableResult._ |
| Redesign Started At | A defined attribute. | _When the workflow redesign for AI began._ |
| Connected to Ai At | A defined attribute. | _When knowledge was connected to the AI._ |
| Model Layer Budget | A defined attribute. | _Spend on models._ |
| Knowledge Layer Budget | A defined attribute. | _Spend on eliciting, encoding and governing knowledge._ |
| Measured Bottom Line Impact | A defined attribute. | _Measured bottom-line result._ |
| Evaluation Context | A defined attribute. | _Instant judged against._ |
| As of Instant | Taken from the linked evaluation context. | _Evaluation instant._ |
| Target Has No Explicit Steps | True when the linked target procedure has no explicit steps. | _Whether the procedure exists only as title and documents._ |
| Target Version Issued At | Taken from the linked target version. | _When the target version was issued._ |
| Target Version Under Specified | True when the ai adoption initiative's target version is an under specified for execution. | _Whether the version lacks conditions or exception handling._ |
| Target Version Notation Only | True when the ai adoption initiative's target version is rests on notation only. | _Whether the version's steps carry no ontology type._ |
| Target Elicitation Evidence Count | Taken from the linked target version. | _Elicitation evidence behind the version._ |
| Reviewed Output Count | The number of assistant answers related to the ai adoption initiative. | _AI outputs experts reviewed during this initiative._ |
| Preceding Reviewed Output Count | Taken from the linked preceding initiative. | _Expert-reviewed outputs of the preceding stage._ |
| Last Outcome Measured At | The largest measured at across the knowledge outcome measurements related to the ai adoption initiative. | _When an outcome was last measured._ |
| Days Since Outcome Measured | Determined by priority: 0 if the last outcome measured at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the last outcome measured at to the as of instant. | _Days since the last outcome measurement._ |
| Ai Insight Count | The number of ai insight proposals related to the ai adoption initiative. | _Insights the initiative folded back as proposals._ |
| Hands Tacit Procedure to Agent | True when all of the following hold: the agentic flag is set; the target procedure has a value; and the target has no explicit steps flag is set. | _TRUE when an agent is assigned a procedure that exists only as tacit knowledge and documents._ |
| Agent on Under Specified Procedure | True when all of the following hold: the agentic flag is set; the target version has a value; and the target version under specified flag is set. | _TRUE when an agent runs a version that does not specify conditions or exception handling._ |
| Agent on Notation Only Procedure | True when all of the following hold: the agentic flag is set; the target version has a value; and the target version notation only flag is set. | _TRUE when an agent runs a version whose steps carry no ontology type._ |
| Calls for Process Knowledge Framework | True when all of the following hold: the task is multi step flag is set and the depends on organizational knowledge flag is set. | _TRUE when the AI task follows ordered steps and depends on organizational knowledge._ |
| Redesigned Before Documented | True when all of the following hold: the redesign started at has a value and at least one of the following holds: the target version is blank or the redesign started at is less than the target version issued at. | _TRUE when a workflow redesign for AI began before the workflow was documented as a version._ |
| Breaks Elicit Encode Connect Order | True when all of the following hold: the connected to ai at has a value and at least one of the following holds: the target version is blank; the target elicitation evidence count is 0; or the connected to ai at is less than the target version issued at. | _TRUE when knowledge was connected to AI with no elicitation behind it, or before it was encoded._ |
| Went Full Without Reviewed Partial Stage | True when all of the following hold: the automation level is “Full” and at least one of the following holds: the preceding initiative is blank or the preceding reviewed output count is 0. | _TRUE for full automation with no preceding partial stage whose output experts reviewed._ |
| Underinvests Knowledge Layer | True when all of the following hold: the model layer budget is greater than 0 and the knowledge layer budget is less than the model layer budget. | _TRUE when the knowledge layer gets less investment than the model layer._ |
| Not Anchored in Process Knowledge | True when all of the following hold: the status is not “Proposed” and the target procedure is blank. | _TRUE for an AI initiative past proposal that is anchored to no modeled procedure._ |
| Agentic Without Knowledge Capture | True when all of the following hold: the agentic flag is set; the status is not “Proposed”; and the ai insight count is 0. | _TRUE for an agentic system past proposal that has produced no procedural knowledge back._ |
| Is Ai Outcome Unmeasured | True when all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the status is “Pilot” or the status is “InProduction” and at least one of the following holds: the last outcome measured at is blank or the days since outcome measured is greater than 30. | _TRUE for a pilot or production AI never measured, or not measured in over 30 days._ |
| Adopted Without Bottom Line Result | True when all of the following hold: the status is “InProduction” and the measured bottom line impact is 0. | _TRUE for AI in production with no measured bottom-line result._ |
| Failed Without Formalized Knowledge | True when all of the following hold: the outcome is “Failed”; the approach is “PromptOnly”; and at least one of the following holds: the target procedure is blank or all of the following hold: the target procedure has a value and the target has no explicit steps flag is set. | _TRUE when prompting a model about work with no formalized steps -- no procedure, or one with no steps -- failed._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Higher Access More Efficient | True when all of the following hold: the comparison baseline has a value; the knowledge access score is greater than the baseline access score; and the minutes per run is less than the baseline minutes per run. | _TRUE when this team has better access than its baseline and takes fewer minutes per run._ |
| Higher Access More Satisfied | True when all of the following hold: the comparison baseline has a value; the knowledge access score is greater than the baseline access score; and the satisfaction score is greater than the baseline satisfaction. | _TRUE when this team has better access than its baseline and higher satisfaction._ |
| Is Unacted Adverse Outcome | True when all of the following hold: the error rate percent is greater than the target error rate percent; the informed change request is blank; and the informed investment decision is blank. | _TRUE when an outcome worse than tolerated fed no change request and no investment decision._ |
| Is Gain Outside Procedural Scope | True when all of the following hold: the efficiency gain percent is greater than 0 and the knowledge scope is not “Procedural”. | _TRUE for an efficiency gain measured on knowledge that is not about procedures._ |

| First Control Adopted At | A defined attribute. | _When the first governance control other than ownership was adopted._ |

| As of Instant | Taken from the linked evaluation context. | _The modeled instant this row is judged against._ |

| Current Steward Role | Taken from the linked current charter. | _Steward role of the charter in force._ |
| Current Steward Agent | Taken from the linked current charter. | _Person holding the steward role now._ |
| Current Authority Role | Taken from the linked current charter. | _Authority role of the charter in force._ |

| Is Ownerless | True when the current charter count is 0. | _TRUE when no ownership charter is in force._ |
| Is Ownerless Past a Year | True when all of the following hold: the ownerless flag is set and the days since registered is greater than 365. | _TRUE for a model that has been under management for more than a year with nobody owning it._ |
| Governance Lapsed | True when all of the following hold: the charter count is greater than 0 and the current charter count is 0. | _TRUE when a model was once chartered and its governance has since lapsed: management stopped rather than continuing as a standing capability._ |
| Has No Current Steward | True when the current steward agent is blank. | _TRUE when nobody holds the steward role for the model now._ |
| Has No Current Authority | True when the current authority agent is blank. | _TRUE when nobody holds authority over the model now._ |
| Is Procedure Without Change Authority | True when all of the following hold: the model kind is “ProcedureFamily” and the current authority agent is blank. | _TRUE for a procedure family where nobody currently holds authority to create, change or retire its definition._ |
| Last Steward Activity At | The largest performed at across the steward activities related to the governed model. | _Most recent recorded steward activity on the model._ |
| Days Since Steward Activity | Determined by priority: the days since registered if the last steward activity at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the last steward activity at to the as of instant. | _Days since any steward activity, or since registration when there was none._ |
| Is Unmaintained | True when the days since steward activity is greater than 90. | _TRUE when no maintenance activity touched the model for more than ninety days._ |
| Documents Behind Count | The number of the governed model's model documents that are behind current releases. | _Model documents describing an older release than the current one._ |
| Is Not Kept Current | True when at least one of the following holds: the unmaintained flag is set or the documents behind count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the model is unmaintained or its documentation describes a release it is no longer at._ |

| Has Open Practice Drift | True when the open practice drift count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when knowledge that no longer matches practice has been detected and is still open._ |
| Is Neglected and Drifting | True when all of the following hold: the unmaintained flag is set and the open practice drift count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when an unmaintained model carries open drift from practice: a representation degrading into something nobody can rely on._ |
| Expert Found Drift Count | The number of the governed model's drift observations that have a detected by of “ExpertWrongAnswer”. | _Drift found only because a domain expert noticed a wrong answer._ |
| Cq Review Count | The number of competency question reviews related to the governed model. | _Competency question set reviews held._ |
| Last Cq Review At | The largest reviewed at across the competency question reviews related to the governed model. | _Most recent competency question set review._ |
| Days Since Cq Review | Determined by priority: the days since registered if the last cq review at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the last cq review at to the as of instant. | _Days since the question set was last reviewed, or since registration._ |
| Cq Review Overdue | True when the days since cq review is greater than 92. | _TRUE when the competency question set has gone more than a quarter (92 days) without review._ |
| Degradation Hidden Until Wrong Answer | True when all of the following hold: the expert found drift count is greater than 0 and the cq review count is 0. | _TRUE when drift surfaced only through an expert noticing a wrong answer on a model whose questions were never periodically reviewed._ |
| Baseline Question Count | The number of the governed model's competency question set entries that are original baselines. | _Original competency questions recorded for the model._ |
| Requirements Spec Incomplete | True when at least one of the following holds: the requirements purpose is blank; the intended users is blank; or the baseline question count is 0. | _TRUE when the requirements specification lacks a purpose, intended users or competency questions._ |
| Collection Control Count | The number of the governed model's governance stage controls that have a stage of “Collection”. | _Governance controls over the collection stage._ |
| Stewardship Control Count | The number of the governed model's governance stage controls that have a stage of “Stewardship”. | _Governance controls over the stewardship stage._ |
| Retrieval Control Count | The number of the governed model's governance stage controls that have a stage of “Retrieval”. | _Governance controls over the retrieval stage._ |
| Use Control Count | The number of the governed model's governance stage controls that have a stage of “Use”. | _Governance controls over the use stage._ |
| Continuous Pipeline Stage Count | The number of the governed model's governance stage controls that are continuous pipeline stages. | _Collection, organization and encoding stages that run continuously._ |
| Lacks Lifecycle Stage Control | True when all of the following hold: the model kind is “ProcedureFamily” and at least one of the following holds: the collection control count is 0; the stewardship control count is 0; the retrieval control count is 0; or the use control count is 0. | _TRUE for a procedure family with no governance control over capture, stewardship, retrieval or use._ |
| Pipeline Not Continuous | True when all of the following hold: the model kind is “ProcedureFamily” and the continuous pipeline stage count is less than 3. | _TRUE for a procedure family whose collection, organization and encoding do not all run continuously._ |
| Procedure Has No Explicit Steps | True when the linked procedure has no explicit steps. | _Whether the procedure exists only as a title and documents._ |
| Is Unmanageable Undocumented Work | True when all of the following hold: the model kind is “ProcedureFamily”; the procedure has a value; and the procedure has no explicit steps flag is set. | _TRUE for a procedure family whose work was never documented into the knowledge system, so it cannot be managed._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |
| Originating Use Case | A defined attribute. | _The concrete use case the model was started from._ |
| Is Without Originating Use Case | True when all of the following hold: the model kind is not “Vocabulary” and the originating use case is blank. | _TRUE when a procedure family or ontology was modeled with no concrete use case behind it._ |
| Pilot Count | The number of model pilots related to the governed model. | _Pilot implementations of the model._ |
| Is Adopted Without Pilot | True when all of the following hold: the model kind is not “Vocabulary” and the pilot count is 0. | _TRUE when a procedure family or ontology was adopted without ever being refined through a pilot._ |
| Requirements Expert Count | The number of the governed model's model activity experts that have a lot activity of “RequirementsSpecification”. | _Experts in requirements specification._ |
| Implementation Expert Count | The number of the governed model's model activity experts that have a lot activity of “Implementation”. | _Experts in implementation._ |
| Publication Expert Count | The number of the governed model's model activity experts that have a lot activity of “Publication”. | _Experts in publication._ |
| Maintenance Expert Count | The number of the governed model's model activity experts that have a lot activity of “Maintenance”. | _Experts in maintenance._ |
| Experts Not Involved Throughout | True when all of the following hold: the model kind is not “Vocabulary” and at least one of the following holds: the requirements expert count is 0; the implementation expert count is 0; the publication expert count is 0; or the maintenance expert count is 0. | _TRUE when some LOT activity of a procedure family or ontology ran with no domain expert taking part._ |
| Real Data Mapping Run Count | The number of the governed model's model data mapping runs that have a data origin of “Real”. | _Runs that mapped the organization's real records into RDF._ |
| Is Implemented Without Real Data | True when all of the following hold: the model kind is not “Vocabulary” and the real data mapping run count is 0. | _TRUE when a procedure family or ontology was never implemented by mapping the organization's real data into RDF._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Model Charter** | Ownership charters: who stewards a governed model and who holds authority over it, with written responsibilities, for a period. | — |
| Name | Computed as the governed model, followed by “ / ”, followed by the steward role, followed by “ + ”, followed by the authority role. | _Display name._ |
| Governed Model | A defined attribute. | _Model chartered._ |
| Steward Role | A defined attribute. | _Role responsible for the model's health._ |
| Authority Role | A defined attribute. | _Role empowered to approve changes._ |
| Steward Responsibilities | A defined attribute. | _The steward's written responsibilities._ |
| Authority Approval Scope | A defined attribute. | _What the authority approves, stated._ |
| Charter Template | A defined attribute. | _Corporate charter template this charter was drawn from, if any._ |
| Local Adaptation | A defined attribute. | _How this organization fitted the template to its own procedures, systems and constraints._ |
| Valid From | A defined attribute. | _Charter start._ |
| Valid to | A defined attribute. | _Charter end._ |
| Supersedes Charter | A defined attribute. | _Charter this one replaced._ |
| Evaluation Context | A defined attribute. | _Evaluation context._ |
| As of Instant | Taken from the linked evaluation context. | _The modeled instant this row is judged against._ |
| Is Current | True when all of the following hold: the valid from is at most the as of instant and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. | _TRUE when the charter is in force at the modeled instant._ |
| Steward Agent | The current agent of the model charter's steward role. | _Who holds the steward role._ |
| Authority Agent | The current agent of the model charter's authority role. | _Who holds the authority role._ |
| Authority Organization | Taken from the linked authority role. | _Organization the authority role belongs to._ |
| Model Kind | Taken from the linked governed model. | _Kind of model chartered._ |
| Model Domain Owner | The domain owning organization of the model charter's governed model. | _Function owning the modeled domain._ |
| Model Headcount | The organization headcount of the model charter's governed model. | _Headcount of the governing organization._ |
| Model Tooling Owner Role | Taken from the linked governed model. | _Role owning the model's tooling._ |
| Model First Control Adopted At | Taken from the linked governed model. | _When the model's first non-ownership control was adopted._ |
| Is Steward Unwritten | True when at least one of the following holds: the steward role is blank or the steward responsibilities is blank. | _TRUE when no steward is named or the steward has no written responsibilities._ |
| Is Authority Scope Unstated | True when at least one of the following holds: the authority role is blank or the authority approval scope is blank. | _TRUE when no authority is named or nothing states what it approves._ |
| Conflates Steward and Authority | True when all of the following hold: the steward role has a value and the steward role is the authority role. | _TRUE when one role is chartered as both steward and authority, so the two responsibilities are never defined apart._ |
| Is Sanctioned Dual Holding | True when all of the following hold: the steward role is not the authority role; the steward agent has a value; the steward agent is the authority agent; and the model headcount is at most 50. | _TRUE when one person holds two distinct steward and authority roles in an organization of fifty or fewer, which needs no committee._ |
| Is Authority Outside Domain Owner | True when all of the following hold: the authority organization has a value; the model domain owner has a value; and the authority organization is not the model domain owner. | _TRUE when authority over the model rests with a function other than the one that owns the domain._ |
| Controls Precede Ownership | True when all of the following hold: the supersedes charter is blank; the model first control adopted at has a value; and the model first control adopted at is less than the valid from. | _TRUE when governance controls were adopted before the model's first owner was named._ |
| Steward Activity Count | The number of steward activities related to the model charter. | _Steward activities recorded under the charter._ |
| Last Drift Watch At | The largest performed at across the model charter's steward activities that have a duty kind of “DriftWatch”. | _Most recent drift watch under the charter._ |
| Days Since Drift Watch | Determined by priority: the number of days from the valid from to the as of instant if the last drift watch at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the last drift watch at to the as of instant. | _Days since the steward last watched for drift, or since the charter began._ |
| Is Drift Watch Lapsed | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set and the days since drift watch is greater than 90. | _TRUE when the steward of a charter in force has not watched for drift in more than ninety days._ |
| Procedure Decision Count | The number of the model charter's change requests that are decided. | _Procedure change requests the authority role has decided._ |
| Model Review Count | The number of the model charter's model change requests that have an authority review. | _Model change requests that received authority review._ |
| Is Named But Unexercised | True when all of the following hold: the current flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the steward activity count is 0 or the procedure decision count plus the model review count is 0. | _TRUE when a charter in force names a steward who has done nothing or an authority that has decided nothing._ |
| Steward is Outside Tooling | True when all of the following hold: the model kind is “Ontology”; the model tooling owner role has a value; and the steward role is not the model tooling owner role. | _TRUE when an ontology's steward is not the role that owns the tooling it is built and published with._ |
| Adopted Template Without Adaptation | True when all of the following hold: the charter template has a value and the local adaptation is blank. | _TRUE when a charter copied a corporate template without fitting it to the organization's own procedures and constraints._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

|------|-------------|-------------------|

| Name | Computed as the model charter, followed by a space, followed by the duty kind. | _Display name._ |
| Model Charter | A defined attribute. | _Charter the duty was performed under._ |
| Duty Kind | A defined attribute. | _DriftWatch, DependencyTracking, UserQuestion, DocumentationUpdate or ValidationSuiteUpdate._ |
| Performed At | A defined attribute. | _When._ |
| Performed by Agent | A defined attribute. | _Who._ |
| Subject | A defined attribute. | _What was looked at or changed._ |
| Release | A defined attribute. | _Release the activity kept in step, when there is one._ |
| Activity Model | The governed model of the steward activity's model charter. | _Model the charter governs._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Model Change Request** | Requests to change a governed model, each begun from a stated need and tied to the competency question that motivates it. | — |
| Name | The same as its title. | _Display name._ |
| Governed Model | A defined attribute. | _Model to change._ |
| Title | A defined attribute. | _Change._ |
| Stated Need | A defined attribute. | _The need the request starts from._ |
| Requested by Agent | A defined attribute. | _Requester._ |
| Requested At | A defined attribute. | _When requested._ |
| Motivating Question | A defined attribute. | _Competency question that motivates the change._ |
| Motivation Kind | A defined attribute. | _ExistingQuestionNowFails or NewQuestionNeeded._ |
| Change Layer | A defined attribute. | _Schema, Instance, Vocabulary or Documentation._ |
| Change Operation | A defined attribute. | _AddClass, AddProperty, RenameClass, RemoveClass, ChangeDomainRange, AddDisjointness, AddVocabularyTerm, AddInstances, ReassignAgent, MoveStepToHuman, CreateDefinition, RetireDefinition._ |
| Classification | A defined attribute. | _DataOperation or ModelingChange._ |
| Route | A defined attribute. | _DataOperations or Governance: the process the request actually went through._ |
| Declared Scale | A defined attribute. | _Patch, Minor or Major as the proposer declared it._ |
| Status | A defined attribute. | _Submitted, ReturnedForClarification, UnderImpactAssessment, Approved, Rejected or Deployed._ |
| Impact Assessment | A defined attribute. | _Impact assessment summary._ |
| Coverage Checked At | A defined attribute. | _When the vocabulary layer and domain coverage model were checked against the change._ |
| Authority Reviewed At | A defined attribute. | _When the authority reviewed the change._ |
| Approved by Agent | A defined attribute. | _Who approved it._ |
| Decided At | A defined attribute. | _When decided._ |
| Implementation Placement | A defined attribute. | _How and where the change is made in the model._ |
| Placement Decided by Agent | A defined attribute. | _Who decided how and where._ |
| Target Release | A defined attribute. | _Release the change ships in._ |
| Compliance Impact | A defined attribute. | _Compliance consequences recorded for moving work between AI and human execution._ |
| Effective At | A defined attribute. | _When a reassignment took effect._ |
| Steward Agent | The current steward agent of the model change request's governed model. | _Steward of the model now._ |
| Authority Agent | The current authority agent of the model change request's governed model. | _Authority over the model now._ |
| Rule Key | Computed as the governed model, followed by “|”, followed by the change layer. | _Key of the change-authority rule for this model and layer._ |
| Required Route | Taken from the linked rule key. | _Process the rule requires for this layer._ |
| Is Accepted | True when at least one of the following holds: the status is “Approved” or the status is “Deployed”. | _TRUE once approved or deployed._ |
| Is Modeling Change | True when the classification is “ModelingChange”. | _TRUE for a modeling change rather than a data operation._ |
| Is Schema Change | True when the change layer is “Schema”. | _TRUE for a change to the schema layer._ |
| Has Authority Review | True when the authority reviewed at has a value. | _TRUE when the authority reviewed the change._ |
| Requires Authority Review | True when at least one of the following holds: the change operation is “RenameClass”; the change operation is “RemoveClass”; the change operation is “ChangeDomainRange”; the change operation is “AddDisjointness”; the change operation is “AddVocabularyTerm”; the change operation is “RetireDefinition”; or the declared scale is “Major”. | _TRUE when the change alters or retires existing elements or vocabularies, adds disjointness, or is major._ |
| Is Minor Scope | True when all of the following hold: the requires authority review is false and the declared scale is not “Major”. | _TRUE for a change the steward may approve and deploy alone._ |
| Steward Own Change Unreviewed | True when all of the following hold: the steward agent has a value; the requested by agent is the steward agent; the is minor scope is false; and the has authority review is false. | _TRUE when the steward raised a change beyond minor scope and the authority never reviewed it._ |
| Steward Approval Out of Bounds | True when all of the following hold: the approved by agent has a value; the approved by agent is the steward agent; the approved by agent is not the authority agent; and the is minor scope is false. | _TRUE when a steward who is not also the authority approved a change beyond the minor changes a steward is authorized to approve._ |
| Authority Review Skipped | True when all of the following hold: the requires authority review flag is set; the accepted flag is set; and the has authority review is false. | _TRUE when a change that alters existing elements or vocabularies, or adds disjointness, was accepted without authority review._ |
| Placement Not Decided by Authority | True when all of the following hold: the implementation placement has a value and the placement decided by agent is not the authority agent. | _TRUE when someone other than the authority decided how and where a change is made._ |
| Is Misrouted | True when all of the following hold: the required route has a value and the route is not the required route. | _TRUE when a change went through a different process than the rule for its layer requires._ |
| Lacks Motivating Question | True when the motivating question is blank. | _TRUE when the request names no competency question._ |
| Unmotivated and Not Returned | True when all of the following hold: the lacks motivating question flag is set and the status is not “ReturnedForClarification”. | _TRUE when a request with no competency question went forward instead of being returned for clarification._ |
| Motivated by Failing Question | True when all of the following hold: the motivating question has a value and the motivation kind is “ExistingQuestionNowFails”. | _TRUE when the change exists because a question the model used to answer now fails._ |
| Is Accepted Without Named Approver | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set and the approved by agent is blank. | _TRUE when an accepted change names nobody as approver._ |
| Deployed Without Target Release | True when all of the following hold: the status is “Deployed”; the schema change flag is set; and the target release is blank. | _TRUE when a deployed schema change names no release._ |
| Is Misclassified Agent Swap | True when all of the following hold: the change operation is “ReassignAgent” and the classification is not “DataOperation”. | _TRUE when swapping which agent fills a role was handled as a modeling change._ |
| Ai to Human Move Without Compliance Review | True when all of the following hold: the change operation is “MoveStepToHuman” and the compliance impact is blank. | _TRUE when a step moved from AI to human execution with no compliance consequences recorded._ |
| Ai to Human Move Unaudited | True when all of the following hold: the change operation is “MoveStepToHuman” and at least one of the following holds: the effective at is blank or the stated need is blank. | _TRUE when a move from AI to human execution does not record when it took effect or why._ |
| Is Ai to Human Move | True when all of the following hold: the change operation is “MoveStepToHuman” and the effective at has a value. | _TRUE for a recorded move of a step from AI to human execution with its effective date._ |
| Lifecycle Change by Unauthorized Agent | True when all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the change operation is “CreateDefinition”; the change operation is “ModifyDefinition”; or the change operation is “RetireDefinition”; the approved by agent has a value; the approved by agent is not the steward agent; and the approved by agent is not the authority agent. | _TRUE when a definition was created, modified or retired on the approval of someone who is neither steward nor authority._ |
| Assessed Inconsistent Count | The number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “InconsistentInstance” and have a finding stage of “Assessment”. | _Instance data the impact assessment found the change would make inconsistent._ |
| Post Deploy Inconsistent Count | The number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “InconsistentInstance” and have a finding stage of “PostDeployment”. | _Inconsistent instance data found only after deployment._ |
| Assessed Inference Count | The number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “AlteredInference” and have a finding stage of “Assessment”. | _Inferences the assessment found the change would alter._ |
| Post Deploy Inference Count | The number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “AlteredInference” and have a finding stage of “PostDeployment”. | _Altered inferences found only after deployment._ |
| Assessed Query Result Count | The number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “AlteredQueryResult” and have a finding stage of “Assessment”. | _Query results the assessment found the change would alter._ |
| Post Deploy Query Result Count | The number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “AlteredQueryResult” and have a finding stage of “PostDeployment”. | _Altered query results found only after deployment._ |
| Assessed Coverage Gap Count | The number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “CoverageGap” and have a finding stage of “Assessment”. | _Vocabulary or coverage-model gaps the assessment found the change would leave._ |
| Would Make Instances Inconsistent | True when the assessed inconsistent count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the assessment found existing instance data the change would make inconsistent._ |
| Would Alter Inferences | True when the assessed inference count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the assessment found inferences the change would alter._ |
| Would Alter Query Results | True when the assessed query result count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the assessment found query results the change would alter._ |
| Would Leave Coverage Incomplete | True when the assessed coverage gap count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the assessment found the change would leave the vocabulary layer or coverage model incomplete._ |
| Missed Inconsistent Instances | True when all of the following hold: the post deploy inconsistent count is greater than 0 and the assessed inconsistent count is 0. | _TRUE when instance data became inconsistent after deployment and the impact assessment had identified none._ |
| Missed Altered Inferences | True when all of the following hold: the post deploy inference count is greater than 0 and the assessed inference count is 0. | _TRUE when inferences changed after deployment and the impact assessment had identified none._ |
| Missed Altered Query Results | True when all of the following hold: the post deploy query result count is greater than 0 and the assessed query result count is 0. | _TRUE when query results changed after deployment and the impact assessment had identified none._ |
| Leaves Coverage Unchecked | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the modeling change flag is set; and the coverage checked at is blank. | _TRUE when an accepted modeling change was never checked against the vocabulary layer and domain coverage model._ |
| Domain Change Spread Wrong Inferences | True when all of the following hold: the change operation is “ChangeDomainRange” and the post deploy inference count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a domain or range change produced altered inferences in deployment._ |
| Intuitive Disjointness Broke Individuals | True when all of the following hold: the change operation is “AddDisjointness”; the lacks motivating question flag is set; and the assessed inconsistent count plus the post deploy inconsistent count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a disjointness axiom added with no motivating question made individuals inconsistent._ |
| Validation Run Count | The number of change validation runs related to the model change request. | _Validation suite runs with the change applied._ |
| Acceptance Failure Total | The total failure count across the model change request's change validation runs that have a run purpose of “Acceptance”. | _Failures in acceptance runs of the full suite with the change applied._ |
| Structural Pass Count | The number of the model change request's change validation runs that have a structural check outcome of “Pass”. | _Runs whose automated structural consistency check passed._ |
| Vocabulary Pass Count | The number of the model change request's change validation runs that have a vocabulary check outcome of “Pass”. | _Runs whose automated approved-vocabulary check passed._ |
| Accepted Without Test Run | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the modeling change flag is set; and the validation run count is 0. | _TRUE when a modeling change was accepted without ever running the validation suite with it applied._ |
| Accepted With Failing Suite | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set and the acceptance failure total is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a change was accepted although the full suite failed with it applied._ |
| Accepted Without Structural Check | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the modeling change flag is set; and the structural pass count is 0. | _TRUE when a modeling change was accepted with no passing automated structural consistency check._ |
| Accepted Without Vocabulary Check | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the modeling change flag is set; and the vocabulary pass count is 0. | _TRUE when a modeling change was accepted with no passing automated check that it uses only approved vocabulary._ |
| Integrity Check Count | The number of change integrity checks related to the model change request. | _Integrity review checks._ |
| Human Integrity Check Count | The number of the model change request's change integrity checks that have a checker kind of “Human”. | _Integrity checks a person performed._ |
| Disjointness Check Count | The number of the model change request's change integrity checks that have a check kind of “Disjointness”. | _Disjointness integrity checks._ |
| Domain Inference Check Count | The number of the model change request's change integrity checks that have a check kind of “DomainInference”. | _DomainInference integrity checks._ |
| Range Consistency Check Count | The number of the model change request's change integrity checks that have a check kind of “RangeConsistency”. | _RangeConsistency integrity checks._ |
| Integrity Decided Without Human | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the schema change flag is set; the integrity check count is greater than 0; and the human integrity check count is 0. | _TRUE when an accepted schema change's integrity was judged only by software._ |
| Skipped Disjointness Review | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the schema change flag is set; and the disjointness check count is 0. | _TRUE when an accepted schema change was never checked for disjointness violations._ |
| Skipped Domain Inference Review | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the schema change flag is set; and the domain inference check count is 0. | _TRUE when an accepted schema change was never checked for unintended domain inferences._ |
| Skipped Range Review | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the schema change flag is set; and the range consistency check count is 0. | _TRUE when an accepted schema change was never checked for property range inconsistencies._ |
| Unresolved Objection Count | The number of the model change request's change objections that are unresolved. | _Stakeholder objections still unresolved._ |
| Approved Over Unresolved Objection | True when all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set and the unresolved objection count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a change was accepted while a stakeholder objection remained unresolved._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Is Additive Schema Change | True when all of the following hold: the change layer is “Schema” and at least one of the following holds: the change operation is “AddClass” or the change operation is “AddProperty”. | _TRUE for a purely additive schema change._ |

| Rationale Without Question | True when all of the following hold: the rationale has a value and the motivating question is blank. | _TRUE when a rationale was recorded but no competency question stands behind it._ |
| Is Schema Change Without Increment | True when all of the following hold: the change layer is “Schema” and the release is blank. | _TRUE when a schema change shipped in no versioned release._ |
| Is Instance Change in Schema Release | True when all of the following hold: the change layer is “Instance” and the release has a value. | _TRUE when an instance data change was versioned as a schema release instead of a data version._ |
| Schema Change Without Request | True when all of the following hold: the change layer is “Schema” and the model change request is blank. | _TRUE when a schema change was made outside the change process, with no change request._ |
| Cannot Be Audited | True when at least one of the following holds: the changed by agent is blank or all of the following hold: the release is blank and the instance data version is blank. | _TRUE when a change names nobody who made it or no version it belongs to._ |
| Cannot Be Rolled Back | True when the prior state commit is blank. | _TRUE when no prior-state commit is recorded, so the change cannot be rolled back._ |
| Is Untraceable Breaking Change | True when all of the following hold: the backward incompatible flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the release is blank or the release decision undocumented flag is set. | _TRUE when a breaking change cannot be traced to a documented versioning decision._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Drift Cause | A defined attribute. | _ShiftingRequirement, NewTechnology or CompetitivePressure._ |

| Resolved At | A defined attribute. | _When resolved._ |

| Work Nature | A defined attribute. | _Transactional (routine) or ExpertiseHeavy (analytical, design or engineering judgment)._ |
| Is Strategically Vital | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when the organization cannot deliver its strategy without the function._ |
| Delivers Own Product | True when an empty string. | _TRUE when the function is part of delivering the organization's own products._ |
| Executing Organization | A defined attribute. | _The organization that actually performs the work._ |
| Specification Holder | A defined attribute. | _The party that holds what is to be built or delivered._ |
| Method Holder | A defined attribute. | _The party that holds how it is built or performed._ |

| Sourcing Rationale | A defined attribute. | _Why the function was placed where it is (CoreCompetencyFocus, CostReduction, Capability)._ |
| Is Outsourced | True when the executing organization is not the client organization. | _TRUE when an organization other than the client performs the work._ |

| Is Knowledge Process Outsourcing | True when all of the following hold: the outsourced flag is set and the work nature is “ExpertiseHeavy”. | _TRUE for expertise-heavy work performed by a provider, the kind that builds deep process knowledge._ |
| Is Vital Expertise Classed Non Core | True when all of the following hold: the sourcing class is “SentOutExecution”; the strategically vital flag is set; and the work nature is “ExpertiseHeavy”. | _TRUE when strategically vital, expertise-heavy work is classified as execution to send out rather than retained core._ |
| Is What How Split | True when the specification holder is not the method holder. | _TRUE when different parties hold what is to be built and how it is built._ |
| Is Method Knowledge Held Outside | True when the method holder is not the client organization. | _TRUE when the knowledge of how the work is really performed is held by a party other than the client._ |
| Claims How Without Doing | True when all of the following hold: the method holder is the client organization and the outsourced flag is set. | _TRUE when the client declares it holds the method knowledge of a function a provider executes._ |
| Is Vital Expertise Process | True when all of the following hold: the strategically vital flag is set and the work nature is “ExpertiseHeavy”. | _TRUE for a strategically vital, expertise-heavy function._ |
| Is Outsourced Vital Expertise Process | True when all of the following hold: the vital expertise process flag is set and the outsourced flag is set. | _TRUE for a strategically vital, expertise-heavy function a provider performs._ |
| Audit Item Count | The number of knowledge audit items related to the sourcing function. | _Audit items comparing held and needed knowledge for this function._ |
| Dependency Count | The number of the sourcing function's knowledge audit items that are knowledge-dependency. | _Audit items that found knowledge the client relies on a provider for._ |
| Coverage Gap Count | The number of the sourcing function's knowledge audit items that are coverage gaps. | _Audit items that found knowledge nobody available to the client holds._ |
| Specification Audit Count | The number of the sourcing function's knowledge audit items that have a knowledge kind of “Specification”. | _Audit items about specification knowledge._ |
| Specification Shortfall Count | The number of the sourcing function's knowledge audit items that have an internal shortfall and have a knowledge kind of “Specification”. | _Specification items where the client holds less than it needs._ |
| Method Shortfall Count | The number of the sourcing function's knowledge audit items that have an internal shortfall and have a knowledge kind of “Method”. | _Method items where the client holds less than it needs._ |
| Provider Ip Documentation Count | The number of the sourcing function's provider engagements that have a documentation ownership of “ProviderIP”. | _Engagements for this function whose documentation stays the provider's property._ |
| Designs What It Cannot Build | True when all of the following hold: the delivers own product flag is set; the outsourced flag is set; the provider ip documentation count is greater than 0; the specification audit count is greater than 0; the specification shortfall count is 0; and the method shortfall count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a product-delivering function is performed by a provider that keeps the documentation, the client's audited specification knowledge is complete, and its method knowledge falls short._ |
| Is Unaudited Function | True when all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the outsourced flag is set or the strategically vital flag is set and the audit item count is 0. | _TRUE when an outsourced or strategically vital function has never been audited for held against needed knowledge._ |
| Capture Initiative Count | The number of knowledge capture initiatives related to the sourcing function. | _Deliberate knowledge capture initiatives for this function._ |
| Is Uncaptured Priority Process | True when all of the following hold: the vital expertise process flag is set; at least one of the following holds: the outsourced flag is set or the coverage gap count is greater than 0; and the capture initiative count is 0. | _TRUE for a vital, expertise-heavy function that is outsourced or has a coverage gap and has no deliberate capture initiative._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Triggered by Agent | A defined attribute. | _Who triggered it._ |
| Completed At | A defined attribute. | _When the assignment change was recorded in the model; blank when not yet._ |
| Ending Assignment | A defined attribute. | _Assignment that ends._ |
| Replacement Assignment | A defined attribute. | _Assignment that replaces it, when there is one._ |
| Dependent Execution | A defined attribute. | _The first procedure run after the trigger that needed the role._ |
| Evaluation Context | A defined attribute. | _The instant the row is judged against._ |
| As of Instant | Taken from the linked evaluation context. | _The modeled evaluation instant._ |
| Policy Trigger Owner Role | Taken from the linked governing policy. | _Role the policy makes responsible for triggering._ |
| Trigger Owner Cover Count | The currently covered assignment count of the role assignment update task's policy trigger owner role. | _Assignments currently covering that role._ |
| Lacks Named Trigger Owner | True when at least one of the following holds: the policy trigger owner role is blank or the trigger owner cover count is 0. | _TRUE when governance names no role responsible for triggering the update, or names one nobody holds._ |
| Policy Sla Hours | The update sla hours of the role assignment update task's governing policy. | _Service level in hours._ |
| Elapsed Minutes | Determined by priority: the number of minutes from the trigger occurred at to the as of instant if the completed at is blank; in all other cases, the number of minutes from the trigger occurred at to the completed at. | _Minutes from the trigger to completion, or to the evaluation instant while incomplete._ |
| Exceeded Update Sla | True when at least one of the following holds: the policy sla hours is 0 or the elapsed minutes is greater than the policy sla hours times 60. | _TRUE when no service level is defined, or the update took longer than it allows._ |
| Ending Role | Taken from the linked ending assignment. | _Role of the ending assignment._ |
| Replacement Role | Taken from the linked replacement assignment. | _Role of the replacement assignment._ |
| Changed Role Instead of Assignment | True when all of the following hold: the replacement assignment has a value and the replacement role is not the ending role. | _TRUE when a change of who does the work was made by moving it to a different role, so the steps bound to the old role had to be re-pointed._ |
| Dependent Run Version | The procedure version of the role assignment update task's dependent execution. | _Version the dependent run enacted._ |
| Dependent Run Started At | Taken from the linked dependent execution. | _When the dependent run started._ |
| Dependent Run Role Step Count | The number of steps related to the role assignment update task. | _Steps of the dependent run's version assigned to the role._ |
| Missed Next Dependent Run | True when all of the following hold: the dependent run role step count is greater than 0; the dependent run started at is greater than the trigger occurred at; and at least one of the following holds: the completed at is blank or the completed at is greater than the dependent run started at. | _TRUE when a run that needs the role started after the trigger and before the assignment change was recorded._ |
| Failed Notice Count | The number of assignment routed notices related to the role assignment update task. | _Notices for the role in the dependent run that reached the wrong person or nobody._ |
| Stale Assignment Broke Routing | True when all of the following hold: the missed next dependent run flag is set and the failed notice count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the assignment was still stale at a run that needed it and that run's notice for the role reached the wrong person or nobody._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|

| Recipient Pair Assignment Count | The number of role assignments related to the assignment routed notice. | _Assignments of the recipient to the role, at any time._ |

| Holder is Still Engaged | True when the linked holder agent is still engaged. | _Whether the holding person still holds a current role._ |
| Holder Service Started At | Taken from the linked holder agent. | _When the holder began service._ |
| Holder Departure At | Taken from the linked holder agent. | _The holder's planned or actual departure._ |
| Days Until Holder Departure | Determined by priority: 99999 if the holder departure at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the as of instant to the holder departure at. | _Days from the evaluation instant to the holder's departure; negative once gone._ |
| Days Served to As of | Determined by priority: 0 if the holder service started at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the holder service started at to the as of instant. | _Days of service up to the evaluation instant._ |
| Days Served to Departure | Determined by priority: 0 if at least one of the following holds: the holder service started at is blank or the holder departure at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the holder service started at to the holder departure at. | _Days of service up to departure._ |
| Holder Tenure Years | Computed as the days served to departure if all of the following hold: the holder departure at has a value and the days until holder departure is less than 0, in all other cases the days served to as of divided by 365 rounded to 1 decimal place(s). | _Years the holder practised: to departure when gone, else to the evaluation instant._ |
| Is Veteran Held | True when all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value and the holder tenure years is at least 10. | _TRUE when a person with ten or more years of practice carries the know-how._ |
| Is Holder Leaving Soon | True when all of the following hold: the holder departure at has a value; the days until holder departure is at least 0; and the days until holder departure is at most 120. | _TRUE when the holder leaves within 120 days of the evaluation instant._ |
| Transfer Count | The number of knowledge transfers related to the know how carrier. | _Recorded transfers of this know-how to someone else._ |
| Repository Entry Count | The number of knowledge repository entries related to the know how carrier. | _Repository entries that capture this know-how._ |
| Source Relationship Count | The number of source relationships related to the know how carrier. | _Collection relationships with this holder on this procedure._ |
| Is Held in Both Forms | True when all of the following hold: the in written procedure flag is set and the trained skill flag is set. | _TRUE when the know-how is at once a written procedure and trained skill._ |
| Is Held by Current Practitioner | True when all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value and the holder is still engaged is true. | _TRUE when a person who still holds a role carries the know-how._ |
| Is Untransferred Veteran Know How | True when all of the following hold: the veteran held flag is set; the holder is still engaged is true; the transfer count is 0; and the repository entry count is 0. | _TRUE when a serving veteran carries know-how never transferred or captured._ |
| Is At Risk of Imminent Loss | True when all of the following hold: the untransferred veteran know how flag is set and the holder leaving soon flag is set. | _TRUE when untransferred veteran know-how belongs to someone leaving within 120 days._ |
| Is Held Only by Departed | True when all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value; the holder is still engaged is false; the transfer count is 0; and the repository entry count is 0. | _TRUE when the only carrier has left and the know-how was neither transferred nor captured._ |
| Is Held by Departed Holder | True when all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value and the holder is still engaged is false. | _TRUE when the person who carried the know-how has left._ |
| Is Captured | True when the repository entry count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when a repository entry captures the know-how._ |
| Must Be Relearned If Holder Leaves | True when all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value; the holder is still engaged is true; and the repository entry count is 0. | _TRUE when a serving holder's know-how has nothing captured for a successor._ |
| Is Overlooked Living Holder | True when all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value; the holder is still engaged is true; the repository entry count is 0; and the source relationship count is 0. | _TRUE when uncaptured know-how has a serving holder no collection relationship has approached._ |
| Transfer Stops Without Veteran | True when all of the following hold: the veteran held flag is set; the holder is still engaged is true; the transfer count is greater than 0; and the repository entry count is 0. | _TRUE when veteran know-how has only been passed person to person with nothing captured, so the next newcomer still needs the veteran._ |
| Dependency Community | The community of practice of the know how carrier's builds on know how. | _The community of the know-how this builds on._ |
| Builds on Same Community Know How | True when all of the following hold: the builds on know how has a value; the community of practice has a value; and the dependency community is the community of practice. | _TRUE when the know-how depends on related know-how concentrated in the same community._ |
| Lost Accumulation Years | Determined by priority: the holder tenure years if the held only by departed flag is set; in all other cases, 0. | _Years of practice lost with a departed sole carrier; zero otherwise._ |
| Is Delegated to Unfit Source | True when all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the replacement plan is “PublicReference” or the replacement plan is “AiGeneration” and the is in public references is false. | _TRUE when the plan is to replace the know-how from public references or AI generation although it is not in public references._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |

| Contradicted Document Revised At | The modified at of the knowledge trace's contradicted document. | _Last revision of the contradicted document._ |
| Is Document Trailing Practice | True when all of the following hold: the trace role is “Contradicts”; the contradicted document has a value; the source is practice evidence flag is set; and the source collected at is greater than the contradicted document revised at. | _TRUE when practice evidence collected after the document's last revision contradicts it._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Collection Occasion** | Recurring occasions at which process knowledge is collected: retrospectives, process reviews and improvement initiatives. | — |
| Name | Computed as the occasion kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the label. | _Display name._ |
| Label | A defined attribute. | _The occasion._ |
| Occasion Kind | A defined attribute. | _Retrospective, ProcessReview or ImprovementInitiative._ |
| Procedure | A defined attribute. | _The procedure the occasion collects knowledge about._ |
| Cadence Days | A defined attribute. | _Days between occurrences._ |
| Last Held At | A defined attribute. | _When it was last held._ |
| Evaluation Context | A defined attribute. | _The instant the row is judged against._ |
| As of Instant | Taken from the linked evaluation context. | _The modeled evaluation instant._ |
| Days Since Held | Determined by priority: 0 if the last held at is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the last held at to the as of instant. | _Days since the occasion was last held._ |
| Is Lapsed | True when the days since held is greater than the cadence days. | _TRUE when the occasion has not been held within its cadence._ |
| Captured Material Count | The number of collected source materials related to the collection occasion. | _Collected materials captured at the occasion._ |
| Is Held Without Capture | True when all of the following hold: the last held at has a value and the captured material count is 0. | _TRUE when the occasion was held and nothing it surfaced was collected._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Stakeholder Perspective** | One stakeholder's view of how a step should be performed, kept with the collected material it comes from and the perspective it conflicts with, rather than merged into a single agreed version. | — |
| Name | Computed as the holder role, followed by “ on ”, followed by the step. | _Display name._ |
| Procedure Version | A defined attribute. | _The process model the view is about._ |
| Step | A defined attribute. | _The step the view is about._ |
| Holder Role | A defined attribute. | _The role whose view this is._ |
| Position | A defined attribute. | _The view, paraphrased._ |
| Source Material | A defined attribute. | _The collected material the view comes from._ |
| Conflicts With Perspective | A defined attribute. | _The perspective this one conflicts with._ |
| Disposition | A defined attribute. | _Retained (kept alongside the other views) or OverriddenByConsensus._ |
| Source Material Kind | Taken from the linked source material. | _Kind of material the view comes from._ |
| Conflict Partner Count | The number of stakeholder perspectives related to the stakeholder perspective. | _Perspectives that name this one as their conflict._ |
| Is in Conflict | True when at least one of the following holds: the conflicts with perspective has a value or the conflict partner count is greater than 0. | _TRUE when the perspective conflicts with another in either direction._ |
| Is Dissenting View Not Kept With Source | True when all of the following hold: the in conflict flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the disposition is “OverriddenByConsensus” or the source material is blank. | _TRUE when a conflicting view was overridden into one version or kept without the source it comes from._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Site | A defined attribute. | _Where the pilot ran._ |
| Started At | A defined attribute. | _When it started._ |
| Finding | A defined attribute. | _What the pilot changed in the model._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |
