| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Artifact Handoff** | One artifact passing from the step that produces it to a step that consumes it, asserted per declared input variable. The edge table the upgrade blast radius is traversed over. | — |
| Name | Computed as the from step, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the to step. | _Display name._ |
| Step Variable | A defined attribute. | _The consuming step's input variable this hand-off feeds._ |
| From Step | A defined attribute. | _Step that produces the artifact._ |
| To Step | A defined attribute. | _Step that consumes it._ |
| Declared Source Step | Taken from the linked step variable. | _Producing step the input variable itself declares._ |
| Declared Consumer Step | Taken from the linked step variable. | _Step that declares the input variable._ |
| Disagrees With Declared Variable | True when at least one of the following holds: the from step is not the declared source step or the to step is not the declared consumer step. | _TRUE when a recorded hand-off names different steps than the input variable it feeds declares, so traversal and declaration have drifted apart._ |
| Handoff Closure | A defined attribute. | _Transitive closure of artifact hand-offs (FromStep -> ToStep), materialized as vw_artifact_handoffs_closure: every step an artifact can reach in one or more hand-offs._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type IRI._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **App Action** | One row per thing a role may DO in the app: the base table it writes, the operation, the access policy that permits it, and the derived value the page highlights afterwards. The app has no per-action endpoint; it executes these rows. | — |
| Name | The same as its label. | _Display name._ |
| Label | A defined attribute. | _The button's words._ |
| Owning Role | A defined attribute. | _The role that performs this action._ |
| Route Path | A defined attribute. | _The app route the action appears on._ |
| Target Table | A defined attribute. | _The base table written._ |
| Operation | A defined attribute. | _INSERT or UPDATE, spelled as the policy's Command is._ |
| Policy | A defined attribute. | _The write policy that permits it. Blank means nothing permits it._ |
| Watched Field | A defined attribute. | _The derived value the page highlights after the write._ |
| Story Episode | A defined attribute. | _The episode of the video series that performs this action on camera._ |
| Description | A defined attribute. | _What the action means, in the role's words._ |
| Policy Command | Taken from the linked policy. | _The permitting policy's SQL command._ |
| Policy Denial Test Count | Taken from the linked policy. | _Denial tests that exercise the permitting policy._ |
| Watched Field is Witness | True when the linked watched field is a witness. | _Whether the highlighted value is a boolean witness._ |
| Input Field Count | The number of app action fields related to the app action. | _Fields this action writes._ |
| Is Unpermitted | True when the policy is blank. | _No access policy permits this action, so the database would refuse it._ |
| Policy Command Disagrees | True when all of the following hold: the policy has a value and the operation is not the policy command. | _The permitting policy is for a different SQL command than the action performs._ |
| Is Unproven Write | True when all of the following hold: the policy has a value and the policy denial test count is 0. | _Permitted, but no denial test proves the policy refuses anyone else._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Extension IRI._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **App Action Field** | The fields one action writes, one row each, and where each value comes from: typed by the person, picked from a list, fixed by the action, or stamped by the server. | — |
| Name | Computed as the app action, followed by “ / ”, followed by the field label. | _Display name._ |
| App Action | A defined attribute. | _The action._ |
| Target Field | A defined attribute. | _The field written._ |
| Field Label | A defined attribute. | _The label shown beside the input._ |
| Input Kind | A defined attribute. | _text, longtext, note (a long text that may be left empty), choice, toggle, date, fixed, or server._ |
| Fixed Value | A defined attribute. | _For fixed: the value. For server: what is stamped (agent, instant, id, iri)._ |
| Choices From | A defined attribute. | _For choice: the table whose rows are offered._ |
| Sort Order | A defined attribute. | _Position in the form._ |
| Target Field Type | Taken from the linked target field. | _raw, relationship, calculated, lookup or aggregation._ |
| Writes Derived Field | True when all of the following hold: the target field has a value; the target field type is not “raw”; and the target field type is not “relationship”. | _The action tries to write a value the model works out for itself. That is never allowed._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Extension IRI._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Abundant Knowledge Gap** | The kinds of knowledge that an abundance of information does not supply, each pointing at the table in this model that represents it. One row per kind named in the source material's 'paradox of abundant knowledge'. | — |
| Name | The same as its label. | _Display name._ |
| Label | A defined attribute. | _Short name of this kind of knowledge._ |
| Gap Kind | A defined attribute. | _HumanJudgment \| UndiscoveredTacitKnowledge \| CuratedToUserAndUseCase._ |
| Description | A defined attribute. | _What this kind of knowledge is._ |
| Why Abundance Does Not Supply It | A defined attribute. | _Why having more information available does not produce this kind of knowledge._ |
| Represented by Table | A defined attribute. | _The table in this model that holds this kind of knowledge._ |
| Representing Table Row Count | The measured row count of the abundant knowledge gap's represented by table. | _Rows measured in the representing table, from the field catalog. This is how much of this kind of knowledge the model actually holds; a kind that is named but held nowhere reads zero. Deliberately a count rather than a yes/no: all three kinds are represented here, so a boolean would be all-true and would state nothing, while the counts differ and say which kind is thinnest._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type._ |

| Term | Description | Narrative Comment |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Ontology Support Programme** | Funded research programmes that produced or supported the ontologies this model reuses. Recorded so the ontology authority can see what happens to a reused vocabulary when the programme behind it ends. | — |
| Name | The same as its label. | _Display name._ |
| Label | A defined attribute. | _Full programme title._ |
| Acronym | A defined attribute. | _Programme acronym._ |
| Funder | A defined attribute. | _Body that funded the programme._ |
| Grant Reference | A defined attribute. | _Grant agreement number, as published by the funder._ |
| Programme Iri | A defined attribute. | _Public record of the programme._ |
| Coordinator | A defined attribute. | _Organization coordinating the programme._ |
| Started on | A defined attribute. | _Programme start date, as published by the funder._ |
| Ends on | A defined attribute. | _Programme end date, as published by the funder._ |
| Is Industry Focused | True when an empty string. | _Whether the programme's purpose is ontology development for industry._ |
| Our Successor Steward | A defined attribute. | _Who this organization relies on to maintain the terms it took from this programme once the programme ends. Blank means nobody has been named._ |
| Why Recorded | A defined attribute. | _Why the ontology authority tracks this programme, whether or not anything has been adopted from it yet._ |
| Evaluation Context | A defined attribute. | _The instant this row is judged against._ |
| As of Instant | Taken from the linked evaluation context. | _The modelled instant._ |
| Supported Profile Count | The number of ontology profiles related to the ontology support programme. | _Ontology profiles in this model that name this programme._ |
| Has Ended | True when all of the following hold: the ends on has a value and the ends on is less than the as of instant. | _Whether the programme has ended as of the modelled instant._ |
| Days Until Programme Ends | Determined by priority: 0 if the ends on is blank; in all other cases, the number of days from the as of instant to the ends on. | _Days from the modelled instant to the programme's end date._ |
| Is Ended With No Steward Named | True when all of the following hold: the ended flag is set and the our successor steward is blank. | _The programme has ended and this organization has named nobody to maintain what it took from it._ |
| Is Ending Soon With No Steward Named | True when all of the following hold: the has ended is false; the ends on has a value; the days until programme ends is at most 180; and the our successor steward is blank. | _The programme has not ended yet, ends within six months of the modelled instant, and nobody here has been named to maintain what we took from it. This is the window in which something can still be done about it._ |
| Semantic Type Iri | A defined attribute. | _Semantic type._ |

## 2b Reachability Rules

_A reachability rule is a transitive closure: relationships that hold not only
directly but through any chain of the same relationship. The asserted edges are
the single source of truth; the inferred edges are necessary consequences of them._

- **Leads to Closure** — one step transition is reachable from another by the **leads to** relationship
  when the second can be reached from the first by following one or more **leads to** edges
  (from its from step to its to step), whether directly asserted or reached transitively.
  - An edge is **asserted** when it exists directly in the step transitions; it is **inferred**
    when no direct edge states it but it follows from a chain of asserted edges.
  - The **hop distance** of a reachable pair is the length of the shortest such chain
    (1 for a directly-asserted edge).
  - _Transitive closure of the step graph (FromStep -> ToStep over every transition kind), materialized by each substrate as vw_step_transitions_closure: every (from, to) pair a procedure can lead to in one or more transitions. A step that lies on a cycle reaches itself._
- **Leads Without Human Gate Closure** — one step transition is reachable from another by the **leads without human gate** relationship
  when the second can be reached from the first by following one or more **leads without human gate** edges
  (from its from step to its to step), whether directly asserted or reached transitively.
  - An edge is **asserted** when it exists directly in the step transitions; it is **inferred**
    when no direct edge states it but it follows from a chain of asserted edges.
  - The **hop distance** of a reachable pair is the length of the shortest such chain
    (1 for a directly-asserted edge).
  - _Transitive closure of the step graph over only the transitions that avoid every human approval gate, materialized as vw_step_transitions_closure_where_avoids_human_approval_gate: every (from, to) pair a procedure can reach without passing a gate._
- **Handoff Closure** — one artifact handoff is reachable from another by the **handoff** relationship
  when the second can be reached from the first by following one or more **handoff** edges
  (from its from step to its to step), whether directly asserted or reached transitively.
  - An edge is **asserted** when it exists directly in the artifact handoffs; it is **inferred**
    when no direct edge states it but it follows from a chain of asserted edges.
  - The **hop distance** of a reachable pair is the length of the shortest such chain
    (1 for a directly-asserted edge).
  - _Transitive closure of artifact hand-offs (FromStep -> ToStep), materialized as vw_artifact_handoffs_closure: every step an artifact can reach in one or more hand-offs._

## 3 Operative Rules

_Operative rules state what the business **obliges**, **prohibits**, or
advises (**should**). Structural rules come from required fields and foreign keys;
semantic rules come from the Constraints table, each keyed on a boolean the rulebook
already computes (cross-referenced as DR-N in the Definitional Rules below)._

### Structural Constraints (from the schema)

- An evaluation context **must** have an as of instant.
- A witness loop **must** have a loop number.
- An observed transition **must** reference exactly one procedure execution.
- An observed transition **must** reference exactly one step transition.
- A delivered communication **must** reference exactly one procedure execution.
- An app route **must** have a route path and a surface.
- A rulebook table **must** have a table name.

## 4 Definitional Rules

_All statements express truth in the business domain; they are neither
procedures nor imperatives. "iff" is avoided in favor of "only if" so a
one-directional necessity is not mistaken for an equivalence. A
**⚠︎ mechanical** chip marks a rule whose deterministic wording is faithful
but clunky — a flag for an optional downstream reword pass, not a defect._

| ID | Declarative rule |
|----|------------------|
| **DR-1 Name** | A rulebook releas's name is computed as the rulebook version, followed by “ / PKO ”, followed by the pko core version iri. |
| **DR-2 Prev Major** | A rulebook releas's prev major is the version major of the rulebook releas's previous release. |
| **DR-3 Prev Minor** | A rulebook releas's prev minor is the version minor of the rulebook releas's previous release. |
| **DR-4 Prev Patch** | A rulebook releas's prev patch is the version patch of the rulebook releas's previous release. |
| **DR-5 Prev Issued At** | A rulebook releas's prev issued at — taken from the linked previous release. |
| **DR-6 Model Current Release** | A rulebook releas's model current release — taken from the linked governed model. |
| **DR-7 Expected Major** | The rulebook releas's expected major is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the prev major plus 1, if the declared scale is “Major”;<br>2. in all other cases, the prev major. |
| **DR-8 Expected Minor** | The rulebook releas's expected minor is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the declared scale is “Major”;<br>2. the prev minor plus 1, if the declared scale is “Minor”;<br>3. in all other cases, the prev minor. |
| **DR-9 Expected Patch** | The rulebook releas's expected patch is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the prev patch plus 1, if the declared scale is “Patch”;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-10 Is Increment Inconsistent With Scale** | A rulebook releas is considered an increment inconsistent with scale if all of the following hold: the previous release has a value and at least one of the following holds: the version major is not the expected major; the version minor is not the expected minor; or the version patch is not the expected patch. |
| **DR-11 Days Since Previous Release** | The rulebook releas's days since previous release is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the previous release is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the prev issued at to the issued at. |
| **DR-12 Is Long Release Cycle** | A rulebook releas is considered a long release cycle if the days since previous release is greater than 60. |
| **DR-13 Is Declared Current Release** | A rulebook releas is considered a declared current release if all of the following hold: the model current release has a value and the rulebook release ID is the model current release. |
| **DR-14 Log Entry Count** | A rulebook releas's log entry count is the number of model change log entries related to the rulebook releas. |
| **DR-15 Logical Change Count** | A rulebook releas's logical change count is the number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that alter a logical model. |
| **DR-16 Non Additive Change Count** | A rulebook releas's non additive change count is the number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that are backward-incompatible. |
| **DR-17 Class Removal or Rename Count** | A rulebook releas's class removal or rename count is the number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that are class removal or renames. |
| **DR-18 Invalidating Domain Range Count** | A rulebook releas's invalidating domain range count is the number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that are invalidating domain range changes. |
| **DR-19 Inconsistent Disjointness Count** | A rulebook releas's inconsistent disjointness count is the number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that are inconsistent disjointnesses. |
| **DR-20 Schema Addition Count** | A rulebook releas's schema addition count is the number of the rulebook releas's model change log entries that are additive schema changes. |
| **DR-21 Suite Update Count** | A rulebook releas's suite update count is the number of the rulebook releas's steward activities that have a duty kind of “ValidationSuiteUpdate”. |
| **DR-22 Consumer Count** | A rulebook releas's consumer count is the number of model consumers related to the rulebook releas. |
| **DR-23 Notified Consumer Count** | A rulebook releas's notified consumer count is the number of the rulebook releas's consumer revalidations that have been notified. |
| **DR-24 Revalidated Consumer Count** | A rulebook releas's revalidated consumer count is the number of the rulebook releas's consumer revalidations that are passed revalidation. |
| **DR-25 Validation Run Count** | A rulebook releas's validation run count is the number of change validation runs related to the rulebook releas. |
| **DR-26 Validation Failure Total** | A rulebook releas's validation failure total is the total failure count across the rulebook releas's change validation runs that have a run purpose of “Acceptance”. |
| **DR-27 Consistent Run Count** | A rulebook releas's consistent run count is the number of the rulebook releas's change validation runs that have a consistency check outcome of “Consistent”. |
| **DR-28 Cq Run Count** | A rulebook releas's cq run count is the number of competency question runs related to the rulebook releas. |
| **DR-29 Answerable Cq Run Count** | A rulebook releas's answerable cq run count is the number of the rulebook releas's competency question runs that have been answerable. |
| **DR-30 Regressed Baseline Count** | A rulebook releas's regressed baseline count is the number of the rulebook releas's competency question runs that are baseline regressions. |
| **DR-31 Cq Coverage Percent** | The rulebook releas's cq coverage percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the cq run count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, 100 times the answerable cq run count divided by the cq run count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). |
| **DR-32 Prev Cq Coverage Percent** | A rulebook releas's prev cq coverage percent — taken from the linked previous release. |
| **DR-33 Prev Cq Run Count** | A rulebook releas's prev cq run count — taken from the linked previous release. |
| **DR-34 Scored Criterion Count** | A rulebook releas's scored criterion count is the number of quality assessments related to the rulebook releas. |
| **DR-35 Stated Criterion Count** | A rulebook releas's stated criterion count is the number of quality criteria related to the rulebook releas. |
| **DR-36 Patch Alters Logical Model** | A rulebook releas is flagged patch alters logical model if all of the following hold: the declared scale is “Patch” and the logical change count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-37 Minor is Not Backward Compatible** | A rulebook releas is flagged minor is not backward compatible if all of the following hold: the declared scale is “Minor” and the non additive change count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-38 Class Removal Without Major** | A rulebook releas is considered to clas a removal without major if all of the following hold: the declared scale is not “Major” and the class removal or rename count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-39 Invalidating Domain Range Without Major** | A rulebook releas is flagged invalidating domain range without major if all of the following hold: the declared scale is not “Major” and the invalidating domain range count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-40 Inconsistent Disjointness Without Major** | A rulebook releas is flagged inconsistent disjointness without major if all of the following hold: the declared scale is not “Major” and the inconsistent disjointness count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-41 Is Breaking Release** | A rulebook releas is considered a breaking release if at least one of the following holds: the declared scale is “Major” or the non additive change count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-42 Breaking Release With Unrevalidated Consumers** | A rulebook releas is flagged breaking release with unrevalidated consumers if all of the following hold: the breaking release flag is set and the revalidated consumer count is less than the consumer count. |
| **DR-43 Breaking Release Without Migration Plan** | A rulebook releas is flagged breaking release without migration plan if all of the following hold: the breaking release flag is set and the migration plan is blank. |
| **DR-44 Is Undocumented Version Decision** | A rulebook releas is considered an undocumented version decision if all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and at least one of the following holds: the version decision rationale is blank or the version decided by agent is blank. |
| **DR-45 Is Unannounced to Dependents** | A rulebook releas is considered an unannounced to dependents if the notified consumer count is less than the consumer count. |
| **DR-46 Is Release Without Recorded Changes** | A rulebook releas is considered a release without recorded changes if all of the following hold: the previous release has a value and the log entry count is 0. |
| **DR-47 Suite Lags Release** | A rulebook releas is flagged suite lags release if all of the following hold: the schema addition count is greater than 0 and the suite update count is 0. |
| **DR-48 Is Untagged Release** | A rulebook releas is considered an untagged release if all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and the rulebook commit is blank. |
| **DR-49 Published Without Approval** | A rulebook releas is flagged published without approval if all of the following hold: the status is “Released” and the approved by agent is blank. |
| **DR-50 Released Despite Failed Validation** | A rulebook releas is flagged released despite failed validation if the validation failure total is greater than 0. |
| **DR-51 Released Without Consistency Check** | A rulebook releas is flagged released without consistency check if all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and the consistent run count is 0. |
| **DR-52 Passed Validation At Release** | A rulebook releas is flagged passed validation at release if all of the following hold: the validation run count is greater than 0 and the validation failure total is 0. |
| **DR-53 Cq Coverage Declined** | A rulebook releas is flagged cq coverage declined if all of the following hold: the previous release has a value; the prev cq run count is greater than 0; the cq run count is greater than 0; and the cq coverage percent is less than the prev cq coverage percent. |
| **DR-54 Has Baseline Regression** | A rulebook releas is considered to have a baseline regression if the regressed baseline count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-55 Released Without Cq Task Test** | A rulebook releas is flagged released without cq task test if all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and the cq run count is 0. |
| **DR-56 Well Formed But Requirements Unshown** | A rulebook releas is flagged well formed but requirements unshown if all of the following hold: the validation run count is greater than 0 and the cq run count is 0. |
| **DR-57 Is Not Scored Against Criteria** | A rulebook releas is considered a not scored against criteria if all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and the scored criterion count is less than the stated criterion count. |
| **DR-58 Is Released Without Licence or Permanent ID** | A rulebook releas is considered a released without licence or permanent ID if all of the following hold: the governed model has a value and at least one of the following holds: the license is blank or the permanent iri is blank. |
| **DR-59 Name** | An ontology profile's name is computed as the label, followed by a space, followed by the version. |
| **DR-60 Mapping Count** | An ontology profile's mapping count is the number of semantic mappings related to the ontology profile. |
| **DR-61 As of Instant** | An ontology profile's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-62 Days Since Last Revision** | The ontology profile's days since last revision is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the last revised at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the last revised at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-63 Days Since Major Revision** | The ontology profile's days since major revision is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the last major revision at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the last major revision at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-64 Days Since Dependency Reviewed** | The ontology profile's days since dependency reviewed is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the dependency reviewed at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the dependency reviewed at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-65 Recent Deprecation Count** | An ontology profile's recent deprecation count is the number of the ontology profile's external standard terms that are recent deprecations. |
| **DR-66 Requires Frequent Review** | An ontology profile is considered to require a frequent review if at least one of the following holds: the recent deprecation count is at least 2 or all of the following hold: the last major revision at has a value and the days since major revision is less than 730. |
| **DR-67 Change Rate Profile** | The ontology profile's change rate profile is determined by the following priority:<br>1. “FrequentDeprecation”, if the recent deprecation count is at least 2;<br>2. “RecentMajorRevision”, if all of the following hold: the last major revision at has a value and the days since major revision is less than 730;<br>3. “Dormant”, if all of the following hold: the last revised at has a value and the days since last revision is greater than 3650;<br>4. in all other cases, “Unassessed”. |
| **DR-68 Is Review Overdue for Change Rate** | An ontology profile is considered a review overdue for change rate if all of the following hold: the requires frequent review flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the dependency reviewed at is blank or the days since dependency reviewed is greater than 180. |
| **DR-69 Prerequisite Adopted At** | An ontology profile's prerequisite adopted at — taken from the linked prerequisite profile. |
| **DR-70 Skips Adoption Path** | An ontology profile is considered to skip an adoption path if all of the following hold: the adoption stage is greater than 1 and at least one of the following holds: the prerequisite profile is blank; the prerequisite adopted at is blank; or the prerequisite adopted at is greater than the adopted at. |
| **DR-71 Namespace is Http** | An ontology profile is flagged namespace is http if at least one of the following holds: the first 7 character(s) of the namespace iri is “http://” or the first 8 character(s) of the namespace iri is “https://”. |
| **DR-72 Namespace Dereferences** | An ontology profile is flagged namespace dereferences if all of the following hold: the namespace is http flag is set and the namespace http status is 200. |
| **DR-73 Publishes Following Linked Data Principles** | An ontology profile is considered to publishe a following linked data principles if all of the following hold: the namespace dereferences flag is set; the namespace serves rdf flag is set; and the mapping count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-74 Name** | An evaluation context's name is computed as the label, followed by “ @ ”, followed by the as of instant. |
| **DR-75 Explicit Fragment Count** | An evaluation context's explicit fragment count is the number of knowledge fragments related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-76 Tacit Fragment Count** | An evaluation context's tacit fragment count is the number of knowledge fragments related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-77 Implicit Fragment Count** | An evaluation context's implicit fragment count is the number of knowledge fragments related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-78 Situated Judgment Fragment Count** | An evaluation context's situated judgment fragment count is the number of knowledge fragments related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-79 Model Reasoned Answer Count** | An evaluation context's model reasoned answer count is the number of assistant answers related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-80 Otherwise Reasoned Answer Count** | An evaluation context's otherwise reasoned answer count is the number of assistant answers related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-81 Assistant Answer Count** | An evaluation context's assistant answer count is computed as the model reasoned answer count plus the otherwise reasoned answer count. |
| **DR-82 Model Reasoned Failed Answer Count** | An evaluation context's model reasoned failed answer count is the number of assistant answers related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-83 Out of Order Step Execution Count** | An evaluation context's out of order step execution count is the number of step executions related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-84 In Order Step Execution Count** | An evaluation context's in order step execution count is the number of step executions related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-85 Step Execution Count** | An evaluation context's step execution count is computed as the out of order step execution count plus the in order step execution count. |
| **DR-86 Early Start Step Execution Count** | An evaluation context's early start step execution count is the number of step executions related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-87 Exact Mapping Count** | An evaluation context's exact mapping count is the number of semantic mappings related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-88 Aligned Mapping Count** | An evaluation context's aligned mapping count is the number of semantic mappings related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-89 Extension Mapping Count** | An evaluation context's extension mapping count is the number of semantic mappings related to the evaluation context. |
| **DR-90 Name** | An organization's name is the same as its display name. |
| **DR-91 Failed Ai Initiative Count** | An organization's failed ai initiative count is the number of the organization's ai adoption initiatives that have a outcome of “Failed”. |
| **DR-92 Owned Procedure Count** | An organization's owned procedure count is the number of procedures related to the organization. |
| **DR-93 Ai Fails for Lack of Captured Knowledge** | An organization is flagged ai fails for lack of captured knowledge if all of the following hold: the failed ai initiative count is greater than 0 and the owned procedure count is 0. |
| **DR-94 Product Delivery Function Count** | An organization's product delivery function count is the number of the organization's sourcing functions that deliver an own product. |
| **DR-95 Provider Held Delivery Method Count** | An organization's provider held delivery method count is the number of the organization's sourcing functions that deliver an own product and are method knowledge held outsides. |
| **DR-96 Is Hollowed Out Firm** | An organization is considered a hollowed out firm if all of the following hold: the product delivery function count is greater than 0 and the provider held delivery method count is the product delivery function count. |
| **DR-97 Audit Finding Count** | An organization's audit finding count is the number of the organization's knowledge audit items that have an internal shortfall. |
| **DR-98 Filled Knowledge Position Count** | An organization's filled knowledge position count is the number of the organization's knowledge workforce positions that have a status of “Filled”. |
| **DR-99 Has Knowledge Findings Without Knowledge Staff** | An organization is considered to have a knowledge findings without knowledge staff if all of the following hold: the audit finding count is greater than 0 and the filled knowledge position count is 0. |
| **DR-100 Departed Holder Know How Count** | An organization's departed holder know how count is the number of the organization's know how carriers that are held by departed holders. |
| **DR-101 Lost Departed Know How Count** | An organization's lost departed know how count is the number of the organization's know how carriers that are held-only-by-departed. |
| **DR-102 Retained Departed Know How Percent** | The organization's retained departed know how percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 100, if the departed holder know how count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, 100 times the departed holder know how count minus the lost departed know how count divided by the departed holder know how count rounded to 0 decimal place(s). |
| **DR-103 Memory Leaves With Staff** | An organization is flagged memory leaves with staff if all of the following hold: the departed holder know how count is greater than 0 and the retained departed know how percent is less than 100. |
| **DR-104 Captured Own Know How Count** | An organization's captured own know how count is the number of the organization's know how carriers that are captured. |
| **DR-105 Documentation Entry Count** | An organization's documentation entry count is the number of knowledge repository entries related to the organization. |
| **DR-106 Unallocated Documentation Count** | An organization's unallocated documentation count is the number of the organization's knowledge repository entries that are not authored on allocated time. |
| **DR-107 Transfer Given Count** | An organization's transfer given count is the number of knowledge transfers related to the organization. |
| **DR-108 Unallocated Transfer Count** | An organization's unallocated transfer count is the number of the organization's knowledge transfers that are not on allocated time. |
| **DR-109 Treats Knowledge Work As Unvalued** | An organization is considered to treat knowledge work as unvalued if all of the following hold: the documentation entry count plus the transfer given count is greater than 0 and 2 times the unallocated documentation count plus the unallocated transfer count is greater than the documentation entry count plus the transfer given count. |
| **DR-110 Person Carried Know How Count** | An organization's person carried know how count is the number of the organization's know how carriers that have a carrier kind of “Person”. |
| **DR-111 Facility Carried Know How Count** | An organization's facility carried know how count is the number of the organization's know how carriers that have a carrier kind of “Facility”. |
| **DR-112 System Carried Know How Count** | An organization's system carried know how count is the number of the organization's know how carriers that have a carrier kind of “System”. |
| **DR-113 Holds Know How in People Plants and Systems** | An organization is considered to hold a know how in people plants and systems if all of the following hold: the person carried know how count is greater than 0; the facility carried know how count is greater than 0; and the system carried know how count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-114 Staged Decline Count** | An organization's staged decline count is the number of the organization's capability declines that follow a preceding stage decline. |
| **DR-115 Eroded in Stages** | An organization is flagged eroded in stages if the staged decline count is at least 2. |
| **DR-116 Name** | An agent's name is the same as its display name. |
| **DR-117 Count of Current Role Assignments** | An agent's count of current role assignments is the number of role assignments related to the agent. |
| **DR-118 Is Still Engaged** | An agent is considered still-engaged if the count of current role assignments is greater than 0. |
| **DR-119 Decision Count** | An agent's decision count is the number of agent decision records related to the agent. |
| **DR-120 Overridden Decision Count** | An agent's overridden decision count is the number of agent decision records related to the agent. |
| **DR-121 Override Rate Percent** | The agent's override rate percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the decision count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, the overridden decision count times 100 divided by the decision count. |
| **DR-122 Is Non Human** | An agent is considered a non human if it is not the case that the agent kind is “Human”. |
| **DR-123 Boundary Violation Count** | An agent's boundary violation count is the number of agent decision records related to the agent. |
| **DR-124 Is Operating Outside Boundary** | An agent is considered operating-outside-boundary if the boundary violation count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-125 Draft Decision Count** | An agent's draft decision count is the number of agent decision records related to the agent. |
| **DR-126 Overridden Draft Count** | An agent's overridden draft count is the number of agent decision records related to the agent. |
| **DR-127 Draft Rewrite Rate Percent** | The agent's draft rewrite rate percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the draft decision count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, the overridden draft count times 100 divided by the draft decision count. |
| **DR-128 Times Named As Broker** | An agent's times named as broker is the number of knowledge broker links related to the agent. |
| **DR-129 Is Recognized Broker** | An agent is considered a recognized broker if the times named as broker is at least 3. |
| **DR-130 At Risk Reliance Count** | An agent's at risk reliance count is the number of knowledge broker links related to the agent. |
| **DR-131 Has At Risk Knowledge Reliance** | An agent is considered to have at risk knowledge reliance if the at risk reliance count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-132 Is Organization Agent** | An agent is considered an organization agent if the represents organization has a value. |
| **DR-133 Answer Count** | An agent's answer count is the number of assistant answers related to the agent. |
| **DR-134 Ai Task Completed Count** | An agent's ai task completed count is the number of the agent's assistant answers that have a task outcome of “Completed”. |
| **DR-135 Ai Task Completion Percent** | The agent's ai task completion percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the answer count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, 100 times the ai task completed count divided by the answer count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). |
| **DR-136 Is Below Task Completion Target** | An agent is considered a below task completion target if all of the following hold: the answer count is greater than 0 and the ai task completion percent is less than 80. |
| **DR-137 Runtime Integration Count** | An agent's runtime integration count is the number of the agent's agent integrations that have a delivery mode of “Runtime”. |
| **DR-138 Lacks Runtime Knowledge Integration** | An agent is considered to lack a runtime knowledge integration if all of the following hold: the agent kind is “AIAgent”; the answer count is greater than 0; and the runtime integration count is 0. |
| **DR-139 Search Event Count** | An agent's search event count is the number of knowledge search events related to the agent. |
| **DR-140 Is Untracked Ai Consumer** | An agent is considered an untracked ai consumer if all of the following hold: the agent kind is “AIAgent”; the answer count is greater than 0; and the search event count is 0. |
| **DR-141 Accountability Assertion Count** | An agent's accountability assertion count is the number of the agent's snapshot assertions that are not inferred. |
| **DR-142 Inferred Category Count** | An agent's inferred category count is the number of the agent's snapshot assertions that are inferred. |
| **DR-143 Category Not Available As Inference** | An agent is flagged category not available as inference if all of the following hold: the accountability assertion count is greater than 0 and the inferred category count is 0. |
| **DR-144 Is Unclassified Agent** | An agent is considered an unclassified agent if all of the following hold: the agent kind is not “Human”; the agent kind is not “AIAgent”; the agent kind is not “AutomatedPipeline”; and the agent kind is not “Organization”. |
| **DR-145 Is Ai Agent Without Model Version** | An agent is considered an ai agent without model version if all of the following hold: the agent kind is “AIAgent” and the version or employment key is blank. |
| **DR-146 Attributed Artifact Count** | An agent's attributed artifact count is the number of execution entities related to the agent. |
| **DR-147 Has Produced Artifacts** | An agent is considered to have a produced artifacts if the attributed artifact count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-148 Has Artifact Blast Radius** | An agent is considered to have an artifact blast radius if the artifact blast radius step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-149 Registry Version Match Count** | An agent's registry version match count is the number of ai registry model versions related to the agent. |
| **DR-150 Is Ai Agent Not Filled From Registry** | An agent is considered ai-agent-not-filled-from-registry if all of the following hold: the agent kind is “AIAgent” and the registry version match count is 0. |
| **DR-151 Current Accountable Human Count** | An agent's current accountable human count is the number of the agent's ai agent accountabilities that are current-human-accountability. |
| **DR-152 Is Ai Agent Without Accountable Human** | An agent is considered an ai agent without accountable human if all of the following hold: the agent kind is “AIAgent”; the count of current role assignments is greater than 0; and the current accountable human count is 0. |
| **DR-153 Community Count** | An agent's community count is the number of community memberships related to the agent. |
| **DR-154 Is Boundary Spanner** | An agent is considered a boundary spanner if the community count is at least 2. |
| **DR-155 Sna Identification Count** | An agent's sna identification count is the number of method applications related to the agent. |
| **DR-156 Is Unidentified Boundary Spanner** | An agent is considered an unidentified boundary spanner if all of the following hold: the boundary spanner flag is set and the sna identification count is 0. |
| **DR-157 Located Know How Count** | An agent's located know how count is the number of the agent's knowledge broker links that locate an other holder. |
| **DR-158 Required Mentoring Hours Per Week** | An agent's required mentoring hours per week is the total expected weekly hours across the agent's mentorships that are active. |
| **DR-159 Lacks Time to Mentor** | An agent is considered to lack a time to mentor if all of the following hold: the required mentoring hours per week is greater than 0 and the protected mentoring hours per week is less than the required mentoring hours per week. |
| **DR-160 Transfers Given Count** | An agent's transfers given count is the number of knowledge transfers related to the agent. |
| **DR-161 Recognition Count** | An agent's recognition count is the number of sharing recognitions related to the agent. |
| **DR-162 Is Unrewarded Sharer** | An agent is considered an unrewarded sharer if all of the following hold: the transfers given count is at least 2 and the recognition count is 0. |
| **DR-163 Downstream of Held Steps Count** | An agent's downstream of held steps count is the total downstream artifact step count across the steps related to the agent. |
| **DR-164 Artifact Blast Radius Step Count** | The agent's artifact blast radius step count is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the downstream of held steps count, if the agent kind is “AIAgent”;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-165 Name** | A role's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-166 Current Agent Kind** | A role's current agent kind — taken from the linked current agent. |
| **DR-167 Active Assignment Count** | A role's active assignment count is the number of role assignments related to the role. |
| **DR-168 Currently Covered Assignment Count** | A role's currently covered assignment count is the number of role assignments related to the role. |
| **DR-169 Has No Current Holder** | A role is considered to have no current holder if the currently covered assignment count is 0. |
| **DR-170 Count of Awaited Decisions** | A role's count of awaited decisions is the number of change requests related to the role. |
| **DR-171 Current Assignment Valid From** | A role's current assignment valid from — taken from the linked current assignment. |
| **DR-172 Is Non Human Held** | A role is considered a non human held if it is not the case that the current agent kind is “Human”. |
| **DR-173 Is Ungoverned Non Human Role** | A role is considered an ungoverned non human role if all of the following hold: the non human held flag is set and the no current holder flag is set. |
| **DR-174 Departed Assignment Count** | A role's departed assignment count is the number of role assignments related to the role. |
| **DR-175 Has Lost a Holder** | A role is considered to have a lost a holder if the departed assignment count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-176 Is Vacated Role** | A role is considered a vacated role if all of the following hold: the lost a holder flag is set and the no current holder flag is set. |
| **DR-177 Ungrounded Boundary Count** | A role's ungrounded boundary count is the number of authority boundaries related to the role. |
| **DR-178 Is Governed by Lapsed Authority** | A role is considered a governed by lapsed authority if the ungrounded boundary count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-179 Unescalated Refusal Count** | A role's unescalated refusal count is the number of send intents related to the role. |
| **DR-180 Unauthorized Enforcement Assignment Count** | A role's unauthorized enforcement assignment count is the number of role assignments related to the role. |
| **DR-181 Is Ungoverned Enforcement Role** | A role is considered an ungoverned enforcement role if the unauthorized enforcement assignment count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-182 Specialized Role Family** | A role's specialized role family — taken from the linked specializes role. |
| **DR-183 Specialization Count** | A role's specialization count is the number of roles related to the role. |
| **DR-184 Has Specializations** | A role is considered to have a specializations if the specialization count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-185 Is Senior Variant Not Specialization** | A role is considered a senior variant not specialization if all of the following hold: the seniority level is “Senior” and at least one of the following holds: the specializes role is blank or the specialized role family is not the role family. |
| **DR-186 Organization Type** | A role's organization type — taken from the linked organization. |
| **DR-187 Is Not Housed in Department** | A role is considered a not housed in department if the organization type is not “Department”. |
| **DR-188 Capability Tag Count** | A role's capability tag count is the number of role capability tags related to the role. |
| **DR-189 Compliance Review Tag Count** | A role's compliance review tag count is the number of the role's role capability tags that have a capability term of “vt-cap-compliance-review”. |
| **DR-190 Has Compliance Review Capability** | A role is considered to have compliance review capability if the compliance review tag count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-191 Role Mention Count** | A role's role mention count is the number of source term mentions related to the role. |
| **DR-192 Unresolved Role Mention Count** | A role's unresolved role mention count is the number of source term mentions related to the role. |
| **DR-193 Is Missed by Phrase Query** | A role is considered a missed by phrase query if the unresolved role mention count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-194 Current Holder Name** | A role's current holder name is the display name of the role's current agent. |
| **DR-195 Backup Role Holder** | A role's backup role holder is the current agent of the role's escalation backup role. |
| **DR-196 Has Escalation Backup** | A role is considered to have an escalation backup if the escalation backup role has a value. |
| **DR-197 Has Unfilled Escalation Backup** | A role is considered to have an unfilled escalation backup if all of the following hold: the escalation backup role has a value and the backup role holder is blank. |
| **DR-198 Release Approval Step Count** | A role's release approval step count is the number of the role's steps that are release approval gates. |
| **DR-199 Is Production Release Approver** | A role is considered a production release approver if the release approval step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-200 Approval Step Count** | A role's approval step count is the number of the role's steps that have a control kind of “Approval”. |
| **DR-201 Name** | A role assignment's name is computed as the role, followed by “ @ ”, followed by the valid from. |
| **DR-202 As of Instant** | A role assignment's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-203 Is Current** | A role assignment is considered current if all of the following hold: the valid from is at most the as of instant and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. |
| **DR-204 Current Agent Key** | The role assignment's current agent key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the agent, if the current flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-205 Is Currently Valid** | A role assignment is considered currently-valid if all of the following hold: the status is “Active” and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. |
| **DR-206 Agent Role Key** | The role assignment's agent role key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the agent, followed by “|”, followed by the role, if the currently valid flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-207 Has Departed** | A role assignment is considered to have departed if all of the following hold: the valid to has a value and the valid to is at most the as of instant. |
| **DR-208 Covers Now** | A role assignment is considered to cover a now if all of the following hold: the status is “Active”; the valid from is at most the as of instant; and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. |
| **DR-209 Role When Covering** | The role assignment's role when covering is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the role, if the covers now flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-210 Agent Kind** | A role assignment's agent kind — taken from the linked agent. |
| **DR-211 Is Non Human Assignment** | A role assignment is considered non-human-assignment if it is not the case that the agent kind is “Human”. |
| **DR-212 Predecessor Agent Kind** | A role assignment's predecessor agent kind — taken from the linked supersedes assignment. |
| **DR-213 Is Human to Non Human Handover** | A role assignment is considered a human to non human handover if all of the following hold: the predecessor agent kind is “Human” and the non human assignment flag is set. |
| **DR-214 Is Unauthorized Non Human Assignment** | A role assignment is considered unauthorized-non-human-assignment if all of the following hold: the non human assignment flag is set and the approving authority flag is not set. |
| **DR-215 Was Authorized by Change Request** | A role assignment is considered to have been authorized by change request if all of the following hold: the approving authority flag is set and the authorizing change request has a value. |
| **DR-216 Decision Count** | A role assignment's decision count is the number of agent decision records related to the role assignment. |
| **DR-217 Overridden Decision Count** | A role assignment's overridden decision count is the number of agent decision records related to the role assignment. |
| **DR-218 Override Rate Percent** | The role assignment's override rate percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the decision count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, the overridden decision count times 100 divided by the decision count. |
| **DR-219 Predecessor Override Rate Percent** | A role assignment's predecessor override rate percent — taken from the linked supersedes assignment. |
| **DR-220 Quality Regressed Vs Predecessor** | A role assignment is flagged quality regressed vs predecessor if all of the following hold: the supersedes assignment has a value and the override rate percent is greater than the predecessor override rate percent. |
| **DR-221 Departed Role Key** | The role assignment's departed role key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the role, if the departed flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-222 Predecessor Decision Count** | A role assignment's predecessor decision count — taken from the linked supersedes assignment. |
| **DR-223 Has Sufficient Sample** | A role assignment is considered to have a sufficient sample if the decision count is at least the minimum decisions for comparison. |
| **DR-224 Predecessor Has Sufficient Sample** | A role assignment is flagged predecessor has sufficient sample if the predecessor decision count is at least the minimum decisions for comparison. |
| **DR-225 Comparison is Evidentially Sound** | A role assignment is flagged comparison is evidentially sound if all of the following hold: the sufficient sample flag is set and the predecessor has sufficient sample flag is set. |
| **DR-226 Single Override Swing Percent** | The role assignment's single override swing percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 100 divided by the decision count, if the decision count is greater than 0;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-227 Quality Verdict is Unsupported** | A role assignment is flagged quality verdict is unsupported if all of the following hold: the comparison is evidentially sound flag is not set and the quality regressed vs predecessor flag is not set. |
| **DR-228 Is Unmeasured Automation Handover** | A role assignment is considered an unmeasured automation handover if all of the following hold: the human to non human handover flag is set and the comparison is evidentially sound flag is not set. |
| **DR-229 Error Correction Count** | A role assignment's error correction count is the number of agent decision records related to the role assignment. |
| **DR-230 Error Rate Percent** | The role assignment's error rate percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the error correction count times 100 divided by the decision count, if the decision count is greater than 0;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-231 Has Dated Authorization** | A role assignment is considered to have a dated authorization if all of the following hold: the approving authority role has a value and the authorization decided at has a value. |
| **DR-232 Days Since Authorization Review** | The role assignment's days since authorization review is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the authorization reviewed at to the as of instant, if the authorization reviewed at has a value;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the valid from to the as of instant. |
| **DR-233 Authorization is Overdue for Review** | A role assignment is flagged authorization is overdue for review if all of the following hold: the authorization review cadence days is greater than 0 and the days since authorization review is greater than the authorization review cadence days. |
| **DR-234 Is Standing Unreviewed Automation** | A role assignment is considered a standing unreviewed automation if all of the following hold: the covers now flag is set and all of the following hold: the non human assignment flag is set and the authorization is overdue for review flag is set. |
| **DR-235 Is Unconditioned Automation Handover** | A role assignment is considered an unconditioned automation handover if all of the following hold: the human to non human handover flag is set and the authorization review cadence days is 0. |
| **DR-236 Exceeds Tolerable Error Rate** | A role assignment is considered to exceed a tolerable error rate if all of the following hold: the max tolerable error rate percent is greater than 0 and the error rate percent is at least the max tolerable error rate percent. |
| **DR-237 Boundary Violation Count for Assignment** | A role assignment's boundary violation count for assignment is the number of agent decision records related to the role assignment. |
| **DR-238 Has Any Boundary Violation** | A role assignment is considered to have any boundary violation if the boundary violation count for assignment is greater than 0. |
| **DR-239 Has Ungrounded Governing Boundary** | A role assignment's has ungrounded governing boundary is true when the role assignment's role is a governed by lapsed authority. |
| **DR-240 Suspension Condition Met** | A role assignment is flagged suspension condition met if at least one of the following holds: the exceeds tolerable error rate flag is set or at least one of the following holds: the any boundary violation flag is set or the ungrounded governing boundary flag is set. |
| **DR-241 Is Operating Under Met Suspension Condition** | A role assignment is considered an operating under met suspension condition if all of the following hold: the suspension condition met flag is set and all of the following hold: the covers now flag is set and the non human assignment flag is set. |
| **DR-242 Has Declared Suspension Condition** | A role assignment is considered to have a declared suspension condition if the max tolerable error rate percent is greater than 0. |
| **DR-243 Has Approving Authority** | A role assignment is considered to have an approving authority if the approving authority role has a value. |
| **DR-244 Has Authorizing Change Request** | A role assignment is considered to have an authorizing change request if the authorizing change request has a value. |
| **DR-245 Is Unauthorized Enforcement Agent** | A role assignment is considered an unauthorized enforcement agent if all of the following hold: the enforcement role flag is set and the unauthorized non human assignment flag is set. |
| **DR-246 Governance Evidence Count** | A role assignment's governance evidence count is computed as the count of the following that hold: the approving authority flag is set and the authorizing change request flag is set. |
| **DR-247 Unauthorized Enforcement Role Key** | The role assignment's unauthorized enforcement role key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the role, if the unauthorized non human assignment flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-248 Scoped Version Status** | A role assignment's scoped version status — taken from the linked for procedure version. |
| **DR-249 Is Scoped to Retired Version** | A role assignment is considered a scoped to retired version if all of the following hold: the current flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the scoped version status is “Deprecated” or the scoped version status is “Archived”. |
| **DR-250 Predecessor Valid to** | A role assignment's predecessor valid to — taken from the linked supersedes assignment. |
| **DR-251 Predecessor Lacks Validity End** | A role assignment is flagged predecessor lacks validity end if all of the following hold: the supersedes assignment has a value and the predecessor valid to is blank. |
| **DR-252 Agent Version Key** | A role assignment's agent version key is the version or employment key of the role assignment's agent. |
| **DR-253 Agent Role Pair Key** | A role assignment's agent role pair key is computed as the agent, followed by “|”, followed by the role. |
| **DR-254 Is Open Ended** | A role assignment is considered open-ended if the valid to is blank. |
| **DR-255 Role Approval Step Count** | A role assignment's role approval step count — taken from the linked role. |
| **DR-256 Receives Approval Notices Now** | A role assignment is considered to receive an approval notices now if all of the following hold: the covers now flag is set and the role approval step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-257 Name** | A community of practice's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-258 Has Own Vocabulary and Norms** | A community of practice is considered to have an own vocabulary and norms if all of the following hold: the own vocabulary has a value and the norms has a value. |
| **DR-259 Sharing Event Count** | A community of practice's sharing event count is the number of knowledge transfers related to the community of practice. |
| **DR-260 Is Mandated Without Sharing Norm** | A community of practice is considered a mandated without sharing norm if all of the following hold: the origin has a value; the origin is not “Grassroots”; and the sharing event count is 0. |
| **DR-261 Interconnected Know How Count** | A community of practice's interconnected know how count is the number of the community of practice's know how carriers that build on same community know how. |
| **DR-262 Physical Know How Count** | A community of practice's physical know how count is the number of the community of practice's know how carriers that have a work medium of “Physical”. |
| **DR-263 Digital Know How Count** | A community of practice's digital know how count is the number of the community of practice's know how carriers that have a work medium of “Digital”. |
| **DR-264 Person Carried Know How Count** | A community of practice's person carried know how count is the number of the community of practice's know how carriers that have a carrier kind of “Person”. |
| **DR-265 Spans Physical and Digital With Humans** | A community of practice is considered to span a physical and digital with humans if all of the following hold: the physical know how count is greater than 0; the digital know how count is greater than 0; and the person carried know how count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-266 External Member Count** | A community of practice's external member count is the number of the community of practice's community memberships that are external members. |
| **DR-267 Specialist Member Count** | A community of practice's specialist member count is the number of the community of practice's community memberships that are specialists. |
| **DR-268 Employer Move Count** | A community of practice's employer move count is the number of the community of practice's knowledge transfers that have a channel of “EmployerChange”. |
| **DR-269 Is Cross Firm Practice Cluster** | A community of practice is considered a cross firm practice cluster if all of the following hold: the external member count is at least 2; the employer move count is at least 1; and the specialist member count is at least 1. |
| **DR-270 Recent Apprenticeship Count** | A community of practice's recent apprenticeship count is the number of the community of practice's mentorships that are recent apprenticeships. |
| **DR-271 Is Circulation Ending for Lack of Apprentices** | A community of practice is considered a circulation ending for lack of apprentices if all of the following hold: the employer move count is at least 1; the open apprenticeship places is greater than 0; and the recent apprenticeship count is 0. |
| **DR-272 Ambient Absorption Count** | A community of practice's ambient absorption count is the number of the community of practice's knowledge transfers that are ambient absorption by non practitioners. |
| **DR-273 Has Ambient Trade Know How** | A community of practice is considered to have an ambient trade know how if all of the following hold: the colocated trade flag is set and the ambient absorption count is at least 1. |
| **DR-274 Name** | A mentorship's name is computed as the mentor agent, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the learner agent. |
| **DR-275 As of Instant** | A mentorship's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-276 Is Active** | A mentorship is considered active if all of the following hold: the valid from has a value; the valid from is at most the as of instant; and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is at least the as of instant. |
| **DR-277 Days Since Started** | The mentorship's days since started is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 99999, if the valid from is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the valid from to the as of instant. |
| **DR-278 Is Recent Apprenticeship** | A mentorship is considered a recent apprenticeship if all of the following hold: the mentorship form is “Apprenticeship”; the days since started is at least 0; and the days since started is at most 1095. |
| **DR-279 Community Label** | A mentorship's community label — taken from the linked community of practice. |
| **DR-280 Name** | A procedure type's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-281 Narrower Type Count** | A procedure type's narrower type count is the number of procedure types related to the procedure type. |
| **DR-282 Has Narrower Types** | A procedure type is considered to have a narrower types if the narrower type count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-283 Is Detached From Taxonomy** | A procedure type is considered detached-from-taxonomy if all of the following hold: the taxonomy rank is not “FunctionalDomain” and the broader procedure type is blank. |
| **DR-284 Broader is Detached** | A procedure type's broader is detached is true when the procedure type's broader procedure type is detached from taxonomy. |
| **DR-285 Is Unreachable by Navigation** | A procedure type is considered an unreachable by navigation if at least one of the following holds: the detached from taxonomy flag is set or all of the following hold: the broader procedure type has a value and the broader is detached is true. |
| **DR-286 Member Count** | A procedure type's member count is the number of procedures related to the procedure type. |
| **DR-287 Members Lacking Distinction Count** | A procedure type's members lacking distinction count is the number of procedures related to the procedure type. |
| **DR-288 Is Arbitrary Grouping** | A procedure type is considered arbitrary-grouping if all of the following hold: the member count is greater than 0 and at least one of the following holds: the distinguishing facet is blank or the members lacking distinction count is the member count. |
| **DR-289 Name** | A procedure's name is the same as its title. |
| **DR-290 Execution Count** | A procedure's execution count is the total execution count across the procedure versions related to the procedure. |
| **DR-291 Is Template Instance** | A procedure is considered a template instance if the template procedure has a value. |
| **DR-292 Target Count** | A procedure's target count is the number of procedure targets related to the procedure. |
| **DR-293 Adoption Count** | A procedure's adoption count is the number of procedure adoptions related to the procedure. |
| **DR-294 Specified Step Total** | A procedure's specified step total is the total count of steps across the procedure versions related to the procedure. |
| **DR-295 Has No Explicit Steps** | A procedure is considered to have no explicit steps if the specified step total is 0. |
| **DR-296 Called by Step Count** | A procedure's called by step count is the number of steps related to the procedure. |
| **DR-297 Is Nested Procedure** | A procedure is considered a nested procedure if the called by step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-298 Failure Criterion Count** | A procedure's failure criterion count is the number of procedure outcome criteria related to the procedure. |
| **DR-299 Has No Failure Criterion** | A procedure is considered to have no failure criterion if the failure criterion count is 0. |
| **DR-300 Lens View Count** | A procedure's lens view count is the number of procedure lens views related to the procedure. |
| **DR-301 Privileges Single Stakeholder View** | A procedure is considered to privilege a single stakeholder view if the lens view count is 1. |
| **DR-302 Step Level View Count** | A procedure's step level view count is the number of procedure lens views related to the procedure. |
| **DR-303 Category Level View Count** | A procedure's category level view count is the number of procedure lens views related to the procedure. |
| **DR-304 Procedure Type Rank** | A procedure's procedure type rank is the taxonomy rank of the procedure's procedure type. |
| **DR-305 Procedure Type Definition** | A procedure's procedure type definition — taken from the linked procedure type. |
| **DR-306 Has Step and Category Resolutions** | A procedure is considered to have a step and category resolutions if all of the following hold: the specified step total is greater than 0 and the procedure type rank is “ProcessType”. |
| **DR-307 Is Missing Demanded Resolution** | A procedure is considered a missing demanded resolution if at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the step level view count is greater than 0 and the no explicit steps flag is set or all of the following hold: the category level view count is greater than 0 and at least one of the following holds: the procedure type is blank or the procedure type rank is not “ProcessType”. |
| **DR-308 Is Inconsistently Categorized** | A procedure is considered inconsistently-categorized if at least one of the following holds: the procedure type is blank; the procedure type rank is not “ProcessType”; or the procedure type definition is blank. |
| **DR-309 Strategic Alignment Count** | A procedure's strategic alignment count is the number of process strategic alignments related to the procedure. |
| **DR-310 Has No Stated Reason for Existing** | A procedure is considered to have no stated reason for existing if the strategic alignment count is 0. |
| **DR-311 Outcome Measure Count** | A procedure's outcome measure count is the number of process outcome measures related to the procedure. |
| **DR-312 Unlinked Measure Count** | A procedure's unlinked measure count is the number of the procedure's process outcome measures that are unlinked to business outcomes. |
| **DR-313 Measures Performance Without Business Link** | A procedure is considered to measure a performance without business link if all of the following hold: the outcome measure count is greater than 0 and the unlinked measure count is the outcome measure count. |
| **DR-314 Hindered by Count** | A procedure's hindered by count is the number of process interdependencies related to the procedure. |
| **DR-315 Is Hindered by Another Operation** | A procedure is considered a hindered by another operation if the hindered by count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-316 Type Distinguishing Facet** | A procedure's type distinguishing facet — taken from the linked procedure type. |
| **DR-317 Type Distinguishing Value** | A procedure's type distinguishing value — taken from the linked procedure type. |
| **DR-318 Matching Distinction Count** | A procedure's matching distinction count is the number of procedure facet assignments related to the procedure. |
| **DR-319 Lacks Type Distinction** | A procedure is considered to lack a type distinction if all of the following hold: the procedure type has a value and the matching distinction count is 0. |
| **DR-320 Lacks Distinction Type Key** | The procedure's lacks distinction type key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure type, if the lacks type distinction flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-321 Managed Vocabulary Count** | A procedure's managed vocabulary count is the number of vocabularies related to the procedure. |
| **DR-322 Lacks Managed Controlled Vocabulary** | A procedure is considered to lack managed controlled vocabulary if all of the following hold: the specified step total is greater than 0 and the managed vocabulary count is 0. |
| **DR-323 Compliance Review Step Count** | A procedure's compliance review step count is the number of steps related to the procedure. |
| **DR-324 Involves Compliance Review Role** | A procedure is considered to involve a compliance review role if the compliance review step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-325 Is Regulated But Unformalized** | A procedure is considered regulated-but-unformalized if all of the following hold: the required by regulation has a value and the no explicit steps flag is set. |
| **DR-326 Agent Intended Count** | A procedure's agent intended count is the number of the procedure's ai adoption initiatives that are agentic. |
| **DR-327 Is Tacit Only Agent Target** | A procedure is considered a tacit only agent target if all of the following hold: the agent intended count is greater than 0 and the no explicit steps flag is set. |
| **DR-328 Repository Entry Count** | A procedure's repository entry count is the number of knowledge repository entries related to the procedure. |
| **DR-329 Stale Entry Count** | A procedure's stale entry count is the number of the procedure's knowledge repository entries that are stales. |
| **DR-330 Departed Only Know How Count** | A procedure's departed only know how count is the number of the procedure's know how carriers that are held-only-by-departed. |
| **DR-331 Has Decayed Transfer Channel** | A procedure is considered to have a decayed transfer channel if at least one of the following holds: the stale entry count is greater than 0 or the departed only know how count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-332 Execution Feedback Entry Count** | A procedure's execution feedback entry count is the number of the procedure's knowledge repository entries that are execution feedbacks. |
| **DR-333 Is Executed Without Feedback Loop** | A procedure is considered an executed without feedback loop if all of the following hold: the execution count is greater than 0 and the execution feedback entry count is 0. |
| **DR-334 Machine Authored Entry Count** | A procedure's machine authored entry count is the number of the procedure's knowledge repository entries that are machine-authored. |
| **DR-335 Practitioner Relationship Count** | A procedure's practitioner relationship count is the number of source relationships related to the procedure. |
| **DR-336 Is Captured by Automation Alone** | A procedure is considered a captured by automation alone if all of the following hold: the machine authored entry count is greater than 0 and the practitioner relationship count is 0. |
| **DR-337 Unengaged Stakeholder Count** | A procedure's unengaged stakeholder count is the number of the procedure's department process accounts that are awaiting-engagement. |
| **DR-338 Has Unengaged Stakeholder** | A procedure is considered to have an unengaged stakeholder if the unengaged stakeholder count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-339 Recent Starter Count** | A procedure's recent starter count is the number of the procedure's onboarding records that are recent starts. |
| **DR-340 Untransferred Veteran Know How Count** | A procedure's untransferred veteran know how count is the number of the procedure's know how carriers that are untransferred veteran know hows. |
| **DR-341 Departing Veteran Know How Count** | A procedure's departing veteran know how count is the number of the procedure's know how carriers that are at-risk-of-imminent-loss. |
| **DR-342 Has Transfer Shortfall Exposure** | A procedure is considered to have a transfer shortfall exposure if at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the recent starter count is at least 3 and the untransferred veteran know how count is greater than 0 or the departing veteran know how count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-343 Proficient With Capture Count** | A procedure's proficient with capture count is the number of the procedure's onboarding records that are proficient and are used captured knowledge. |
| **DR-344 Proficient Without Capture Count** | A procedure's proficient without capture count is the number of the procedure's onboarding records that are proficient and are not used captured knowledge. |
| **DR-345 Days With Capture Total** | A procedure's days with capture total is the total days to proficiency across the procedure's onboarding records that are proficient and are used captured knowledge. |
| **DR-346 Days Without Capture Total** | A procedure's days without capture total is the total days to proficiency across the procedure's onboarding records that are proficient and are not used captured knowledge. |
| **DR-347 Avg Days to Proficiency With Capture** | The procedure's avg days to proficiency with capture is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the proficient with capture count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, the days with capture total divided by the proficient with capture count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). |
| **DR-348 Avg Days to Proficiency Without Capture** | The procedure's avg days to proficiency without capture is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the proficient without capture count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, the days without capture total divided by the proficient without capture count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). |
| **DR-349 Formalization Does Not Ease Onboarding** | A procedure is flagged formalization does not ease onboarding if all of the following hold: the proficient with capture count is greater than 0; the proficient without capture count is greater than 0; and the avg days to proficiency with capture is at least the avg days to proficiency without capture. |
| **DR-350 Collected Material Count** | A procedure's collected material count is the number of collected source materials related to the procedure. |
| **DR-351 In Work Capture Count** | A procedure's in work capture count is the number of the procedure's collected source materials that are captured in flow of works. |
| **DR-352 Is Capture Separate From Work** | A procedure is considered a capture separate from work if all of the following hold: the collected material count is greater than 0 and the in work capture count is 0. |
| **DR-353 Expert Acquisition Hours** | A procedure's expert acquisition hours is the total expert effort hours across the collected source materials related to the procedure. |
| **DR-354 Compliance Document Count** | A procedure's compliance document count is the number of resources related to the procedure. |
