| **DR-355 Name** | A procedure version's name is the same as its title. |
| **DR-356 Count of Steps** | A procedure version's count of steps is the number of steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-357 Count of Open Knowledge Gaps** | A procedure version's count of open knowledge gaps is the number of the procedure version's knowledge gaps that have a status of “Open”. |
| **DR-358 Is Ready for Execution** | A procedure version is considered a ready for execution if all of the following hold: the status is “Approved”; the count of steps is greater than 0; and the count of open knowledge gaps is 0. |
| **DR-359 Specified Step Count** | A procedure version's specified step count is the number of steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-360 Overdue Review Count** | A procedure version's overdue review count is the number of review events related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-361 Open Change Request Count** | A procedure version's open change request count is the number of change requests related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-362 Open High Severity Gap Count** | A procedure version's open high severity gap count is the number of knowledge gaps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-363 Is Fit to Execute** | A procedure version is considered a fit to execute if all of the following hold: the status is “Approved”; the overdue review count is 0; the open change request count is 0; and the open high severity gap count is 0. |
| **DR-364 Steward Review Cadence Days** | A procedure version's steward review cadence days is the total review cadence days across the stewardship assignments related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-365 Count of Stewardship Assignments** | A procedure version's count of stewardship assignments is the number of stewardship assignments related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-366 Has Any Steward** | A procedure version is considered to have any steward if the count of stewardship assignments is greater than 0. |
| **DR-367 Is Live** | A procedure version is considered live if at least one of the following holds: the status is “Approved” or the status is “Published”. |
| **DR-368 Is Unstewarded** | A procedure version is considered unstewarded if the any steward flag is not set. |
| **DR-369 Is Live and Unstewarded** | A procedure version is considered live-and-unstewarded if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the unstewarded flag is set. |
| **DR-370 Count of Open Blocking Gaps** | A procedure version's count of open blocking gaps is the number of knowledge gaps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-371 Has Open Blocking Gap** | A procedure version is considered to have an open blocking gap if the count of open blocking gaps is greater than 0. |
| **DR-372 Is Live With Blocking Gap** | A procedure version is considered a live with blocking gap if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the open blocking gap flag is set. |
| **DR-373 Should Not Be Executable** | A procedure version is considered to require not be executable if all of the following hold: the ready for execution flag is set and the open blocking gap flag is set. |
| **DR-374 Count of Unapproved Reliance Fragments** | A procedure version's count of unapproved reliance fragments is the number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-375 Runs on Unapproved Knowledge** | A procedure version is considered to run on unapproved knowledge if the count of unapproved reliance fragments is greater than 0. |
| **DR-376 Count of Overdue Gaps** | A procedure version's count of overdue gaps is the number of knowledge gaps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-377 Count of Change Requests** | A procedure version's count of change requests is the number of change requests related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-378 Count of Review Events** | A procedure version's count of review events is the number of review events related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-379 Has Governance Record** | A procedure version is considered to have a governance record if at least one of the following holds: the count of change requests is greater than 0 or the count of review events is greater than 0. |
| **DR-380 As of Instant** | A procedure version's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-381 Days Since Modified** | A procedure version's days since modified is computed as the number of days from the modified at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-382 Days Since Last Review** | A procedure version's days since last review is an aggregated value computed across the procedure version's related records. |
| **DR-383 Was Modified Since Last Review** | A procedure version is considered to have been modified since last review if the days since modified is less than the days since last review. |
| **DR-384 Modifier is Authority** | A procedure version's modifier is authority is the agent kind of the procedure version's modified by agent. |
| **DR-385 Has Unwitnessed Change** | A procedure version is considered to have an unwitnessed change if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the was modified since last review flag is set. |
| **DR-386 Count of Stale Fragments** | A procedure version's count of stale fragments is the number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-387 Knowledge is Staler Than Cadence** | A procedure version is flagged knowledge is staler than cadence if the count of stale fragments is greater than 0. |
| **DR-388 Compound Fragile Fragment Count** | A procedure version's compound fragile fragment count is the number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-389 Rests on Compound Fragile Knowledge** | A procedure version is considered to rest on compound fragile knowledge if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the compound fragile fragment count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-390 Concentrated Witness Session Count** | A procedure version's concentrated witness session count is the number of elicitation sessions related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-391 Knowledge Base is Concentrated** | A procedure version is flagged knowledge base is concentrated if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the concentrated witness session count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-392 Machine Consumed Unapproved Count** | A procedure version's machine consumed unapproved count is the number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-393 Feeds Unapproved Knowledge to Machines** | A procedure version is considered to feed an unapproved knowledge to machines if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the machine consumed unapproved count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-394 Genuinely Overdue Fragment Count** | A procedure version's genuinely overdue fragment count is the number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-395 Awaited Decision Count** | A procedure version's awaited decision count is the number of change requests related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-396 Scoped Open Blocking Gap Count** | A procedure version's scoped open blocking gap count is the number of knowledge gaps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-397 Is Blocked on Pending Decision** | A procedure version is considered a blocked on pending decision if all of the following hold: the awaited decision count is greater than 0 and the scoped open blocking gap count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-398 Unexercised Human Gate Count** | A procedure version's unexercised human gate count is the number of steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-399 Ai Boundary is Unevidenced** | A procedure version is flagged ai boundary is unevidenced if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the unexercised human gate count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-400 Load Bearing Unapproved Count** | A procedure version's load bearing unapproved count is the number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-401 Unlanded Decision Count** | A procedure version's unlanded decision count is the number of change requests related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-402 Unrehearsed Control Entry Count** | A procedure version's unrehearsed control entry count is the number of step transitions related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-403 Has Unrehearsed Control Entry** | A procedure version is considered to have unrehearsed control entry if the unrehearsed control entry count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-404 Is Live With Unrehearsed Control** | A procedure version is considered a live with unrehearsed control if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the unrehearsed control entry flag is set. |
| **DR-405 Cadence Breach Count** | A procedure version's cadence breach count is the number of review events related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-406 Is in Cadence Breach** | A procedure version is considered in-cadence-breach if the cadence breach count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-407 Has Decision in Flight** | A procedure version is considered to have a decision in flight if the open change request count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-408 Is Unremediated Cadence Breach** | A procedure version is considered an unremediated cadence breach if all of the following hold: the in cadence breach flag is set and the decision in flight flag is not set. |
| **DR-409 Is Managed Cadence Breach** | A procedure version is considered a managed cadence breach if all of the following hold: the in cadence breach flag is set and the decision in flight flag is set. |
| **DR-410 Governance is Silent** | A procedure version is flagged governance is silent if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the governance record flag is not set. |
| **DR-411 Valid Fragment Count** | A procedure version's valid fragment count is the number of knowledge fragments related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-412 Still Owns Valid Knowledge** | A procedure version is flagged still owns valid knowledge if the valid fragment count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-413 Incoming Supersession Count** | A procedure version's incoming supersession count is the number of procedure version links related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-414 Is Still Referenced** | A procedure version is considered still-referenced if the incoming supersession count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-415 Is Load Bearing Orphan** | A procedure version is considered a load bearing orphan if all of the following hold: the unstewarded flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the still owns valid knowledge flag is set or the still referenced flag is set. |
| **DR-416 Is Cleanly Retired** | A procedure version is considered cleanly-retired if all of the following hold: the unstewarded flag is set; the still owns valid knowledge flag is not set; and the still referenced flag is not set. |
| **DR-417 Stalled Implementation Count** | A procedure version's stalled implementation count is the number of change requests related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-418 Is Held Unfit by Landed Decisions** | A procedure version is considered a held unfit by landed decisions if all of the following hold: the fit to execute flag is not set and the stalled implementation count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-419 Undeclared Control Kind Count** | A procedure version's undeclared control kind count is the number of steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-420 Control Taxonomy is Incomplete** | A procedure version is flagged control taxonomy is incomplete if the undeclared control kind count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-421 Has Approved Change Request** | A procedure version is considered to have an approved change request if the approved change request count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-422 Approved Change Request Count** | A procedure version's approved change request count is the number of change requests related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-423 Unwatched Unowned Control Count** | A procedure version's unwatched unowned control count is the number of requirements related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-424 Mining Run Count** | A procedure version's mining run count is the number of process mining runs related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-425 Drifted Mining Run Count** | A procedure version's drifted mining run count is the number of process mining runs related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-426 Has Unresolved Mining Drift** | A procedure version is considered to have an unresolved mining drift if the drifted mining run count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-427 Entry Step ID** | A procedure version's entry step ID is the largest entry step key across the steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-428 Execution Count** | A procedure version's execution count is the number of procedure executions related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-429 Status is Pko** | A procedure version's status is pko when the linked status is a pko status. |
| **DR-430 Uses Non Pko Status** | A procedure version is considered to use a non pko status if the status is pko is false. |
| **DR-431 Exception Count** | A procedure version's exception count is the number of exceptions related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-432 Fallback Transition Count** | A procedure version's fallback transition count is the number of the procedure version's step transitions that have a transition kind of “Fallback”. |
| **DR-433 Alternative Transition Count** | A procedure version's alternative transition count is the number of the procedure version's step transitions that have a transition kind of “Alternative”. |
| **DR-434 Has No Exception Handling** | A procedure version is considered to have no exception handling if all of the following hold: the count of steps is greater than 0; the exception count is 0; the fallback transition count is 0; and the alternative transition count is 0. |
| **DR-435 Latest Source Document Modified At** | A procedure version's latest source document modified at is the largest resource modified at across the procedure resources related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-436 Days Document Trails Version** | The procedure version's days document trails version is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the latest source document modified at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the latest source document modified at to the modified at. |
| **DR-437 Document Lags Practice** | A procedure version is flagged document lags practice if all of the following hold: the latest source document modified at has a value and the days document trails version is greater than 60. |
| **DR-438 Human Step Count** | A procedure version's human step count is the number of the procedure version's steps that have a assigned agent kind of “Human”. |
| **DR-439 Non Human Step Count** | A procedure version's non human step count is computed as the count of steps minus the human step count. |
| **DR-440 Mixes Human and Software Steps** | A procedure version is considered to mixe a human and software steps if all of the following hold: the human step count is greater than 0 and the non human step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-441 Day Run Count** | A procedure version's day run count is the number of the procedure version's procedure executions that have a shift of “Day”. |
| **DR-442 Night Run Count** | A procedure version's night run count is the number of the procedure version's procedure executions that have a shift of “Night”. |
| **DR-443 Day Deviating Run Count** | A procedure version's day deviating run count is the number of procedure executions related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-444 Night Deviating Run Count** | A procedure version's night deviating run count is the number of procedure executions related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-445 Is Inconsistent Across Shifts** | A procedure version is considered an inconsistent across shifts if all of the following hold: the day run count is greater than 0; the night run count is greater than 0; and at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the day deviating run count is 0 and the night deviating run count is greater than 0 or all of the following hold: the day deviating run count is greater than 0 and the night deviating run count is 0. |
| **DR-446 Overlaps Relation Count** | A procedure version's overlaps relation count is the number of activity relations related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-447 Enables Relation Count** | A procedure version's enables relation count is the number of activity relations related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-448 Prevents Relation Count** | A procedure version's prevents relation count is the number of activity relations related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-449 Steps Without Ontology Type Count** | A procedure version's steps without ontology type count is the number of steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-450 Rests on Notation Only** | A procedure version is considered to rest on notation only if the steps without ontology type count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-451 Is Current Without Motivation** | A procedure version is considered a current without motivation if all of the following hold: the current flag is set and the new version motivation is blank. |
| **DR-452 Conditionless Step Count** | A procedure version's conditionless step count is the number of steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-453 Is Under Specified for Execution** | A procedure version is considered an under specified for execution if at least one of the following holds: the count of steps is 0; the conditionless step count is the count of steps; or the no exception handling flag is set. |
| **DR-454 Coarse Top Level Step Count** | A procedure version's coarse top level step count is the number of steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-455 Fine Top Level Step Count** | A procedure version's fine top level step count is the number of steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-456 Mixes Granularity At One Level** | A procedure version is considered to mixe a granularity at one level if all of the following hold: the coarse top level step count is greater than 0 and the fine top level step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-457 Procedure Type of Version** | A procedure version's procedure type of version — taken from the linked procedure. |
| **DR-458 Created by Agent Kind** | A procedure version's created by agent kind — taken from the linked created by agent. |
| **DR-459 Elicitation Session Count** | A procedure version's elicitation session count is the number of elicitation sessions related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-460 Expert Capture Count** | A procedure version's expert capture count is the number of the procedure version's authoring submissions that have a submitter expertise of “DomainExpert”. |
| **DR-461 Elicitation Evidence Count** | A procedure version's elicitation evidence count is computed as the elicitation session count plus the expert capture count. |
| **DR-462 Indexed Segment Count** | A procedure version's indexed segment count is the number of the procedure version's retrieval segments that are indexed. |
| **DR-463 Search Count** | A procedure version's search count is the number of knowledge search events related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-464 Successful Search Count** | A procedure version's successful search count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge search events that are not found nothing useful. |
| **DR-465 Search Success Percent** | The procedure version's search success percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the search count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, 100 times the successful search count divided by the search count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). |
| **DR-466 Open Question Annotation Count** | A procedure version's open question annotation count is the number of the procedure version's model annotations that have a annotation kind of “Question” and have a status of “Open”. |
| **DR-467 Is Inadequate for Use** | A procedure version is considered an inadequate for use if at least one of the following holds: the indexed segment count is 0; all of the following hold: the search count is greater than 0 and the search success percent is less than 50; or the open question annotation count is at least 2. |
| **DR-468 Served Assertion Count** | A procedure version's served assertion count is the number of snapshot assertions related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-469 Lacks Machine Interpretable Encoding** | A procedure version is considered to lack machine interpretable encoding if all of the following hold: the current flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the indexed segment count is 0 or the served assertion count is 0. |
| **DR-470 Structured Query Count** | A procedure version's structured query count is the number of knowledge query definitions related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-471 Profile Validated Submission Count** | A procedure version's profile validated submission count is the number of the procedure version's authoring submissions that are profile validation passed. |
| **DR-472 Reasoned Assertion Count** | A procedure version's reasoned assertion count is the number of the procedure version's snapshot assertions that are snapshot is reasoned. |
| **DR-473 Is Not Query Validate Reason Ready** | A procedure version is considered not-query-validate-reason-ready if all of the following hold: the current flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the structured query count is 0; the profile validated submission count is 0; or the reasoned assertion count is 0. |
| **DR-474 Published Projection Count** | A procedure version's published projection count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge projections that are published. |
| **DR-475 Consumer Sync Count** | A procedure version's consumer sync count is the number of consumer system syncs related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-476 Is Unreachable Knowledge** | A procedure version is considered an unreachable knowledge if all of the following hold: the current flag is set; the published projection count is 0; and the consumer sync count is 0. |
| **DR-477 Human Sync Count** | A procedure version's human sync count is the number of the procedure version's consumer system syncs that reache a humans. |
| **DR-478 Machine Sync Count** | A procedure version's machine sync count is the number of the procedure version's consumer system syncs that reache a machines. |
| **DR-479 Human Channel Count** | A procedure version's human channel count is computed as the published projection count plus the human sync count. |
| **DR-480 Machine Channel Count** | A procedure version's machine channel count is computed as the machine sync count plus the served assertion count. |
| **DR-481 Serves Only Humans or Only Machines** | A procedure version is considered to serve an only humans or only machines if all of the following hold: the current flag is set; the human channel count plus the machine channel count is greater than 0; and at least one of the following holds: the human channel count is 0 or the machine channel count is 0. |
| **DR-482 Fresh Mining Run Count** | A procedure version's fresh mining run count is the number of the procedure version's process mining runs that are not stale mining evidences. |
| **DR-483 Lacks Continuous Drift Detection** | A procedure version is considered to lack a continuous drift detection if all of the following hold: the current flag is set; the execution count is greater than 0; and the fresh mining run count is 0. |
| **DR-484 Outcome Measurement Count** | A procedure version's outcome measurement count is the number of knowledge outcome measurements related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-485 Is Disconnected From Outcomes** | A procedure version is considered a disconnected from outcomes if all of the following hold: the current flag is set; the execution count is greater than 0; and the outcome measurement count is 0. |
| **DR-486 Ai Contribution Count** | A procedure version's ai contribution count is the number of ai insight proposals related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-487 Ai Consumption Count** | A procedure version's ai consumption count is computed as the served assertion count plus the indexed segment count. |
| **DR-488 Uses Ai in One Direction Only** | A procedure version is considered to use an ai in one direction only if at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the ai contribution count is greater than 0 and the ai consumption count is 0 or all of the following hold: the ai contribution count is 0 and the ai consumption count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-489 Is Unmodified for Twelve Months** | A procedure version is considered an unmodified for twelve months if all of the following hold: the current flag is set and the days since modified is greater than 365. |
| **DR-490 Design Decision Count** | A procedure version's design decision count is the number of process design decisions related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-491 Is Live Without Recorded Decisions** | A procedure version is considered a live without recorded decisions if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the design decision count is 0. |
| **DR-492 Ai Artifact Consuming Input Count** | A procedure version's ai artifact consuming input count is the number of the procedure version's step variables that are input from ai artifacts. |
| **DR-493 Contains Steps Affected by Ai Agent Change** | A procedure version is considered to contain a steps affected by ai agent change if the ai artifact consuming input count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-494 Interview Session Count** | A procedure version's interview session count is the number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that have a elicitation mode of “Interview”. |
| **DR-495 Observation Session Count** | A procedure version's observation session count is the number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that have a elicitation mode of “Observation”. |
| **DR-496 Workshop Session Count** | A procedure version's workshop session count is the number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that have a elicitation mode of “Workshop”. |
| **DR-497 Protocol Session Count** | A procedure version's protocol session count is the number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that have a elicitation mode of “Protocol”. |
| **DR-498 Incident Session Count** | A procedure version's incident session count is the number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that have a elicitation mode of “Incident”. |
| **DR-499 Reconciled Divergence Count** | A procedure version's reconciled divergence count is the number of the procedure version's workflow view divergences that are reconciled. |
| **DR-500 Complementary Method Count** | A procedure version's complementary method count is computed as the count of the following that hold: the interview session count is greater than 0; the observation session count is greater than 0; the workshop session count is greater than 0; the protocol session count is greater than 0; and the incident session count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-501 Relies on Single Method** | A procedure version is considered to relie on single method if the complementary method count is 1. |
| **DR-502 Misses a Required Elicitation Mode** | A procedure version is considered to misse a required elicitation mode if all of the following hold: the complementary method count is greater than 0 and at least one of the following holds: the workshop session count is 0; the interview session count is 0; the observation session count is 0; or the reconciled divergence count is 0. |
| **DR-503 Critical Incident Count** | A procedure version's critical incident count is the number of critical incidents related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-504 Judgment Unprobed by Incidents** | A procedure version is flagged judgment unprobed by incidents if all of the following hold: the tacit judgment fragment count is greater than 0 and the critical incident count is 0. |
| **DR-505 Sme Approval Count** | A procedure version's sme approval count is the number of the procedure version's representation reviews that are reviewer is affected sme; have a review purpose of “RepresentationApproval”; and have a decision of “Approved”. |
| **DR-506 Sme Ai Evaluation Count** | A procedure version's sme ai evaluation count is the number of the procedure version's representation reviews that are reviewer is affected sme and have a review purpose of “AiEvaluation”. |
| **DR-507 Is Approved Without Sme Signoff** | A procedure version is considered an approved without sme signoff if all of the following hold: the status is “Approved” and the sme approval count is 0. |
| **DR-508 Experts Evaluate Ai Not Representation** | A procedure version is considered to expert an evaluate ai not representation if all of the following hold: the sme ai evaluation count is greater than 0 and the sme approval count is 0. |
| **DR-509 Ke Session Count** | A procedure version's ke session count is the number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that are facilitator is knowledge engineer. |
| **DR-510 Ke Field Session Count** | A procedure version's ke field session count is the number of the procedure version's elicitation sessions that are ke field sessions. |
| **DR-511 Is Studied Only From the Desk** | A procedure version is considered a studied only from the desk if all of the following hold: the ke session count is greater than 0 and the ke field session count is 0. |
| **DR-512 Judgment Held Outside Sop Count** | A procedure version's judgment held outside sop count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge holdings that are judgment outside documents. |
| **DR-513 Tacit Holding Count** | A procedure version's tacit holding count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge holdings that have a knowledge form of “Tacit”. |
| **DR-514 Explicit Holding Count** | A procedure version's explicit holding count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge holdings that have a knowledge form of “Explicit”. |
| **DR-515 Tacit Share Exceeds Explicit** | A procedure version is flagged tacit share exceeds explicit if the tacit holding count is greater than the explicit holding count. |
| **DR-516 Hands Held Count** | A procedure version's hands held count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge holdings that are unformalized process knowledges and have a carrier of “OperatorMemory”. |
| **DR-517 Negotiated Practice Count** | A procedure version's negotiated practice count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge holdings that are unformalized process knowledges and have a carrier of “UnspokenCrewAgreement”. |
| **DR-518 Lives in Hands Silence and Negotiation** | A procedure version is considered to live in hands silence and negotiation if all of the following hold: the hands held count is greater than 0; the judgment held outside sop count is greater than 0; and the negotiated practice count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-519 Process Model Trace Count** | A procedure version's process model trace count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge traces that have a target kind of “ProcessModel” and have a trace role of “Origin”. |
| **DR-520 Is Live Model Untraced** | A procedure version is considered live-model-untraced if all of the following hold: the live flag is set and the process model trace count is 0. |
| **DR-521 Trailing Practice Trace Count** | A procedure version's trailing practice trace count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge traces that are document trailing practices. |
| **DR-522 Is Documented Behind Practice** | A procedure version is considered a documented behind practice if the trailing practice trace count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-523 Tacit Fragment Count** | A procedure version's tacit fragment count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge fragments that have a knowledge form of “Tacit”. |
| **DR-524 Is Standardized Without Tacit Capture** | A procedure version is considered a standardized without tacit capture if all of the following hold: the standardization driver is “Compliance” and the tacit fragment count is 0. |
| **DR-525 Tacit Form Fragment Count** | A procedure version's tacit form fragment count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge fragments that have a knowledge form of “Tacit”. |
| **DR-526 Situated Judgment Fragment Count** | A procedure version's situated judgment fragment count is the number of the procedure version's knowledge fragments that have a knowledge form of “SituatedJudgment”. |
| **DR-527 Tacit Judgment Fragment Count** | A procedure version's tacit judgment fragment count is computed as the tacit form fragment count plus the situated judgment fragment count. |
| **DR-528 First Step** | A procedure version's first step is the largest declared first step key across the steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-529 Fallback Step** | A procedure version's fallback step is the largest declared fallback step key across the steps related to the procedure version. |
| **DR-530 First Step Disagrees With Graph** | A procedure version is flagged first step disagrees with graph if all of the following hold: the declared first step count is greater than 0; the graph entry step count is greater than 0; and the first step is not the entry step ID. |
| **DR-531 Declared First Step Count** | A procedure version's declared first step count is the number of the procedure version's steps that are declared first steps. |
| **DR-532 Graph Entry Step Count** | A procedure version's graph entry step count is the number of the procedure version's steps that are entry steps. |
| **DR-533 Owner Organization** | A procedure version's owner organization — taken from the linked procedure. |
| **DR-534 Name** | A procedure version link's name is computed as the previous procedure version, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the next procedure version. |
| **DR-535 Superseded Version Key** | The procedure version link's superseded version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the previous procedure version, if the relation iri is “https://w3id.org/pko#nextVersion”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-536 Name** | A procedure status change's name is computed as the procedure version, followed by “: ”, followed by the from status, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the to status. |
| **DR-537 Is Unattributed Change** | A procedure status change is considered an unattributed change if the changed by agent is blank. |
| **DR-538 Change Kind Contradicts Target** | A procedure status change is flagged change kind contradicts target if at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the change kind is “Approve” and the to status is not “Approved”; all of the following hold: the change kind is “Validate” and the to status is not “Validation”; or all of the following hold: the change kind is “Archive”; the to status is not “Archived”; and the to status is not “Deprecated”. |
| **DR-539 Name** | A step's name is computed as the step number, followed by “. ”, followed by the title. |
| **DR-540 Assigned Role Label** | A step's assigned role label — taken from the linked assigned role. |
| **DR-541 Assigned Agent Kind** | A step's assigned agent kind is the current agent kind of the step's assigned role. |
| **DR-542 Blocking Requirement Count** | A step's blocking requirement count is the number of step requirements related to the step. |
| **DR-543 Stale Binding Count** | A step's stale binding count is the number of operational bindings related to the step. |
| **DR-544 Authoritative Stale Count** | A step's authoritative stale count is the number of operational bindings related to the step. |
| **DR-545 Available Exception Count** | A step's available exception count is the number of exceptions related to the step. |
| **DR-546 Declared Verification Count** | A step's declared verification count is the number of step verifications related to the step. |
| **DR-547 Is Preparation Step** | A step is considered a preparation step if at least one of the following holds: the assigned role is “finance-analyst” or the assigned role is “variance-review-agent”. |
| **DR-548 Is Approval Step** | A step is considered an approval step if at least one of the following holds: the assigned role is “controller” or the assigned role is “cfo”. |
| **DR-549 Stale Authoritative Binding Count** | A step's stale authoritative binding count is the number of operational bindings related to the step. |
| **DR-550 Inputs are Fresh** | A step is considered to input are fresh if the stale authoritative binding count is 0. |
| **DR-551 Is Software Assigned** | A step is considered software-assigned if at least one of the following holds: the assigned agent kind is “AIAgent” or the assigned agent kind is “AutomatedPipeline”. |
| **DR-552 Is Human Approval Gate** | A step is considered a human approval gate if all of the following hold: the software assigned flag is not set and at least one of the following holds: the step ID is “policy-05” or the step ID is “close-06”. |
| **DR-553 Gate Held by Human** | A step is flagged gate held by human if all of the following hold: the human approval gate flag is set and the assigned agent kind is “Human”. |
| **DR-554 Binding Boundary Count** | A step's binding boundary count is the number of authority boundaries related to the step. |
| **DR-555 Assigned Role is Ungoverned** | A step's assigned role is ungoverned is true when the step's assigned role is an ungoverned non human role. |
| **DR-556 Unusable Binding Count** | A step's unusable binding count is the number of operational bindings related to the step. |
| **DR-557 All Sources Usable** | A step is flagged all sources usable if the unusable binding count is 0. |
| **DR-558 Unwarranted Boundary Count** | A step's unwarranted boundary count is the number of authority boundaries related to the step. |
| **DR-559 Is Governed by Unwarranted Boundary** | A step is considered governed-by-unwarranted-boundary if the unwarranted boundary count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-560 Software Execution Count** | A step's software execution count is the number of step executions related to the step. |
| **DR-561 Has Been Approached by Software** | A step is considered to have a been approached by software if the software execution count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-562 Is Unexercised Human Gate** | A step is considered an unexercised human gate if all of the following hold: the human approval gate flag is set and the been approached by software flag is not set. |
| **DR-563 Is Demonstrated Human Gate** | A step is considered a demonstrated human gate if all of the following hold: the human approval gate flag is set; the been approached by software flag is set; and the gate held by human flag is set. |
| **DR-564 Unexercised Gate Version Key** | The step's unexercised gate version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the unexercised human gate flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-565 Has Declared Control Kind** | A step is considered to have a declared control kind if the control kind has a value. |
| **DR-566 Undeclared Control Version Key** | The step's undeclared control version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. an empty string, if the declared control kind flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, the procedure version. |
| **DR-567 Approval Step is Software Assigned** | A step is flagged approval step is software assigned if all of the following hold: the control kind is “Approval” and the software assigned flag is set. |
| **DR-568 Unwitnessed Blocking Count** | A step's unwitnessed blocking count is the number of step requirements related to the step. |
| **DR-569 Reachable Step Count** | A step's reachable step count is the number of vw step transitions closure related to the step. |
| **DR-570 Reached From Step Count** | A step's reached from step count is the number of vw step transitions closure related to the step. |
| **DR-571 Self Reach Count** | A step's self reach count is the number of vw step transitions closure related to the step. |
| **DR-572 Is on Rework Loop** | A step is considered on-rework-loop if the self reach count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-573 Is Blocking Control on Rework Loop** | A step is considered a blocking control on rework loop if all of the following hold: the on rework loop flag is set and the blocking requirement count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-574 Incoming Transition Count** | A step's incoming transition count is the number of step transitions related to the step. |
| **DR-575 Is Entry Step** | A step is considered an entry step if the incoming transition count is 0. |
| **DR-576 Entry Step Key** | The step's entry step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step ID, if the entry step flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-577 Version Entry Step ID** | A step's version entry step ID — taken from the linked procedure version. |
| **DR-578 Gate Free Reach From Entry Count** | A step's gate free reach from entry count is the number of vw step transitions closure where avoids human approval gate related to the step. |
| **DR-579 Is Reachable From Entry Without Human Gate** | A step is considered a reachable from entry without human gate if the gate free reach from entry count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-580 Is Gate Bypassed Publication** | A step is considered a gate bypassed publication if all of the following hold: the control kind is “Publication” and the reachable from entry without human gate flag is set. |
| **DR-581 Child Step Count** | A step's child step count is the number of steps related to the step. |
| **DR-582 Parent Step Kind** | A step's parent step kind — taken from the linked parent step. |
| **DR-583 Is Composite Without Children** | A step is considered a composite without children if all of the following hold: the step kind is “MultiStep” and the child step count is 0. |
| **DR-584 Precondition Count** | A step's precondition count is the number of step conditions related to the step. |
| **DR-585 Postcondition Count** | A step's postcondition count is the number of step conditions related to the step. |
| **DR-586 Invariant Count** | A step's invariant count is the number of step conditions related to the step. |
| **DR-587 Safety Critical Condition Count** | A step's safety critical condition count is the number of step conditions related to the step. |
| **DR-588 Failure Mode Count** | A step's failure mode count is the number of failure modes related to the step. |
| **DR-589 Cue Count** | A step's cue count is the number of step cues related to the step. |
| **DR-590 Danger Cue Count** | A step's danger cue count is the number of step cues related to the step. |
| **DR-591 Decision Point Count** | A step's decision point count is the number of decision points related to the step. |
| **DR-592 Knowledge Fragment Count** | A step's knowledge fragment count is the number of knowledge fragments related to the step. |
| **DR-593 Has Instruction Only** | A step is considered to have an instruction only if all of the following hold: the precondition count plus the postcondition count plus the invariant count is 0; the cue count is 0; the failure mode count is 0; the decision point count is 0; and the knowledge fragment count is 0. |
| **DR-594 Input Variable Count** | A step's input variable count is the number of step variables related to the step. |
| **DR-595 Output Variable Count** | A step's output variable count is the number of step variables related to the step. |
| **DR-596 Required Lock Count** | A step's required lock count is the number of step lock requirements related to the step. |
| **DR-597 Required Protective Equipment Count** | A step's required protective equipment count is the number of step protective equipment related to the step. |
| **DR-598 Is Isolation Without Lock** | A step is considered an isolation without lock if all of the following hold: the isolates energy source has a value and the required lock count is 0. |
| **DR-599 Referenced Resource Count** | A step's referenced resource count is the number of step resources related to the step. |
| **DR-600 Untyped Version Key** | The step's untyped version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the semantic type iri is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-601 Is Accountable to Software** | A step is considered an accountable to software if all of the following hold: the assigned agent kind has a value and the assigned agent kind is not “Human”. |
| **DR-602 Has Downstream Steps** | A step is considered to have a downstream steps if the reachable step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-603 Incompleteness Cue Count** | A step's incompleteness cue count is the number of step cues related to the step. |
| **DR-604 Has Incompleteness Cue** | A step is considered to have an incompleteness cue if the incompleteness cue count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-605 Has Postcondition** | A step is considered to have a postcondition if the postcondition count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-606 Accountable Agent** | A step's accountable agent is the current agent of the step's assigned role. |
| **DR-607 Has No Accountable Agent** | A step is considered to have no accountable agent if the accountable agent is blank. |
| **DR-608 Conditionless Version Key** | The step's conditionless version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the precondition count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-609 Prerequisite Downstream Count** | A step's prerequisite downstream count is the number of vw step transitions closure related to the step. |
| **DR-610 Prerequisite is Downstream** | A step is flagged prerequisite is downstream if all of the following hold: the prerequisite step has a value and the prerequisite downstream count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-611 States Operational Knowledge** | A step is considered to state an operational knowledge if all of the following hold: the prerequisite step has a value; the precondition count is greater than 0; and the reached from step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-612 Bottleneck Allocation Count** | A step's bottleneck allocation count is the number of the step's tactical resource allocations that are bottlenecks. |
| **DR-613 Is Bottleneck Step** | A step is considered a bottleneck step if the bottleneck allocation count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-614 Coarse Top Level Version Key** | The step's coarse top level version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if all of the following hold: the parent step is blank and the detail level is “Activity”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-615 Fine Top Level Version Key** | The step's fine top level version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if all of the following hold: the parent step is blank and the detail level is “Action”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-616 Context Sensitivity Count** | A step's context sensitivity count is the number of step context sensitivities related to the step. |
| **DR-617 Unscoped Sensitivity Count** | A step's unscoped sensitivity count is the number of step context sensitivities related to the step. |
| **DR-618 Is Context Sensitive But Unscoped** | A step is considered context-sensitive-but-unscoped if all of the following hold: the context sensitivity count is greater than 0 and the unscoped sensitivity count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-619 Version Procedure** | A step's version procedure — taken from the linked procedure version. |
| **DR-620 Assigned Role Does Compliance Review** | A step's assigned role does compliance review is true when the step's assigned role has compliance review capability. |
| **DR-621 Compliance Review Procedure Key** | The step's compliance review procedure key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the version procedure, if the assigned role does compliance review flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-622 Step Procedure Type** | A step's step procedure type is the procedure type of version of the step's procedure version. |
| **DR-623 Is Release Approval Gate** | A step is considered a release approval gate if all of the following hold: the control kind is “Approval” and the step procedure type is “software-release”. |
| **DR-624 Regulatory Requirement Count** | A step's regulatory requirement count is the number of the step's step requirements that are requirement is regulatory. |
| **DR-625 Tool Function Count** | A step's tool function count is the number of step functions related to the step. |
| **DR-626 Parseable Condition Count** | A step's parseable condition count is the number of the step's step conditions that are machine-parseable. |
| **DR-627 Dmn Decision Count** | A step's dmn decision count is the number of the step's decision points that are dmn-encoded. |
| **DR-628 Tool Use Rules Only in Prose** | A step is flagged tool use rules only in prose if all of the following hold: the tool function count is greater than 0; the parseable condition count is 0; and the dmn decision count is 0. |
| **DR-629 Open Outdated Flag Count** | A step's open outdated flag count is the number of the step's model annotations that are open outdated flags. |
| **DR-630 Has Reported Reality Mismatch** | A step is considered to have a reported reality mismatch if the open outdated flag count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-631 Deviated Run Count** | A step's deviated run count is the number of the step's step executions that have a deviation. |
| **DR-632 Is Drifted From Practice** | A step is considered a drifted from practice if at least one of the following holds: the deviated run count is at least 2 or all of the following hold: the deviated run count is greater than 0 and the open outdated flag count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-633 Ai Failure Count** | A step's ai failure count is the number of the step's assistant answers that have a task outcome of “Failed”. |
| **DR-634 Is Ai Failure Point** | A step is considered an ai failure point if the ai failure count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-635 Ai Artifact Input Count** | A step's ai artifact input count is the number of the step's step variables that are input from ai artifacts. |
| **DR-636 Consumes Ai Agent Artifact** | A step is considered to consume an ai agent artifact if the ai artifact input count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-637 Collection Evidence Count** | A step's collection evidence count is the number of knowledge traces related to the step. |
| **DR-638 Has Collection Evidence** | A step is considered to have a collection evidence if the collection evidence count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-639 Activity Origin Trace Count** | A step's activity origin trace count is the number of the step's knowledge traces that have a target kind of “ActivityDefinition” and have a trace role of “Origin”. |
| **DR-640 Version Model Trace Count** | A step's version model trace count is the process model trace count of the step's procedure version. |
| **DR-641 Is Untraced Activity in Traced Model** | A step is considered an untraced activity in traced model if all of the following hold: the version model trace count is greater than 0 and the activity origin trace count is 0. |
| **DR-642 Elicited Validation Count** | A step's elicited validation count is the number of the step's knowledge traces that are source is people capture and have a trace role of “Validates”. |
| **DR-643 Elicited Extension Count** | A step's elicited extension count is the number of the step's knowledge traces that are source is people capture and have a trace role of “Extends”. |
| **DR-644 Downstream Artifact Step Count** | A step's downstream artifact step count is the number of vw artifact handoffs closure related to the step. |
| **DR-645 Declared First Step Key** | The step's declared first step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step ID, if the declared first step flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-646 Declared Fallback Step Key** | The step's declared fallback step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step ID, if the declared fallback step flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-647 Owner Organization** | A step's owner organization — taken from the linked procedure version. |
| **DR-648 Name** | A step transition's name is computed as the from step, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the to step. |
| **DR-649 Is Recovery Path** | A step transition is considered a recovery path if at least one of the following holds: the transition kind is “Fallback” or the transition kind is “Alternative”. |
| **DR-650 Count of From Step Executions** | A step transition's count of from step executions is the number of step executions related to the step transition. |
| **DR-651 Count of to Step Executions** | A step transition's count of to step executions is the number of step executions related to the step transition. |
| **DR-652 Has Reachable Origin** | A step transition is considered to have a reachable origin if the count of from step executions is greater than 0. |
| **DR-653 Has Reachable Target** | A step transition is considered to have a reachable target if the count of to step executions is greater than 0. |
| **DR-654 Is Never Exercised** | A step transition is considered never-exercised if it is not the case that all of the following hold: the reachable origin flag is set and the reachable target flag is set. |
| **DR-655 Is Untested Recovery Path** | A step transition is considered an untested recovery path if all of the following hold: the recovery path flag is set and the never exercised flag is set. |
| **DR-656 Count of Observed Traversals** | A step transition's count of observed traversals is the number of observed transitions related to the step transition. |
| **DR-657 Has Been Traversed** | A step transition is considered to have been traversed if the count of observed traversals is greater than 0. |
| **DR-658 Is Unwalked Recovery Path** | A step transition is considered an unwalked recovery path if all of the following hold: the recovery path flag is set and the been traversed flag is not set. |
| **DR-659 Target Blocking Requirement Count** | A step transition's target blocking requirement count — taken from the linked to step. |
| **DR-660 Target Carries Blocking Control** | A step transition is flagged target carries blocking control if the target blocking requirement count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-661 Is Unrehearsed Control Entry** | A step transition is considered unrehearsed-control-entry if all of the following hold: the unwalked recovery path flag is set and the target carries blocking control flag is set. |
| **DR-662 Unrehearsed Control Version Key** | The step transition's unrehearsed control version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the unrehearsed control entry flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-663 From Step is Human Approval Gate** | A step transition's from step is human approval gate when the linked from step is a human approval gate. |
| **DR-664 To Step is Human Approval Gate** | A step transition's to step is human approval gate when the linked to step is a human approval gate. |
| **DR-665 Avoids Human Approval Gate** | A step transition is considered to avoid a human approval gate if all of the following hold: the from step is human approval gate flag is not set and the to step is human approval gate flag is not set. |
| **DR-666 Decision Point Count** | A step transition's decision point count is the number of decision points related to the step transition. |
| **DR-667 Is Undocumented Branch** | A step transition is considered an undocumented branch if all of the following hold: the transition kind is not “Next” and the decision point count is 0. |
| **DR-668 Name** | An action's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-669 Name** | A function's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-670 Name** | A tool's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-671 Name** | A step action's name is computed as the step, followed by “ / ”, followed by the action. |
| **DR-672 Name** | A step function's name is computed as the step, followed by “ / ”, followed by the function. |
| **DR-673 Name** | A step tool's name is computed as the step, followed by “ / ”, followed by the tool. |
| **DR-674 Name** | A requirement's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-675 Satisfaction Record Count** | A requirement's satisfaction record count is the number of requirement satisfactions related to the requirement. |
| **DR-676 Step Binding Count** | A requirement's step binding count is the number of step requirements related to the requirement. |
| **DR-677 Is Bound to Any Step** | A requirement is considered a bound to any step if the step binding count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-678 Has Ever Been Evaluated** | A requirement is considered to have ever been evaluated if the satisfaction record count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-679 Negative Outcome Count** | A requirement's negative outcome count is the number of requirement satisfactions related to the requirement. |
| **DR-680 Is Inoperative Control** | A requirement is considered an inoperative control if all of the following hold: the blocking flag is set; the bound to any step flag is set; and the ever been evaluated flag is not set. |
| **DR-681 Is Decorative Control** | A requirement is considered a decorative control if all of the following hold: the blocking flag is set and the bound to any step flag is not set. |
| **DR-682 Has Ever Produced Negative** | A requirement is considered to have ever produced negative if the negative outcome count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-683 Is Unfalsified Control** | A requirement is considered an unfalsified control if all of the following hold: the blocking flag is set; the ever been evaluated flag is set; and the ever produced negative flag is not set. |
| **DR-684 Claims a Witness Field** | A requirement is considered to claim a witness field if the witness field name has a value. |
| **DR-685 Named Witness Field Exists** | A requirement's named witness field exists is true when the requirement's witness field name is derived. |
| **DR-686 Derived Has Computed Witness** | A requirement is flagged derived has computed witness if all of the following hold: the claims a witness field flag is set and the named witness field exists flag is set. |
| **DR-687 Witness Claim is Unverified** | A requirement is considered to witnes claim is unverified if it is not the case that the has computed witness is the derived has computed witness. |
| **DR-688 Is Unwitnessed Blocking Control** | A requirement is considered an unwitnessed blocking control if all of the following hold: the blocking flag is set and the derived has computed witness flag is not set. |
| **DR-689 Witness Fire Count** | A requirement's witness fire count is the same as its negative outcome count. |
| **DR-690 Witness Has Never Fired** | A requirement is considered to witnes has never fired if all of the following hold: the computed witness flag is set and the witness fire count is 0. |
| **DR-691 Evaluation Sample Size** | A requirement's evaluation sample size is the same as its satisfaction record count. |
| **DR-692 Has Meaningful Sample** | A requirement is considered to have a meaningful sample if the evaluation sample size is at least the minimum sample for assurance. |
| **DR-693 Is Untested Witness** | A requirement is considered an untested witness if all of the following hold: the witness has never fired flag is set and the meaningful sample flag is not set. |
| **DR-694 Is Evidenced Holding Control** | A requirement is considered an evidenced holding control if all of the following hold: the witness has never fired flag is set and the meaningful sample flag is set. |
| **DR-695 Control Assurance State** | The requirement's control assurance state is determined by the following priority:<br>1. “Decorative”, if the bound to any step flag is not set;<br>2. “Inoperative”, if the ever been evaluated flag is not set;<br>3. “Asserted”, if the computed witness flag is not set;<br>4. “Demonstrated”, if the witness fire count is greater than 0;<br>5. “Holding”, if the meaningful sample flag is set;<br>6. in all other cases, “Untested”. |
| **DR-696 Unexercised Binding Count** | A requirement's unexercised binding count is the number of step requirements related to the requirement. |
| **DR-697 Witness is Partially Scoped** | A requirement is considered to witnes is partially scoped if all of the following hold: the computed witness flag is set and the unexercised binding count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-698 Accountable Agent** | A requirement's accountable agent is the current agent of the requirement's accountable role. |
| **DR-699 Has Named Owner** | A requirement is considered to have a named owner if the accountable role has a value. |
| **DR-700 Is Orphaned Blocking Control** | A requirement is considered an orphaned blocking control if all of the following hold: the blocking flag is set and the named owner flag is not set. |
| **DR-701 Is Unwatched and Unowned** | A requirement is considered unwatched-and-unowned if all of the following hold: the blocking flag is set; the computed witness flag is not set; and the named owner flag is not set. |
| **DR-702 Attestation Exposure Note** | The requirement's attestation exposure note is determined by the following priority:<br>1. an empty string, if the blocking flag is not set;<br>2. “Unwatched and unowned: exposure defaults to the signatory.”, if the unwatched and unowned flag is set;<br>3. “Witnessed but unowned: no named accountability.”, if the orphaned blocking control flag is set;<br>4. “Owned but unwitnessed: rests on human judgement.”, if the computed witness flag is not set;<br>5. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-703 Unwatched Unowned Flag** | The requirement's unwatched unowned flag is determined by the following priority:<br>1. “unwatched-unowned”, if the unwatched and unowned flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-704 Uses Controlled Vocabulary** | A requirement is considered to use controlled vocabulary if the controlled term has a value. |
| **DR-705 Is Regulatory Requirement** | A requirement is considered regulatory-requirement if the regulatory framework has a value. |
| **DR-706 Constraint Trace Count** | A requirement's constraint trace count is the number of the requirement's knowledge traces that have a target kind of “Constraint”. |
| **DR-707 Is Untraced Bound Constraint** | A requirement is considered an untraced bound constraint if all of the following hold: the bound to any step flag is set and the constraint trace count is 0. |
| **DR-708 Name** | A step requirement's name is computed as the step, followed by “ / ”, followed by the requirement. |
| **DR-709 Requirement is Blocking** | A step requirement's requirement is blocking when the linked requirement is blocking. |
| **DR-710 Blocking Step Key** | The step requirement's blocking step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step, if the requirement is blocking flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-711 Step When Blocking** | The step requirement's step when blocking is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step, if the requirement is blocking flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-712 Requirement Lacks Witness** | A step requirement's requirement lacks witness is true when the step requirement's requirement is an unwitnessed blocking control. |
| **DR-713 Unwitnessed Step Key** | The step requirement's unwitnessed step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step, if the requirement lacks witness flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-714 Satisfaction Count for Binding** | A step requirement's satisfaction count for binding is the number of requirement satisfactions related to the step requirement. |
| **DR-715 Binding Was Ever Exercised** | A step requirement is flagged binding was ever exercised if the satisfaction count for binding is greater than 0. |
| **DR-716 Is Unexercised Blocking Binding** | A step requirement is considered unexercised-blocking-binding if all of the following hold: the requirement is blocking flag is set and the binding was ever exercised flag is not set. |
| **DR-717 Unexercised Binding Requirement Key** | The step requirement's unexercised binding requirement key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the requirement, if the unexercised blocking binding flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-718 Requirement is Regulatory** | A step requirement's requirement is regulatory when the linked requirement is regulatory requirement. |
| **DR-719 Name** | A step verification's name is computed as the step, followed by “ / ”, followed by the verification kind. |
| **DR-720 Name** | A rationale's name is the same as its title. |
| **DR-721 Name** | An exception's name is the same as its condition. |
| **DR-722 Active Exception Step Key** | The exception's active exception step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the trigger step, if the status is “Active”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-723 Name** | A resource's name is the same as its title. |
| **DR-724 Is Approved Source** | A resource is considered an approved source if the approval status is “Approved”. |
| **DR-725 Source Modified At** | A resource's source modified at — taken from the linked extracted from resource. |
| **DR-726 Is Stale Extraction** | A resource is considered a stale extraction if all of the following hold: the extracted from resource has a value and the source modified at is greater than the modified at. |
| **DR-727 Referencing Step Count** | A resource's referencing step count is the number of step resources related to the resource. |
| **DR-728 Referencing Version Count** | A resource's referencing version count is the number of procedure resources related to the resource. |
| **DR-729 Is Unused Resource** | A resource is considered an unused resource if all of the following hold: the referencing step count is 0 and the referencing version count is 0. |
| **DR-730 Is Content Without Organization** | A resource is considered a content without organization if all of the following hold: the description has a value and at least one of the following holds: the artifact type concept is blank; the keywords is blank; or the referencing step count plus the referencing version count is 0. |
| **DR-731 Trailing Practice Count** | A resource's trailing practice count is the number of the resource's knowledge traces that are document trailing practices. |
| **DR-732 Is Behind Current Practice** | A resource is considered a behind current practice if the trailing practice count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-733 Name** | A procedure resource's name is computed as the procedure version, followed by “ / ”, followed by the resource. |
| **DR-734 Relation Iri** | The procedure resource's relation iri is determined by the following priority:<br>1. “https://w3id.org/pko#wasExtractedFrom”, if the relation is “wasExtractedFrom”;<br>2. in all other cases, “http://purl.org/dc/terms/references”. |
| **DR-735 Resource Modified At** | A procedure resource's resource modified at — taken from the linked resource. |
| **DR-736 Name** | An elicitation session's name is computed as the method, followed by “ / ”, followed by the started at. |
| **DR-737 As of Instant** | An elicitation session's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-738 Days Since Elicited** | An elicitation session's days since elicited is computed as the number of days from the ended at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-739 Is Single Witness Method** | An elicitation session is considered a single witness method if at least one of the following holds: the method is “Shadowing” or the method is “PractitionerInterview”. |
| **DR-740 Practitioner is Still Engaged** | An elicitation session's practitioner is still engaged when the linked practitioner agent is still engaged. |
| **DR-741 Valid Fragments Produced** | An elicitation session's valid fragments produced is the number of knowledge fragments related to the elicitation session. |
| **DR-742 Is High Yield Session** | An elicitation session is considered a high yield session if the valid fragments produced is at least 3. |
| **DR-743 Is Concentrated Single Witness** | An elicitation session is considered a concentrated single witness if all of the following hold: the single witness method flag is set and the high yield session flag is set. |
| **DR-744 Is Stale Concentrated Witness** | An elicitation session is considered a stale concentrated witness if all of the following hold: the concentrated single witness flag is set and the days since elicited is greater than 180. |
| **DR-745 Concentrated Session Version Key** | The elicitation session's concentrated session version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the concentrated single witness flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-746 Elicitation Mode** | The elicitation session's elicitation mode is determined by the following priority:<br>1. “Interview”, if the method is “PractitionerInterview”;<br>2. “Observation”, if the method is “Shadowing”;<br>3. “Workshop”, if the method is “FacilitatedWorkshop”;<br>4. “Incident”, if the method is “CriticalIncidentTechnique”;<br>5. “Protocol”, if at least one of the following holds: the method is “ThinkAloudProtocol”; the method is “RetrospectiveProtocol”; the method is “ConceptLaddering”; or the method is “RepertoryGrid”;<br>6. in all other cases, “Other”. |
| **DR-747 Is Interview** | An elicitation session is considered an interview if the elicitation mode is “Interview”. |
| **DR-748 Is Workshop** | An elicitation session is considered a workshop if the elicitation mode is “Workshop”. |
| **DR-749 Why Probe Count** | An elicitation session's why probe count is the number of the elicitation session's interview probes that have a probe kind of “Why”. |
| **DR-750 Shortfall Probe Count** | An elicitation session's shortfall probe count is the number of the elicitation session's interview probes that have a probe kind of “ProcedureFallsShort”. |
| **DR-751 Is Interview Without Why Probe** | An elicitation session is considered an interview without why probe if all of the following hold: the interview flag is set and the why probe count is 0. |
| **DR-752 Is Interview Without Shortfall Probe** | An elicitation session is considered an interview without shortfall probe if all of the following hold: the interview flag is set and the shortfall probe count is 0. |
| **DR-753 Initiator Count** | An elicitation session's initiator count is the number of the elicitation session's elicitation participants that have a process stake of “Initiates”. |
| **DR-754 Executor Count** | An elicitation session's executor count is the number of the elicitation session's elicitation participants that have a process stake of “Executes”. |
| **DR-755 Dependent Count** | An elicitation session's dependent count is the number of the elicitation session's elicitation participants that have a process stake of “DependsOnResults”. |
| **DR-756 Uninvited Participant Count** | An elicitation session's uninvited participant count is the number of the elicitation session's elicitation participants that are not usually-invited. |
| **DR-757 Gathers Whole Process Chain** | An elicitation session is considered to gather a whole process chain if all of the following hold: the workshop flag is set; the initiator count is greater than 0; the executor count is greater than 0; and the dependent count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-758 Is Workshop Without Usual Outsiders** | An elicitation session is considered a workshop without usual outsiders if all of the following hold: the workshop flag is set and the uninvited participant count is 0. |
| **DR-759 Method Family** | An elicitation session's method family — taken from the linked method. |
| **DR-760 Facilitator Knowledge Engineer Role Count** | An elicitation session's facilitator knowledge engineer role count is the number of the elicitation session's roles that have a role ID of “knowledge-engineer”. |
| **DR-761 Facilitator is Knowledge Engineer** | An elicitation session is flagged facilitator is knowledge engineer if the facilitator knowledge engineer role count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-762 Is Generic or Unskilled Capture** | An elicitation session is considered a generic or unskilled capture if all of the following hold: the method has a value and at least one of the following holds: the method family is not “Elicitation” or the facilitator is knowledge engineer flag is not set. |
| **DR-763 Is Ke Field Session** | An elicitation session is considered a ke field session if all of the following hold: the facilitator is knowledge engineer flag is set and the setting is “InSitu”. |
| **DR-764 Is Reviewed Recording** | An elicitation session is considered reviewed-recording if all of the following hold: the recording reference has a value and the practitioner reviewed at has a value. |
| **DR-765 Name** | A knowledge fragment's name is computed as the knowledge form, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 60 character(s) of the statement. |
| **DR-766 As of Instant** | A knowledge fragment's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-767 Is Currently Valid** | A knowledge fragment is considered currently-valid if all of the following hold: the valid from is at most the as of instant; at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant; and the status is “Approved”. |
| **DR-768 Source Agent is Still Engaged** | A knowledge fragment's source agent is still engaged when the linked source agent is still engaged. |
| **DR-769 Source Agent Kind** | A knowledge fragment's source agent kind — taken from the linked source agent. |
| **DR-770 Has Human Source** | A knowledge fragment is considered to have a human source if the source agent kind is “Human”. |
| **DR-771 Has Orphaned Provenance** | A knowledge fragment is considered to have an orphaned provenance if all of the following hold: the currently valid flag is set and the source agent is still engaged flag is not set. |
| **DR-772 Is Undefendable Tacit Claim** | A knowledge fragment is considered an undefendable tacit claim if all of the following hold: the orphaned provenance flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the knowledge form is “Tacit” or the knowledge form is “SituatedJudgment”. |
| **DR-773 Is Approved** | A knowledge fragment is considered approved if the status is “Approved”. |
| **DR-774 Is Within Validity Window** | A knowledge fragment is considered a within validity window if all of the following hold: the valid from is at most the as of instant and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. |
| **DR-775 Is Relied Upon** | A knowledge fragment is considered a relied upon if all of the following hold: the step has a value and the within validity window flag is set. |
| **DR-776 Step Procedure Version Status** | A knowledge fragment's step procedure version status — taken from the linked step. |
| **DR-777 Is Attached to Live Version** | A knowledge fragment's is attached to live version when the linked procedure version is live. |
| **DR-778 Is Unapproved But Relied on** | A knowledge fragment is considered an unapproved but relied on if all of the following hold: the relied upon flag is set; the attached to live version flag is set; and the approved flag is not set. |
| **DR-779 Evidence Age Days** | A knowledge fragment's evidence age days is the days since elicited of the knowledge fragment's elicitation session. |
| **DR-780 Has Recorded Elicitation** | A knowledge fragment is considered to have a recorded elicitation if the elicitation session has a value. |
| **DR-781 Is From Single Witness** | A knowledge fragment's is from single witness is true when the knowledge fragment's elicitation session is a single witness method. |
| **DR-782 Evidence Expiry Days** | The knowledge fragment's evidence expiry days is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 180, if the from single witness flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, 365. |
| **DR-783 Evidence Has Expired** | A knowledge fragment is flagged evidence has expired if all of the following hold: the recorded elicitation flag is set and the evidence age days is greater than the evidence expiry days. |
| **DR-784 Owner Agent** | A knowledge fragment's owner agent is the current agent of the knowledge fragment's owner role. |
| **DR-785 Is Awaiting Approval** | A knowledge fragment is considered an awaiting approval if the status is “Reviewed”. |
| **DR-786 Owner is Me** | A knowledge fragment is flagged owner is me if the owner role is “hr-policy-owner”. |
| **DR-787 Is My Unfinished Approval** | A knowledge fragment is considered a my unfinished approval if all of the following hold: the owner is me flag is set and the awaiting approval flag is set. |
| **DR-788 Is Invoked by an Exception** | A knowledge fragment's is invoked by an exception is the number of exceptions related to the knowledge fragment. |
| **DR-789 Has Operational Reliance** | A knowledge fragment is considered to have an operational reliance if the is invoked by an exception is greater than 0. |
| **DR-790 Is Unapproved and Operationally Live** | A knowledge fragment is considered unapproved-and-operationally-live if all of the following hold: the my unfinished approval flag is set and the operational reliance flag is set. |
| **DR-791 Age Days** | A knowledge fragment's age days is computed as the number of days from the valid from to the as of instant. |
| **DR-792 Is Low Confidence** | A knowledge fragment is considered a low confidence if at least one of the following holds: the confidence is “Medium” or the confidence is “Low”. |
| **DR-793 Owning Version Cadence Days** | A knowledge fragment's owning version cadence days is the steward review cadence days of the knowledge fragment's procedure version. |
| **DR-794 Exceeds Owning Cadence** | A knowledge fragment is considered to exceed an owning cadence if the age days is greater than the owning version cadence days. |
| **DR-795 Is Aging Low Confidence Claim** | A knowledge fragment is considered an aging low confidence claim if all of the following hold: the exceeds owning cadence flag is set and the low confidence flag is set. |
| **DR-796 Owner Role Agent Kind** | A knowledge fragment's owner role agent kind is the current agent kind of the knowledge fragment's owner role. |
| **DR-797 Is Human Owned** | A knowledge fragment is considered human-owned if the owner role agent kind is “Human”. |
