| **DR-798 Is Ai Validated by Ai** | A knowledge fragment is considered an ai validated by ai if all of the following hold: it is not the case that the source agent kind is “Human” and the human owned flag is not set. |
| **DR-799 Review Cadence Days** | A knowledge fragment's review cadence days is the steward review cadence days of the knowledge fragment's procedure version. |
| **DR-800 Is Overdue for Review** | A knowledge fragment is considered an overdue for review if all of the following hold: the currently valid flag is set and the age days is greater than the review cadence days. |
| **DR-801 Predates Current Role Holder** | A knowledge fragment is considered to predate a current role holder if all of the following hold: the owner role agent kind has a value and the valid from is less than the owner role assignment valid from. |
| **DR-802 Owner Role Assignment Valid From** | A knowledge fragment's owner role assignment valid from is the current assignment valid from of the knowledge fragment's owner role. |
| **DR-803 Fragility Signal Count** | A knowledge fragment's fragility signal count is computed as the count of the following that hold: the from single witness flag is set; the overdue for review flag is set; the low confidence flag is set; and the operational reliance flag is set. |
| **DR-804 Is Compound Fragile** | A knowledge fragment is considered a compound fragile if the fragility signal count is at least 3. |
| **DR-805 Is Single Point of Failure** | A knowledge fragment is considered a single point of failure if all of the following hold: the from single witness flag is set and the operational reliance flag is set. |
| **DR-806 Is Expiring Single Point of Failure** | A knowledge fragment is considered an expiring single point of failure if all of the following hold: the single point of failure flag is set and the overdue for review flag is set. |
| **DR-807 Compound Fragile Version Key** | The knowledge fragment's compound fragile version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the compound fragile flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-808 Valid Fragment Session Key** | The knowledge fragment's valid fragment session key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the elicitation session, if the currently valid flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-809 Consuming Step is Software Assigned** | A knowledge fragment's consuming step is software assigned when the linked step is software assigned. |
| **DR-810 Consuming Step Agent Kind** | A knowledge fragment's consuming step agent kind is the assigned agent kind of the knowledge fragment's step. |
| **DR-811 Is Unapproved and Machine Consumed** | A knowledge fragment is considered unapproved-and-machine-consumed if all of the following hold: the unapproved but relied on flag is set and the consuming step is software assigned flag is set. |
| **DR-812 Is Unapproved and Human Consumed** | A knowledge fragment is considered unapproved-and-human-consumed if all of the following hold: the unapproved but relied on flag is set and the consuming step is software assigned flag is not set. |
| **DR-813 Machine Consumed Unapproved Version Key** | The knowledge fragment's machine consumed unapproved version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the unapproved and machine consumed flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-814 Has Review Record** | A knowledge fragment is considered to have a review record if the last reviewed at has a value. |
| **DR-815 Days Since Actual Review** | The knowledge fragment's days since actual review is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the last reviewed at to the as of instant, if the review record flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-816 Is Unreviewed Since Authoring** | A knowledge fragment is considered unreviewed-since-authoring if all of the following hold: the currently valid flag is set and the review record flag is not set. |
| **DR-817 Is Genuinely Overdue** | A knowledge fragment is considered a genuinely overdue if all of the following hold: the currently valid flag is set; the review record flag is set; and the days since actual review is greater than the review cadence days. |
| **DR-818 Review Recency is Inferred** | A knowledge fragment is flagged review recency is inferred if all of the following hold: the overdue for review flag is set and the review record flag is not set. |
| **DR-819 Inference Disagrees With Record** | A knowledge fragment is flagged inference disagrees with record if all of the following hold: the review record flag is set; the overdue for review flag is set; and the genuinely overdue flag is not set. |
| **DR-820 Genuinely Overdue Version Key** | The knowledge fragment's genuinely overdue version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the genuinely overdue flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-821 Ratified Boundary Count** | A knowledge fragment's ratified boundary count is the number of authority boundaries related to the knowledge fragment. |
| **DR-822 Reliance Surface Count** | A knowledge fragment's reliance surface count is computed as the is invoked by an exception plus the ratified boundary count. |
| **DR-823 Days Awaiting My Approval** | The knowledge fragment's days awaiting my approval is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the valid from to the as of instant, if the my unfinished approval flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-824 Is High Blast Radius Unapproved** | A knowledge fragment is considered high-blast-radius-unapproved if all of the following hold: the unapproved and operationally live flag is set and the reliance surface count is greater than 1. |
| **DR-825 Is Long Unapproved** | A knowledge fragment is considered long-unapproved if all of the following hold: the my unfinished approval flag is set and the days awaiting my approval is greater than 30. |
| **DR-826 Unapproved Load Bearing Version Key** | The knowledge fragment's unapproved load bearing version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the high blast radius unapproved flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-827 Owner Role is Vacated** | A knowledge fragment's owner role is vacated when the linked owner role is a vacated role. |
| **DR-828 Is Orphaned by Role** | A knowledge fragment is considered an orphaned by role if all of the following hold: the currently valid flag is set and the owner role is vacated flag is set. |
| **DR-829 Valid Fragment Version Key** | The knowledge fragment's valid fragment version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the currently valid flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-830 Is Flattened to Brittle Rule** | A knowledge fragment is considered a flattened to brittle rule if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the knowledge form is “Tacit” or the knowledge form is “SituatedJudgment”; the encoded as is “HardRule”; and the stated conditions is blank. |
| **DR-831 Corroboration Count** | A knowledge fragment's corroboration count is the number of the knowledge fragment's fragment corroborations that agree. |
| **DR-832 Rests on Single Data Point** | A knowledge fragment is considered to rest on single data point if all of the following hold: the status is “Approved” and the corroboration count is 0. |
| **DR-833 Owner Organization** | A knowledge fragment's owner organization — taken from the linked procedure version. |
| **DR-834 Name** | A knowledge gap's name is computed as the severity, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 60 character(s) of the statement. |
| **DR-835 Is Open** | A knowledge gap is considered open if at least one of the following holds: the status is “Open” or the status is “Investigating”. |
| **DR-836 Open Gap Version Key** | The knowledge gap's open gap version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if all of the following hold: the open flag is set and the severity is “High”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-837 Is Blocking** | A knowledge gap is considered blocking if the blocking kind is “Blocking”. |
| **DR-838 Is Open and Blocking** | A knowledge gap is considered open-and-blocking if all of the following hold: the open flag is set and the blocking flag is set. |
| **DR-839 As of Instant** | A knowledge gap's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-840 Days Open** | The knowledge gap's days open is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the identified at to the as of instant, if the open flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-841 Tolerance Days** | The knowledge gap's tolerance days is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 30, if the severity is “High”;<br>2. 90, if the severity is “Medium”;<br>3. in all other cases, 180. |
| **DR-842 Is Overdue Gap** | A knowledge gap is considered an overdue gap if the days open is greater than the tolerance days. |
| **DR-843 Owner Agent** | A knowledge gap's owner agent is the current agent of the knowledge gap's owner role. |
| **DR-844 Owner is Still Engaged** | A knowledge gap's owner is still engaged when the linked owner agent is still engaged. |
| **DR-845 Has Resolution Plan** | A knowledge gap is considered to have a resolution plan if the resolution plan has a value. |
| **DR-846 Is Abandoned Unknown** | A knowledge gap is considered an abandoned unknown if all of the following hold: the overdue gap flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the resolution plan flag is not set or the owner is still engaged flag is not set. |
| **DR-847 Open Blocking Gap Version Key** | The knowledge gap's open blocking gap version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the open and blocking flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-848 Owner Role is Vacated** | A knowledge gap's owner role is vacated when the linked owner role is a vacated role. |
| **DR-849 Is Ownerless Open Gap** | A knowledge gap is considered an ownerless open gap if all of the following hold: the open flag is set and the owner role is vacated flag is set. |
| **DR-850 Is Known and Unresolved** | A knowledge gap is considered known-and-unresolved if all of the following hold: the identified at has a value and the open flag is set. |
| **DR-851 Is Gatekeeping or Sabotage** | A knowledge gap is considered a gatekeeping or sabotage if at least one of the following holds: the gap cause is “Gatekeeping” or the gap cause is “Sabotage”. |
| **DR-852 Is Unattributed Gatekeeping** | A knowledge gap is considered unattributed-gatekeeping if all of the following hold: the holder declined to share flag is set and the gatekeeping or sabotage flag is not set. |
| **DR-853 Is Required Gatekept Uncodified** | A knowledge gap is considered required-gatekept-uncodified if all of the following hold: the gatekeeping or sabotage flag is set; the blocking kind is “Blocking”; and the codified as fragment is blank. |
| **DR-854 Owner Organization** | A knowledge gap's owner organization — taken from the linked procedure version. |
| **DR-855 Answering Change Title** | A knowledge gap's answering change title — taken from the linked answered by model change request. |
| **DR-856 Answering Change Status** | A knowledge gap's answering change status — taken from the linked answered by model change request. |
| **DR-857 Name** | An FA q's name is the same as its question. |
| **DR-858 Resolution Count** | An FA q's resolution count is the number of user questions related to the FA q. |
| **DR-859 Is Unused Faq** | An FA q is considered an unused faq if the resolution count is 0. |
| **DR-860 Name** | An explanation's name is the same as its title. |
| **DR-861 Name** | A procedure execution's name is computed as the procedure version, followed by “ / ”, followed by the context. |
| **DR-862 Expected Step Count** | A procedure execution's expected step count is the specified step count of the procedure execution's procedure version. |
| **DR-863 Completed Step Count** | A procedure execution's completed step count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-864 Control Breach Count** | A procedure execution's control breach count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-865 Late Step Count** | A procedure execution's late step count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-866 Is Structurally Complete** | A procedure execution is considered a structurally complete if the completed step count is at least the expected step count. |
| **DR-867 Diverged From Specification** | A procedure execution is flagged diverged from specification if at least one of the following holds: the structurally complete flag is not set or the control breach count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-868 All Blocking Controls Evaluated** | A procedure execution is flagged all blocking controls evaluated if the unevaluated blocking total is 0. |
| **DR-869 Unevaluated Blocking Total** | A procedure execution's unevaluated blocking total is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-870 Separation of Duties Held** | A procedure execution is flagged separation of duties held if the separation violation count is 0. |
| **DR-871 Separation Violation Count** | A procedure execution's separation violation count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-872 Is Attestation Ready** | A procedure execution is considered attestation-ready if all of the following hold: the structurally complete flag is set; the diverged from specification flag is not set; the all blocking controls evaluated flag is set; and the separation of duties held flag is set. |
| **DR-873 Attestation Blocker Summary** | The procedure execution's attestation blocker summary is determined by the following priority:<br>1. an empty string, if the attestation ready flag is set;<br>2. “Incomplete: specified steps did not all complete.”, if the structurally complete flag is not set;<br>3. “Segregation of duties violated.”, if the separation violation count is greater than 0;<br>4. “Blocking controls were never evaluated.”, if the unevaluated blocking total is greater than 0;<br>5. in all other cases, “Control breach recorded on one or more steps.”. |
| **DR-874 Executed Version is Fit** | A procedure execution's executed version is fit is true when the procedure execution's procedure version is a fit to execute. |
| **DR-875 Signed Against Unfit Version** | A procedure execution is flagged signed against unfit version if all of the following hold: the execution status is “Completed” and the executed version is fit flag is not set. |
| **DR-876 Asserted Only Control Count** | A procedure execution's asserted only control count is the number of requirement satisfactions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-877 Assurance is Mostly Asserted** | A procedure execution is flagged assurance is mostly asserted if the asserted only control count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-878 Unreachable Handling Failure Count** | A procedure execution's unreachable handling failure count is the number of message deliveries related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-879 Retention Breach Count** | A procedure execution's retention breach count is the number of message deliveries related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-880 Cleared Legal Review Count** | A procedure execution's cleared legal review count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-881 Has Cleared Legal Review** | A procedure execution is considered to have a cleared legal review if the cleared legal review count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-882 Abandoned Failure Count** | A procedure execution's abandoned failure count is the number of message deliveries related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-883 Delivered Count** | A procedure execution's delivered count is the number of message deliveries related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-884 Total Delivery Attempt Count** | A procedure execution's total delivery attempt count is the number of message deliveries related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-885 Has Abandoned Failures** | A procedure execution is considered to have an abandoned failures if the abandoned failure count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-886 Mishandled Refusal Count** | A procedure execution's mishandled refusal count is the number of send intents related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-887 Unclean Step Count** | A procedure execution's unclean step count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-888 Ran Clean** | A procedure execution is flagged ran clean if the unclean step count is 0. |
| **DR-889 Count of Approval Executions** | A procedure execution's count of approval executions is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-890 Has Human Approval** | A procedure execution is considered to have a human approval if the count of approval executions is greater than 0. |
| **DR-891 Count of Delivery Executions** | A procedure execution's count of delivery executions is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-892 Has Delivered** | A procedure execution is considered to have delivered if the count of delivery executions is greater than 0. |
| **DR-893 Delivered Without Approval** | A procedure execution is flagged delivered without approval if all of the following hold: the delivered flag is set and the human approval flag is not set. |
| **DR-894 Invalid Approval Count** | A procedure execution's invalid approval count is the number of requirement satisfactions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-895 Approval Chain is Complete** | A procedure execution is flagged approval chain is complete if the invalid approval count is 0. |
| **DR-896 Vacuously Clean Step Count** | A procedure execution's vacuously clean step count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-897 Preparation Step Count** | A procedure execution's preparation step count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-898 Approval Step Count** | A procedure execution's approval step count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-899 Separation Was Testable** | A procedure execution is flagged separation was testable if all of the following hold: the preparation step count is greater than 0 and the approval step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-900 Separation Held Under Test** | A procedure execution is flagged separation held under test if all of the following hold: the separation was testable flag is set and the separation of duties held flag is set. |
| **DR-901 Separation is Vacuously Green** | A procedure execution is flagged separation is vacuously green if all of the following hold: the separation of duties held flag is set and the separation was testable flag is not set. |
| **DR-902 Separation Assurance Note** | The procedure execution's separation assurance note is determined by the following priority:<br>1. “Violated: same agent prepared and approved.”, if the separation violation count is greater than 0;<br>2. “Not tested: this run had no preparation/approval pair.”, if the separation is vacuously green flag is set;<br>3. in all other cases, “Held under test.”. |
| **DR-903 Ungoverned Divergence Count** | A procedure execution's ungoverned divergence count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-904 Divergence Was Fully Governed** | A procedure execution is flagged divergence was fully governed if all of the following hold: the diverged from specification flag is set and the ungoverned divergence count is 0. |
| **DR-905 Computedly Witnessed Control Count** | A procedure execution's computedly witnessed control count is the number of requirement satisfactions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-906 Evaluated Control Count** | A procedure execution's evaluated control count is computed as the computedly witnessed control count plus the asserted only control count. |
| **DR-907 Computed Assurance Ratio** | The procedure execution's computed assurance ratio is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the evaluated control count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, the computedly witnessed control count divided by the evaluated control count. |
| **DR-908 Interested Party Assertion Count** | A procedure execution's interested party assertion count is the number of requirement satisfactions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-909 Assurance Grade** | The procedure execution's assurance grade is determined by the following priority:<br>1. “None: no blocking control was evaluated.”, if the evaluated control count is 0;<br>2. “Weak: at least one control rests on an interested-party assertion.”, if the interested party assertion count is greater than 0;<br>3. “Thin: most controls rest on human assertion.”, if the computed assurance ratio is less than 0.5;<br>4. “Mixed: computed and asserted controls.”, if the computed assurance ratio is less than 1;<br>5. in all other cases, “Computed: every evaluated control has a witness.”. |
| **DR-910 Attestation Would Be Weakly Based** | A procedure execution is flagged attestation would be weakly based if all of the following hold: the attestation ready flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the interested party assertion count is greater than 0 or the computed assurance ratio is less than 0.5. |
| **DR-911 Independent Human Observation Count** | A procedure execution's independent human observation count is the number of verification outcomes related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-912 Has Any Independent Observation** | A procedure execution is considered to have any independent observation if the independent human observation count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-913 Self Attested Approval Count** | A procedure execution's self attested approval count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-914 Assurance Chain is Circular** | A procedure execution is flagged assurance chain is circular if all of the following hold: the self attested approval count is greater than 0 and the any independent observation flag is not set. |
| **DR-915 Latest Attestation Instant** | A procedure execution's latest attestation instant is the largest signed at across the attestations related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-916 Has Been Attested** | A procedure execution is considered to have been attested if the attestation count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-917 Attestation Count** | A procedure execution's attestation count is the number of attestations related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-918 Post Attestation Score Count** | A procedure execution's post attestation score count is the number of requirement satisfactions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-919 Basis Changed After Signature** | A procedure execution is considered to basi a changed after signature if all of the following hold: the been attested flag is set and the post attestation score count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-920 Requires Re Attestation** | A procedure execution is considered to require a re attestation if all of the following hold: the basis changed after signature flag is set and the attestation ready flag is not set. |
| **DR-921 Intended Recipient Count** | A procedure execution's intended recipient count is the number of send intents related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-922 Reached Recipient Count** | A procedure execution's reached recipient count is the number of send intents related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-923 Silently Dropped Count** | A procedure execution's silently dropped count is the number of send intents related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-924 Delivery Yield Percent** | The procedure execution's delivery yield percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the reached recipient count times 100 divided by the intended recipient count, if the intended recipient count is greater than 0;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-925 Campaign Silently Lost Audience** | A procedure execution is flagged campaign silently lost audience if the silently dropped count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-926 Unrecorded Refusal Count** | A procedure execution's unrecorded refusal count is the number of send intents related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-927 Has Unrecorded Refusals** | A procedure execution is considered to have an unrecorded refusals if the unrecorded refusal count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-928 Independently Confirmed Intent Count** | A procedure execution's independently confirmed intent count is the number of send intents related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-929 Send Decisions are Entirely Self Witnessed** | A procedure execution is flagged send decisions are entirely self witnessed if all of the following hold: the intended recipient count is greater than 0 and the independently confirmed intent count is 0. |
| **DR-930 Participant Count** | A procedure execution's participant count is the number of execution participants related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-931 Deviating Step Count** | A procedure execution's deviating step count is the number of step executions related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-932 Has Step Deviation** | A procedure execution is considered to have a step deviation if the deviating step count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-933 Deviating Facility Key** | The procedure execution's deviating facility key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the facility, if the step deviation flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-934 Clean Facility Key** | The procedure execution's clean facility key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the facility, if all of the following hold: the facility has a value and the has step deviation is false;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-935 Deviating Day Version Key** | The procedure execution's deviating day version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if all of the following hold: the step deviation flag is set and the shift is “Day”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-936 Deviating Night Version Key** | The procedure execution's deviating night version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if all of the following hold: the step deviation flag is set and the shift is “Night”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-937 Status Change Count** | A procedure execution's status change count is the number of procedure status changes related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-938 Claims Completion Without All Steps** | A procedure execution is considered to claim a completion without all steps if all of the following hold: the execution status is “Completed” and the completed step count is less than the expected step count. |
| **DR-939 Is Unconfirmed Completion** | A procedure execution is considered an unconfirmed completion if all of the following hold: the execution status is “Completed” and the confirmed by agent is blank. |
| **DR-940 Has No Recorded Outcome** | A procedure execution is considered to have no recorded outcome if the outcome is blank. |
| **DR-941 Feedback Count** | A procedure execution's feedback count is the number of user feedback related to the procedure execution. |
| **DR-942 Is Unreported Mistake** | A procedure execution is considered an unreported mistake if all of the following hold: the step deviation flag is set and the feedback count is 0. |
| **DR-943 Owner Organization** | A procedure execution's owner organization — taken from the linked procedure version. |
| **DR-944 Stopped At Gap Statement** | A procedure execution's stopped at gap statement — taken from the linked stopped at knowledge gap. |
| **DR-945 Stopped At Gap Status** | A procedure execution's stopped at gap status — taken from the linked stopped at knowledge gap. |

| **DR-1125 Improvement Cycle Path** | The issue occurrence's improvement cycle path is determined by the following priority:<br>1. an empty string, if the redesign change request is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, “Observed at ”, followed by the executed step, followed by “ by ”, followed by the encountered by agent, followed by “; recorded as ”, followed by the error, followed by “ (”, followed by the issue cause, followed by “); redesigned by ”, followed by the redesign change request. |
| **DR-1126 Name** | A user question's name is computed as the first 70 character(s) of the question text. |
| **DR-1127 Is Unaddressed Question** | A user question is considered an unaddressed question if all of the following hold: the addressed by resource is blank and the resolved by faq is blank. |
| **DR-1128 Name** | A user feedback's name is computed as the disposition, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 60 character(s) of the feedback text. |
| **DR-1129 Is Unactioned Procedure Critique** | A user feedback is considered an unactioned procedure critique if all of the following hold: the feedback on procedure has a value; the change request key is blank; and the disposition is not “Declined”. |
| **DR-1130 Collection Follow Up Count** | A user feedback's collection follow up count is the number of collected source materials related to the user feedback. |
| **DR-1131 Is Tacit Signal Not Fed Into Collection** | A user feedback is considered a tacit signal not fed into collection if all of the following hold: the reveals tacit knowledge flag is set and the collection follow up count is 0. |
| **DR-1132 Name** | A stewardship assignment's name is computed as the procedure version, followed by “ / steward=”, followed by the steward role. |
| **DR-1133 Count of Review Events** | A stewardship assignment's count of review events is the number of review events related to the stewardship assignment. |
| **DR-1134 Has Ever Been Reviewed** | A stewardship assignment is considered to have ever been reviewed if the count of review events is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1135 As of Instant** | A stewardship assignment's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-1136 Is Current Assignment** | A stewardship assignment is considered current-assignment if all of the following hold: the valid from is at most the as of instant and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. |
| **DR-1137 Name** | A change request's name is the same as its title. |
| **DR-1138 Is Open** | A change request is considered open if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the status is “Draft”; the status is “UnderReview”; or the status is “Approved” and the implemented at is blank. |
| **DR-1139 Open Change Version Key** | The change request's open change version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the open flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1140 Is Decided** | A change request is considered decided if the decided at has a value. |
| **DR-1141 As of Instant** | A change request's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-1142 Days Pending** | The change request's days pending is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the requested at to the decided at, if the decided flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the requested at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-1143 Is Still Pending** | A change request is considered still-pending if all of the following hold: the open flag is set and the decided flag is not set. |
| **DR-1144 Is Stalled** | A change request is considered stalled if all of the following hold: the still pending flag is set and the days pending is greater than 14. |
| **DR-1145 Authority Agent** | A change request's authority agent is the current agent of the change request's authority role. |
| **DR-1146 Requester is Authority** | A change request is flagged requester is authority if the requested by agent is the authority agent. |
| **DR-1147 Awaits Authority Decision** | A change request is considered to await an authority decision if all of the following hold: the status is “UnderReview” and the decided flag is not set. |
| **DR-1148 Authority Role Label** | A change request's authority role label — taken from the linked authority role. |
| **DR-1149 Touches Live Version** | A change request's touches live version when the linked procedure version is live. |
| **DR-1150 Is Live Decision Backlog** | A change request is considered a live decision backlog if all of the following hold: the awaits authority decision flag is set and the touches live version flag is set. |
| **DR-1151 Blocks an Open Gap** | A change request is considered to block an open gap if all of the following hold: the live decision backlog flag is set and the change kind is “Enhancement”. |
| **DR-1152 Backlog Version Key** | The change request's backlog version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the live decision backlog flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1153 Is My Pending Decision** | A change request is considered a my pending decision if all of the following hold: the authority role is “hr-policy-owner” and the awaits authority decision flag is set. |
| **DR-1154 Is My Blocking Backlog** | A change request is considered a my blocking backlog if all of the following hold: the my pending decision flag is set and the blocks an open gap flag is set. |
| **DR-1155 Is My Overdue Backlog** | A change request is considered a my overdue backlog if all of the following hold: the my blocking backlog flag is set and the days pending is greater than 14. |
| **DR-1156 Is Implemented** | A change request is considered implemented if the implemented at has a value. |
| **DR-1157 Is My Decided Request** | A change request is considered a my decided request if all of the following hold: the authority role is “hr-policy-owner” and the decided flag is set. |
| **DR-1158 Is My Decided But Unlanded** | A change request is considered my-decided-but-unlanded if all of the following hold: the my decided request flag is set and the implemented flag is not set. |
| **DR-1159 Decision Latency Days** | The change request's decision latency days is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the requested at to the decided at, if the decided flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-1160 Implementation Latency Days** | The change request's implementation latency days is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the decided at to the implemented at, if the implemented flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-1161 Delay is Downstream of Me** | A change request is flagged delay is downstream of me if all of the following hold: the my decided but unlanded flag is set and the decision latency days is at most 14. |
| **DR-1162 Unlanded Version Key** | The change request's unlanded version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the my decided but unlanded flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1163 Is Approved Not Implemented** | A change request is considered approved-not-implemented if all of the following hold: the status is “Approved” and the implemented flag is not set. |
| **DR-1164 Days Since Approval** | The change request's days since approval is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the decided at to the as of instant, if the decided flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-1165 Is Stalled Implementation** | A change request is considered a stalled implementation if all of the following hold: the approved not implemented flag is set and the days since approval is greater than 14. |
| **DR-1166 Stalled Implementation Version Key** | The change request's stalled implementation version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the stalled implementation flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1167 Approved Version Key** | The change request's approved version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the approved decision flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1168 Is Approved Decision** | A change request is considered an approved decision if the status is “Approved”. |
| **DR-1169 Owner Organization** | A change request's owner organization — taken from the linked procedure version. |
| **DR-1170 Name** | A review event's name is computed as the procedure version, followed by “ / ”, followed by the review kind. |
| **DR-1171 As of Instant** | A review event's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-1172 Is Overdue** | A review event is considered an overdue if the next review due is less than the as of instant. |
| **DR-1173 Overdue Version Key** | The review event's overdue version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the overdue flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1174 Promised Cadence Days** | A review event's promised cadence days is the steward review cadence days of the review event's procedure version. |
| **DR-1175 Days Since Reviewed** | A review event's days since reviewed is computed as the number of days from the reviewed at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-1176 Exceeds Promised Cadence** | A review event is considered to exceed a promised cadence if the days since reviewed is greater than the promised cadence days. |
| **DR-1177 Cadence Drift Days** | A review event's cadence drift days is computed as the days since reviewed minus the promised cadence days. |
| **DR-1178 Promise and Behavior Disagree** | A review event is flagged promise and behavior disagree if all of the following hold: the exceeds promised cadence flag is set and the overdue flag is not set. |
| **DR-1179 Cadence Breach Version Key** | The review event's cadence breach version key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure version, if the exceeds promised cadence flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1180 Version Modified At** | A review event's version modified at — taken from the linked procedure version. |
| **DR-1181 Review Did Not Refresh Modified** | A review event is flagged review did not refresh modified if all of the following hold: the version modified at has a value and the reviewed at is greater than the version modified at. |
| **DR-1182 Name** | A learning activity's name is computed as the activity kind, followed by “ / ”, followed by the occurred at. |
| **DR-1183 Name** | An operational binding's name is computed as the step, followed by “ / ”, followed by the record or schema key. |
| **DR-1184 As of Instant** | An operational binding's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-1185 Age Minutes** | An operational binding's age minutes is computed as the number of minutes from the last observed at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-1186 Is Fresh** | An operational binding is considered a fresh if the age minutes is at most the freshness sla minutes. |
| **DR-1187 Stale Binding Step Key** | The operational binding's stale binding step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step, if the fresh flag is not set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1188 Authoritative Stale Step Key** | The operational binding's authoritative stale step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step, if all of the following hold: the fresh flag is not set and the authoritative flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1189 Is Stale and Authoritative** | An operational binding is considered stale-and-authoritative if all of the following hold: the authoritative flag is set and the fresh flag is not set. |
| **DR-1190 Step When Stale** | The operational binding's step when stale is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step, if the stale and authoritative flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1191 Resource is Approved** | An operational binding's resource is approved is true when the operational binding's resource is an approved source. |
| **DR-1192 Is Usable for Drafting** | An operational binding is considered usable-for-drafting if all of the following hold: the resource is approved flag is set and the fresh flag is set. |
| **DR-1193 Step When Unusable** | The operational binding's step when unusable is determined by the following priority:<br>1. an empty string, if the usable for drafting flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, the step. |
| **DR-1194 Name** | A communication policy's name is computed as the channel, followed by “ policy / ”, followed by the procedure version. |
| **DR-1195 Consent Violation Count** | A communication policy's consent violation count is the number of the communication policy's message deliveries that are consent violations. |
| **DR-1196 Quiet Hours Violation Count** | A communication policy's quiet hours violation count is the number of message deliveries related to the communication policy. |
| **DR-1197 Is Active Policy** | A communication policy is considered an active policy if the status is “Active”. |
| **DR-1198 Name** | A message template's name is computed as the communication policy, followed by “ / ”, followed by the locale. |
| **DR-1199 Policy Max Message Length** | A message template's policy max message length — taken from the linked communication policy. |
| **DR-1200 Policy Max Segments** | A message template's policy max segments — taken from the linked communication policy. |
| **DR-1201 Body Template Length** | A message template's body template length is computed as the length of the body template. |
| **DR-1202 Is Template Over Length** | A message template is considered a template over length if the body template length is greater than the policy max message length. |
| **DR-1203 Valid Approval Count** | A message template's valid approval count is the number of template approvals related to the message template. |
| **DR-1204 Has Valid Approval** | A message template is considered to have a valid approval if the valid approval count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1205 Is Claiming Unbacked Approval** | A message template is considered a claiming unbacked approval if all of the following hold: the status is “Approved” and the valid approval flag is not set. |
| **DR-1206 Last Approved Body Hash** | A message template's last approved body hash — taken from the linked last valid approval. |
| **DR-1207 Has Body Drifted** | A message template is considered to have body drifted if all of the following hold: the last approved body hash has a value and the current body hash is not the last approved body hash. |
| **DR-1208 Is Sendable Under Approval** | A message template is considered a sendable under approval if all of the following hold: the status is “Approved” and all of the following hold: the valid approval flag is set and the body drifted flag is not set. |
| **DR-1209 Drifted Send Count** | A message template's drifted send count is the number of message deliveries related to the message template. |
| **DR-1210 Unanswered Delivery Count** | A message template's unanswered delivery count is the number of message deliveries related to the message template. |
| **DR-1211 Transmitted Delivery Count** | A message template's transmitted delivery count is the number of message deliveries related to the message template. |
| **DR-1212 Template Draws No Response** | A message template is flagged template draws no response if all of the following hold: the transmitted delivery count is greater than 0 and the unanswered delivery count is the transmitted delivery count. |
| **DR-1213 Last Approval At** | A message template's last approval at is the decided at of the message template's last valid approval. |
| **DR-1214 Name** | A semantic mapping's name is computed as the source path, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the target iri. |
| **DR-1215 Profile Namespace Dereferences** | A semantic mapping's profile namespace dereferences when the linked ontology profile is namespace dereferences. |
| **DR-1216 Reinvents Standard Term** | A semantic mapping is considered to reinvent a standard term if all of the following hold: the mapping relation is “extension” and the available standard iri has a value. |
| **DR-1217 Is Non Resolvable Term Iri** | A semantic mapping is considered a non resolvable term iri if at least one of the following holds: the first 4 character(s) of the target iri is not “http” or all of the following hold: the ontology profile has a value and the profile namespace dereferences is false. |
| **DR-1218 Name** | A witness loop's name is computed as “Loop ”, followed by the loop number, followed by “: ”, followed by the title. |
| **DR-1219 Question Count** | A witness loop's question count is the number of role questions related to the witness loop. |
| **DR-1220 Is Complete** | A witness loop is considered a complete if the completed at has a value. |
| **DR-1221 Name** | A role question's name is computed as the asking role, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 60 character(s) of the question text. |
| **DR-1222 Predicate Count** | A role question's predicate count is the number of rulebook fields related to the role question. |
| **DR-1223 Is Answered** | A role question is considered answered if the predicate count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1224 Name** | A rulebook field's name is computed as the target table, followed by a period, followed by the field name. |
| **DR-1225 Is Derived** | A rulebook field is considered derived if at least one of the following holds: the field type is “calculated”; the field type is “lookup”; or the field type is “aggregation”. |
| **DR-1226 Is Witness** | A rulebook field is considered a witness if the invented for question has a value. |
| **DR-1227 Disagreeing Substrate Count** | A rulebook field's disagreeing substrate count is the number of field disagreements related to the rulebook field. |
| **DR-1228 Is Substrate Contested** | A rulebook field is considered substrate-contested if the disagreeing substrate count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1229 Has Measured Data** | A rulebook field is considered to have a measured data if the measured substantive count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1230 Is Discriminating** | A rulebook field is considered discriminating if the measured distinct value count is at least 2. |
| **DR-1231 Name** | A test suite's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1232 Test Count** | A test suite's test count is the number of test cases related to the test suite. |
| **DR-1233 Pass Count** | A test suite's pass count is the number of test cases related to the test suite. |
| **DR-1234 Blocking Fail Count** | A test suite's blocking fail count is the number of test cases related to the test suite. |
| **DR-1235 Is Green** | A test suite is considered a green if the blocking fail count is 0. |
| **DR-1236 Name** | A test cas's name is computed as the test kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the subject. |
| **DR-1237 Is Blocking** | A test cas is considered blocking if the severity is “blocking”. |
| **DR-1238 Is Passing** | A test cas is considered passing if the last outcome is “PASS”. |
| **DR-1239 Is Failing** | A test cas is considered failing if the last outcome is “FAIL”. |
| **DR-1240 Needs Attention** | A test cas is considered to need an attention if all of the following hold: the failing flag is set and the blocking flag is set. |
| **DR-1241 Passing Suite Key** | The test cas's passing suite key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the suite, if the passing flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1242 Needs Attention Suite Key** | The test cas's needs attention suite key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the suite, if the needs attention flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1243 Name** | An exception invocation's name is computed as the step execution, followed by “ / ”, followed by the exception. |
| **DR-1244 Expected Handling** | An exception invocation's expected handling — taken from the linked exception. |
| **DR-1245 Required Approval Role** | An exception invocation's required approval role — taken from the linked exception. |
| **DR-1246 Required Approval Role Holder** | An exception invocation's required approval role holder is the current agent of the exception invocation's required approval role. |
| **DR-1247 Approval Role Matches** | An exception invocation is flagged approval role matches if the approved by agent is the required approval role holder. |
| **DR-1248 Is Approved** | An exception invocation is considered approved if the approved by agent has a value. |
| **DR-1249 Is Improperly Approved** | An exception invocation is considered improperly-approved if at least one of the following holds: the approved flag is not set or the approval role matches flag is not set. |
| **DR-1250 Invoker Agent Kind** | An exception invocation's invoker agent kind — taken from the linked invoked by agent. |
| **DR-1251 Invoker Also Prepared Key** | An exception invocation's invoker also prepared key is computed as the parent procedure execution, followed by “|”, followed by the approved by agent. |
| **DR-1252 Parent Procedure Execution** | An exception invocation's parent procedure execution — taken from the linked step execution. |
| **DR-1253 Approver Prepared Count** | An exception invocation's approver prepared count is the number of step executions related to the exception invocation. |
| **DR-1254 Delegated to Preparer** | An exception invocation is flagged delegated to preparer if the approver prepared count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1255 Is Ungoverned Invocation** | An exception invocation is considered an ungoverned invocation if at least one of the following holds: the improperly approved flag is set or the delegated to preparer flag is set. |
| **DR-1256 Name** | A verification outcome's name is computed as the step execution, followed by “ / ”, followed by the step verification. |
| **DR-1257 Expected Signal Value** | A verification outcome's expected signal value — taken from the linked step verification. |
| **DR-1258 Signal Identifier** | A verification outcome's signal identifier — taken from the linked step verification. |
| **DR-1259 Signal Matches Expected** | A verification outcome is flagged signal matches expected if the observed signal value is the expected signal value. |
| **DR-1260 Has Evidence** | A verification outcome is considered to have an evidence if the evidence uri has a value. |
| **DR-1261 Is Unbacked Observation** | A verification outcome is considered an unbacked observation if all of the following hold: the signal matches expected flag is set and the evidence flag is not set. |
| **DR-1262 Is Self Witnessed** | A verification outcome is considered self-witnessed if the observed by agent is the step executor agent. |
| **DR-1263 Step Executor Agent** | A verification outcome's step executor agent is the executed by agent of the verification outcome's step execution. |
| **DR-1264 Self Witnessed Step Key** | The verification outcome's self witnessed step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step execution, if the self witnessed flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1265 Unbacked Step Key** | The verification outcome's unbacked step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step execution, if the unbacked observation flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1266 Is Self Witnessed and Unbacked** | A verification outcome is considered self-witnessed-and-unbacked if all of the following hold: the self witnessed flag is set and the evidence flag is not set. |
| **DR-1267 Is Uncorroborated Pass** | A verification outcome is considered an uncorroborated pass if all of the following hold: the signal matches expected flag is set and the self witnessed and unbacked flag is set. |
| **DR-1268 Uncorroborated Pass Step Key** | The verification outcome's uncorroborated pass step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step execution, if the uncorroborated pass flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1269 Observer is Non Human** | A verification outcome's observer is non human when the linked observed by agent is a non human. |
| **DR-1270 Observer is Independent of Executor** | A verification outcome is flagged observer is independent of executor if the self witnessed flag is not set. |
| **DR-1271 Is Independent Human Observation** | A verification outcome is considered an independent human observation if all of the following hold: the observer is non human flag is not set; the self witnessed flag is not set; and the evidence flag is set. |
| **DR-1272 Independent Observation Execution Key** | The verification outcome's independent observation execution key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the parent procedure execution of outcome, if the independent human observation flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1273 Parent Procedure Execution of Outcome** | A verification outcome's parent procedure execution of outcome — taken from the linked step execution. |
| **DR-1274 Name** | An observed transition's name is computed as the step transition, followed by “ @ ”, followed by the observed at. |
| **DR-1275 Name** | A recipient's name is the same as its display name. |
| **DR-1276 Has Sms Consent** | A recipient is considered to have sms consent if the sms consent status is “Granted”. |
| **DR-1277 Is Email Reachable** | A recipient is considered email-reachable if the email address has a value. |
| **DR-1278 Is Sms Reachable** | A recipient is considered sms-reachable if the mobile number has a value. |
| **DR-1279 Is Unreachable** | A recipient is considered unreachable if all of the following hold: the email reachable flag is not set and the sms reachable flag is not set. |
| **DR-1280 Is Communicationally Stranded** | A recipient is considered communicationally-stranded if all of the following hold: the sms reachable flag is not set and the email reachable flag is not set. |
| **DR-1281 Name** | A message delivery's name is computed as the recipient, followed by “ / ”, followed by the message template, followed by “ / ”, followed by the sent at. |
| **DR-1282 Policy Channel** | A message delivery's policy channel is the communication policy of the message delivery's message template. |
| **DR-1283 Channel Name** | A message delivery's channel name — taken from the linked policy channel. |
| **DR-1284 Policy Requires Consent** | A message delivery's policy requires consent is true when the message delivery's policy channel is consent required. |
| **DR-1285 Recipient Has Sms Consent** | A message delivery's recipient has sms consent when the linked recipient has sms consent. |
| **DR-1286 Was Actually Transmitted** | A message delivery is considered to have been actually transmitted if at least one of the following holds: the delivery status is “Sent” or at least one of the following holds: the delivery status is “Delivered” or the delivery status is “Bounced”. |
| **DR-1287 Is Consent Violation** | A message delivery is considered a consent violation if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and all of the following hold: the policy requires consent flag is set and the recipient has sms consent flag is not set. |
| **DR-1288 Consent Violation Policy Key** | The message delivery's consent violation policy key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the policy channel, if the consent violation flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1289 Policy Quiet Hours Start Hour** | A message delivery's policy quiet hours start hour — taken from the linked policy channel. |
| **DR-1290 Policy Quiet Hours End Hour** | A message delivery's policy quiet hours end hour — taken from the linked policy channel. |
| **DR-1291 Policy Has Quiet Hours** | A message delivery is flagged policy has quiet hours if the policy quiet hours start hour is not the policy quiet hours end hour. |
| **DR-1292 Quiet Window Wraps Midnight** | A message delivery is flagged quiet window wraps midnight if the policy quiet hours start hour is greater than the policy quiet hours end hour. |
| **DR-1293 Is Inside Quiet Window** | A message delivery is considered an inside quiet window if the OR of the sent at local hour is at least the policy quiet hours start hour and the sent at local hour is less than the policy quiet hours end hour if the quiet window wraps midnight flag is set, in all other cases the AND of the sent at local hour is at least the policy quiet hours start hour and the sent at local hour is less than the policy quiet hours end hour. |
| **DR-1294 Is Quiet Hours Violation** | A message delivery is considered a quiet hours violation if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and all of the following hold: the policy has quiet hours flag is set and the inside quiet window flag is set. |
| **DR-1295 Quiet Hours Violation Policy Key** | The message delivery's quiet hours violation policy key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the policy channel, if the quiet hours violation flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1296 Recipient is Unreachable** | A message delivery's recipient is unreachable when the linked recipient is unreachable. |
| **DR-1297 Is Acknowledged** | A message delivery is considered acknowledged if the acknowledged at has a value. |
| **DR-1298 Invoked Exception Condition** | A message delivery's invoked exception condition — taken from the linked invoked exception. |
| **DR-1299 Has Unreachable Exception Invoked** | A message delivery is considered to have unreachable exception invoked if the invoked exception is “exc-unreachable”. |
| **DR-1300 Is Fabricated Acknowledgement** | A message delivery is considered fabricated-acknowledgement if all of the following hold: the recipient is unreachable flag is set and the acknowledged flag is set. |
| **DR-1301 Is Unhandled Unreachable** | A message delivery is considered unhandled-unreachable if all of the following hold: the recipient is unreachable flag is set and the unreachable exception invoked flag is not set. |
| **DR-1302 Unreachable Failure Key** | The message delivery's unreachable failure key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure execution, if at least one of the following holds: the fabricated acknowledgement flag is set or the unhandled unreachable flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1303 Policy Retention Days** | A message delivery's policy retention days — taken from the linked policy channel. |
| **DR-1304 As of Instant** | A message delivery's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-1305 Age Days** | A message delivery's age days is computed as the number of days from the sent at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-1306 Is Within Retention Window** | A message delivery is considered a within retention window if the age days is at most the policy retention days. |
| **DR-1307 Has Rendered Body** | A message delivery is considered to have rendered body if the rendered body has a value. |
| **DR-1308 Is Evidence Required** | A message delivery is considered evidence-required if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and the within retention window flag is set. |
| **DR-1309 Is Retention Breach** | A message delivery is considered a retention breach if all of the following hold: the evidence required flag is set and the rendered body flag is not set. |
| **DR-1310 Retention Breach Execution Key** | The message delivery's retention breach execution key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure execution, if the retention breach flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1311 Sending Step Execution Step** | A message delivery's sending step execution step — taken from the linked step execution. |
| **DR-1312 Execution Has Cleared Legal Review** | A message delivery's execution has cleared legal review when the linked procedure execution has a cleared legal review. |
| **DR-1313 Is Unreviewed Send** | A message delivery is considered an unreviewed send if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and the execution has cleared legal review flag is not set. |
| **DR-1314 Rendered Body Length** | A message delivery's rendered body length is computed as the length of the rendered body. |
| **DR-1315 Policy Max Message Length At Send** | A message delivery's policy max message length at send — taken from the linked policy channel. |
| **DR-1316 Segment Count** | The message delivery's segment count is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the rendered body length is 0;<br>2. 1, if the rendered body length is at most the policy max message length at send;<br>3. in all other cases, the rendered body length divided by the policy max message length at send rounded up to 0 decimal place(s). |
| **DR-1317 Policy Max Segments At Send** | A message delivery's policy max segments at send — taken from the linked policy channel. |
| **DR-1318 Is Over Segment Limit** | A message delivery is considered an over segment limit if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and the segment count is greater than the policy max segments at send. |
| **DR-1319 Template Has Valid Approval** | A message delivery's template has valid approval when the linked message template has a valid approval. |
| **DR-1320 Is Unapproved Send** | A message delivery is considered an unapproved send if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and the template has valid approval flag is not set. |
| **DR-1321 Policy Required Opt Out Phrase** | A message delivery's policy required opt out phrase — taken from the linked policy channel. |
| **DR-1322 Policy Requires Opt Out** | A message delivery is flagged policy requires opt out if the policy required opt out phrase has a value. |
| **DR-1323 Opt Out Phrase Position** | A message delivery's opt out phrase position is computed as the position of the policy required opt out phrase within the rendered body. |
| **DR-1324 Has Opt Out Phrase** | A message delivery is considered to have an opt out phrase if the opt out phrase position is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1325 Is Opt Out in First Segment** | A message delivery is considered an opt out in first segment if all of the following hold: the opt out phrase flag is set and the opt out phrase position is at most the policy max message length at send. |
| **DR-1326 Is Missing Required Opt Out** | A message delivery is considered a missing required opt out if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and all of the following hold: the policy requires opt out flag is set and the opt out phrase flag is not set. |
| **DR-1327 Is Opt Out At Risk of Truncation** | A message delivery is considered an opt out at risk of truncation if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and all of the following hold: the policy requires opt out flag is set and all of the following hold: the opt out phrase flag is set and the opt out in first segment flag is not set. |
| **DR-1328 Is Failed Delivery** | A message delivery is considered failed-delivery if at least one of the following holds: the delivery status is “Failed” or the delivery status is “Bounced”. |
| **DR-1329 Is Suppressed** | A message delivery is considered suppressed if the delivery status is “Suppressed”. |
| **DR-1330 Is Triaged** | A message delivery is considered triaged if the invoked exception has a value. |
| **DR-1331 Is Abandoned Failure** | A message delivery is considered an abandoned failure if all of the following hold: the failed delivery flag is set and the triaged flag is not set. |
| **DR-1332 Abandoned Failure Execution Key** | The message delivery's abandoned failure execution key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure execution, if the abandoned failure flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1333 Reached Execution Key** | The message delivery's reached execution key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure execution, if the delivery status is “Delivered”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1334 Template Was Sendable** | A message delivery's template was sendable is true when the message delivery's message template is a sendable under approval. |
| **DR-1335 Is Drifted Send** | A message delivery is considered a drifted send if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and the template was sendable flag is not set. |
| **DR-1336 Drifted Send Template Key** | The message delivery's drifted send template key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the message template, if the drifted send flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1337 Was Sent Outside Business Hours** | A message delivery is considered to have been sent outside business hours if at least one of the following holds: the sent at local hour is less than 8 or the sent at local hour is greater than 18. |
| **DR-1338 Was Delivered and Unanswered** | A message delivery is considered to have been delivered and unanswered if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and the acknowledged flag is not set. |
| **DR-1339 Is Poorly Timed Unanswered** | A message delivery is considered poorly-timed-unanswered if all of the following hold: the was delivered and unanswered flag is set and the was sent outside business hours flag is set. |
| **DR-1340 Is Well Timed Unanswered** | A message delivery is considered well-timed-unanswered if all of the following hold: the was delivered and unanswered flag is set and the was sent outside business hours flag is not set. |
| **DR-1341 Unanswered Template Key** | The message delivery's unanswered template key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the message template, if the was delivered and unanswered flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1342 Transmitted Template Key** | The message delivery's transmitted template key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the message template, if the was actually transmitted flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1343 Approval Preceded Send** | A message delivery is flagged approval preceded send if all of the following hold: the approval decided at send has a value and the sent at is greater than the approval decided at send. |
| **DR-1344 Has Frozen Approval Evidence** | A message delivery is considered to have a frozen approval evidence if all of the following hold: the approving agent at send has a value and the approval decided at send has a value. |
| **DR-1345 Provenance is Live Derived** | A message delivery is flagged provenance is live derived if the frozen approval evidence flag is not set. |
| **DR-1346 Current Last Approval At** | A message delivery's current last approval at — taken from the linked message template. |
| **DR-1347 Template Reapproved Since Send** | A message delivery is flagged template reapproved since send if all of the following hold: the current last approval at has a value and the current last approval at is greater than the sent at. |
| **DR-1348 Is Unprovable Approval Claim** | A message delivery is considered an unprovable approval claim if all of the following hold: the provenance is live derived flag is set and all of the following hold: the template reapproved since send flag is set and the template has valid approval flag is set. |
| **DR-1349 Has Sent Reminder** | A message delivery is considered to have a sent reminder if the reminder count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1350 Acknowledgement is Outstanding** | A message delivery is flagged acknowledgement is outstanding if all of the following hold: the was actually transmitted flag is set and all of the following hold: the evidence required flag is set and the acknowledged flag is not set. |
| **DR-1351 Outstanding Age Days** | The message delivery's outstanding age days is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the sent at to the as of instant, if the acknowledgement is outstanding flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-1352 Is Unchased Acknowledgement** | A message delivery is considered unchased-acknowledgement if all of the following hold: the acknowledgement is outstanding flag is set and all of the following hold: the outstanding age days is greater than 7 and the sent reminder flag is not set. |
| **DR-1353 Is Exhausted Follow Up** | A message delivery is considered an exhausted follow up if all of the following hold: the acknowledgement is outstanding flag is set and the reminder count is at least 3. |
| **DR-1354 Needs Human Escalation** | A message delivery is considered to need a human escalation if all of the following hold: the exhausted follow up flag is set and the unreachable exception invoked flag is not set. |
| **DR-1355 Name** | A template approval's name is computed as the message template, followed by “ / ”, followed by the decision, followed by “ / ”, followed by the decided at. |
| **DR-1356 Is Approval Decision** | A template approval is considered an approval decision if the decision is “Approved”. |
| **DR-1357 Template Policy** | A template approval's template policy is the communication policy of the template approval's message template. |
| **DR-1358 Required Approval Role** | A template approval's required approval role — taken from the linked template policy. |
| **DR-1359 Is Decided by Required Role** | A template approval is considered a decided by required role if the decided in role is the required approval role. |
| **DR-1360 Valid Approval Template Key** | The template approval's valid approval template key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the message template, if all of the following hold: the approval decision flag is set and the decided by required role flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1361 Name** | A send intent's name is computed as the recipient, followed by “ / ”, followed by the message template, followed by “ / intent”. |
| **DR-1362 Intent Policy** | A send intent's intent policy is the communication policy of the send intent's message template. |
| **DR-1363 Intent Channel** | A send intent's intent channel — taken from the linked intent policy. |
| **DR-1364 Policy is Active** | A send intent's policy is active is true when the send intent's intent policy is an active policy. |
| **DR-1365 Intent Requires Consent** | A send intent's intent requires consent is true when the send intent's intent policy is consent required. |
| **DR-1366 Recipient Has Channel Consent** | A send intent's recipient has channel consent is true when the send intent's recipient has sms consent. |
| **DR-1367 Consent Gate Passed** | A send intent is flagged consent gate passed if at least one of the following holds: the intent requires consent flag is not set or the recipient has channel consent flag is set. |
| **DR-1368 Recipient is Sms Reachable** | A send intent's recipient is sms reachable when the linked recipient is sms reachable. |
| **DR-1369 Recipient is Email Reachable** | A send intent's recipient is email reachable when the linked recipient is email reachable. |
| **DR-1370 Reachability Gate Passed** | A send intent is flagged reachability gate passed if the recipient is sms reachable if the intent channel is “SMS”, in all other cases the recipient is email reachable. |
| **DR-1371 Permission Gate Passed** | A send intent is flagged permission gate passed if all of the following hold: the policy is active flag is set and all of the following hold: the consent gate passed flag is set and the reachability gate passed flag is set. |
| **DR-1372 Intent Quiet Start Hour** | A send intent's intent quiet start hour is the quiet hours start hour of the send intent's intent policy. |
| **DR-1373 Intent Quiet End Hour** | A send intent's intent quiet end hour is the quiet hours end hour of the send intent's intent policy. |
| **DR-1374 Intent Policy Has Quiet Hours** | A send intent is flagged intent policy has quiet hours if the intent quiet start hour is not the intent quiet end hour. |
| **DR-1375 Intent Quiet Window Wraps** | A send intent is flagged intent quiet window wraps if the intent quiet start hour is greater than the intent quiet end hour. |
| **DR-1376 Intent is Inside Quiet Window** | A send intent is flagged intent is inside quiet window if the OR of the proposed send at local hour is at least the intent quiet start hour and the proposed send at local hour is less than the intent quiet end hour if the intent quiet window wraps flag is set, in all other cases the AND of the proposed send at local hour is at least the intent quiet start hour and the proposed send at local hour is less than the intent quiet end hour. |
| **DR-1377 Timing Gate Passed** | A send intent is flagged timing gate passed if at least one of the following holds: the intent policy has quiet hours flag is not set or the intent is inside quiet window flag is not set. |
| **DR-1378 Hours Until Window Opens** | The send intent's hours until window opens is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the timing gate passed flag is set;<br>2. the intent quiet end hour minus the proposed send at local hour, if the proposed send at local hour is less than the intent quiet end hour;<br>3. in all other cases, 24 minus the proposed send at local hour plus the intent quiet end hour. |
| **DR-1379 Intent Max Message Length** | A send intent's intent max message length — taken from the linked intent policy. |
| **DR-1380 Intent Max Segments** | A send intent's intent max segments — taken from the linked intent policy. |
| **DR-1381 Length Gate Passed** | A send intent is flagged length gate passed if all of the following hold: the proposed body length is greater than 0 and the proposed segment count is at most the intent max segments. |
| **DR-1382 Intent Required Opt Out Phrase** | A send intent's intent required opt out phrase — taken from the linked intent policy. |
| **DR-1383 Opt Out Gate Passed** | A send intent is flagged opt out gate passed if at least one of the following holds: the intent required opt out phrase is blank or all of the following hold: the proposed opt out position is greater than 0 and the proposed opt out position is at most the intent max message length. |
| **DR-1384 Content Gate Passed** | A send intent is flagged content gate passed if all of the following hold: the length gate passed flag is set and the opt out gate passed flag is set. |
| **DR-1385 Template is Sendable** | A send intent's template is sendable is true when the send intent's message template is a sendable under approval. |
| **DR-1386 Execution Has Legal Clearance** | A send intent's execution has legal clearance is true when the send intent's procedure execution has a cleared legal review. |
| **DR-1387 Intent Approval Role** | A send intent's intent approval role — taken from the linked intent policy. |
| **DR-1388 Approval Role Agent Kind** | A send intent's approval role agent kind is the current agent kind of the send intent's intent approval role. |
| **DR-1389 Approval is Human** | A send intent is flagged approval is human if the approval role agent kind is “Human”. |
| **DR-1390 Authorization Gate Passed** | A send intent is flagged authorization gate passed if all of the following hold: the template is sendable flag is set and all of the following hold: the execution has legal clearance flag is set and the approval is human flag is set. |
| **DR-1391 Is Cleared to Send** | A send intent is considered a cleared to send if all of the following hold: the permission gate passed flag is set and all of the following hold: the timing gate passed flag is set and all of the following hold: the content gate passed flag is set and the authorization gate passed flag is set. |
| **DR-1392 Blocking Gate Name** | The send intent's blocking gate name is determined by the following priority:<br>1. an empty string, if the cleared to send flag is set;<br>2. “Permission”, if the permission gate passed flag is not set;<br>3. “Timing”, if the timing gate passed flag is not set;<br>4. “Content”, if the content gate passed flag is not set;<br>5. in all other cases, “Authorization”. |
| **DR-1393 Has Resulting Delivery** | A send intent is considered to have resulting delivery if the resulting delivery has a value. |
| **DR-1394 Resulting Delivery Was Transmitted** | A send intent's resulting delivery was transmitted is true when the send intent's resulting delivery was actually transmitted. |
| **DR-1395 Is Overridden Refusal** | A send intent is considered overridden-refusal if all of the following hold: the cleared to send flag is not set and all of the following hold: the resulting delivery flag is set and the resulting delivery was transmitted flag is set. |
| **DR-1396 Is Silently Dropped** | A send intent is considered silently-dropped if all of the following hold: the cleared to send flag is not set and the resulting delivery flag is not set. |
| **DR-1397 Resulting Delivery Exception** | A send intent's resulting delivery exception is the invoked exception of the send intent's resulting delivery. |
| **DR-1398 Refusal Cited an Exception** | A send intent is flagged refusal cited an exception if the resulting delivery exception has a value. |
| **DR-1399 Is Properly Handled Refusal** | A send intent is considered properly-handled-refusal if all of the following hold: the cleared to send flag is not set and all of the following hold: the resulting delivery flag is set and all of the following hold: the resulting delivery was transmitted flag is not set and the refusal cited an exception flag is set. |
| **DR-1400 Refusal Failure Execution Key** | The send intent's refusal failure execution key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure execution, if at least one of the following holds: the overridden refusal flag is set or the silently dropped flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1401 Intent Execution Key** | A send intent's intent execution key is the same as its procedure execution. |
| **DR-1402 Delivered Intent Execution Key** | The send intent's delivered intent execution key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure execution, if all of the following hold: the resulting delivery flag is set and the resulting delivery was transmitted flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
