| **DR-1861 Name** | A faq category's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1862 Faq Count** | A faq category's faq count is the number of FA qs related to the faq category. |
| **DR-1863 Name** | A faq target's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1864 Faq Count** | A faq target's faq count is the number of FA qs related to the faq target. |
| **DR-1865 Name** | An authoring submission's name is computed as the procedure version, followed by “ by ”, followed by the submitted by agent. |
| **DR-1866 Is Expert Authored Conforming** | An authoring submission is considered expert-authored-conforming if all of the following hold: the submitter expertise is “DomainExpert” and the profile validation passed flag is set. |
| **DR-1867 Is Non Conforming Accepted** | An authoring submission is considered non-conforming-accepted if all of the following hold: the was accepted flag is set and the profile validation passed is false. |
| **DR-1868 Name** | A process knowledge level's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1869 Tacit Strategy Count** | A process knowledge level's tacit strategy count is the number of the process knowledge level's level capture strategies that have a knowledge form of “Tacit”. |
| **DR-1870 Explicit Strategy Count** | A process knowledge level's explicit strategy count is the number of the process knowledge level's level capture strategies that have a knowledge form of “Explicit”. |
| **DR-1871 Lacks Capture Strategy for Either Form** | A process knowledge level is considered to lack a capture strategy for either form if at least one of the following holds: the tacit strategy count is 0 or the explicit strategy count is 0. |
| **DR-1872 Name** | A level capture strategy's name is computed as the level, followed by a space, followed by the knowledge form, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 40 character(s) of the description. |
| **DR-1873 Contradicts Knowledge Form** | A level capture strategy is considered to contradict a knowledge form if at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the knowledge form is “Tacit” and the transfer mode is “Codified” or all of the following hold: the knowledge form is “Explicit” and the transfer mode is “InPerson”. |
| **DR-1874 Name** | A level pyramid question's name is computed as the level, followed by “ answers ”, followed by the question kind. |
| **DR-1875 Name** | A process level statement's name is computed as the procedure, followed by a space, followed by the level, followed by a space, followed by the question kind. |
| **DR-1876 Level Question Key** | A process level statement's level question key is computed as the level, followed by “|”, followed by the question kind. |
| **DR-1877 Pyramid Match Count** | A process level statement's pyramid match count is the number of level pyramid questions related to the process level statement. |
| **DR-1878 Is Filed At Wrong Level** | A process level statement is considered a filed at wrong level if the pyramid match count is 0. |
| **DR-1879 Name** | A tactical resource allocation's name is computed as the step, followed by “ / ”, followed by the resource label. |
| **DR-1880 Utilization Percent** | The tactical resource allocation's utilization percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the available units per week is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, the demanded units per week times 100 divided by the available units per week rounded to 1 decimal place(s). |
| **DR-1881 Is Bottleneck** | A tactical resource allocation is considered a bottleneck if the demanded units per week is greater than the available units per week. |
| **DR-1882 Name** | A process strategic alignment's name is computed as the procedure, followed by “ serves ”, followed by the organization. |
| **DR-1883 States No Trade Off** | A process strategic alignment is considered to state no trade off if the trade offs is blank. |
| **DR-1884 Name** | A business outcome's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1885 Linked Measure Count** | A business outcome's linked measure count is the number of process outcome measures related to the business outcome. |
| **DR-1886 Name** | A process outcome measure's name is computed as the procedure, followed by “: ”, followed by the label. |
| **DR-1887 Is Unlinked to Business Outcome** | A process outcome measure is considered an unlinked to business outcome if the business outcome is blank. |
| **DR-1888 Name** | A process stage's name is computed as the procedure version, followed by “ stage ”, followed by the label. |
| **DR-1889 Step Count** | A process stage's step count is the number of steps related to the process stage. |
| **DR-1890 Owner Has No Holder** | A process stage's owner has no holder is true when the process stage's owner role has no current holder. |
| **DR-1891 Is Unowned or Empty Stage** | A process stage is considered an unowned or empty stage if at least one of the following holds: the owner role is blank; the owner has no holder flag is set; or the step count is 0. |
| **DR-1892 Name** | A process interdependency's name is computed as the from procedure, followed by a space, followed by the effect, followed by a space, followed by the to procedure. |
| **DR-1893 Is Hindering Dependency** | A process interdependency is considered hindering-dependency if the effect is “Hinders”. |
| **DR-1894 Hindered Procedure Key** | The process interdependency's hindered procedure key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the to procedure, if the effect is “Hinders”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1895 Name** | A stakeholder lens's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1896 Granularity Rank** | The stakeholder lens's granularity rank is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 3, if the required granularity is “Step”;<br>2. 2, if the required granularity is “Stage”;<br>3. 1, if the required granularity is “Category”;<br>4. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-1897 Name** | A procedure lens view's name is computed as the procedure, followed by “ for ”, followed by the stakeholder lens. |
| **DR-1898 Procedure Current Version** | A procedure lens view's procedure current version is the current version key of the procedure lens view's procedure. |
| **DR-1899 Lens Granularity Rank** | A procedure lens view's lens granularity rank — taken from the linked stakeholder lens. |
| **DR-1900 View Granularity Rank** | The procedure lens view's view granularity rank is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 3, if the granularity is “Step”;<br>2. 2, if the granularity is “Stage”;<br>3. 1, if the granularity is “Category”;<br>4. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-1901 Is Granularity Misfit** | A procedure lens view is considered a granularity misfit if all of the following hold: the lens granularity rank is greater than 0 and the view granularity rank is not the lens granularity rank. |
| **DR-1902 Is Disconnected Silo** | A procedure lens view is considered a disconnected silo if at least one of the following holds: the projects version is blank or the projects version is not the procedure current version. |
| **DR-1903 Step Level Procedure Key** | The procedure lens view's step level procedure key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure, if the lens granularity rank is 3;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1904 Category Level Procedure Key** | The procedure lens view's category level procedure key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the procedure, if the lens granularity rank is 1;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1905 Name** | An applicability scope's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1906 Dimension Count** | An applicability scope's dimension count is computed as the count of the following that hold: the business unit has a value; the geography has a value; the customer segment has a value; and the regulatory regime has a value. |
| **DR-1907 States Conditions** | An applicability scope is considered to state a conditions if at least one of the following holds: the applies when has a value or the exclusion condition has a value. |
| **DR-1908 Name** | A step context sensitivity's name is computed as the step, followed by “ / ”, followed by the context factor. |
| **DR-1909 Unscoped Step Key** | The step context sensitivity's unscoped step key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the step, if the applicability scope is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1910 Name** | A situational variant's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1911 Scope Dimension Count** | A situational variant's scope dimension count — taken from the linked applicability scope. |
| **DR-1912 Scope States Conditions** | A situational variant's scope states conditions when the linked applicability scope is states conditions. |
| **DR-1913 Has No Applicability Dimension** | A situational variant is considered to have no applicability dimension if at least one of the following holds: the applicability scope is blank or the scope dimension count is 0. |
| **DR-1914 Diverges Without Stated Conditions** | A situational variant is considered to diverge a without stated conditions if all of the following hold: the adaptation has a value and at least one of the following holds: the applicability scope is blank or the scope states conditions is false. |
| **DR-1915 Name** | A collected source material's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1916 Is Modeled Before Organized** | A collected source material is considered modeled-before-organized if all of the following hold: the encoded into version has a value and at least one of the following holds: the organized at is blank or the encoded at is less than the organized at. |
| **DR-1917 Source Document Revised At** | A collected source material's source document revised at is the modified at of the collected source material's source document. |
| **DR-1918 Is Document Source** | A collected source material is considered a document source if the material kind is “DocumentExcerpt”. |
| **DR-1919 Is People Capture** | A collected source material is considered a people capture if at least one of the following holds: the material kind is “Transcript” or the material kind is “FieldNotes”. |
| **DR-1920 Is Practice Evidence** | A collected source material is considered a practice evidence if at least one of the following holds: the material kind is “FieldNotes” or the material kind is “MinedEventTrace”. |
| **DR-1921 Is Captured in Flow of Work** | A collected source material is considered a captured in flow of work if the captured during execution has a value. |
| **DR-1922 Dependent Trace Count** | A collected source material's dependent trace count is the number of knowledge traces related to the collected source material. |
| **DR-1923 Is Dependency Invisible to Change** | A collected source material is considered a dependency invisible to change if all of the following hold: the encoded into version has a value and the dependent trace count is 0. |
| **DR-1924 Changed Dependent Count** | A collected source material's changed dependent count is the number of the collected source material's knowledge traces that are source changed since takens. |
| **DR-1925 Has Knowledge Affected by Source Change** | A collected source material is considered to have a knowledge affected by source change if the changed dependent count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1926 Name** | A scheme refinement's name is computed as the vocabulary, followed by “ refined ”, followed by the refined at. |
| **DR-1927 Name** | A term label variant's name is computed as the vocabulary term, followed by a space, followed by the label kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the wording. |
| **DR-1928 Term Scheme** | A term label variant's term scheme is the vocabulary of the term label variant's vocabulary term. |
| **DR-1929 Term Pref Label** | A term label variant's term pref label — taken from the linked vocabulary term. |
| **DR-1930 Wording Key** | A term label variant's wording key is computed as the term scheme, followed by “|”, followed by the wording. |
| **DR-1931 Pref Wording Key** | The term label variant's pref wording key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the wording key, if the label kind is “pref”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1932 Concepts Sharing Wording** | A term label variant's concepts sharing wording is the number of term label variants related to the term label variant. |
| **DR-1933 Is Ambiguous Label** | A term label variant is considered an ambiguous label if the concepts sharing wording is greater than 1. |
| **DR-1934 Practitioner Mention Count** | A term label variant's practitioner mention count is the number of the term label variant's source term mentions that have a mention origin of “Practitioner”. |
| **DR-1935 Pref Wording** | The term label variant's pref wording is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the wording, if the label kind is “pref”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1936 Same Pref Wording Count** | A term label variant's same pref wording count is the number of term label variants related to the term label variant. |
| **DR-1937 Is Cross Scheme Duplicate Pref** | A term label variant is considered a cross scheme duplicate pref if all of the following hold: the label kind is “pref” and the same pref wording count is greater than 1. |
| **DR-1938 Name** | An ai labeling run's name is computed as the agent, followed by a space, followed by the run at. |
| **DR-1939 Output Count** | An ai labeling run's output count is the number of source term mentions related to the ai labeling run. |
| **DR-1940 Non Canonical Output Count** | An ai labeling run's non canonical output count is the number of the ai labeling run's source term mentions that are non canonical generated values. |
| **DR-1941 Grounding Scheme is Machine Accessible** | An ai labeling run's grounding scheme is machine accessible when the linked grounding scheme is machine accessible. |
| **DR-1942 Is Ungrounded Synonym Sprawl** | An ai labeling run is considered an ungrounded synonym sprawl if all of the following hold: the grounding scheme is blank and the non canonical output count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1943 Grounded in Non Machine Readable Scheme** | An ai labeling run is flagged grounded in non machine readable scheme if all of the following hold: the grounding scheme has a value and the grounding scheme is machine accessible is false. |
| **DR-1944 Name** | A source term mention's name is computed as the concept scheme, followed by “: ”, followed by the wording. |
| **DR-1945 Wording Key** | A source term mention's wording key is computed as the concept scheme, followed by “|”, followed by the wording. |
| **DR-1946 Matching Label Count** | A source term mention's matching label count is the number of term label variants related to the source term mention. |
| **DR-1947 Matching Pref Label Count** | A source term mention's matching pref label count is the number of term label variants related to the source term mention. |
| **DR-1948 Is Uncontrolled Wording** | A source term mention is considered uncontrolled-wording if the matching label count is 0. |
| **DR-1949 Is Non Canonical Generated Value** | A source term mention is considered a non canonical generated value if all of the following hold: the mention origin is “AIGenerated” and the matching pref label count is 0. |
| **DR-1950 Intended Term Role** | A source term mention's intended term role is the represents role of the source term mention's intended term. |
| **DR-1951 Unresolved Intended Term Key** | The source term mention's unresolved intended term key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the intended term, if the matching label count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1952 Unresolved Role Key** | The source term mention's unresolved role key is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the intended term role, if the matching label count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-1953 Name** | A term relation's name is computed as the from term, followed by a space, followed by the relation kind, followed by a space, followed by the to term. |
| **DR-1954 From Term Grandparent** | A term relation's from term grandparent is the broader term parent of the term relation's from term. |
| **DR-1955 Asserts Indirect Link As Direct** | A term relation is considered to assert an indirect link as direct if all of the following hold: the relation kind is “broader” and the to term is the from term grandparent. |
| **DR-1956 Name** | A term meaning change's name is computed as the vocabulary term, followed by “ meaning changed ”, followed by the changed at. |
| **DR-1957 Span Days** | The term meaning change's span days is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the prior meaning since is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the prior meaning since to the changed at. |
| **DR-1958 Name** | An external standard term's name is the same as its term iri. |
| **DR-1959 As of Instant** | An external standard term's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-1960 Rehomed Term Same As** | An external standard term's rehomed term same as is the same as iri of the external standard term's rehomed as term. |
| **DR-1961 Rehomed Term Namespace** | An external standard term's rehomed term namespace is the namespace iri of the external standard term's rehomed as term. |
| **DR-1962 Rehomed Term Release Issued At** | An external standard term's rehomed term release issued at is the introduced release issued at of the external standard term's rehomed as term. |
| **DR-1963 Profile Namespace Iri** | An external standard term's profile namespace iri — taken from the linked ontology profile. |
| **DR-1964 Days Since Deprecated** | The external standard term's days since deprecated is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the deprecated at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the deprecated at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-1965 Is Recent Deprecation** | An external standard term is considered a recent deprecation if all of the following hold: the deprecated by source flag is set; the deprecated at has a value; and the days since deprecated is at most 730. |
| **DR-1966 Using Mapping Count** | An external standard term's using mapping count is the number of semantic mappings related to the external standard term. |
| **DR-1967 Stale Identifier Mapping Count** | An external standard term's stale identifier mapping count is the number of semantic mappings related to the external standard term. |
| **DR-1968 Is Adopted But Deprecated** | An external standard term is considered adopted-but-deprecated if all of the following hold: the deprecated by source flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the using mapping count is greater than 0 or the rehomed as term has a value. |
| **DR-1969 Is Alignment Stale After Deprecation** | An external standard term is considered an alignment stale after deprecation if all of the following hold: the deprecated by source flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the alignment updated at is blank or the alignment updated at is less than the deprecated at. |
| **DR-1970 Is Needed Deprecated Term Not Rehomed** | An external standard term is considered needed-deprecated-term-not-rehomed if all of the following hold: the deprecated by source flag is set; the model still needs term flag is set; and the rehomed as term is blank. |
| **DR-1971 Is Rehomed Without Identity Link** | An external standard term is considered a rehomed without identity link if all of the following hold: the rehomed as term has a value and at least one of the following holds: the rehomed term same as is blank or the rehomed term same as is not the term iri. |
| **DR-1972 Is Rehomed Without New Release** | An external standard term is considered a rehomed without new release if all of the following hold: the rehomed as term has a value and at least one of the following holds: the rehomed term release issued at is blank or the rehomed term release issued at is less than the deprecated at. |
| **DR-1973 Has Unpropagated Identifier Change** | An external standard term is considered to have an unpropagated identifier change if all of the following hold: the previous term iri has a value and the stale identifier mapping count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-1974 Rehoming Kept External Namespace** | An external standard term is flagged rehoming kept external namespace if all of the following hold: the rehomed as term has a value and the rehomed term namespace is the profile namespace iri. |
| **DR-1975 Name** | A role capability tag's name is computed as the role, followed by “ can ”, followed by the capability term. |
| **DR-1976 Capability Scheme Dimension** | A role capability tag's capability scheme dimension is the scheme governed dimension of the role capability tag's capability term. |
| **DR-1977 Is Tag Outside Capability Scheme** | A role capability tag is considered a tag outside capability scheme if the capability scheme dimension is not “AgentCapability”. |
| **DR-1978 Name** | A classification facet's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1979 Assignment Count** | A classification facet's assignment count is the number of procedure facet assignments related to the classification facet. |
| **DR-1980 Name** | A procedure facet assignment's name is computed as the procedure, followed by a space, followed by the facet, followed by “=”, followed by the facet value. |
| **DR-1981 Name** | An encoding lifecycle stage's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1982 Annotation Count** | An encoding lifecycle stage's annotation count is the number of model annotations related to the encoding lifecycle stage. |
| **DR-1983 Is Stage Without Feedback** | An encoding lifecycle stage is considered a stage without feedback if the annotation count is 0. |
| **DR-1984 Name** | A knowledge consumer system's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-1985 Model Sync Count** | A knowledge consumer system's model sync count is the number of consumer system syncs related to the knowledge consumer system. |
| **DR-1986 Integration Count** | A knowledge consumer system's integration count is the number of agent integrations related to the knowledge consumer system. |
| **DR-1987 Is Knowledge Silo** | A knowledge consumer system is considered a knowledge silo if all of the following hold: the holds procedure knowledge flag is set; the exports standard format is false; and the model sync count is 0. |
| **DR-1988 Is Unlinked Toolchain Component** | A knowledge consumer system is considered an unlinked toolchain component if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the system kind is “ProcessModelingTool”; the system kind is “SemanticRepository”; or the system kind is “AIPlatform” and the model sync count plus the integration count is 0. |
| **DR-1989 Semantic Layer Component Count** | A knowledge consumer system's semantic layer component count is computed as the count of the following that hold: the taxonomy flag is set; the thesaurus flag is set; the ontology flag is set; the metadata schema flag is set; and the reasoner flag is set. |
| **DR-1990 Platform Capability Count** | A knowledge consumer system's platform capability count is computed as the count of the following that hold: the reasoner flag is set; the semantic storage flag is set; the graph algorithms flag is set; and the machine learning flag is set. |
| **DR-1991 Is Immature Graph Platform** | A knowledge consumer system is considered an immature graph platform if all of the following hold: the system kind is “KnowledgeGraphPlatform” and the platform capability count is less than 4. |
| **DR-1992 Holds Computationally Encoded Procedure Knowledge** | A knowledge consumer system is considered to hold a computationally encoded procedure knowledge if all of the following hold: the holds procedure knowledge flag is set; the computationally queryable flag is set; the computationally validatable flag is set; and the reasoner flag is set. |
| **DR-1993 Stores Procedure Knowledge Without Computational Access** | A knowledge consumer system is considered to store a procedure knowledge without computational access if all of the following hold: the holds procedure knowledge flag is set and the holds computationally encoded procedure knowledge is false. |
| **DR-1994 Name** | A consumer system sync's name is computed as the consumer system, followed by “ holds ”, followed by the loaded version. |
| **DR-1995 System Audience** | A consumer system sync's system audience — taken from the linked consumer system. |
| **DR-1996 Loaded Procedure** | A consumer system sync's loaded procedure — taken from the linked loaded version. |
| **DR-1997 Canonical Version** | A consumer system sync's canonical version is the current version key of the consumer system sync's loaded procedure. |
| **DR-1998 Canonical Version Modified At** | A consumer system sync's canonical version modified at — taken from the linked canonical version. |
| **DR-1999 Loaded Version Creator** | A consumer system sync's loaded version creator is the created by agent of the consumer system sync's loaded version. |
| **DR-2000 Is Behind Canonical Version** | A consumer system sync is considered a behind canonical version if all of the following hold: the canonical version has a value and the loaded version is not the canonical version. |
| **DR-2001 Predates Version Change** | A consumer system sync is considered to predate a version change if all of the following hold: the loaded version is the canonical version and the synced at is less than the canonical version modified at. |
| **DR-2002 Is Ai Fed From Forked Copy** | A consumer system sync is considered ai-fed-from-forked-copy if all of the following hold: the system audience is not “Human” and the source resource has a value. |
| **DR-2003 Drops Provenance in Transit** | A consumer system sync is considered to drop a provenance in transit if all of the following hold: the loaded version creator has a value and the carries provenance is false. |
| **DR-2004 Reaches Humans** | A consumer system sync is considered to reache a humans if at least one of the following holds: the system audience is “Human” or the system audience is “Both”. |
| **DR-2005 Reaches Machines** | A consumer system sync is considered to reache a machines if at least one of the following holds: the system audience is “AI” or the system audience is “Both”. |
| **DR-2006 Name** | An integration pathway's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2007 Integration Count on Pathway** | An integration pathway's integration count on pathway is the number of agent integrations related to the integration pathway. |
| **DR-2008 Name** | An agent integration's name is computed as the agent, followed by “ via ”, followed by the pathway. |
| **DR-2009 Pathway Integration Count** | An agent integration's pathway integration count — taken from the linked pathway. |
| **DR-2010 Observed Answer Count** | An agent integration's observed answer count is the number of assistant answers related to the agent integration. |
| **DR-2011 Is Shadow Integration** | An agent integration is considered a shadow integration if all of the following hold: the observed answer count is greater than 0 and the registry entry key is blank. |
| **DR-2012 Is One Off Connection** | An agent integration is considered a one off connection if the pathway integration count is at most 1. |
| **DR-2013 Snapshot is Governed** | An agent integration's snapshot is governed when the linked serves snapshot is governed. |
| **DR-2014 Is Deployed on Ungoverned Graph** | An agent integration is considered a deployed on ungoverned graph if all of the following hold: the serves snapshot has a value and the snapshot is governed is false. |
| **DR-2015 Name** | A grounding snapshot's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2016 Is Governed** | A grounding snapshot is considered governed if all of the following hold: the steward role has a value; the governance reviewed at has a value; and the governance reviewed at is at most the served from. |
| **DR-2017 Reasoner Run Count** | A grounding snapshot's reasoner run count is the number of reasoner runs related to the grounding snapshot. |
| **DR-2018 Consistent Reasoner Run Count** | A grounding snapshot's consistent reasoner run count is the number of the grounding snapshot's reasoner runs that are consistent. |
| **DR-2019 Latest Materialized At** | A grounding snapshot's latest materialized at is the largest materialized at across the reasoner runs related to the grounding snapshot. |
| **DR-2020 Served Without Consistency Check** | A grounding snapshot is flagged served without consistency check if all of the following hold: the served from has a value and the consistent reasoner run count is 0. |
| **DR-2021 Served Before Materialization** | A grounding snapshot is flagged served before materialization if all of the following hold: the served from has a value and at least one of the following holds: the latest materialized at is blank or the latest materialized at is greater than the served from. |
| **DR-2022 Assertion Count** | A grounding snapshot's assertion count is the number of snapshot assertions related to the grounding snapshot. |
| **DR-2023 Stale Assignment Assertion Count** | A grounding snapshot's stale assignment assertion count is the number of the grounding snapshot's snapshot assertions that are stale role assertions. |
| **DR-2024 Serves Stale Role Assignments** | A grounding snapshot is considered to serve a stale role assignments if the stale assignment assertion count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2025 Deprecated As Current Count** | A grounding snapshot's deprecated as current count is the number of the grounding snapshot's snapshot assertions that present deprecated as current. |
| **DR-2026 Serves Deprecated As Current** | A grounding snapshot is considered to serve deprecated as current if the deprecated as current count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2027 Name** | A reasoner run's name is computed as the snapshot, followed by “ / ”, followed by the reasoner profile. |
| **DR-2028 Is Richness Tractability Failure** | A reasoner run is considered a richness tractability failure if at least one of the following holds: the duration seconds is greater than the time budget seconds or the dropped axiom count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2029 Passes Schema But Fails Reasoner** | A reasoner run is considered to passe a schema but fails reasoner if all of the following hold: the schema validation passed flag is set and the is consistent is false. |
| **DR-2030 Name** | A snapshot assertion's name is computed as the subject identifier, followed by a space, followed by the predicate, followed by a space, followed by the object value. |
| **DR-2031 Source Version Status** | A snapshot assertion's source version status — taken from the linked source procedure version. |
| **DR-2032 Source Assignment is Current** | A snapshot assertion's source assignment is current when the linked source role assignment is current. |
| **DR-2033 Snapshot Consistent Run Count** | A snapshot assertion's snapshot consistent run count is the consistent reasoner run count of the snapshot assertion's snapshot. |
| **DR-2034 Snapshot is Reasoned** | A snapshot assertion is flagged snapshot is reasoned if the snapshot consistent run count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2035 Is Stale Role Assertion** | A snapshot assertion is considered a stale role assertion if all of the following hold: the source role assignment has a value and the source assignment is current is false. |
| **DR-2036 Presents Deprecated As Current** | A snapshot assertion is considered to present deprecated as current if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the source version status is “Deprecated” or the source version status is “Archived” and the presented status is “Current”. |
| **DR-2037 Lacks Provenance** | A snapshot assertion is considered to lack a provenance if all of the following hold: the provenance uri is blank; the source procedure version is blank; the source step is blank; and the source role assignment is blank. |
| **DR-2038 Has Opaque Identifier** | A snapshot assertion is considered to have an opaque identifier if at least one of the following holds: the first 9 character(s) of the subject identifier is “urn:uuid:” or the first 2 character(s) of the subject identifier is “_:”. |
| **DR-2039 Lacks Dublin Core** | A snapshot assertion is considered to lack a dublin core if at least one of the following holds: the dc title is blank or the dc description is blank. |
| **DR-2040 Name** | A retrieval segment's name is computed as the retrieval segment ID, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 50 character(s) of the segment text. |
| **DR-2041 Author Agent Kind** | A retrieval segment's author agent kind — taken from the linked authored by agent. |
| **DR-2042 Related From Count** | A retrieval segment's related from count is the number of retrieval segments related to the retrieval segment. |
| **DR-2043 Is Isolated Chunk** | A retrieval segment is considered an isolated chunk if all of the following hold: the position in process is blank; the applicability condition is blank; the related segment is blank; and the related from count is 0. |
| **DR-2044 Contradicted is Indexed** | A retrieval segment's contradicted is indexed when the linked contradicts segment is indexed. |
| **DR-2045 Is Inconsistent Grounding** | A retrieval segment is considered inconsistent-grounding if all of the following hold: the indexed flag is set; the contradicts segment has a value; and the contradicted is indexed flag is set. |
| **DR-2046 Is Machine Held Knowledge** | A retrieval segment is considered a machine held knowledge if all of the following hold: the author agent kind has a value; the author agent kind is not “Human”; and the accountable role is blank. |
| **DR-2047 Name** | A knowledge query definition's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2048 Source System Count** | A knowledge query definition's source system count is the number of knowledge query sources related to the knowledge query definition. |
| **DR-2049 Misses a Layer** | A knowledge query definition is considered to misse a layer if all of the following hold: the needs ontology and instances flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the traverses ontology layer is false or the traverses instance layer is false. |
| **DR-2050 Consolidated Distributed Sources** | A knowledge query definition is flagged consolidated distributed sources if all of the following hold: the source system count is greater than 1 and the ran over consolidated copy flag is set. |
| **DR-2051 Name** | A knowledge query source's name is computed as the query definition, followed by “ reads ”, followed by the consumer system. |
| **DR-2052 Name** | An assistant answer's name is computed as the answering agent, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 50 character(s) of the question text. |
| **DR-2053 Grounding Count** | An assistant answer's grounding count is the number of answer groundings related to the assistant answer. |
| **DR-2054 Own Knowledge Grounding Count** | An assistant answer's own knowledge grounding count is the number of the assistant answer's answer groundings that are from own knowledges. |
| **DR-2055 Cited Grounding Count** | An assistant answer's cited grounding count is the number of the assistant answer's answer groundings that are cited to user. |
| **DR-2056 Stale Grounding Count** | An assistant answer's stale grounding count is the number of the assistant answer's answer groundings that ground on stale assertion. |
| **DR-2057 Is Not From Own Knowledge** | An assistant answer is considered a not from own knowledge if all of the following hold: the delivery disposition is “Delivered” and the own knowledge grounding count is 0. |
| **DR-2058 Is Untraceable to Source** | An assistant answer is considered an untraceable to source if all of the following hold: the delivery disposition is “Delivered”; the grounding count is greater than 0; and the cited grounding count is 0. |
| **DR-2059 Context Unescalated Danger Cue Count** | An assistant answer's context unescalated danger cue count — taken from the linked step execution. |
| **DR-2060 Stayed Silent on Safety Problem** | An assistant answer is flagged stayed silent on safety problem if all of the following hold: the context unescalated danger cue count is greater than 0 and the raised safety concern is false. |
| **DR-2061 Context Step Ended At** | An assistant answer's context step ended at — taken from the linked step execution. |
| **DR-2062 Arrived After Step Ended** | An assistant answer is flagged arrived after step ended if all of the following hold: the answer kind is “Guidance”; the context step ended at has a value; and the answered at is greater than the context step ended at. |
| **DR-2063 Execution of Context** | An assistant answer's execution of context is the procedure execution of the assistant answer's step execution. |
| **DR-2064 Context Step** | An assistant answer's context step — taken from the linked step execution. |
| **DR-2065 Assumed Step Completed Count** | An assistant answer's assumed step completed count is the number of step executions related to the assistant answer. |
| **DR-2066 Lost Track of State** | An assistant answer is flagged lost track of state if all of the following hold: the assumed current step has a value; the execution of context has a value; and the assumed step completed count is 0. |
| **DR-2067 Specified Transition Count** | An assistant answer's specified transition count is the number of step transitions related to the assistant answer. |
| **DR-2068 Contradicts Shared Model** | An assistant answer is considered to contradict a shared model if all of the following hold: the asserted next step has a value and the specified transition count is 0. |
| **DR-2069 Is Explicitly Grounded Recommendation** | An assistant answer is considered an explicitly grounded recommendation if all of the following hold: the answer kind is “Recommendation” and the own knowledge grounding count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2070 Recommendation Rests on Nothing Explicit** | An assistant answer is flagged recommendation rests on nothing explicit if all of the following hold: the answer kind is “Recommendation” and the own knowledge grounding count is 0. |
| **DR-2071 Recommended Step Regulatory Count** | An assistant answer's recommended step regulatory count is the regulatory requirement count of the assistant answer's recommended step. |
| **DR-2072 Requirement Check Count** | An assistant answer's requirement check count is the number of answer requirement checks related to the assistant answer. |
| **DR-2073 Conflict Count** | An assistant answer's conflict count is the number of the assistant answer's answer requirement checks that have a verdict of “Conflicts”. |
| **DR-2074 Conflicts With Regulation** | An assistant answer is considered to conflict a with regulation if the conflict count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2075 Is Unchecked Regulated Recommendation** | An assistant answer is considered an unchecked regulated recommendation if all of the following hold: the answer kind is “Recommendation”; the recommended step regulatory count is greater than 0; and the requirement check count is 0. |
| **DR-2076 Delivered Despite Conflict** | An assistant answer is flagged delivered despite conflict if all of the following hold: the conflict count is greater than 0 and the delivery disposition is “Delivered”. |
| **DR-2077 Recommended Step Needs Human** | An assistant answer's recommended step needs human is true when the assistant answer's recommended step requires human confirmation. |
| **DR-2078 Acted on Without Human Judgment** | An assistant answer is flagged acted on without human judgment if all of the following hold: the recommended step needs human flag is set; the was acted on flag is set; and the human reviewed by is blank. |
| **DR-2079 Answered Compliance Question From Documents** | An assistant answer is flagged answered compliance question from documents if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the question topic is “Authority” or the question topic is “Safety” and the retrieval mode is “DocumentPassage”. |
| **DR-2080 Document Interpretation Erred** | An assistant answer is flagged document interpretation erred if all of the following hold: the retrieval mode is “DocumentPassage”; the question topic is “Authority”; and the was correct is false. |
| **DR-2081 Model Did the Reasoning** | An assistant answer is flagged model did the reasoning if all of the following hold: the needs inference flag is set and the derivation performed by is “LanguageModel”. |
| **DR-2082 Wrong Because Graph Was Stale** | An assistant answer is flagged wrong because graph was stale if all of the following hold: the retrieval mode is “StructuredQuery”; the was correct is false; and the stale grounding count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2083 Owner Organization** | An assistant answer's owner organization — taken from the linked step execution. |
| **DR-2084 Model Reasoned and Task Failed** | An assistant answer is flagged model reasoned and task failed if all of the following hold: the model did the reasoning flag is set and the task outcome is “Failed”. |
| **DR-2085 Name** | An answer grounding's name is computed as the assistant answer, followed by “ <- ”, followed by the snapshot assertion, followed by the retrieval segment, followed by the external source uri. |
| **DR-2086 Is From Own Knowledge** | An answer grounding is considered a from own knowledge if all of the following hold: the external source uri is blank and at least one of the following holds: the snapshot assertion has a value or the retrieval segment has a value. |
| **DR-2087 Assertion is Stale** | An answer grounding's assertion is stale is true when the answer grounding's snapshot assertion is a stale role assertion. |
| **DR-2088 Assertion Presents Deprecated** | An answer grounding's assertion presents deprecated is true when the answer grounding's snapshot assertion is presents deprecated as current. |
| **DR-2089 Grounds on Stale Assertion** | An answer grounding is considered to ground on stale assertion if all of the following hold: the snapshot assertion has a value and at least one of the following holds: the assertion is stale flag is set or the assertion presents deprecated flag is set. |
| **DR-2090 Name** | An answer requirement check's name is computed as the assistant answer, followed by “ vs ”, followed by the requirement. |
| **DR-2091 Name** | An ai tool invocation's name is computed as the invoking agent, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the function. |
| **DR-2092 Executed Step** | An ai tool invocation's executed step — taken from the linked step execution. |
| **DR-2093 Declared Function Count** | An ai tool invocation's declared function count is the number of step functions related to the ai tool invocation. |
| **DR-2094 Is Undeclared Tool Use** | An ai tool invocation is considered an undeclared tool use if the declared function count is 0. |
| **DR-2095 Declared Input Count** | An ai tool invocation's declared input count is the step input variable count of the ai tool invocation's step execution. |
| **DR-2096 Acted Without Declared Context** | An ai tool invocation is flagged acted without declared context if all of the following hold: the declared input count is greater than 0 and the supplied input count is less than the declared input count. |
| **DR-2097 Name** | An embedding probe's name is computed as the term a, followed by “ / ”, followed by the term b, followed by “ @ ”, followed by the embedding model. |
| **DR-2098 Synonyms Not Similar** | An embedding probe is considered to synonym a not similar if all of the following hold: the expected relation is “NearSynonym” and the cosine similarity is less than 0.7. |
| **DR-2099 Opposites Not Opposed** | An embedding probe is considered to opposite not opposed if all of the following hold: the expected relation is “Opposite” and the cosine similarity is greater than 0.3. |
| **DR-2100 Name** | A prompt template's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2101 Child Template Count** | A prompt template's child template count is the number of prompt templates related to the prompt template. |
| **DR-2102 Is Disconnected Prompt Knowledge** | A prompt template is considered a disconnected prompt knowledge if all of the following hold: the carries procedure instructions flag is set and the source procedure version is blank. |
| **DR-2103 Is Unmanaged Prompt in Use** | A prompt template is considered an unmanaged prompt in use if all of the following hold: the used by agent has a value and at least one of the following holds: the library status is not “Maintained” or the maintained by role is blank. |
| **DR-2104 Spends Budget on Rare Detail** | A prompt template is considered to spend a budget on rare detail if all of the following hold: the includes rare detail flag is set and the estimated tokens is greater than the token budget. |
| **DR-2105 Condensation Percent** | The prompt template's condensation percent is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the source token count is 0;<br>2. in all other cases, 100 times the estimated tokens divided by the source token count rounded to 1 decimal place(s). |
| **DR-2106 Is Verbatim Dump** | A prompt template is considered a verbatim dump if all of the following hold: the source token count is greater than 0 and the condensation percent is at least 90. |
| **DR-2107 Name** | A knowledge projection's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2108 Version Modified At** | A knowledge projection's version modified at — taken from the linked procedure version. |
| **DR-2109 Open Count** | A knowledge projection's open count is the number of knowledge search events related to the knowledge projection. |
| **DR-2110 Diagram Can Diverge From Model** | A knowledge projection is flagged diagram can diverge from model if all of the following hold: the projection kind is “Diagram” and at least one of the following holds: the generated by tool is blank or the generated at is less than the version modified at. |
| **DR-2111 Narrative Not Generated From Model** | A knowledge projection is flagged narrative not generated from model if all of the following hold: the projection kind is “Narrative” and at least one of the following holds: the generated by tool is blank or the generated at is less than the version modified at. |
| **DR-2112 Narrative Unreachable** | A knowledge projection is flagged narrative unreachable if all of the following hold: the projection kind is “Narrative”; the published uri is blank; and the open count is 0. |
| **DR-2113 Is Published** | A knowledge projection is considered published if the published uri has a value. |
| **DR-2114 Name** | A model annotation's name is computed as the annotation kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 50 character(s) of the body. |
| **DR-2115 Is Discussion in Authoritative Model** | A model annotation is considered a discussion in authoritative model if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the annotation kind is “Comment”; the annotation kind is “Question”; the annotation kind is “Suggestion”; or the annotation kind is “AlternativeInterpretation” and the stored in is “AuthoritativeRulebook”. |
| **DR-2116 Flag Bypassed Annotation Interface** | A model annotation is flagged flag bypassed annotation interface if all of the following hold: the annotation kind is “FlagOutdated” and the entered through is not “AnnotationPanel”. |
| **DR-2117 Is Lost New Knowledge** | A model annotation is considered a lost new knowledge if all of the following hold: the annotation kind is “NewKnowledge”; the status is not “Declined”; and the promoted to fragment is blank. |
| **DR-2118 Is Friction Without Gap** | A model annotation is considered a friction without gap if all of the following hold: the annotation kind is “MissingKnowledge” and the raised knowledge gap is blank. |
| **DR-2119 Is Open Outdated Flag** | A model annotation is considered an open outdated flag if all of the following hold: the annotation kind is “FlagOutdated” and the status is “Open”. |
| **DR-2120 Name** | A knowledge search event's name is computed as the searched by agent, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 40 character(s) of the query text. |
| **DR-2121 Found Nothing Useful** | A knowledge search event is flagged found nothing useful if at least one of the following holds: the result count is 0 or all of the following hold: the opened segment is blank and the opened projection is blank. |
| **DR-2122 Gave Up After Seeing Results** | A knowledge search event is flagged gave up after seeing results if all of the following hold: the was abandoned flag is set and the result count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2123 Is Unlinked Failed Search** | A knowledge search event is considered an unlinked failed search if all of the following hold: the found nothing useful flag is set; the linked knowledge gap is blank; and the linked usability barrier is blank. |
| **DR-2124 Name** | An ai adoption initiative's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2125 As of Instant** | An ai adoption initiative's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2126 Target Has No Explicit Steps** | An ai adoption initiative's target has no explicit steps when the linked target procedure has no explicit steps. |
| **DR-2127 Target Version Issued At** | An ai adoption initiative's target version issued at — taken from the linked target version. |
| **DR-2128 Target Version Under Specified** | An ai adoption initiative's target version under specified is true when the ai adoption initiative's target version is an under specified for execution. |
| **DR-2129 Target Version Notation Only** | An ai adoption initiative's target version notation only is true when the ai adoption initiative's target version is rests on notation only. |
| **DR-2130 Target Elicitation Evidence Count** | An ai adoption initiative's target elicitation evidence count — taken from the linked target version. |
| **DR-2131 Reviewed Output Count** | An ai adoption initiative's reviewed output count is the number of assistant answers related to the ai adoption initiative. |
| **DR-2132 Preceding Reviewed Output Count** | An ai adoption initiative's preceding reviewed output count — taken from the linked preceding initiative. |
| **DR-2133 Last Outcome Measured At** | An ai adoption initiative's last outcome measured at is the largest measured at across the knowledge outcome measurements related to the ai adoption initiative. |
| **DR-2134 Days Since Outcome Measured** | The ai adoption initiative's days since outcome measured is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the last outcome measured at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the last outcome measured at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2135 Ai Insight Count** | An ai adoption initiative's ai insight count is the number of ai insight proposals related to the ai adoption initiative. |
| **DR-2136 Hands Tacit Procedure to Agent** | An ai adoption initiative is considered to hand a tacit procedure to agent if all of the following hold: the agentic flag is set; the target procedure has a value; and the target has no explicit steps flag is set. |
| **DR-2137 Agent on Under Specified Procedure** | An ai adoption initiative is flagged agent on under specified procedure if all of the following hold: the agentic flag is set; the target version has a value; and the target version under specified flag is set. |
| **DR-2138 Agent on Notation Only Procedure** | An ai adoption initiative is flagged agent on notation only procedure if all of the following hold: the agentic flag is set; the target version has a value; and the target version notation only flag is set. |
| **DR-2139 Calls for Process Knowledge Framework** | An ai adoption initiative is considered to call for process knowledge framework if all of the following hold: the task is multi step flag is set and the depends on organizational knowledge flag is set. |
| **DR-2140 Redesigned Before Documented** | An ai adoption initiative is flagged redesigned before documented if all of the following hold: the redesign started at has a value and at least one of the following holds: the target version is blank or the redesign started at is less than the target version issued at. |
| **DR-2141 Breaks Elicit Encode Connect Order** | An ai adoption initiative is considered to break an elicit encode connect order if all of the following hold: the connected to ai at has a value and at least one of the following holds: the target version is blank; the target elicitation evidence count is 0; or the connected to ai at is less than the target version issued at. |
| **DR-2142 Went Full Without Reviewed Partial Stage** | An ai adoption initiative is flagged went full without reviewed partial stage if all of the following hold: the automation level is “Full” and at least one of the following holds: the preceding initiative is blank or the preceding reviewed output count is 0. |
| **DR-2143 Underinvests Knowledge Layer** | An ai adoption initiative is considered to underinvest a knowledge layer if all of the following hold: the model layer budget is greater than 0 and the knowledge layer budget is less than the model layer budget. |
| **DR-2144 Not Anchored in Process Knowledge** | An ai adoption initiative is flagged not anchored in process knowledge if all of the following hold: the status is not “Proposed” and the target procedure is blank. |
| **DR-2145 Agentic Without Knowledge Capture** | An ai adoption initiative is flagged agentic without knowledge capture if all of the following hold: the agentic flag is set; the status is not “Proposed”; and the ai insight count is 0. |
| **DR-2146 Is Ai Outcome Unmeasured** | An ai adoption initiative is considered ai-outcome-unmeasured if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the status is “Pilot” or the status is “InProduction” and at least one of the following holds: the last outcome measured at is blank or the days since outcome measured is greater than 30. |
| **DR-2147 Adopted Without Bottom Line Result** | An ai adoption initiative is flagged adopted without bottom line result if all of the following hold: the status is “InProduction” and the measured bottom line impact is 0. |
| **DR-2148 Failed Without Formalized Knowledge** | An ai adoption initiative is flagged failed without formalized knowledge if all of the following hold: the outcome is “Failed”; the approach is “PromptOnly”; and at least one of the following holds: the target procedure is blank or all of the following hold: the target procedure has a value and the target has no explicit steps flag is set. |
| **DR-2149 Name** | A knowledge outcome measurement's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2150 Baseline Access Score** | A knowledge outcome measurement's baseline access score is the knowledge access score of the knowledge outcome measurement's comparison baseline. |
| **DR-2151 Baseline Error Rate** | A knowledge outcome measurement's baseline error rate is the error rate percent of the knowledge outcome measurement's comparison baseline. |
| **DR-2152 Baseline Minutes Per Run** | A knowledge outcome measurement's baseline minutes per run — taken from the linked comparison baseline. |
| **DR-2153 Baseline Satisfaction** | A knowledge outcome measurement's baseline satisfaction is the satisfaction score of the knowledge outcome measurement's comparison baseline. |
| **DR-2154 Higher Access Fewer Errors** | A knowledge outcome measurement is flagged higher access fewer errors if all of the following hold: the comparison baseline has a value; the knowledge access score is greater than the baseline access score; and the error rate percent is less than the baseline error rate. |
| **DR-2155 Higher Access More Efficient** | A knowledge outcome measurement is flagged higher access more efficient if all of the following hold: the comparison baseline has a value; the knowledge access score is greater than the baseline access score; and the minutes per run is less than the baseline minutes per run. |
| **DR-2156 Higher Access More Satisfied** | A knowledge outcome measurement is flagged higher access more satisfied if all of the following hold: the comparison baseline has a value; the knowledge access score is greater than the baseline access score; and the satisfaction score is greater than the baseline satisfaction. |
| **DR-2157 Is Unacted Adverse Outcome** | A knowledge outcome measurement is considered an unacted adverse outcome if all of the following hold: the error rate percent is greater than the target error rate percent; the informed change request is blank; and the informed investment decision is blank. |
| **DR-2158 Is Gain Outside Procedural Scope** | A knowledge outcome measurement is considered a gain outside procedural scope if all of the following hold: the efficiency gain percent is greater than 0 and the knowledge scope is not “Procedural”. |
| **DR-2159 Name** | An ai insight proposal's name is computed as the proposing agent, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 50 character(s) of the statement. |
| **DR-2160 Target Creator Kind** | An ai insight proposal's target creator kind is the created by agent kind of the ai insight proposal's target procedure version. |
| **DR-2161 Is Unvalidated or Stranded Insight** | An ai insight proposal is considered an unvalidated or stranded insight if at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the folded into change request has a value and the validated by agent is blank or all of the following hold: the validation verdict is “Valid” and the folded into change request is blank. |
| **DR-2162 Grew Model Without Human Seed** | An ai insight proposal is flagged grew model without human seed if all of the following hold: the insight kind is “ModelExtension” and at least one of the following holds: the target procedure version is blank or the target creator kind is not “Human”. |
| **DR-2163 Name** | An assistant benchmark's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2164 Accuracy Lift Points** | An assistant benchmark's accuracy lift points is computed as the graph grounded accuracy percent minus the ungrounded accuracy percent. |
| **DR-2165 Shows Spatial Lift From Graph Queries** | An assistant benchmark is considered to show a spatial lift from graph queries if all of the following hold: the task family is “Spatial”; the generates database queries flag is set; and the accuracy lift points is at least 20. |
| **DR-2166 Shows Geospatial Retrieval Lift** | An assistant benchmark is considered to show a geospatial retrieval lift if all of the following hold: the task family is “Geospatial” and the accuracy lift points is at least 20. |
| **DR-2167 Name** | A governed model's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2168 As of Instant** | A governed model's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2169 Days Since Registered** | A governed model's days since registered is computed as the number of days from the registered at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2170 Charter Count** | A governed model's charter count is the number of model charters related to the governed model. |
| **DR-2171 Current Charter Count** | A governed model's current charter count is the number of the governed model's model charters that are current. |
| **DR-2172 Current Steward Role** | A governed model's current steward role — taken from the linked current charter. |
| **DR-2173 Current Steward Agent** | A governed model's current steward agent — taken from the linked current charter. |
| **DR-2174 Current Authority Role** | A governed model's current authority role — taken from the linked current charter. |
| **DR-2175 Current Authority Agent** | A governed model's current authority agent — taken from the linked current charter. |
| **DR-2176 Is Ownerless** | A governed model is considered ownerless if the current charter count is 0. |
| **DR-2177 Is Ownerless Past a Year** | A governed model is considered an ownerless past a year if all of the following hold: the ownerless flag is set and the days since registered is greater than 365. |
| **DR-2178 Governance Lapsed** | A governed model is flagged governance lapsed if all of the following hold: the charter count is greater than 0 and the current charter count is 0. |
| **DR-2179 Has No Current Steward** | A governed model is considered to have no current steward if the current steward agent is blank. |
| **DR-2180 Has No Current Authority** | A governed model is considered to have no current authority if the current authority agent is blank. |
| **DR-2181 Is Procedure Without Change Authority** | A governed model is considered a procedure without change authority if all of the following hold: the model kind is “ProcedureFamily” and the current authority agent is blank. |
| **DR-2182 Last Steward Activity At** | A governed model's last steward activity at is the largest performed at across the steward activities related to the governed model. |
| **DR-2183 Days Since Steward Activity** | The governed model's days since steward activity is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the days since registered, if the last steward activity at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the last steward activity at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2184 Is Unmaintained** | A governed model is considered unmaintained if the days since steward activity is greater than 90. |
| **DR-2185 Documents Behind Count** | A governed model's documents behind count is the number of the governed model's model documents that are behind current releases. |
| **DR-2186 Is Not Kept Current** | A governed model is considered not-kept-current if at least one of the following holds: the unmaintained flag is set or the documents behind count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2187 Open Practice Drift Count** | A governed model's open practice drift count is the number of the governed model's drift observations that are open practice mismatches. |
| **DR-2188 Has Open Practice Drift** | A governed model is considered to have an open practice drift if the open practice drift count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2189 Is Neglected and Drifting** | A governed model is considered neglected-and-drifting if all of the following hold: the unmaintained flag is set and the open practice drift count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2190 Expert Found Drift Count** | A governed model's expert found drift count is the number of the governed model's drift observations that have a detected by of “ExpertWrongAnswer”. |
| **DR-2191 Cq Review Count** | A governed model's cq review count is the number of competency question reviews related to the governed model. |
| **DR-2192 Last Cq Review At** | A governed model's last cq review at is the largest reviewed at across the competency question reviews related to the governed model. |
| **DR-2193 Days Since Cq Review** | The governed model's days since cq review is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the days since registered, if the last cq review at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the last cq review at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2194 Cq Review Overdue** | A governed model is flagged cq review overdue if the days since cq review is greater than 92. |
| **DR-2195 Degradation Hidden Until Wrong Answer** | A governed model is flagged degradation hidden until wrong answer if all of the following hold: the expert found drift count is greater than 0 and the cq review count is 0. |
| **DR-2196 Baseline Question Count** | A governed model's baseline question count is the number of the governed model's competency question set entries that are original baselines. |
| **DR-2197 Requirements Spec Incomplete** | A governed model is considered to requirement a spec incomplete if at least one of the following holds: the requirements purpose is blank; the intended users is blank; or the baseline question count is 0. |
| **DR-2198 Collection Control Count** | A governed model's collection control count is the number of the governed model's governance stage controls that have a stage of “Collection”. |
| **DR-2199 Stewardship Control Count** | A governed model's stewardship control count is the number of the governed model's governance stage controls that have a stage of “Stewardship”. |
| **DR-2200 Retrieval Control Count** | A governed model's retrieval control count is the number of the governed model's governance stage controls that have a stage of “Retrieval”. |
| **DR-2201 Use Control Count** | A governed model's use control count is the number of the governed model's governance stage controls that have a stage of “Use”. |
| **DR-2202 Continuous Pipeline Stage Count** | A governed model's continuous pipeline stage count is the number of the governed model's governance stage controls that are continuous pipeline stages. |
| **DR-2203 Lacks Lifecycle Stage Control** | A governed model is considered to lack a lifecycle stage control if all of the following hold: the model kind is “ProcedureFamily” and at least one of the following holds: the collection control count is 0; the stewardship control count is 0; the retrieval control count is 0; or the use control count is 0. |
| **DR-2204 Pipeline Not Continuous** | A governed model is flagged pipeline not continuous if all of the following hold: the model kind is “ProcedureFamily” and the continuous pipeline stage count is less than 3. |
| **DR-2205 Procedure Has No Explicit Steps** | A governed model's procedure has no explicit steps when the linked procedure has no explicit steps. |
| **DR-2206 Is Unmanageable Undocumented Work** | A governed model is considered an unmanageable undocumented work if all of the following hold: the model kind is “ProcedureFamily”; the procedure has a value; and the procedure has no explicit steps flag is set. |
| **DR-2207 Is Without Originating Use Case** | A governed model is considered a without originating use case if all of the following hold: the model kind is not “Vocabulary” and the originating use case is blank. |
| **DR-2208 Pilot Count** | A governed model's pilot count is the number of model pilots related to the governed model. |
| **DR-2209 Is Adopted Without Pilot** | A governed model is considered an adopted without pilot if all of the following hold: the model kind is not “Vocabulary” and the pilot count is 0. |
| **DR-2210 Requirements Expert Count** | A governed model's requirements expert count is the number of the governed model's model activity experts that have a lot activity of “RequirementsSpecification”. |
| **DR-2211 Implementation Expert Count** | A governed model's implementation expert count is the number of the governed model's model activity experts that have a lot activity of “Implementation”. |
| **DR-2212 Publication Expert Count** | A governed model's publication expert count is the number of the governed model's model activity experts that have a lot activity of “Publication”. |
| **DR-2213 Maintenance Expert Count** | A governed model's maintenance expert count is the number of the governed model's model activity experts that have a lot activity of “Maintenance”. |
| **DR-2214 Experts Not Involved Throughout** | A governed model is considered to expert a not involved throughout if all of the following hold: the model kind is not “Vocabulary” and at least one of the following holds: the requirements expert count is 0; the implementation expert count is 0; the publication expert count is 0; or the maintenance expert count is 0. |
| **DR-2215 Real Data Mapping Run Count** | A governed model's real data mapping run count is the number of the governed model's model data mapping runs that have a data origin of “Real”. |
| **DR-2216 Is Implemented Without Real Data** | A governed model is considered an implemented without real data if all of the following hold: the model kind is not “Vocabulary” and the real data mapping run count is 0. |
| **DR-2217 Name** | A model charter's name is computed as the governed model, followed by “ / ”, followed by the steward role, followed by “ + ”, followed by the authority role. |
| **DR-2218 As of Instant** | A model charter's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2219 Is Current** | A model charter is considered current if all of the following hold: the valid from is at most the as of instant and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. |
| **DR-2220 Steward Agent** | A model charter's steward agent is the current agent of the model charter's steward role. |
| **DR-2221 Authority Agent** | A model charter's authority agent is the current agent of the model charter's authority role. |
| **DR-2222 Authority Organization** | A model charter's authority organization — taken from the linked authority role. |
| **DR-2223 Model Kind** | A model charter's model kind — taken from the linked governed model. |
| **DR-2224 Model Domain Owner** | A model charter's model domain owner is the domain owning organization of the model charter's governed model. |
| **DR-2225 Model Headcount** | A model charter's model headcount is the organization headcount of the model charter's governed model. |
| **DR-2226 Model Tooling Owner Role** | A model charter's model tooling owner role — taken from the linked governed model. |
| **DR-2227 Model First Control Adopted At** | A model charter's model first control adopted at — taken from the linked governed model. |
| **DR-2228 Is Steward Unwritten** | A model charter is considered a steward unwritten if at least one of the following holds: the steward role is blank or the steward responsibilities is blank. |
| **DR-2229 Is Authority Scope Unstated** | A model charter is considered authority-scope-unstated if at least one of the following holds: the authority role is blank or the authority approval scope is blank. |
| **DR-2230 Conflates Steward and Authority** | A model charter is considered to conflate a steward and authority if all of the following hold: the steward role has a value and the steward role is the authority role. |
| **DR-2231 Is Sanctioned Dual Holding** | A model charter is considered sanctioned-dual-holding if all of the following hold: the steward role is not the authority role; the steward agent has a value; the steward agent is the authority agent; and the model headcount is at most 50. |
| **DR-2232 Is Authority Outside Domain Owner** | A model charter is considered an authority outside domain owner if all of the following hold: the authority organization has a value; the model domain owner has a value; and the authority organization is not the model domain owner. |
| **DR-2233 Controls Precede Ownership** | A model charter is considered to control a precede ownership if all of the following hold: the supersedes charter is blank; the model first control adopted at has a value; and the model first control adopted at is less than the valid from. |
| **DR-2234 Steward Activity Count** | A model charter's steward activity count is the number of steward activities related to the model charter. |
| **DR-2235 Last Drift Watch At** | A model charter's last drift watch at is the largest performed at across the model charter's steward activities that have a duty kind of “DriftWatch”. |
| **DR-2236 Days Since Drift Watch** | The model charter's days since drift watch is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the valid from to the as of instant, if the last drift watch at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the last drift watch at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2237 Is Drift Watch Lapsed** | A model charter is considered drift-watch-lapsed if all of the following hold: the current flag is set and the days since drift watch is greater than 90. |
| **DR-2238 Procedure Decision Count** | A model charter's procedure decision count is the number of the model charter's change requests that are decided. |
| **DR-2239 Model Review Count** | A model charter's model review count is the number of the model charter's model change requests that have an authority review. |
| **DR-2240 Is Named But Unexercised** | A model charter is considered named-but-unexercised if all of the following hold: the current flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the steward activity count is 0 or the procedure decision count plus the model review count is 0. |
| **DR-2241 Steward is Outside Tooling** | A model charter is flagged steward is outside tooling if all of the following hold: the model kind is “Ontology”; the model tooling owner role has a value; and the steward role is not the model tooling owner role. |
| **DR-2242 Adopted Template Without Adaptation** | A model charter is flagged adopted template without adaptation if all of the following hold: the charter template has a value and the local adaptation is blank. |
| **DR-2243 Name** | A steward activity's name is computed as the model charter, followed by a space, followed by the duty kind. |
| **DR-2244 Activity Model** | A steward activity's activity model is the governed model of the steward activity's model charter. |
| **DR-2245 Name** | A model change request's name is the same as its title. |
| **DR-2246 Steward Agent** | A model change request's steward agent is the current steward agent of the model change request's governed model. |
| **DR-2247 Authority Agent** | A model change request's authority agent is the current authority agent of the model change request's governed model. |
| **DR-2248 Rule Key** | A model change request's rule key is computed as the governed model, followed by “|”, followed by the change layer. |
| **DR-2249 Required Route** | A model change request's required route — taken from the linked rule key. |
| **DR-2250 Is Accepted** | A model change request is considered accepted if at least one of the following holds: the status is “Approved” or the status is “Deployed”. |
| **DR-2251 Is Modeling Change** | A model change request is considered a modeling change if the classification is “ModelingChange”. |
| **DR-2252 Is Schema Change** | A model change request is considered a schema change if the change layer is “Schema”. |
| **DR-2253 Has Authority Review** | A model change request is considered to have an authority review if the authority reviewed at has a value. |
| **DR-2254 Requires Authority Review** | A model change request is considered to require an authority review if at least one of the following holds: the change operation is “RenameClass”; the change operation is “RemoveClass”; the change operation is “ChangeDomainRange”; the change operation is “AddDisjointness”; the change operation is “AddVocabularyTerm”; the change operation is “RetireDefinition”; or the declared scale is “Major”. |
| **DR-2255 Is Minor Scope** | A model change request is considered a minor scope if all of the following hold: the requires authority review is false and the declared scale is not “Major”. |
| **DR-2256 Steward Own Change Unreviewed** | A model change request is flagged steward own change unreviewed if all of the following hold: the steward agent has a value; the requested by agent is the steward agent; the is minor scope is false; and the has authority review is false. |
| **DR-2257 Steward Approval Out of Bounds** | A model change request is flagged steward approval out of bounds if all of the following hold: the approved by agent has a value; the approved by agent is the steward agent; the approved by agent is not the authority agent; and the is minor scope is false. |
| **DR-2258 Authority Review Skipped** | A model change request is flagged authority review skipped if all of the following hold: the requires authority review flag is set; the accepted flag is set; and the has authority review is false. |
| **DR-2259 Placement Not Decided by Authority** | A model change request is flagged placement not decided by authority if all of the following hold: the implementation placement has a value and the placement decided by agent is not the authority agent. |
| **DR-2260 Is Misrouted** | A model change request is considered misrouted if all of the following hold: the required route has a value and the route is not the required route. |
| **DR-2261 Lacks Motivating Question** | A model change request is considered to lack a motivating question if the motivating question is blank. |
| **DR-2262 Unmotivated and Not Returned** | A model change request is flagged unmotivated and not returned if all of the following hold: the lacks motivating question flag is set and the status is not “ReturnedForClarification”. |
| **DR-2263 Motivated by Failing Question** | A model change request is flagged motivated by failing question if all of the following hold: the motivating question has a value and the motivation kind is “ExistingQuestionNowFails”. |
| **DR-2264 Is Accepted Without Named Approver** | A model change request is considered an accepted without named approver if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set and the approved by agent is blank. |
| **DR-2265 Deployed Without Target Release** | A model change request is flagged deployed without target release if all of the following hold: the status is “Deployed”; the schema change flag is set; and the target release is blank. |
| **DR-2266 Is Misclassified Agent Swap** | A model change request is considered a misclassified agent swap if all of the following hold: the change operation is “ReassignAgent” and the classification is not “DataOperation”. |
| **DR-2267 Ai to Human Move Without Compliance Review** | A model change request is flagged ai to human move without compliance review if all of the following hold: the change operation is “MoveStepToHuman” and the compliance impact is blank. |
| **DR-2268 Ai to Human Move Unaudited** | A model change request is flagged ai to human move unaudited if all of the following hold: the change operation is “MoveStepToHuman” and at least one of the following holds: the effective at is blank or the stated need is blank. |
| **DR-2269 Is Ai to Human Move** | A model change request is considered an ai to human move if all of the following hold: the change operation is “MoveStepToHuman” and the effective at has a value. |
| **DR-2270 Lifecycle Change by Unauthorized Agent** | A model change request is flagged lifecycle change by unauthorized agent if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the change operation is “CreateDefinition”; the change operation is “ModifyDefinition”; or the change operation is “RetireDefinition”; the approved by agent has a value; the approved by agent is not the steward agent; and the approved by agent is not the authority agent. |
| **DR-2271 Assessed Inconsistent Count** | A model change request's assessed inconsistent count is the number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “InconsistentInstance” and have a finding stage of “Assessment”. |
