| **DR-2272 Post Deploy Inconsistent Count** | A model change request's post deploy inconsistent count is the number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “InconsistentInstance” and have a finding stage of “PostDeployment”. |
| **DR-2273 Assessed Inference Count** | A model change request's assessed inference count is the number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “AlteredInference” and have a finding stage of “Assessment”. |
| **DR-2274 Post Deploy Inference Count** | A model change request's post deploy inference count is the number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “AlteredInference” and have a finding stage of “PostDeployment”. |
| **DR-2275 Assessed Query Result Count** | A model change request's assessed query result count is the number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “AlteredQueryResult” and have a finding stage of “Assessment”. |
| **DR-2276 Post Deploy Query Result Count** | A model change request's post deploy query result count is the number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “AlteredQueryResult” and have a finding stage of “PostDeployment”. |
| **DR-2277 Assessed Coverage Gap Count** | A model change request's assessed coverage gap count is the number of the model change request's change impact findings that have a finding kind of “CoverageGap” and have a finding stage of “Assessment”. |
| **DR-2278 Would Make Instances Inconsistent** | A model change request is flagged would make instances inconsistent if the assessed inconsistent count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2279 Would Alter Inferences** | A model change request is flagged would alter inferences if the assessed inference count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2280 Would Alter Query Results** | A model change request is flagged would alter query results if the assessed query result count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2281 Would Leave Coverage Incomplete** | A model change request is flagged would leave coverage incomplete if the assessed coverage gap count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2282 Missed Inconsistent Instances** | A model change request is flagged missed inconsistent instances if all of the following hold: the post deploy inconsistent count is greater than 0 and the assessed inconsistent count is 0. |
| **DR-2283 Missed Altered Inferences** | A model change request is flagged missed altered inferences if all of the following hold: the post deploy inference count is greater than 0 and the assessed inference count is 0. |
| **DR-2284 Missed Altered Query Results** | A model change request is flagged missed altered query results if all of the following hold: the post deploy query result count is greater than 0 and the assessed query result count is 0. |
| **DR-2285 Leaves Coverage Unchecked** | A model change request is considered to leave coverage unchecked if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the modeling change flag is set; and the coverage checked at is blank. |
| **DR-2286 Domain Change Spread Wrong Inferences** | A model change request is flagged domain change spread wrong inferences if all of the following hold: the change operation is “ChangeDomainRange” and the post deploy inference count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2287 Intuitive Disjointness Broke Individuals** | A model change request is flagged intuitive disjointness broke individuals if all of the following hold: the change operation is “AddDisjointness”; the lacks motivating question flag is set; and the assessed inconsistent count plus the post deploy inconsistent count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2288 Validation Run Count** | A model change request's validation run count is the number of change validation runs related to the model change request. |
| **DR-2289 Acceptance Failure Total** | A model change request's acceptance failure total is the total failure count across the model change request's change validation runs that have a run purpose of “Acceptance”. |
| **DR-2290 Structural Pass Count** | A model change request's structural pass count is the number of the model change request's change validation runs that have a structural check outcome of “Pass”. |
| **DR-2291 Vocabulary Pass Count** | A model change request's vocabulary pass count is the number of the model change request's change validation runs that have a vocabulary check outcome of “Pass”. |
| **DR-2292 Accepted Without Test Run** | A model change request is flagged accepted without test run if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the modeling change flag is set; and the validation run count is 0. |
| **DR-2293 Accepted With Failing Suite** | A model change request is flagged accepted with failing suite if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set and the acceptance failure total is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2294 Accepted Without Structural Check** | A model change request is flagged accepted without structural check if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the modeling change flag is set; and the structural pass count is 0. |
| **DR-2295 Accepted Without Vocabulary Check** | A model change request is flagged accepted without vocabulary check if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the modeling change flag is set; and the vocabulary pass count is 0. |
| **DR-2296 Integrity Check Count** | A model change request's integrity check count is the number of change integrity checks related to the model change request. |
| **DR-2297 Human Integrity Check Count** | A model change request's human integrity check count is the number of the model change request's change integrity checks that have a checker kind of “Human”. |
| **DR-2298 Disjointness Check Count** | A model change request's disjointness check count is the number of the model change request's change integrity checks that have a check kind of “Disjointness”. |
| **DR-2299 Domain Inference Check Count** | A model change request's domain inference check count is the number of the model change request's change integrity checks that have a check kind of “DomainInference”. |
| **DR-2300 Range Consistency Check Count** | A model change request's range consistency check count is the number of the model change request's change integrity checks that have a check kind of “RangeConsistency”. |
| **DR-2301 Integrity Decided Without Human** | A model change request is flagged integrity decided without human if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the schema change flag is set; the integrity check count is greater than 0; and the human integrity check count is 0. |
| **DR-2302 Skipped Disjointness Review** | A model change request is flagged skipped disjointness review if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the schema change flag is set; and the disjointness check count is 0. |
| **DR-2303 Skipped Domain Inference Review** | A model change request is flagged skipped domain inference review if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the schema change flag is set; and the domain inference check count is 0. |
| **DR-2304 Skipped Range Review** | A model change request is flagged skipped range review if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set; the schema change flag is set; and the range consistency check count is 0. |
| **DR-2305 Unresolved Objection Count** | A model change request's unresolved objection count is the number of the model change request's change objections that are unresolved. |
| **DR-2306 Approved Over Unresolved Objection** | A model change request is flagged approved over unresolved objection if all of the following hold: the accepted flag is set and the unresolved objection count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2307 Name** | A change authority rule's name is computed as the governed model, followed by a space, followed by the change layer. |
| **DR-2308 Misrouted Request Count** | A change authority rule's misrouted request count is the number of the change authority rule's model change requests that are misrouted. |
| **DR-2309 Is Rule Bypassed** | A change authority rule is considered rule-bypassed if the misrouted request count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2310 Name** | A change impact finding's name is computed as the model change request, followed by a space, followed by the finding kind, followed by a space, followed by the finding stage. |
| **DR-2311 Name** | A change integrity check's name is computed as the model change request, followed by a space, followed by the check kind. |
| **DR-2312 Checker Kind** | A change integrity check's checker kind is the agent kind of the change integrity check's checked by agent. |
| **DR-2313 Name** | A change objection's name is computed as the model change request, followed by “ objection by ”, followed by the raised by agent. |
| **DR-2314 Is Unresolved** | A change objection is considered unresolved if the resolved at is blank. |
| **DR-2315 Name** | A change validation run's name is computed as the model change request, followed by a space, followed by the run purpose, followed by “ run”. |
| **DR-2316 Release** | A change validation run's release is the target release of the change validation run's model change request. |
| **DR-2317 Expected Chain Count** | A change validation run's expected chain count is the number of expected inference checks related to the change validation run. |
| **DR-2318 Unproduced Chain Count** | A change validation run's unproduced chain count is the number of the change validation run's expected inference checks that are unproduced. |
| **DR-2319 Has Uninspected Failures** | A change validation run is considered to have an uninspected failures if all of the following hold: the failure count is greater than 0 and the failures inspected at is blank. |
| **DR-2320 Is Unconfirmed Consistency** | A change validation run is considered unconfirmed-consistency if the consistency check outcome is not “Consistent”. |
| **DR-2321 Misses Expected Inference** | A change validation run is considered to misse an expected inference if the unproduced chain count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2322 Name** | An expected inference check's name is computed as the change validation run, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 50 character(s) of the chain description. |
| **DR-2323 Is Unproduced** | An expected inference check is considered unproduced if the produced value is not the expected value. |
| **DR-2324 Name** | A model consumer's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2325 Name** | A consumer revalidation's name is computed as the rulebook release, followed by “ / ”, followed by the model consumer. |
| **DR-2326 Name** | A model document's name is the same as its title. |
| **DR-2327 Model Current Release** | A model document's model current release — taken from the linked governed model. |
| **DR-2328 Is Behind Current Release** | A model document is considered a behind current release if all of the following hold: the documented release has a value; the model current release has a value; and the documented release is not the model current release. |
| **DR-2329 Name** | A staleness query run's name is computed as the governed model, followed by “ staleness run”. |
| **DR-2330 Runner Kind** | A staleness query run's runner kind is the agent kind of the staleness query run's ran by agent. |
| **DR-2331 Not Surfaced to Steward** | A staleness query run is flagged not surfaced to steward if all of the following hold: the stale workflow count is greater than 0 and the surfaced to steward at is blank. |
| **DR-2332 Name** | An external dependency revision's name is computed as the ontology profile, followed by a space, followed by the revision label. |
| **DR-2333 Affected Mapping Count** | An external dependency revision's affected mapping count — taken from the linked ontology profile. |
| **DR-2334 As of Instant** | An external dependency revision's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2335 Days Since Published** | An external dependency revision's days since published is computed as the number of days from the published at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2336 Is Untracked Revision** | An external dependency revision is considered an untracked revision if all of the following hold: the tracked at is blank; the affected mapping count is greater than 0; and the days since published is greater than 30. |
| **DR-2337 Name** | A stakeholder question's name is computed as the first 60 character(s) of the question text. |
| **DR-2338 Triager Kind** | A stakeholder question's triager kind is the agent kind of the stakeholder question's triaged by agent. |
| **DR-2339 Result Route** | A stakeholder question's result route — taken from the linked resulting change request. |
| **DR-2340 As of Instant** | A stakeholder question's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2341 Days Open** | The stakeholder question's days open is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of days from the asked at to the as of instant, if the answered at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the asked at to the answered at. |
| **DR-2342 Is Unanswered Past Due** | A stakeholder question is considered an unanswered past due if all of the following hold: the answered at is blank and the days open is greater than 14. |
| **DR-2343 Is Unanswerable Today** | A stakeholder question is considered unanswerable-today if the answering role question is blank. |
| **DR-2344 Is Untriaged Unanswerable** | A stakeholder question is considered untriaged-unanswerable if all of the following hold: the unanswerable today flag is set and the triage outcome is blank. |
| **DR-2345 Needs Structural Change** | A stakeholder question is considered to need a structural change if the triage outcome is “StructuralChange”. |
| **DR-2346 Unanswerable Without Scope Request** | A stakeholder question is flagged unanswerable without scope request if all of the following hold: the unanswerable today flag is set and the resulting change request is blank. |
| **DR-2347 Is Misrouted After Triage** | A stakeholder question is considered a misrouted after triage if all of the following hold: the resulting change request has a value and at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the triage outcome is “MoreData” and the result route is not “DataOperations” or all of the following hold: the triage outcome is not “MoreData”; the triage outcome has a value; and the result route is not “Governance”. |
| **DR-2348 Name** | A model expansion request's name is computed as the first 60 character(s) of the workflow description. |
| **DR-2349 Model Domain Owner** | A model expansion request's model domain owner is the domain owning organization of the model expansion request's governed model. |
| **DR-2350 Concept Count** | A model expansion request's concept count is the number of expansion concept fits related to the model expansion request. |
| **DR-2351 Uncovered Concept Count** | A model expansion request's uncovered concept count is the number of the model expansion request's expansion concept fits that are uncovered. |
| **DR-2352 Is Cross Function Expansion** | A model expansion request is considered a cross function expansion if all of the following hold: the requesting organization has a value; the model domain owner has a value; and the requesting organization is not the model domain owner. |
| **DR-2353 Requires Schema Extension** | A model expansion request is considered to require a schema extension if the uncovered concept count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2354 Fit Decision Contradicts Concept Fit** | A model expansion request is flagged fit decision contradicts concept fit if all of the following hold: the fit decision is “FitsExistingSchema” and the uncovered concept count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2355 Name** | An expansion concept fit's name is computed as the model expansion request, followed by “: ”, followed by the concept label. |
| **DR-2356 Is Uncovered** | An expansion concept fit is considered uncovered if the covering table is blank. |
| **DR-2357 Name** | A competency question set entry's name is computed as the governed model, followed by “ / ”, followed by the role question. |
| **DR-2358 As of Instant** | A competency question set entry's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2359 Days Since Added** | A competency question set entry's days since added is computed as the number of days from the added at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2360 Is Outgrown Baseline Question** | A competency question set entry is considered an outgrown baseline question if all of the following hold: the original baseline flag is set; the days since added is greater than 365; and the relevance verdict is “NoLongerRelevant”. |
| **DR-2361 Irrelevant But Still Active** | A competency question set entry is flagged irrelevant but still active if all of the following hold: the relevance verdict is “NoLongerRelevant” and the status is “Active”. |
| **DR-2362 Governance Use Count** | A competency question set entry's governance use count is computed as the count of the following that hold: the used for scoping flag is set; the used as acceptance criterion flag is set; the used as test driver flag is set; and the used for governance flag is set. |
| **DR-2363 Serves Every Governance Use** | A competency question set entry is considered to serve every governance use if the governance use count is 4. |
| **DR-2364 Name** | A competency question run's name is computed as the cq set entry, followed by “ @ ”, followed by the rulebook release. |
| **DR-2365 Entry is Original** | A competency question run's entry is original is true when the competency question run's cq set entry is an original baseline. |
| **DR-2366 Prior Was Answerable** | A competency question run's prior was answerable when the linked prior run was answerable. |
| **DR-2367 Is Baseline Regression** | A competency question run is considered a baseline regression if all of the following hold: the entry is original flag is set; the prior run has a value; the prior was answerable flag is set; and the was answerable is false. |
| **DR-2368 Is Unfixed Wrong Answer** | A competency question run is considered an unfixed wrong answer if all of the following hold: the answer outcome is “Wrong” and the defect change request is blank. |
| **DR-2369 Name** | A competency question review's name is computed as the governed model, followed by “ question review”. |
| **DR-2370 Name** | A quality criteria's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2371 Assessment Count** | A quality criteria's assessment count is the number of quality assessments related to the quality criteria. |
| **DR-2372 Name** | A quality assessment's name is computed as the rulebook release, followed by “ / ”, followed by the quality criterion. |
| **DR-2373 Name** | A term definition's name is computed as the rulebook table, followed by “ definition”. |
| **DR-2374 Drafter Kind** | A term definition's drafter kind is the agent kind of the term definition's drafted by agent. |
| **DR-2375 Ai Draft Adopted Unrevised** | A term definition is flagged ai draft adopted unrevised if all of the following hold: the drafter kind is “AIAgent” and the revised by agent is blank. |
| **DR-2376 Name** | A model proposal's name is computed as the proposal kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 50 character(s) of the content. |
| **DR-2377 Proposer Kind** | A model proposal's proposer kind is the agent kind of the model proposal's proposed by agent. |
| **DR-2378 Reviewer Kind** | A model proposal's reviewer kind is the agent kind of the model proposal's reviewed by agent. |
| **DR-2379 Committer Kind** | A model proposal's committer kind is the agent kind of the model proposal's committed by agent. |
| **DR-2380 Model Steward Agent** | A model proposal's model steward agent is the current steward agent of the model proposal's governed model. |
| **DR-2381 Is Ai Candidate** | A model proposal is considered an ai candidate if the proposer kind is “AIAgent”. |
| **DR-2382 Is Only Proposed** | A model proposal is considered only-proposed if the committed at is blank. |
| **DR-2383 Committed Without Expert Review** | A model proposal is flagged committed without expert review if all of the following hold: the committed at has a value and at least one of the following holds: the reviewed at is blank or the reviewer kind is not “Human”. |
| **DR-2384 Entered Without Quality Check** | A model proposal is flagged entered without quality check if all of the following hold: the committed at has a value and the quality check outcome is not “Pass”. |
| **DR-2385 Approver Unknown** | A model proposal is flagged approver unknown if all of the following hold: the committed at has a value and the reviewed by agent is blank. |
| **DR-2386 Committed Outside Any Version** | A model proposal is flagged committed outside any version if all of the following hold: the committed at has a value; the adopted in release is blank; and the adopted in data version is blank. |
| **DR-2387 Ai Question Adopted Unvetted** | A model proposal is flagged ai question adopted unvetted if all of the following hold: the ai candidate flag is set; the proposal kind is “CompetencyQuestion”; the committed at has a value; and the reviewed at is blank. |
| **DR-2388 Ai Alignment Decided by Ai** | A model proposal is flagged ai alignment decided by ai if all of the following hold: the ai candidate flag is set; the proposal kind is “Alignment”; the committed at has a value; and the committer kind is not “Human”. |
| **DR-2389 Ai Axiom Without Human Review** | A model proposal is flagged ai axiom without human review if all of the following hold: the ai candidate flag is set; at least one of the following holds: the proposal kind is “Axiom”; the proposal kind is “Disjointness”; or the proposal kind is “DomainRange”; the committed at has a value; and the reviewer kind is not “Human”. |
| **DR-2390 Adoption Not Answered by Person** | A model proposal is flagged adoption not answered by person if all of the following hold: the ai candidate flag is set; the committed at has a value; and the committer kind is not “Human”. |
| **DR-2391 Has No Human Touchpoint** | A model proposal is considered to have no human touchpoint if all of the following hold: the committed at has a value; the proposer kind is not “Human”; the reviewer kind is not “Human”; and the committer kind is not “Human”. |
| **DR-2392 Ai Instance Data Loaded Without Steward** | A model proposal is flagged ai instance data loaded without steward if all of the following hold: the ai candidate flag is set; the proposal kind is “InstanceData”; the committed at has a value; and the reviewed by agent is not the model steward agent. |
| **DR-2393 Awaits Engineer Vetting** | A model proposal is considered to await engineer vetting if all of the following hold: the ai candidate flag is set; the proposal kind is “CompetencyQuestion”; the source document has a value; the reviewed at is blank; and the committed at is blank. |
| **DR-2394 Is Pending Alignment Decision** | A model proposal is considered a pending alignment decision if all of the following hold: the proposal kind is “Alignment”; the review outcome is blank; and the committed at is blank. |
| **DR-2395 Awaits Steward Approval** | A model proposal is considered to await a steward approval if all of the following hold: the proposal kind is “InstanceData”; the reviewed at is blank; and the committed at is blank. |
| **DR-2396 Name** | An assignment instant check's name is computed as the step, followed by “ / ”, followed by the role assignment. |
| **DR-2397 Step Role** | An assignment instant check's step role is the assigned role of the assignment instant check's step. |
| **DR-2398 Assignment Role** | An assignment instant check's assignment role — taken from the linked role assignment. |
| **DR-2399 Assignment Valid From** | An assignment instant check's assignment valid from — taken from the linked role assignment. |
| **DR-2400 Assignment Valid to** | An assignment instant check's assignment valid to — taken from the linked role assignment. |
| **DR-2401 Assignment Agent** | An assignment instant check's assignment agent — taken from the linked role assignment. |
| **DR-2402 Assignment Agent Version** | An assignment instant check's assignment agent version is the agent version key of the assignment instant check's role assignment. |
| **DR-2403 Held Step At Instant** | An assignment instant check is flagged held step at instant if all of the following hold: the assignment role is the step role; the assignment valid from is at most the audit instant; and at least one of the following holds: the assignment valid to is blank or the assignment valid to is greater than the audit instant. |
| **DR-2404 Name** | An instance data version's name is the same as its data version label. |
| **DR-2405 Logged Change Count** | An instance data version's logged change count is the number of model change log entries related to the instance data version. |
| **DR-2406 Name** | A domain coverage area's name is the same as its area label. |
| **DR-2407 Is Uncovered Area** | A domain coverage area is considered an uncovered area if the covering table is blank. |
| **DR-2408 Name** | A governance stage control's name is computed as the governed model, followed by a space, followed by the stage. |
| **DR-2409 Is Continuous Pipeline Stage** | A governance stage control is considered a continuous pipeline stage if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the stage is “Collection”; the stage is “Organization”; or the stage is “Encoding” and the continuous flag is set. |
| **DR-2410 Name** | A process design decision's name is computed as the first 60 character(s) of the decision. |
| **DR-2411 Is Commitment Without Rationale** | A process design decision is considered a commitment without rationale if all of the following hold: the decision has a value and the rationale is blank. |
| **DR-2412 Days Before Recorded** | A process design decision's days before recorded is computed as the number of days from the decided at to the recorded at. |
| **DR-2413 Is Recorded After the Fact** | A process design decision is considered a recorded after the fact if the days before recorded is greater than 30. |
| **DR-2414 Name** | A model change log entry's name is computed as the change operation, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 50 character(s) of the change summary. |
| **DR-2415 Motivating Question** | A model change log entry's motivating question — taken from the linked model change request. |
| **DR-2416 Release Version** | A model change log entry's release version is the rulebook version of the model change log entry's release. |
| **DR-2417 Release Decision Undocumented** | A model change log entry's release decision undocumented is true when the model change log entry's release is an undocumented version decision. |
| **DR-2418 Alters Logical Model** | A model change log entry is considered to alter a logical model if at least one of the following holds: the change layer is “Schema” or the change layer is “Vocabulary”. |
| **DR-2419 Is Class Removal or Rename** | A model change log entry is considered a class removal or rename if at least one of the following holds: the change operation is “RemoveClass” or the change operation is “RenameClass”. |
| **DR-2420 Is Invalidating Domain Range Change** | A model change log entry is considered an invalidating domain range change if all of the following hold: the change operation is “ChangeDomainRange” and the invalidates instances flag is set. |
| **DR-2421 Is Inconsistent Disjointness** | A model change log entry is considered an inconsistent disjointness if all of the following hold: the change operation is “AddDisjointness” and the invalidates instances flag is set. |
| **DR-2422 Is Backward Incompatible** | A model change log entry is considered backward-incompatible if at least one of the following holds: the class removal or rename flag is set or the invalidates instances flag is set. |
| **DR-2423 Is Additive Schema Change** | A model change log entry is considered an additive schema change if all of the following hold: the change layer is “Schema” and at least one of the following holds: the change operation is “AddClass” or the change operation is “AddProperty”. |
| **DR-2424 Is Unexplained Modification** | A model change log entry is considered an unexplained modification if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the change layer is “Schema” or the change layer is “Instance” and the rationale is blank. |
| **DR-2425 Rationale Without Question** | A model change log entry is flagged rationale without question if all of the following hold: the rationale has a value and the motivating question is blank. |
| **DR-2426 Is Schema Change Without Increment** | A model change log entry is considered schema-change-without-increment if all of the following hold: the change layer is “Schema” and the release is blank. |
| **DR-2427 Is Instance Change in Schema Release** | A model change log entry is considered an instance change in schema release if all of the following hold: the change layer is “Instance” and the release has a value. |
| **DR-2428 Schema Change Without Request** | A model change log entry is flagged schema change without request if all of the following hold: the change layer is “Schema” and the model change request is blank. |
| **DR-2429 Cannot Be Audited** | A model change log entry is flagged cannot be audited if at least one of the following holds: the changed by agent is blank or all of the following hold: the release is blank and the instance data version is blank. |
| **DR-2430 Cannot Be Rolled Back** | A model change log entry is flagged cannot be rolled back if the prior state commit is blank. |
| **DR-2431 Is Untraceable Breaking Change** | A model change log entry is considered an untraceable breaking change if all of the following hold: the backward incompatible flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the release is blank or the release decision undocumented flag is set. |
| **DR-2432 Name** | A drift observation's name is computed as the governed model, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 50 character(s) of the description. |
| **DR-2433 Release Passed Validation** | A drift observation's release passed validation is true when the drift observation's since release is passed validation at release. |
| **DR-2434 Release Issued At** | A drift observation's release issued at — taken from the linked since release. |
| **DR-2435 Is Open Practice Mismatch** | A drift observation is considered an open practice mismatch if all of the following hold: the drift kind is “PracticeMismatch” and the resolved at is blank. |
| **DR-2436 Went Undetected by Passing Suite** | A drift observation is flagged went undetected by passing suite if all of the following hold: the since release has a value; the release passed validation flag is set; and the detected by is not “ValidationSuite”. |
| **DR-2437 Drift Follows Clean Release** | A drift observation is flagged drift follows clean release if all of the following hold: the since release has a value; the release passed validation flag is set; and the observed at is greater than the release issued at. |
| **DR-2438 Name** | A sourcing function's name is computed as the client organization, followed by “: ”, followed by the label. |
| **DR-2439 Is Outsourced** | A sourcing function is considered outsourced if the executing organization is not the client organization. |
| **DR-2440 Is Business Process Outsourcing** | A sourcing function is considered business-process-outsourcing if all of the following hold: the outsourced flag is set and the work nature is “Transactional”. |
| **DR-2441 Is Knowledge Process Outsourcing** | A sourcing function is considered knowledge-process-outsourcing if all of the following hold: the outsourced flag is set and the work nature is “ExpertiseHeavy”. |
| **DR-2442 Is Vital Expertise Classed Non Core** | A sourcing function is considered a vital expertise classed non core if all of the following hold: the sourcing class is “SentOutExecution”; the strategically vital flag is set; and the work nature is “ExpertiseHeavy”. |
| **DR-2443 Is What How Split** | A sourcing function is considered a what how split if the specification holder is not the method holder. |
| **DR-2444 Is Method Knowledge Held Outside** | A sourcing function is considered a method knowledge held outside if the method holder is not the client organization. |
| **DR-2445 Claims How Without Doing** | A sourcing function is considered to claim how without doing if all of the following hold: the method holder is the client organization and the outsourced flag is set. |
| **DR-2446 Is Vital Expertise Process** | A sourcing function is considered a vital expertise process if all of the following hold: the strategically vital flag is set and the work nature is “ExpertiseHeavy”. |
| **DR-2447 Is Outsourced Vital Expertise Process** | A sourcing function is considered an outsourced vital expertise process if all of the following hold: the vital expertise process flag is set and the outsourced flag is set. |
| **DR-2448 Audit Item Count** | A sourcing function's audit item count is the number of knowledge audit items related to the sourcing function. |
| **DR-2449 Dependency Count** | A sourcing function's dependency count is the number of the sourcing function's knowledge audit items that are knowledge-dependency. |
| **DR-2450 Coverage Gap Count** | A sourcing function's coverage gap count is the number of the sourcing function's knowledge audit items that are coverage gaps. |
| **DR-2451 Specification Audit Count** | A sourcing function's specification audit count is the number of the sourcing function's knowledge audit items that have a knowledge kind of “Specification”. |
| **DR-2452 Specification Shortfall Count** | A sourcing function's specification shortfall count is the number of the sourcing function's knowledge audit items that have an internal shortfall and have a knowledge kind of “Specification”. |
| **DR-2453 Method Shortfall Count** | A sourcing function's method shortfall count is the number of the sourcing function's knowledge audit items that have an internal shortfall and have a knowledge kind of “Method”. |
| **DR-2454 Provider Ip Documentation Count** | A sourcing function's provider ip documentation count is the number of the sourcing function's provider engagements that have a documentation ownership of “ProviderIP”. |
| **DR-2455 Designs What It Cannot Build** | A sourcing function is considered to design a what it cannot build if all of the following hold: the delivers own product flag is set; the outsourced flag is set; the provider ip documentation count is greater than 0; the specification audit count is greater than 0; the specification shortfall count is 0; and the method shortfall count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2456 Is Unaudited Function** | A sourcing function is considered an unaudited function if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the outsourced flag is set or the strategically vital flag is set and the audit item count is 0. |
| **DR-2457 Capture Initiative Count** | A sourcing function's capture initiative count is the number of knowledge capture initiatives related to the sourcing function. |
| **DR-2458 Is Uncaptured Priority Process** | A sourcing function is considered an uncaptured priority process if all of the following hold: the vital expertise process flag is set; at least one of the following holds: the outsourced flag is set or the coverage gap count is greater than 0; and the capture initiative count is 0. |
| **DR-2459 Name** | A knowledge audit's name is computed as the organization, followed by “: ”, followed by the title. |
| **DR-2460 Finding Count** | A knowledge audit's finding count is the number of the knowledge audit's knowledge audit items that have an internal shortfall. |
| **DR-2461 Treats Deficit As Cost Problem** | A knowledge audit is considered to treat a deficit as cost problem if all of the following hold: the finding count is greater than 0 and the problem framing is not “KnowledgeDeficit”. |
| **DR-2462 Name** | A knowledge audit item's name is computed as the knowledge audit, followed by “ / ”, followed by the knowledge area. |
| **DR-2463 Client Organization** | A knowledge audit item's client organization — taken from the linked knowledge audit. |
| **DR-2464 Has Internal Shortfall** | A knowledge audit item is considered to have an internal shortfall if the held internal level is less than the needed level. |
| **DR-2465 Is Knowledge Dependency** | A knowledge audit item is considered knowledge-dependency if all of the following hold: the internal shortfall flag is set; the provider holding knowledge has a value; and the provider held level is at least the needed level. |
| **DR-2466 Is Coverage Gap** | A knowledge audit item is considered a coverage gap if all of the following hold: the internal shortfall flag is set and the knowledge dependency flag is not set. |
| **DR-2467 Is Unnamed Finding** | A knowledge audit item is considered unnamed-finding if all of the following hold: the internal shortfall flag is set and the named knowledge gap is blank. |
| **DR-2468 Is Single Team Silo** | A knowledge audit item is considered a single team silo if all of the following hold: the held internal level is at least the needed level and the internal holding team count is 1. |
| **DR-2469 Name** | A knowledge capture initiative's name is computed as the sourcing function, followed by “ by ”, followed by the knowledge method. |
| **DR-2470 Name** | A knowledge workforce position's name is computed as the organization, followed by a space, followed by the discipline. |
| **DR-2471 Name** | A provider engagement's name is computed as the client organization, followed by “ <- ”, followed by the provider. |
| **DR-2472 Is Active** | A provider engagement is considered active if the status is “Active”. |
| **DR-2473 Relied Dependency Count** | A provider engagement's relied dependency count is the number of knowledge audit items related to the provider engagement. |
| **DR-2474 Is Unplanned Knowledge Return** | A provider engagement is considered an unplanned knowledge return if all of the following hold: the relied dependency count is greater than 0; the documentation ownership is “ProviderIP”; and the knowledge return plan is blank. |
| **DR-2475 Is Knowledge Access Unsecured** | A provider engagement is considered knowledge-access-unsecured if all of the following hold: the active flag is set; the relied dependency count is greater than 0; and the has knowledge access clause is false. |
| **DR-2476 Required Deliverable Count** | A provider engagement's required deliverable count is the number of knowledge deliverables related to the provider engagement. |
| **DR-2477 To Client Required Count** | A provider engagement's to client required count is the number of the provider engagement's knowledge deliverables that have a direction of “ToClient”. |
| **DR-2478 To Client Delivered Count** | A provider engagement's to client delivered count is the number of the provider engagement's knowledge deliverables that are delivered and have a direction of “ToClient”. |
| **DR-2479 To Provider Delivered Count** | A provider engagement's to provider delivered count is the number of the provider engagement's knowledge deliverables that are delivered and have a direction of “ToProvider”. |
| **DR-2480 Joint Deliverable Count** | A provider engagement's joint deliverable count is the number of the provider engagement's knowledge deliverables that have a direction of “Joint”. |
| **DR-2481 Lacks Knowledge Deliverables** | A provider engagement is considered to lack a knowledge deliverables if all of the following hold: the active flag is set and the required deliverable count is 0. |
| **DR-2482 Is One Way Learning** | A provider engagement is considered one-way-learning if all of the following hold: the active flag is set; the required deliverable count is greater than 0; and at least one of the following holds: the to client delivered count is 0 or the to provider delivered count is 0. |
| **DR-2483 Is Short Term Without Joint Knowledge** | A provider engagement is considered a short term without joint knowledge if all of the following hold: the active flag is set; the term months is less than 36; and the joint deliverable count is 0. |
| **DR-2484 Obliges Knowledge Flow Back** | A provider engagement is considered to oblige a knowledge flow back if all of the following hold: the to client required count is greater than 0 and the knowledge return plan has a value. |
| **DR-2485 Name** | A knowledge deliverable's name is computed as the provider engagement, followed by a space, followed by the direction, followed by “: ”, followed by the title. |
| **DR-2486 Is Delivered** | A knowledge deliverable is considered delivered if the delivered at has a value. |
| **DR-2487 Name** | A corporate governance program's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2488 Is Compliance Only** | A corporate governance program is considered a compliance only if all of the following hold: the covers compliance flag is set; the covers data quality is false; the covers information management is false; and the covers knowledge management is false. |
| **DR-2489 Name** | A records retention policy's name is computed as the record class, followed by “ / ”, followed by the retention driver. |
| **DR-2490 Program Sponsor Discipline** | A records retention policy's program sponsor discipline — taken from the linked governance program. |
| **DR-2491 Is Legal Led Knowledge Destruction** | A records retention policy is considered a legal led knowledge destruction if all of the following hold: the program sponsor discipline is “Legal”; the retention driver is “ComplianceRisk”; and the retention years is less than the knowledge useful life years. |
| **DR-2492 Name** | An ai registry model version's name is computed as the dc title, followed by a space, followed by the dc has version. |
| **DR-2493 Graph Individual Count** | An ai registry model version's graph individual count is the number of agents related to the ai registry model version. |
| **DR-2494 Live Production Deployment Count** | An ai registry model version's live production deployment count is the number of the ai registry model version's ai model deployments that are live in productions. |
| **DR-2495 Is Live But Unregistered in Graph** | An ai registry model version is considered a live but unregistered in graph if all of the following hold: the live production deployment count is greater than 0 and the graph individual count is 0. |
| **DR-2496 Name** | An ai model deployment's name is computed as the model version, followed by “ @ ”, followed by the environment. |
| **DR-2497 As of Instant** | An ai model deployment's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2498 Is Live in Production** | An ai model deployment is considered a live in production if all of the following hold: the environment is “Production”; the deployed at is at most the as of instant; and at least one of the following holds: the retired at is blank or the retired at is greater than the as of instant. |
| **DR-2499 Agent Identifier** | An ai model deployment's agent identifier is the dc identifier of the ai model deployment's model version. |
| **DR-2500 Assignment Link Count** | An ai model deployment's assignment link count is the number of role assignments related to the ai model deployment. |
| **DR-2501 Artifact Link Count** | An ai model deployment's artifact link count is the number of execution entities related to the ai model deployment. |
| **DR-2502 Is Isolated Registry Fact** | An ai model deployment is considered an isolated registry fact if all of the following hold: the live in production flag is set; the assignment link count is 0; and the artifact link count is 0. |
| **DR-2503 Name** | An ai model evaluation's name is computed as the model version, followed by a space, followed by the metric. |
| **DR-2504 Passed** | An ai model evaluation is flagged passed if the score is at least the pass threshold. |
| **DR-2505 Name** | An ai agent accountability's name is computed as the ai agent, followed by “ accountable to ”, followed by the accountable agent. |
| **DR-2506 As of Instant** | An ai agent accountability's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2507 Is Current** | An ai agent accountability is considered current if all of the following hold: the valid from is at most the as of instant and at least one of the following holds: the valid to is blank or the valid to is greater than the as of instant. |
| **DR-2508 Accountable Agent Kind** | An ai agent accountability's accountable agent kind — taken from the linked accountable agent. |
| **DR-2509 Is Accountable to Non Person** | An ai agent accountability is considered an accountable to non person if the accountable agent kind is not “Human”. |
| **DR-2510 Is Current Human Accountability** | An ai agent accountability is considered current-human-accountability if all of the following hold: the current flag is set and the accountable agent kind is “Human”. |
| **DR-2511 Name** | An agent upgrade assessment's name is computed as the current agent, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the candidate agent, followed by “ (”, followed by the assessment method, followed by “)”. |
| **DR-2512 Attributed Artifact Count** | An agent upgrade assessment's attributed artifact count — taken from the linked current agent. |
| **DR-2513 Traversed Downstream Step Count** | An agent upgrade assessment's traversed downstream step count is the artifact blast radius step count of the agent upgrade assessment's current agent. |
| **DR-2514 Missed Traversed Impact** | An agent upgrade assessment is flagged missed traversed impact if the listed affected step count is less than the traversed downstream step count. |
| **DR-2515 Name** | An assignment update policy's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2516 Name** | A role assignment update task's name is computed as the role, followed by a space, followed by the trigger event, followed by “ @ ”, followed by the trigger occurred at. |
| **DR-2517 As of Instant** | A role assignment update task's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2518 Policy Trigger Owner Role** | A role assignment update task's policy trigger owner role — taken from the linked governing policy. |
| **DR-2519 Trigger Owner Cover Count** | A role assignment update task's trigger owner cover count is the currently covered assignment count of the role assignment update task's policy trigger owner role. |
| **DR-2520 Lacks Named Trigger Owner** | A role assignment update task is considered to lack a named trigger owner if at least one of the following holds: the policy trigger owner role is blank or the trigger owner cover count is 0. |
| **DR-2521 Policy Sla Hours** | A role assignment update task's policy sla hours is the update sla hours of the role assignment update task's governing policy. |
| **DR-2522 Elapsed Minutes** | The role assignment update task's elapsed minutes is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the number of minutes from the trigger occurred at to the as of instant, if the completed at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of minutes from the trigger occurred at to the completed at. |
| **DR-2523 Exceeded Update Sla** | A role assignment update task is flagged exceeded update sla if at least one of the following holds: the policy sla hours is 0 or the elapsed minutes is greater than the policy sla hours times 60. |
| **DR-2524 Ending Role** | A role assignment update task's ending role — taken from the linked ending assignment. |
| **DR-2525 Replacement Role** | A role assignment update task's replacement role — taken from the linked replacement assignment. |
| **DR-2526 Changed Role Instead of Assignment** | A role assignment update task is flagged changed role instead of assignment if all of the following hold: the replacement assignment has a value and the replacement role is not the ending role. |
| **DR-2527 Dependent Run Version** | A role assignment update task's dependent run version is the procedure version of the role assignment update task's dependent execution. |
| **DR-2528 Dependent Run Started At** | A role assignment update task's dependent run started at — taken from the linked dependent execution. |
| **DR-2529 Dependent Run Role Step Count** | A role assignment update task's dependent run role step count is the number of steps related to the role assignment update task. |
| **DR-2530 Missed Next Dependent Run** | A role assignment update task is flagged missed next dependent run if all of the following hold: the dependent run role step count is greater than 0; the dependent run started at is greater than the trigger occurred at; and at least one of the following holds: the completed at is blank or the completed at is greater than the dependent run started at. |
| **DR-2531 Failed Notice Count** | A role assignment update task's failed notice count is the number of assignment routed notices related to the role assignment update task. |
| **DR-2532 Stale Assignment Broke Routing** | A role assignment update task is flagged stale assignment broke routing if all of the following hold: the missed next dependent run flag is set and the failed notice count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2533 Name** | An assignment routed notice's name is computed as the procedure execution, followed by “ / ”, followed by the notice step, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the routed to agent. |
| **DR-2534 Notice Role** | An assignment routed notice's notice role is the assigned role of the assignment routed notice's notice step. |
| **DR-2535 Recipient Role Key** | An assignment routed notice's recipient role key is computed as the routed to agent, followed by “|”, followed by the notice role. |
| **DR-2536 Recipient Pair Assignment Count** | An assignment routed notice's recipient pair assignment count is the number of role assignments related to the assignment routed notice. |
| **DR-2537 Recipient Valid From** | An assignment routed notice's recipient valid from is the largest valid from across the role assignments related to the assignment routed notice. |
| **DR-2538 Recipient Latest Valid to** | An assignment routed notice's recipient latest valid to is the largest valid to across the role assignments related to the assignment routed notice. |
| **DR-2539 Recipient Open Ended Count** | An assignment routed notice's recipient open ended count is the number of the assignment routed notice's role assignments that are open-ended. |
| **DR-2540 Recipient Held Role When Sent** | An assignment routed notice is flagged recipient held role when sent if all of the following hold: the routed to agent has a value; the recipient pair assignment count is greater than 0; the recipient valid from is at most the sent at; and at least one of the following holds: the recipient open ended count is greater than 0 or the recipient latest valid to is greater than the sent at. |
| **DR-2541 Reached Wrong Person or Nobody** | An assignment routed notice is flagged reached wrong person or nobody if the recipient held role when sent flag is not set. |
| **DR-2542 Routed Around Model** | An assignment routed notice is flagged routed around model if all of the following hold: the routing source is not “RoleAssignments” and the recipient held role when sent flag is not set. |
| **DR-2543 Name** | A practitioner expertise's name is computed as the agent, followed by “: ”, followed by the cue. |
| **DR-2544 Knows More Than Can Say** | A practitioner expertise is considered to know a more than can say if all of the following hold: the expert kind is “Detection”; the unstated basis has a value; and the reliable call count is at least 3. |
| **DR-2545 Is Unexplained Foresight** | A practitioner expertise is considered an unexplained foresight if all of the following hold: the expert kind is “DesignForesight”; the unstated basis has a value; and the foresight confirmed flag is set. |
| **DR-2546 Name** | A critical incident's name is computed as the outcome, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 60 character(s) of the account. |
| **DR-2547 Is Adverse or Improvised** | A critical incident is considered adverse-or-improvised if at least one of the following holds: the outcome is “WentBadly” or the outcome is “Improvised”. |
| **DR-2548 Has Surfaced Judgment** | A critical incident is considered to have surfaced judgment if the revealed judgment has a value. |
| **DR-2549 Name** | An interview probe's name is computed as the probe kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 60 character(s) of the prompt. |
| **DR-2550 Why Answer** | The interview probe's why answer is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the answer, if the probe kind is “Why”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-2551 Shortfall Answer** | The interview probe's shortfall answer is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the answer, if the probe kind is “ProcedureFallsShort”;<br>2. in all other cases, an empty string. |
| **DR-2552 Name** | An observed action's name is computed as the action kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 60 character(s) of the action description. |
| **DR-2553 Is Small Choice** | An observed action is considered a small choice if the action kind is “SmallChoice”. |
| **DR-2554 Is Unofficial Workaround** | An observed action is considered an unofficial workaround if the action kind is “Workaround”. |
| **DR-2555 Is Omitted From Own Account** | An observed action is considered an omitted from own account if all of the following hold: the elicitation session has a value and the mentioned in own account flag is not set. |
| **DR-2556 Is Missed Step Left Uncaptured** | An observed action is considered missed-step-left-uncaptured if all of the following hold: the omitted from own account flag is set and the captured as fragment is blank. |
| **DR-2557 Is Watched Not Questioned** | An observed action is considered watched-not-questioned if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the action kind is “SmallChoice” or the action kind is “Workaround” and the stated reason is blank. |
| **DR-2558 Has Recorded Reason** | An observed action is considered to have a recorded reason if the stated reason has a value. |
| **DR-2559 Has Counterfactual Answer** | An observed action is considered to have a counterfactual answer if all of the following hold: the counterfactual condition has a value and the counterfactual answer has a value. |
| **DR-2560 Name** | An elicitation participant's name is computed as the agent, followed by “ in ”, followed by the elicitation session. |
| **DR-2561 Is Practitioner** | An elicitation participant is considered a practitioner if the participation role is “Practitioner”. |
| **DR-2562 Is Subject Matter Expert** | An elicitation participant is considered a subject matter expert if the participation role is “SubjectMatterExpert”. |
| **DR-2563 Is Knowledge Engineer** | An elicitation participant is considered a knowledge engineer if the participation role is “KnowledgeEngineer”. |
| **DR-2564 Is Knowledge Producer** | An elicitation participant is considered a knowledge producer if at least one of the following holds: the knowledge flow is “Producer” or the knowledge flow is “Both”. |
| **DR-2565 Is Knowledge Consumer** | An elicitation participant is considered a knowledge consumer if at least one of the following holds: the knowledge flow is “Consumer” or the knowledge flow is “Both”. |
| **DR-2566 Name** | A representation review's name is computed as the review purpose, followed by “: ”, followed by the procedure version, followed by “ by ”, followed by the reviewer agent. |
| **DR-2567 Name** | A workflow view divergence's name is computed as the step, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 40 character(s) of the view a, followed by “ / ”, followed by the first 40 character(s) of the view b. |
| **DR-2568 Is Reconciled** | A workflow view divergence is considered reconciled if the reconciled statement has a value. |
| **DR-2569 Is Surfaced But Unreconciled** | A workflow view divergence is considered surfaced-but-unreconciled if all of the following hold: the view a has a value; the view b has a value; and the reconciled statement is blank. |
| **DR-2570 Name** | An expert cognition's name is computed as the cognition kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 60 character(s) of the statement. |
| **DR-2571 Is Mental Model** | An expert cognition is considered a mental model if the cognition kind is “MentalModel”. |
| **DR-2572 Is Automatic Heuristic** | An expert cognition is considered automatic-heuristic if all of the following hold: the cognition kind is “DecisionHeuristic” and the applied automatically flag is set. |
| **DR-2573 Is Heuristic Oversimplified** | An expert cognition is considered heuristic-oversimplified if all of the following hold: the cognition kind is “DecisionHeuristic”; the expert stated exceptions flag is set; and the captured exceptions is blank. |
| **DR-2574 Name** | A concept ladder rung's name is computed as the step, followed by a space, followed by the rung kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 50 character(s) of the statement. |
| **DR-2575 Step Top Level** | A concept ladder rung's step top level is the largest ladder level across the concept ladder rungs related to the concept ladder rung. |
| **DR-2576 Is Ultimate Goal** | A concept ladder rung is considered an ultimate goal if all of the following hold: the ladder level is greater than 0 and the ladder level is the step top level. |
| **DR-2577 Is Decomposition Rung** | A concept ladder rung is considered a decomposition rung if the ladder level is less than 0. |
| **DR-2578 Name** | A repertory grid construct's name is the same as its dimension. |
| **DR-2579 Dimension** | A repertory grid construct's dimension is computed as the pole a, followed by “ vs ”, followed by the pole b. |
| **DR-2580 Is Never Stated Dimension** | A repertory grid construct is considered a never stated dimension if all of the following hold: the pole a has a value and the was stated unprompted flag is not set. |
| **DR-2581 Is Recorded Discriminating Dimension** | A repertory grid construct is considered a recorded discriminating dimension if all of the following hold: the pole a has a value and the separates situations flag is set. |
| **DR-2582 Name** | A knowledge conversion's name is computed as the conversion mode, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 60 character(s) of the description. |
| **DR-2583 Is Mode Inconsistent With Forms** | A knowledge conversion is considered a mode inconsistent with forms if it is not the case that at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the conversion mode is “Socialization”; the from form is “Tacit”; and the to form is “Tacit”; all of the following hold: the conversion mode is “Externalization”; the from form is “Tacit”; and the to form is “Explicit”; all of the following hold: the conversion mode is “Combination”; the from form is “Explicit”; and the to form is “Explicit”; or all of the following hold: the conversion mode is “Internalization”; the from form is “Explicit”; and the to form is “Tacit”. |
| **DR-2584 Name** | A knowledge holding's name is computed as the snapshot, followed by a space, followed by the carrier, followed by “: ”, followed by the first 50 character(s) of the statement. |
| **DR-2585 Formalized Fragment Session** | A knowledge holding's formalized fragment session is the elicitation session of the knowledge holding's formalized as. |
| **DR-2586 Is Unformalized Process Knowledge** | A knowledge holding is considered an unformalized process knowledge if all of the following hold: the formalized as is blank and the carrier is not “ProcedureRulebook”. |
| **DR-2587 Is Procedural Knowledge** | A knowledge holding is considered a procedural knowledge if the formalized as has a value. |
| **DR-2588 Is Judgment Outside Document** | A knowledge holding is considered a judgment outside document if all of the following hold: the unsaid in sop flag is set and the unformalized process knowledge flag is set. |
| **DR-2589 Is Veteran Discretion** | A knowledge holding is considered a veteran discretion if all of the following hold: the holder is veteran flag is set; the handles exception or discretion flag is set; and the unformalized process knowledge flag is set. |
| **DR-2590 Is Formalized Without Elicitation Work** | A knowledge holding is considered a formalized without elicitation work if all of the following hold: the formalized as has a value and the formalized fragment session is blank. |
| **DR-2591 Name** | A fragment corroboration's name is computed as the knowledge fragment, followed by “ via ”, followed by the elicitation session. |
| **DR-2592 Name** | A knowledge test outcome's name is computed as the procedure, followed by “: ”, followed by the outcome area. |
| **DR-2593 Is Improved** | A knowledge test outcome is considered improved if at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the higher is better flag is set and the after test value is greater than the baseline value or all of the following hold: the higher is better flag is not set and the after test value is less than the baseline value. |
| **DR-2594 Name** | A know how carrier's name is computed as the topic, followed by “ / ”, followed by the carrier kind. |
| **DR-2595 As of Instant** | A know how carrier's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2596 Holder is Still Engaged** | A know how carrier's holder is still engaged when the linked holder agent is still engaged. |
| **DR-2597 Holder Service Started At** | A know how carrier's holder service started at — taken from the linked holder agent. |
| **DR-2598 Holder Departure At** | A know how carrier's holder departure at — taken from the linked holder agent. |
| **DR-2599 Days Until Holder Departure** | The know how carrier's days until holder departure is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 99999, if the holder departure at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the as of instant to the holder departure at. |
| **DR-2600 Days Served to As of** | The know how carrier's days served to as of is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the holder service started at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the holder service started at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2601 Days Served to Departure** | The know how carrier's days served to departure is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if at least one of the following holds: the holder service started at is blank or the holder departure at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the holder service started at to the holder departure at. |
| **DR-2602 Holder Tenure Years** | A know how carrier's holder tenure years is computed as the days served to departure if all of the following hold: the holder departure at has a value and the days until holder departure is less than 0, in all other cases the days served to as of divided by 365 rounded to 1 decimal place(s). |
| **DR-2603 Is Veteran Held** | A know how carrier is considered a veteran held if all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value and the holder tenure years is at least 10. |
| **DR-2604 Is Holder Leaving Soon** | A know how carrier is considered a holder leaving soon if all of the following hold: the holder departure at has a value; the days until holder departure is at least 0; and the days until holder departure is at most 120. |
| **DR-2605 Transfer Count** | A know how carrier's transfer count is the number of knowledge transfers related to the know how carrier. |
| **DR-2606 Repository Entry Count** | A know how carrier's repository entry count is the number of knowledge repository entries related to the know how carrier. |
| **DR-2607 Source Relationship Count** | A know how carrier's source relationship count is the number of source relationships related to the know how carrier. |
| **DR-2608 Is Held in Both Forms** | A know how carrier is considered a held in both forms if all of the following hold: the in written procedure flag is set and the trained skill flag is set. |
| **DR-2609 Is Held by Current Practitioner** | A know how carrier is considered a held by current practitioner if all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value and the holder is still engaged is true. |
| **DR-2610 Is Untransferred Veteran Know How** | A know how carrier is considered an untransferred veteran know how if all of the following hold: the veteran held flag is set; the holder is still engaged is true; the transfer count is 0; and the repository entry count is 0. |
| **DR-2611 Is At Risk of Imminent Loss** | A know how carrier is considered at-risk-of-imminent-loss if all of the following hold: the untransferred veteran know how flag is set and the holder leaving soon flag is set. |
| **DR-2612 Is Held Only by Departed** | A know how carrier is considered held-only-by-departed if all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value; the holder is still engaged is false; the transfer count is 0; and the repository entry count is 0. |
| **DR-2613 Is Held by Departed Holder** | A know how carrier is considered a held by departed holder if all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value and the holder is still engaged is false. |
| **DR-2614 Is Captured** | A know how carrier is considered captured if the repository entry count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2615 Must Be Relearned If Holder Leaves** | A know how carrier is considered to require be relearned if holder leaves if all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value; the holder is still engaged is true; and the repository entry count is 0. |
| **DR-2616 Is Overlooked Living Holder** | A know how carrier is considered an overlooked living holder if all of the following hold: the holder agent has a value; the holder is still engaged is true; the repository entry count is 0; and the source relationship count is 0. |
| **DR-2617 Transfer Stops Without Veteran** | A know how carrier is flagged transfer stops without veteran if all of the following hold: the veteran held flag is set; the holder is still engaged is true; the transfer count is greater than 0; and the repository entry count is 0. |
| **DR-2618 Dependency Community** | A know how carrier's dependency community is the community of practice of the know how carrier's builds on know how. |
| **DR-2619 Builds on Same Community Know How** | A know how carrier is considered to build on same community know how if all of the following hold: the builds on know how has a value; the community of practice has a value; and the dependency community is the community of practice. |
| **DR-2620 Lost Accumulation Years** | The know how carrier's lost accumulation years is determined by the following priority:<br>1. the holder tenure years, if the held only by departed flag is set;<br>2. in all other cases, 0. |
| **DR-2621 Is Delegated to Unfit Source** | A know how carrier is considered a delegated to unfit source if all of the following hold: at least one of the following holds: the replacement plan is “PublicReference” or the replacement plan is “AiGeneration” and the is in public references is false. |
| **DR-2622 Name** | A knowledge transfer's name is computed as the know how, followed by “ via ”, followed by the channel. |
| **DR-2623 From Organization** | A knowledge transfer's from organization — taken from the linked from agent. |
| **DR-2624 Recipient Role Count** | A knowledge transfer's recipient role count is the count of current role assignments of the knowledge transfer's recipient agent. |
| **DR-2625 Is Traditional Channel** | A knowledge transfer is considered a traditional channel if at least one of the following holds: the channel is “Document”; the channel is “TrainingProgram”; or the channel is “Mentoring”. |
| **DR-2626 Is Social Network Channel** | A knowledge transfer is considered a social network channel if at least one of the following holds: the channel is “PersonalRelationship”; the channel is “Collaboration”; the channel is “DesignProductionIteration”; or the channel is “EmployerChange”. |
| **DR-2627 Is Ambient Absorption by Non Practitioner** | A knowledge transfer is considered an ambient absorption by non practitioner if all of the following hold: the recipient agent has a value; the channel is “AmbientExposure”; and the recipient role count is 0. |
| **DR-2628 Know How Topic** | A knowledge transfer's know how topic — taken from the linked know how. |
| **DR-2629 Name** | A knowledge repository entry's name is the same as its title. |
| **DR-2630 As of Instant** | A knowledge repository entry's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2631 Author is Still Engaged** | A knowledge repository entry's author is still engaged when the linked author agent is still engaged. |
| **DR-2632 Author Agent Kind** | A knowledge repository entry's author agent kind — taken from the linked author agent. |
| **DR-2633 Owner Organization** | A knowledge repository entry's owner organization — taken from the linked procedure. |
| **DR-2634 Days Since Updated** | The knowledge repository entry's days since updated is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the last updated at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the last updated at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2635 Is Stale** | A knowledge repository entry is considered a stale if all of the following hold: the review interval days is greater than 0 and the days since updated is greater than the review interval days. |
| **DR-2636 Is Execution Feedback** | A knowledge repository entry is considered an execution feedback if the fed from execution has a value. |
| **DR-2637 Is Machine Authored** | A knowledge repository entry is considered machine-authored if all of the following hold: the author agent has a value and at least one of the following holds: the author agent kind is “AIAgent” or the author agent kind is “AutomatedPipeline”. |
| **DR-2638 Outlives Author Tenure** | A knowledge repository entry is considered to outlive an author tenure if all of the following hold: the author agent has a value; the author is still engaged is false; and the is stale is false. |
| **DR-2639 Is Uncredited Expert Know How** | A knowledge repository entry is considered an uncredited expert know how if all of the following hold: the source expert has a value; the source expert is not the author agent; and the credits source expert is false. |
| **DR-2640 Name** | A community membership's name is computed as the agent, followed by “ in ”, followed by the community of practice. |
| **DR-2641 Member Organization** | A community membership's member organization — taken from the linked agent. |
| **DR-2642 Community Organization** | A community membership's community organization — taken from the linked community of practice. |
| **DR-2643 Is External Member** | A community membership is considered an external member if all of the following hold: the member organization has a value and the member organization is not the community organization. |
| **DR-2644 Name** | A source relationship's name is computed as the knowledge engineer, followed by “ with ”, followed by the source agent. |
| **DR-2645 Is Unnegotiated Power Gap** | A source relationship is considered an unnegotiated power gap if all of the following hold: the power dynamic has a value; the power dynamic is not “Balanced”; and the negotiated agreement is blank. |
| **DR-2646 Is Extractive Relationship** | A source relationship is considered an extractive relationship if all of the following hold: the trust level has a value; the trust level is not “Established”; and the trust building practice is blank. |
| **DR-2647 Name** | A department process account's name is computed as the department, followed by “ on ”, followed by the procedure. |
| **DR-2648 Conflicting Department** | A department process account's conflicting department — taken from the linked conflicts with account. |
| **DR-2649 Is Awaiting Engagement** | A department process account is considered awaiting-engagement if the engaged at is blank. |
| **DR-2650 Is Conflicting Account** | A department process account is considered a conflicting account if all of the following hold: the conflicts with account has a value and the conflicting department is not the department. |
| **DR-2651 Is Unresolved Disagreement** | A department process account is considered unresolved-disagreement if all of the following hold: the conflicting account flag is set and the resolution practice is blank. |
| **DR-2652 Name** | A problem occurrence's name is computed as the problem signature, followed by “ / ”, followed by the problem occurrence ID. |
| **DR-2653 Solver is Still Engaged** | A problem occurrence's solver is still engaged when the linked solved by agent is still engaged. |
| **DR-2654 Is Solved** | A problem occurrence is considered solved if the solved at has a value. |
| **DR-2655 Prior Was Solved** | A problem occurrence's prior was solved when the linked prior occurrence is solved. |
| **DR-2656 Prior Solution Entry** | A problem occurrence's prior solution entry — taken from the linked prior occurrence. |
| **DR-2657 Prior Solver** | A problem occurrence's prior solver is the solved by agent of the problem occurrence's prior occurrence. |
| **DR-2658 Prior Solver is Still Engaged** | A problem occurrence's prior solver is still engaged when the linked prior occurrence is still engaged. |
| **DR-2659 Is Solved Without Recorded Solution** | A problem occurrence is considered a solved without recorded solution if all of the following hold: the solved flag is set and the solution entry is blank. |
| **DR-2660 Has Been Solved Before** | A problem occurrence is considered to have a been solved before if all of the following hold: the prior occurrence has a value and the prior was solved is true. |
| **DR-2661 Has Consultable Specialist** | A problem occurrence is considered to have a consultable specialist if all of the following hold: the been solved before flag is set; the prior solver has a value; and the prior solver is still engaged is true. |
| **DR-2662 Is Relearned Solved Problem** | A problem occurrence is considered a relearned solved problem if all of the following hold: the been solved before flag is set and the prior solution entry is blank. |
| **DR-2663 Is Turnover Regression** | A problem occurrence is considered a turnover regression if all of the following hold: the relearned solved problem flag is set; the prior solver has a value; and the prior solver is still engaged is false. |
| **DR-2664 Name** | An onboarding record's name is computed as the new starter, followed by “ on ”, followed by the procedure. |
| **DR-2665 As of Instant** | An onboarding record's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2666 Is Proficient** | An onboarding record is considered proficient if the proficient at has a value. |
| **DR-2667 Days to Proficiency** | The onboarding record's days to proficiency is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if at least one of the following holds: the started at is blank or the proficient at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the started at to the proficient at. |
| **DR-2668 Days Since Start** | The onboarding record's days since start is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 99999, if the started at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the started at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2669 Is Recent Start** | An onboarding record is considered a recent start if all of the following hold: the days since start is at least 0 and the days since start is at most 180. |
| **DR-2670 Procedure Repository Entry Count** | An onboarding record's procedure repository entry count — taken from the linked procedure. |
| **DR-2671 Procedure Departed Only Count** | An onboarding record's procedure departed only count is the departed only know how count of the onboarding record's procedure. |
| **DR-2672 Is Starting From Nothing** | An onboarding record is considered starting-from-nothing if all of the following hold: the procedure repository entry count is 0 and the procedure departed only count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2673 Name** | A sharing recognition's name is computed as the recognition kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the recognized agent. |
| **DR-2674 Name** | A capability decline's name is computed as the organization, followed by “: ”, followed by the stage. |
| **DR-2675 Preceding Stage** | A capability decline's preceding stage — taken from the linked preceding stage decline. |
| **DR-2676 Preceding Decline Started At** | A capability decline's preceding decline started at — taken from the linked preceding stage decline. |
| **DR-2677 Follows Preceding Stage Decline** | A capability decline is considered to follow a preceding stage decline if all of the following hold: the preceding stage decline has a value; the preceding decline started at is less than the decline started at; and at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the stage is “EngineerTraining” and the preceding stage is “FacilityInvestment” or all of the following hold: the stage is “KnowHowUpkeep” and the preceding stage is “EngineerTraining”. |
| **DR-2678 Name** | A knowledge trace's name is computed as the target kind, followed by “ <- ”, followed by the source material, followed by “ (”, followed by the trace role, followed by “)”. |
| **DR-2679 Source Material Kind** | A knowledge trace's source material kind — taken from the linked source material. |
| **DR-2680 Source Collected At** | A knowledge trace's source collected at — taken from the linked source material. |
| **DR-2681 Source Revised At** | A knowledge trace's source revised at is the source document revised at of the knowledge trace's source material. |
| **DR-2682 Source is Document** | A knowledge trace's source is document is true when the knowledge trace's source material is a document source. |
| **DR-2683 Source is People Capture** | A knowledge trace's source is people capture when the linked source material is a people capture. |
| **DR-2684 Source is Practice Evidence** | A knowledge trace's source is practice evidence when the linked source material is a practice evidence. |
| **DR-2685 Is Source Changed Since Taken** | A knowledge trace is considered a source changed since taken if all of the following hold: the source revised at has a value and the source revised at is greater than the source collected at. |
| **DR-2686 Modeled Duration Minutes** | A knowledge trace's modeled duration minutes is the expected duration minutes of the knowledge trace's step. |
