| **DR-2687 Is Unfaithful to Source** | A knowledge trace is considered an unfaithful to source if all of the following hold: the step has a value; the source stated duration minutes is greater than 0; and the modeled duration minutes is not the source stated duration minutes. |
| **DR-2688 Derived by Agent Kind** | A knowledge trace's derived by agent kind — taken from the linked derived by agent. |
| **DR-2689 Is Machine Derived** | A knowledge trace is considered machine-derived if all of the following hold: the derived by agent has a value and the derived by agent kind is not “Human”. |
| **DR-2690 Is Self Validated** | A knowledge trace is considered self-validated if all of the following hold: the validated by agent has a value and the validated by agent is the derived by agent. |
| **DR-2691 Has Incomplete Provenance** | A knowledge trace is considered to have an incomplete provenance if at least one of the following holds: the source material is blank; the derivation route is blank; or the validated by agent is blank. |
| **DR-2692 Provenance Statement** | A knowledge trace's provenance statement is computed as “From ”, followed by the source material, followed by “; route: ”, followed by the derivation route, followed by “; derived by ”, followed by the derived by agent, followed by “; confirmed by ”, followed by the validated by agent. |
| **DR-2693 Is Aspect Unsupported by Source Kind** | A knowledge trace is considered an aspect unsupported by source kind if at least one of the following holds: all of the following hold: the traced aspect is “Workaround” and the source material kind is not “FieldNotes” or all of the following hold: the traced aspect is “ActualExecution” and the source material kind is not “MinedEventTrace”. |
| **DR-2694 Is Document Origin** | A knowledge trace is considered a document origin if all of the following hold: the trace role is “Origin” and the source is document flag is set. |
| **DR-2695 Step Elicited Validation Count** | A knowledge trace's step elicited validation count — taken from the linked step. |
| **DR-2696 Step Elicited Extension Count** | A knowledge trace's step elicited extension count — taken from the linked step. |
| **DR-2697 Is Document Start Never Validated** | A knowledge trace is considered document-start-never-validated if all of the following hold: the document origin flag is set; the step has a value; and the step elicited validation count is 0. |
| **DR-2698 Is Document Start Never Extended** | A knowledge trace is considered document-start-never-extended if all of the following hold: the document origin flag is set; the step has a value; and the step elicited extension count is 0. |
| **DR-2699 Contradicted Document Revised At** | A knowledge trace's contradicted document revised at is the modified at of the knowledge trace's contradicted document. |
| **DR-2700 Is Document Trailing Practice** | A knowledge trace is considered a document trailing practice if all of the following hold: the trace role is “Contradicts”; the contradicted document has a value; the source is practice evidence flag is set; and the source collected at is greater than the contradicted document revised at. |
| **DR-2701 Prescribed Versus Enacted** | The knowledge trace's prescribed versus enacted is determined by the following priority:<br>1. an empty string, if the contradicted document is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, “Prescribed in ”, followed by the contradicted document, followed by “; enacted per ”, followed by the source material, followed by “: ”, followed by the source statement. |
| **DR-2702 Name** | A mined flow edge's name is computed as the from step, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the to step. |
| **DR-2703 Documented Transition Count** | A mined flow edge's documented transition count is the number of step transitions related to the mined flow edge. |
| **DR-2704 Is Undocumented Path** | A mined flow edge is considered an undocumented path if the documented transition count is 0. |
| **DR-2705 To Step Expected Minutes** | A mined flow edge's to step expected minutes is the expected duration minutes of the mined flow edge's to step. |
| **DR-2706 Is Bottleneck** | A mined flow edge is considered a bottleneck if all of the following hold: the to step expected minutes is greater than 0 and the median wait minutes is greater than 4 times the to step expected minutes. |
| **DR-2707 Is Mined Path Recorded As Intent Without Decision** | A mined flow edge is considered a mined path recorded as intent without decision if all of the following hold: the recorded stance is “Intended” and the intent decision by is blank. |
| **DR-2708 Name** | A collection occasion's name is computed as the occasion kind, followed by “: ”, followed by the label. |
| **DR-2709 As of Instant** | A collection occasion's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2710 Days Since Held** | The collection occasion's days since held is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the last held at is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the last held at to the as of instant. |
| **DR-2711 Is Lapsed** | A collection occasion is considered lapsed if the days since held is greater than the cadence days. |
| **DR-2712 Captured Material Count** | A collection occasion's captured material count is the number of collected source materials related to the collection occasion. |
| **DR-2713 Is Held Without Capture** | A collection occasion is considered a held without capture if all of the following hold: the last held at has a value and the captured material count is 0. |
| **DR-2714 Name** | A stakeholder perspective's name is computed as the holder role, followed by “ on ”, followed by the step. |
| **DR-2715 Source Material Kind** | A stakeholder perspective's source material kind — taken from the linked source material. |
| **DR-2716 Conflict Partner Count** | A stakeholder perspective's conflict partner count is the number of stakeholder perspectives related to the stakeholder perspective. |
| **DR-2717 Is in Conflict** | A stakeholder perspective is considered in-conflict if at least one of the following holds: the conflicts with perspective has a value or the conflict partner count is greater than 0. |
| **DR-2718 Is Dissenting View Not Kept With Source** | A stakeholder perspective is considered a dissenting view not kept with source if all of the following hold: the in conflict flag is set and at least one of the following holds: the disposition is “OverriddenByConsensus” or the source material is blank. |
| **DR-2719 Name** | A model pilot's name is computed as the governed model, followed by “ pilot: ”, followed by the site. |
| **DR-2720 Name** | A model activity expert's name is computed as the governed model, followed by a space, followed by the lot activity, followed by a space, followed by the expert. |
| **DR-2721 Name** | A model data mapping run's name is computed as the governed model, followed by “ mapping ”, followed by the data origin. |
| **DR-2722 Name** | An artifact handoff's name is computed as the from step, followed by “ -> ”, followed by the to step. |
| **DR-2723 Declared Source Step** | An artifact handoff's declared source step — taken from the linked step variable. |
| **DR-2724 Declared Consumer Step** | An artifact handoff's declared consumer step — taken from the linked step variable. |
| **DR-2725 Disagrees With Declared Variable** | An artifact handoff is considered to disagree with declared variable if at least one of the following holds: the from step is not the declared source step or the to step is not the declared consumer step. |
| **DR-2726 Name** | An app action's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2727 Policy Command** | An app action's policy command — taken from the linked policy. |
| **DR-2728 Policy Denial Test Count** | An app action's policy denial test count — taken from the linked policy. |
| **DR-2729 Watched Field is Witness** | An app action's watched field is witness when the linked watched field is a witness. |
| **DR-2730 Input Field Count** | An app action's input field count is the number of app action fields related to the app action. |
| **DR-2731 Is Unpermitted** | An app action is considered unpermitted if the policy is blank. |
| **DR-2732 Policy Command Disagrees** | An app action is flagged policy command disagrees if all of the following hold: the policy has a value and the operation is not the policy command. |
| **DR-2733 Is Unproven Write** | An app action is considered an unproven write if all of the following hold: the policy has a value and the policy denial test count is 0. |
| **DR-2734 Name** | An app action field's name is computed as the app action, followed by “ / ”, followed by the field label. |
| **DR-2735 Target Field Type** | An app action field's target field type — taken from the linked target field. |
| **DR-2736 Writes Derived Field** | An app action field is considered to write a derived field if all of the following hold: the target field has a value; the target field type is not “raw”; and the target field type is not “relationship”. |
| **DR-2737 Name** | An abundant knowledge gap's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2738 Representing Table Row Count** | An abundant knowledge gap's representing table row count is the measured row count of the abundant knowledge gap's represented by table. |
| **DR-2739 Name** | An ontology support programme's name is the same as its label. |
| **DR-2740 As of Instant** | An ontology support programme's as of instant — taken from the linked evaluation context. |
| **DR-2741 Supported Profile Count** | An ontology support programme's supported profile count is the number of ontology profiles related to the ontology support programme. |
| **DR-2742 Has Ended** | An ontology support programme is considered to have ended if all of the following hold: the ends on has a value and the ends on is less than the as of instant. |
| **DR-2743 Days Until Programme Ends** | The ontology support programme's days until programme ends is determined by the following priority:<br>1. 0, if the ends on is blank;<br>2. in all other cases, the number of days from the as of instant to the ends on. |
| **DR-2744 Is Ended With No Steward Named** | An ontology support programme is considered ended-with-no-steward-named if all of the following hold: the ended flag is set and the our successor steward is blank. |
| **DR-2745 Is Ending Soon With No Steward Named** | An ontology support programme is considered ending-soon-with-no-steward-named if all of the following hold: the has ended is false; the ends on has a value; the days until programme ends is at most 180; and the our successor steward is blank. |

## 5 Traceability to Schema

_The expression column is the rule's definition in RuleSpeak® notation —
the same logic the rulebook stores, written for a business reader._

| Schema element | Kind | Expression |
|----------------|------|------------|
| **RulebookReleases.Name** | formula | `RulebookVersion & " / PKO " & PkoCoreVersionIri` |
| **RulebookReleases.PrevMajor** | lookup | `Lookup(RulebookReleases.VersionMajor via PreviousRelease)` |
| **RulebookReleases.PrevMinor** | lookup | `Lookup(RulebookReleases.VersionMinor via PreviousRelease)` |
| **RulebookReleases.PrevPatch** | lookup | `Lookup(RulebookReleases.VersionPatch via PreviousRelease)` |
| **RulebookReleases.PrevIssuedAt** | lookup | `Lookup(RulebookReleases.IssuedAt via PreviousRelease)` |
| **RulebookReleases.ModelCurrentRelease** | lookup | `Lookup(GovernedModels.CurrentRelease via GovernedModel)` |
| **RulebookReleases.ExpectedMajor** | formula | `If(DeclaredScale = "Major", PrevMajor + 1, PrevMajor)` |
| **RulebookReleases.ExpectedMinor** | formula | `If(DeclaredScale = "Major", 0, If(DeclaredScale = "Minor", PrevMinor + 1, PrevMinor))` |
| **RulebookReleases.ExpectedPatch** | formula | `If(DeclaredScale = "Patch", PrevPatch + 1, 0)` |
| **RulebookReleases.IsIncrementInconsistentWithScale** | formula | `And(PreviousRelease <> "", Or(VersionMajor <> ExpectedMajor, VersionMinor <> ExpectedMinor, VersionPatch <> ExpectedPatch))` |
| **RulebookReleases.DaysSincePreviousRelease** | formula | `If(PreviousRelease = "", 0, DaysBetween(IssuedAt, PrevIssuedAt))` |
| **RulebookReleases.IsLongReleaseCycle** | formula | `DaysSincePreviousRelease > 60` |
| **RulebookReleases.IsDeclaredCurrentRelease** | formula | `And(ModelCurrentRelease <> "", RulebookReleaseId = ModelCurrentRelease)` |

| **RulebookReleases.NonAdditiveChangeCount** | rollup | `Count(ModelChangeLogEntries via Release)` |
| **RulebookReleases.ClassRemovalOrRenameCount** | rollup | `Count(ModelChangeLogEntries via Release)` |
| **RulebookReleases.InvalidatingDomainRangeCount** | rollup | `Count(ModelChangeLogEntries via Release)` |
| **RulebookReleases.InconsistentDisjointnessCount** | rollup | `Count(ModelChangeLogEntries via Release)` |
| **RulebookReleases.SchemaAdditionCount** | rollup | `Count(ModelChangeLogEntries via Release)` |

| **RoleAssignments.IsCurrentlyValid** | formula | `And(Status = "Active", Or(ValidTo = "", ValidTo > AsOfInstant))` |
| **RoleAssignments.AgentRoleKey** | formula | `If(IsCurrentlyValid, Agent & "\|" & Role, "")` |
| **RoleAssignments.HasDeparted** | formula | `And(ValidTo <> "", ValidTo <= AsOfInstant)` |
| **RoleAssignments.CoversNow** | formula | `And(Status = "Active", ValidFrom <= AsOfInstant, Or(ValidTo = "", ValidTo > AsOfInstant))` |
| **RoleAssignments.RoleWhenCovering** | formula | `If(CoversNow, Role, "")` |
| **RoleAssignments.AgentKind** | lookup | `Lookup(Agents.AgentKind via Agent)` |
| **RoleAssignments.IsNonHumanAssignment** | formula | `Not(AgentKind = "Human")` |
| **RoleAssignments.PredecessorAgentKind** | lookup | `Lookup(RoleAssignments.AgentKind via SupersedesAssignment)` |
| **RoleAssignments.IsHumanToNonHumanHandover** | formula | `And(PredecessorAgentKind = "Human", IsNonHumanAssignment)` |
| **RoleAssignments.IsUnauthorizedNonHumanAssignment** | formula | `And(IsNonHumanAssignment, Not(HasApprovingAuthority))` |
| **RoleAssignments.WasAuthorizedByChangeRequest** | formula | `And(HasApprovingAuthority, AuthorizingChangeRequest <> "")` |
| **RoleAssignments.DecisionCount** | rollup | `Count(AgentDecisionRecords via RoleAssignmentWhenScored)` |
| **RoleAssignments.OverriddenDecisionCount** | rollup | `Count(AgentDecisionRecords via RoleAssignmentWhenOverridden)` |
| **RoleAssignments.OverrideRatePercent** | formula | `If(DecisionCount = 0, 0, OverriddenDecisionCount * 100 / DecisionCount)` |
| **RoleAssignments.PredecessorOverrideRatePercent** | lookup | `Lookup(RoleAssignments.OverrideRatePercent via SupersedesAssignment)` |
| **RoleAssignments.QualityRegressedVsPredecessor** | formula | `And(SupersedesAssignment <> "", OverrideRatePercent > PredecessorOverrideRatePercent)` |
| **RoleAssignments.DepartedRoleKey** | formula | `If(HasDeparted, Role, "")` |
| **RoleAssignments.PredecessorDecisionCount** | lookup | `Lookup(RoleAssignments.DecisionCount via SupersedesAssignment)` |
| **RoleAssignments.HasSufficientSample** | formula | `DecisionCount >= MinimumDecisionsForComparison` |
| **RoleAssignments.PredecessorHasSufficientSample** | formula | `PredecessorDecisionCount >= MinimumDecisionsForComparison` |
| **RoleAssignments.ComparisonIsEvidentiallySound** | formula | `And(HasSufficientSample, PredecessorHasSufficientSample)` |
| **RoleAssignments.SingleOverrideSwingPercent** | formula | `If(DecisionCount > 0, 100 / DecisionCount, 0)` |
| **RoleAssignments.QualityVerdictIsUnsupported** | formula | `And(Not(ComparisonIsEvidentiallySound), Not(QualityRegressedVsPredecessor))` |
| **RoleAssignments.IsUnmeasuredAutomationHandover** | formula | `And(IsHumanToNonHumanHandover, Not(ComparisonIsEvidentiallySound))` |
| **RoleAssignments.ErrorCorrectionCount** | rollup | `Count(AgentDecisionRecords via ErrorCorrectionRoleAssignmentKey)` |
| **RoleAssignments.ErrorRatePercent** | formula | `If(DecisionCount > 0, ErrorCorrectionCount * 100 / DecisionCount, 0)` |
| **RoleAssignments.HasDatedAuthorization** | formula | `And(ApprovingAuthorityRole <> "", AuthorizationDecidedAt <> "")` |
| **RoleAssignments.DaysSinceAuthorizationReview** | formula | `If(AuthorizationReviewedAt <> "", DaysBetween(AsOfInstant, AuthorizationReviewedAt), DaysBetween(AsOfInstant, ValidFrom))` |
| **RoleAssignments.AuthorizationIsOverdueForReview** | formula | `And(AuthorizationReviewCadenceDays > 0, DaysSinceAuthorizationReview > AuthorizationReviewCadenceDays)` |
| **RoleAssignments.IsStandingUnreviewedAutomation** | formula | `And(CoversNow, And(IsNonHumanAssignment, AuthorizationIsOverdueForReview))` |
| **RoleAssignments.IsUnconditionedAutomationHandover** | formula | `And(IsHumanToNonHumanHandover, AuthorizationReviewCadenceDays = 0)` |
| **RoleAssignments.ExceedsTolerableErrorRate** | formula | `And(MaxTolerableErrorRatePercent > 0, ErrorRatePercent >= MaxTolerableErrorRatePercent)` |
| **RoleAssignments.BoundaryViolationCountForAssignment** | rollup | `Count(AgentDecisionRecords via BoundaryViolationRoleAssignmentKey)` |
| **RoleAssignments.HasAnyBoundaryViolation** | formula | `BoundaryViolationCountForAssignment > 0` |
| **RoleAssignments.HasUngroundedGoverningBoundary** | lookup | `Lookup(Roles.IsGovernedByLapsedAuthority via Role)` |
| **RoleAssignments.SuspensionConditionMet** | formula | `Or(ExceedsTolerableErrorRate, Or(HasAnyBoundaryViolation, HasUngroundedGoverningBoundary))` |
| **RoleAssignments.IsOperatingUnderMetSuspensionCondition** | formula | `And(SuspensionConditionMet, And(CoversNow, IsNonHumanAssignment))` |
| **RoleAssignments.HasDeclaredSuspensionCondition** | formula | `MaxTolerableErrorRatePercent > 0` |
| **RoleAssignments.HasApprovingAuthority** | formula | `ApprovingAuthorityRole <> ""` |
| **RoleAssignments.HasAuthorizingChangeRequest** | formula | `AuthorizingChangeRequest <> ""` |
| **RoleAssignments.IsUnauthorizedEnforcementAgent** | formula | `And(IsEnforcementRole, IsUnauthorizedNonHumanAssignment)` |
| **RoleAssignments.GovernanceEvidenceCount** | formula | `If(HasApprovingAuthority, 1, 0) + If(HasAuthorizingChangeRequest, 1, 0)` |
| **RoleAssignments.UnauthorizedEnforcementRoleKey** | formula | `If(IsUnauthorizedNonHumanAssignment, Role, "")` |
| **RoleAssignments.ScopedVersionStatus** | lookup | `Lookup(ProcedureVersions.Status via ForProcedureVersion)` |
| **RoleAssignments.IsScopedToRetiredVersion** | formula | `And(IsCurrent, Or(ScopedVersionStatus = "Deprecated", ScopedVersionStatus = "Archived"))` |
| **RoleAssignments.PredecessorValidTo** | lookup | `Lookup(RoleAssignments.ValidTo via SupersedesAssignment)` |
| **RoleAssignments.PredecessorLacksValidityEnd** | formula | `And(SupersedesAssignment <> "", PredecessorValidTo = "")` |
| **RoleAssignments.AgentVersionKey** | lookup | `Lookup(Agents.VersionOrEmploymentKey via Agent)` |
| **RoleAssignments.AgentRolePairKey** | formula | `Agent & "\|" & Role` |
| **RoleAssignments.IsOpenEnded** | formula | `ValidTo = ""` |
| **RoleAssignments.RoleApprovalStepCount** | lookup | `Lookup(Roles.ApprovalStepCount via Role)` |
| **RoleAssignments.ReceivesApprovalNoticesNow** | formula | `And(CoversNow, RoleApprovalStepCount > 0)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.Name** | formula | `Label` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.HasOwnVocabularyAndNorms** | formula | `And(OwnVocabulary <> "", Norms <> "")` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.SharingEventCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeTransfers via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.IsMandatedWithoutSharingNorm** | formula | `And(Origin <> "", Origin <> "Grassroots", SharingEventCount = 0)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.InterconnectedKnowHowCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowHowCarriers via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.PhysicalKnowHowCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowHowCarriers via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.DigitalKnowHowCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowHowCarriers via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.PersonCarriedKnowHowCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowHowCarriers via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.SpansPhysicalAndDigitalWithHumans** | formula | `And(PhysicalKnowHowCount > 0, DigitalKnowHowCount > 0, PersonCarriedKnowHowCount > 0)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.ExternalMemberCount** | rollup | `Count(CommunityMemberships via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.SpecialistMemberCount** | rollup | `Count(CommunityMemberships via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.EmployerMoveCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeTransfers via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.IsCrossFirmPracticeCluster** | formula | `And(ExternalMemberCount >= 2, EmployerMoveCount >= 1, SpecialistMemberCount >= 1)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.RecentApprenticeshipCount** | rollup | `Count(Mentorships via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.IsCirculationEndingForLackOfApprentices** | formula | `And(EmployerMoveCount >= 1, OpenApprenticeshipPlaces > 0, RecentApprenticeshipCount = 0)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.AmbientAbsorptionCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeTransfers via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **CommunitiesOfPractice.HasAmbientTradeKnowHow** | formula | `And(IsColocatedTrade, AmbientAbsorptionCount >= 1)` |
| **Mentorships.Name** | formula | `MentorAgent & " -> " & LearnerAgent` |
| **Mentorships.AsOfInstant** | lookup | `Lookup(EvaluationContexts.AsOfInstant via EvaluationContext)` |
| **Mentorships.IsActive** | formula | `And(ValidFrom <> "", ValidFrom <= AsOfInstant, Or(ValidTo = "", ValidTo >= AsOfInstant))` |
| **Mentorships.DaysSinceStarted** | formula | `If(ValidFrom = "", 99999, DaysBetween(AsOfInstant, ValidFrom))` |
| **Mentorships.IsRecentApprenticeship** | formula | `And(MentorshipForm = "Apprenticeship", DaysSinceStarted >= 0, DaysSinceStarted <= 1095)` |
| **Mentorships.CommunityLabel** | lookup | `Lookup(CommunitiesOfPractice.Label via CommunityOfPractice)` |
| **ProcedureTypes.Name** | formula | `Label` |
| **ProcedureTypes.NarrowerTypeCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcedureTypes via BroaderProcedureType)` |
| **ProcedureTypes.HasNarrowerTypes** | formula | `NarrowerTypeCount > 0` |
| **ProcedureTypes.IsDetachedFromTaxonomy** | formula | `And(TaxonomyRank <> "FunctionalDomain", BroaderProcedureType = "")` |
| **ProcedureTypes.BroaderIsDetached** | lookup | `Lookup(ProcedureTypes.IsDetachedFromTaxonomy via BroaderProcedureType)` |
| **ProcedureTypes.IsUnreachableByNavigation** | formula | `Or(IsDetachedFromTaxonomy, And(BroaderProcedureType <> "", BroaderIsDetached = TRUE))` |
| **ProcedureTypes.MemberCount** | rollup | `Count(Procedures via ProcedureType)` |
| **ProcedureTypes.MembersLackingDistinctionCount** | rollup | `Count(Procedures via LacksDistinctionTypeKey)` |
| **ProcedureTypes.IsArbitraryGrouping** | formula | `And(MemberCount > 0, Or(DistinguishingFacet = "", MembersLackingDistinctionCount = MemberCount))` |
| **Procedures.Name** | formula | `Title` |
| **Procedures.ExecutionCount** | rollup | `Sum(ProcedureVersions.ExecutionCount via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.IsTemplateInstance** | formula | `TemplateProcedure <> ""` |
| **Procedures.TargetCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcedureTargets via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.AdoptionCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcedureAdoptions via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.SpecifiedStepTotal** | rollup | `Sum(ProcedureVersions.CountOfSteps via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.HasNoExplicitSteps** | formula | `SpecifiedStepTotal = 0` |
| **Procedures.CalledByStepCount** | rollup | `Count(Steps via CallsProcedure)` |
| **Procedures.IsNestedProcedure** | formula | `CalledByStepCount > 0` |
| **Procedures.FailureCriterionCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcedureOutcomeCriteria via FailureProcedureKey)` |
| **Procedures.HasNoFailureCriterion** | formula | `FailureCriterionCount = 0` |
| **Procedures.LensViewCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcedureLensViews via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.PrivilegesSingleStakeholderView** | formula | `LensViewCount = 1` |
| **Procedures.StepLevelViewCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcedureLensViews via StepLevelProcedureKey)` |
| **Procedures.CategoryLevelViewCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcedureLensViews via CategoryLevelProcedureKey)` |
| **Procedures.ProcedureTypeRank** | lookup | `Lookup(ProcedureTypes.TaxonomyRank via ProcedureType)` |
| **Procedures.ProcedureTypeDefinition** | lookup | `Lookup(ProcedureTypes.Definition via ProcedureType)` |
| **Procedures.HasStepAndCategoryResolutions** | formula | `And(SpecifiedStepTotal > 0, ProcedureTypeRank = "ProcessType")` |
| **Procedures.IsMissingDemandedResolution** | formula | `Or(And(StepLevelViewCount > 0, HasNoExplicitSteps), And(CategoryLevelViewCount > 0, Or(ProcedureType = "", ProcedureTypeRank <> "ProcessType")))` |
| **Procedures.IsInconsistentlyCategorized** | formula | `Or(ProcedureType = "", ProcedureTypeRank <> "ProcessType", ProcedureTypeDefinition = "")` |
| **Procedures.StrategicAlignmentCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcessStrategicAlignments via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.HasNoStatedReasonForExisting** | formula | `StrategicAlignmentCount = 0` |
| **Procedures.OutcomeMeasureCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcessOutcomeMeasures via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.UnlinkedMeasureCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcessOutcomeMeasures via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.MeasuresPerformanceWithoutBusinessLink** | formula | `And(OutcomeMeasureCount > 0, UnlinkedMeasureCount = OutcomeMeasureCount)` |
| **Procedures.HinderedByCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcessInterdependencies via HinderedProcedureKey)` |
| **Procedures.IsHinderedByAnotherOperation** | formula | `HinderedByCount > 0` |
| **Procedures.TypeDistinguishingFacet** | lookup | `Lookup(ProcedureTypes.DistinguishingFacet via ProcedureType)` |
| **Procedures.TypeDistinguishingValue** | lookup | `Lookup(ProcedureTypes.DistinguishingValue via ProcedureType)` |
| **Procedures.MatchingDistinctionCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcedureFacetAssignments via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.LacksTypeDistinction** | formula | `And(ProcedureType <> "", MatchingDistinctionCount = 0)` |
| **Procedures.LacksDistinctionTypeKey** | formula | `If(LacksTypeDistinction, ProcedureType, "")` |
| **Procedures.ManagedVocabularyCount** | rollup | `Count(Vocabularies via ManagedSchemeProcedureKey)` |
| **Procedures.LacksManagedControlledVocabulary** | formula | `And(SpecifiedStepTotal > 0, ManagedVocabularyCount = 0)` |
| **Procedures.ComplianceReviewStepCount** | rollup | `Count(Steps via ComplianceReviewProcedureKey)` |
| **Procedures.InvolvesComplianceReviewRole** | formula | `ComplianceReviewStepCount > 0` |
| **Procedures.IsRegulatedButUnformalized** | formula | `And(RequiredByRegulation <> "", HasNoExplicitSteps)` |
| **Procedures.AgentIntendedCount** | rollup | `Count(AiAdoptionInitiatives via TargetProcedure)` |
| **Procedures.IsTacitOnlyAgentTarget** | formula | `And(AgentIntendedCount > 0, HasNoExplicitSteps)` |
| **Procedures.RepositoryEntryCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeRepositoryEntries via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.StaleEntryCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeRepositoryEntries via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.DepartedOnlyKnowHowCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowHowCarriers via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.HasDecayedTransferChannel** | formula | `Or(StaleEntryCount > 0, DepartedOnlyKnowHowCount > 0)` |
| **Procedures.ExecutionFeedbackEntryCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeRepositoryEntries via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.IsExecutedWithoutFeedbackLoop** | formula | `And(ExecutionCount > 0, ExecutionFeedbackEntryCount = 0)` |
| **Procedures.MachineAuthoredEntryCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeRepositoryEntries via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.PractitionerRelationshipCount** | rollup | `Count(SourceRelationships via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.IsCapturedByAutomationAlone** | formula | `And(MachineAuthoredEntryCount > 0, PractitionerRelationshipCount = 0)` |
| **Procedures.UnengagedStakeholderCount** | rollup | `Count(DepartmentProcessAccounts via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.HasUnengagedStakeholder** | formula | `UnengagedStakeholderCount > 0` |
| **Procedures.RecentStarterCount** | rollup | `Count(OnboardingRecords via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.UntransferredVeteranKnowHowCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowHowCarriers via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.DepartingVeteranKnowHowCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowHowCarriers via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.HasTransferShortfallExposure** | formula | `Or(And(RecentStarterCount >= 3, UntransferredVeteranKnowHowCount > 0), DepartingVeteranKnowHowCount > 0)` |
| **Procedures.ProficientWithCaptureCount** | rollup | `Count(OnboardingRecords via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.ProficientWithoutCaptureCount** | rollup | `Count(OnboardingRecords via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.DaysWithCaptureTotal** | rollup | `Sum(OnboardingRecords.DaysToProficiency via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.DaysWithoutCaptureTotal** | rollup | `Sum(OnboardingRecords.DaysToProficiency via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.AvgDaysToProficiencyWithCapture** | formula | `If(ProficientWithCaptureCount = 0, 0, Round(DaysWithCaptureTotal / ProficientWithCaptureCount, 1))` |
| **Procedures.AvgDaysToProficiencyWithoutCapture** | formula | `If(ProficientWithoutCaptureCount = 0, 0, Round(DaysWithoutCaptureTotal / ProficientWithoutCaptureCount, 1))` |
| **Procedures.FormalizationDoesNotEaseOnboarding** | formula | `And(ProficientWithCaptureCount > 0, ProficientWithoutCaptureCount > 0, AvgDaysToProficiencyWithCapture >= AvgDaysToProficiencyWithoutCapture)` |
| **Procedures.CollectedMaterialCount** | rollup | `Count(CollectedSourceMaterials via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.InWorkCaptureCount** | rollup | `Count(CollectedSourceMaterials via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.IsCaptureSeparateFromWork** | formula | `And(CollectedMaterialCount > 0, InWorkCaptureCount = 0)` |
| **Procedures.ExpertAcquisitionHours** | rollup | `Sum(CollectedSourceMaterials.ExpertEffortHours via Procedure)` |
| **Procedures.ComplianceDocumentCount** | rollup | `Count(Resources via ComplianceRecordFor)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.Name** | formula | `Title` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CountOfSteps** | rollup | `Count(Steps via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CountOfOpenKnowledgeGaps** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeGaps via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsReadyForExecution** | formula | `And(Status = "Approved", CountOfSteps > 0, CountOfOpenKnowledgeGaps = 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.SpecifiedStepCount** | rollup | `Count(Steps via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.OverdueReviewCount** | rollup | `Count(ReviewEvents via OverdueVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.OpenChangeRequestCount** | rollup | `Count(ChangeRequests via OpenChangeVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.OpenHighSeverityGapCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeGaps via OpenGapVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsFitToExecute** | formula | `And(Status = "Approved", OverdueReviewCount = 0, OpenChangeRequestCount = 0, OpenHighSeverityGapCount = 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.StewardReviewCadenceDays** | rollup | `Sum(StewardshipAssignments.ReviewCadenceDays via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CountOfStewardshipAssignments** | rollup | `Count(StewardshipAssignments via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.HasAnySteward** | formula | `CountOfStewardshipAssignments > 0` |

| **ProcedureVersions.IsLiveAndUnstewarded** | formula | `And(IsLive, IsUnstewarded)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CountOfOpenBlockingGaps** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeGaps via IsOpenAndBlocking)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.HasOpenBlockingGap** | formula | `CountOfOpenBlockingGaps > 0` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsLiveWithBlockingGap** | formula | `And(IsLive, HasOpenBlockingGap)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.RunsOnUnapprovedKnowledge** | formula | `CountOfUnapprovedRelianceFragments > 0` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CountOfOverdueGaps** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeGaps via IsOverdueGap)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CountOfChangeRequests** | rollup | `Count(ChangeRequests via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CountOfReviewEvents** | rollup | `Count(ReviewEvents via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.HasGovernanceRecord** | formula | `Or(CountOfChangeRequests > 0, CountOfReviewEvents > 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.AsOfInstant** | lookup | `Lookup(EvaluationContexts.AsOfInstant via EvaluationContext)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.DaysSinceModified** | formula | `DaysBetween(AsOfInstant, ModifiedAt)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.WasModifiedSinceLastReview** | formula | `DaysSinceModified < DaysSinceLastReview` |

| **ProcedureVersions.HasUnwitnessedChange** | formula | `And(IsLive, WasModifiedSinceLastReview)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CountOfStaleFragments** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeFragments via ExceedsOwningCadence)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.KnowledgeIsStalerThanCadence** | formula | `CountOfStaleFragments > 0` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CompoundFragileFragmentCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeFragments via CompoundFragileVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.RestsOnCompoundFragileKnowledge** | formula | `And(IsLive, CompoundFragileFragmentCount > 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ConcentratedWitnessSessionCount** | rollup | `Count(ElicitationSessions via ConcentratedSessionVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.KnowledgeBaseIsConcentrated** | formula | `And(IsLive, ConcentratedWitnessSessionCount > 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.MachineConsumedUnapprovedCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeFragments via MachineConsumedUnapprovedVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.FeedsUnapprovedKnowledgeToMachines** | formula | `And(IsLive, MachineConsumedUnapprovedCount > 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.GenuinelyOverdueFragmentCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeFragments via GenuinelyOverdueVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.AwaitedDecisionCount** | rollup | `Count(ChangeRequests via BacklogVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ScopedOpenBlockingGapCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeGaps via OpenBlockingGapVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsBlockedOnPendingDecision** | formula | `And(AwaitedDecisionCount > 0, ScopedOpenBlockingGapCount > 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.UnexercisedHumanGateCount** | rollup | `Count(Steps via UnexercisedGateVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.AiBoundaryIsUnevidenced** | formula | `And(IsLive, UnexercisedHumanGateCount > 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.LoadBearingUnapprovedCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeFragments via UnapprovedLoadBearingVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.UnlandedDecisionCount** | rollup | `Count(ChangeRequests via UnlandedVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.UnrehearsedControlEntryCount** | rollup | `Count(StepTransitions via UnrehearsedControlVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.HasUnrehearsedControlEntry** | formula | `UnrehearsedControlEntryCount > 0` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsLiveWithUnrehearsedControl** | formula | `And(IsLive, HasUnrehearsedControlEntry)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CadenceBreachCount** | rollup | `Count(ReviewEvents via CadenceBreachVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsInCadenceBreach** | formula | `CadenceBreachCount > 0` |
| **ProcedureVersions.HasDecisionInFlight** | formula | `OpenChangeRequestCount > 0` |

| **ProcedureVersions.ValidFragmentCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeFragments via ValidFragmentVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.StillOwnsValidKnowledge** | formula | `ValidFragmentCount > 0` |

| **ProcedureVersions.StalledImplementationCount** | rollup | `Count(ChangeRequests via StalledImplementationVersionKey)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.UndeclaredControlKindCount** | rollup | `Count(Steps via UndeclaredControlVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ControlTaxonomyIsIncomplete** | formula | `UndeclaredControlKindCount > 0` |
| **ProcedureVersions.HasApprovedChangeRequest** | formula | `ApprovedChangeRequestCount > 0` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ApprovedChangeRequestCount** | rollup | `Count(ChangeRequests via ApprovedVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.UnwatchedUnownedControlCount** | rollup | `Count(Requirements via UnwatchedUnownedFlag)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.MiningRunCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcessMiningRuns via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.DriftedMiningRunCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcessMiningRuns via DriftedMiningRunKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.HasUnresolvedMiningDrift** | formula | `DriftedMiningRunCount > 0` |
| **ProcedureVersions.EntryStepId** | rollup | `Max(Steps.EntryStepKey via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ExecutionCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcedureExecutions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.StatusIsPko** | lookup | `Lookup(LifecycleStatuses.IsPkoStatus via Status)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.UsesNonPkoStatus** | formula | `StatusIsPko = FALSE` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ExceptionCount** | rollup | `Count(Exceptions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.FallbackTransitionCount** | rollup | `Count(StepTransitions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.AlternativeTransitionCount** | rollup | `Count(StepTransitions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.HasNoExceptionHandling** | formula | `And(CountOfSteps > 0, ExceptionCount = 0, FallbackTransitionCount = 0, AlternativeTransitionCount = 0)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.HumanStepCount** | rollup | `Count(Steps via ProcedureVersion)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.DayRunCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcedureExecutions via ProcedureVersion)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.IsInconsistentAcrossShifts** | formula | `And(DayRunCount > 0, NightRunCount > 0, Or(And(DayDeviatingRunCount = 0, NightDeviatingRunCount > 0), And(DayDeviatingRunCount > 0, NightDeviatingRunCount = 0)))` |
| **ProcedureVersions.OverlapsRelationCount** | rollup | `Count(ActivityRelations via OverlapsVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.EnablesRelationCount** | rollup | `Count(ActivityRelations via EnablesVersionKey)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.PreventsRelationCount** | rollup | `Count(ActivityRelations via PreventsVersionKey)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.RestsOnNotationOnly** | formula | `StepsWithoutOntologyTypeCount > 0` |

| **ProcedureVersions.IsUnderSpecifiedForExecution** | formula | `Or(CountOfSteps = 0, ConditionlessStepCount = CountOfSteps, HasNoExceptionHandling)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.MixesGranularityAtOneLevel** | formula | `And(CoarseTopLevelStepCount > 0, FineTopLevelStepCount > 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ProcedureTypeOfVersion** | lookup | `Lookup(Procedures.ProcedureType via Procedure)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.IndexedSegmentCount** | rollup | `Count(RetrievalSegments via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.SearchCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeSearchEvents via SoughtProcedureVersion)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.LacksMachineInterpretableEncoding** | formula | `And(IsCurrent, Or(IndexedSegmentCount = 0, ServedAssertionCount = 0))` |
| **ProcedureVersions.StructuredQueryCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeQueryDefinitions via TargetProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ProfileValidatedSubmissionCount** | rollup | `Count(AuthoringSubmissions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ReasonedAssertionCount** | rollup | `Count(SnapshotAssertions via SourceProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsNotQueryValidateReasonReady** | formula | `And(IsCurrent, Or(StructuredQueryCount = 0, ProfileValidatedSubmissionCount = 0, ReasonedAssertionCount = 0))` |
| **ProcedureVersions.PublishedProjectionCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeProjections via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ConsumerSyncCount** | rollup | `Count(ConsumerSystemSyncs via LoadedVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsUnreachableKnowledge** | formula | `And(IsCurrent, PublishedProjectionCount = 0, ConsumerSyncCount = 0)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.MachineSyncCount** | rollup | `Count(ConsumerSystemSyncs via LoadedVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.HumanChannelCount** | formula | `PublishedProjectionCount + HumanSyncCount` |
| **ProcedureVersions.MachineChannelCount** | formula | `MachineSyncCount + ServedAssertionCount` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ServesOnlyHumansOrOnlyMachines** | formula | `And(IsCurrent, HumanChannelCount + MachineChannelCount > 0, Or(HumanChannelCount = 0, MachineChannelCount = 0))` |
| **ProcedureVersions.FreshMiningRunCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcessMiningRuns via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.LacksContinuousDriftDetection** | formula | `And(IsCurrent, ExecutionCount > 0, FreshMiningRunCount = 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.OutcomeMeasurementCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeOutcomeMeasurements via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsDisconnectedFromOutcomes** | formula | `And(IsCurrent, ExecutionCount > 0, OutcomeMeasurementCount = 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.AiContributionCount** | rollup | `Count(AiInsightProposals via TargetProcedureVersion)` |

| **ProcedureVersions.UsesAiInOneDirectionOnly** | formula | `Or(And(AiContributionCount > 0, AiConsumptionCount = 0), And(AiContributionCount = 0, AiConsumptionCount > 0))` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsUnmodifiedForTwelveMonths** | formula | `And(IsCurrent, DaysSinceModified > 365)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.DesignDecisionCount** | rollup | `Count(ProcessDesignDecisions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsLiveWithoutRecordedDecisions** | formula | `And(IsLive, DesignDecisionCount = 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.AiArtifactConsumingInputCount** | rollup | `Count(StepVariables via ConsumerWorkflow)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ContainsStepsAffectedByAiAgentChange** | formula | `AiArtifactConsumingInputCount > 0` |
| **ProcedureVersions.InterviewSessionCount** | rollup | `Count(ElicitationSessions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ObservationSessionCount** | rollup | `Count(ElicitationSessions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.WorkshopSessionCount** | rollup | `Count(ElicitationSessions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ProtocolSessionCount** | rollup | `Count(ElicitationSessions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IncidentSessionCount** | rollup | `Count(ElicitationSessions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ReconciledDivergenceCount** | rollup | `Count(WorkflowViewDivergences via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ComplementaryMethodCount** | formula | `If(InterviewSessionCount > 0, 1, 0) + If(ObservationSessionCount > 0, 1, 0) + If(WorkshopSessionCount > 0, 1, 0) + If(ProtocolSessionCount > 0, 1, 0) + If(IncidentSessionCount > 0, 1, 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ReliesOnSingleMethod** | formula | `ComplementaryMethodCount = 1` |
| **ProcedureVersions.MissesARequiredElicitationMode** | formula | `And(ComplementaryMethodCount > 0, Or(WorkshopSessionCount = 0, InterviewSessionCount = 0, ObservationSessionCount = 0, ReconciledDivergenceCount = 0))` |
| **ProcedureVersions.CriticalIncidentCount** | rollup | `Count(CriticalIncidents via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.JudgmentUnprobedByIncidents** | formula | `And(TacitJudgmentFragmentCount > 0, CriticalIncidentCount = 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.SmeApprovalCount** | rollup | `Count(RepresentationReviews via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.SmeAiEvaluationCount** | rollup | `Count(RepresentationReviews via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsApprovedWithoutSmeSignoff** | formula | `And(Status = "Approved", SmeApprovalCount = 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ExpertsEvaluateAiNotRepresentation** | formula | `And(SmeAiEvaluationCount > 0, SmeApprovalCount = 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.KeSessionCount** | rollup | `Count(ElicitationSessions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.KeFieldSessionCount** | rollup | `Count(ElicitationSessions via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsStudiedOnlyFromTheDesk** | formula | `And(KeSessionCount > 0, KeFieldSessionCount = 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.JudgmentHeldOutsideSopCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeHoldings via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.TacitHoldingCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeHoldings via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ExplicitHoldingCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeHoldings via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.TacitShareExceedsExplicit** | formula | `TacitHoldingCount > ExplicitHoldingCount` |
| **ProcedureVersions.HandsHeldCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeHoldings via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.NegotiatedPracticeCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeHoldings via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.LivesInHandsSilenceAndNegotiation** | formula | `And(HandsHeldCount > 0, JudgmentHeldOutsideSopCount > 0, NegotiatedPracticeCount > 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.ProcessModelTraceCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeTraces via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsLiveModelUntraced** | formula | `And(IsLive, ProcessModelTraceCount = 0)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.TrailingPracticeTraceCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeTraces via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.IsDocumentedBehindPractice** | formula | `TrailingPracticeTraceCount > 0` |

| **ProcedureVersions.DeclaredFirstStepCount** | rollup | `Count(Steps via ProcedureVersion)` |
| **ProcedureVersions.GraphEntryStepCount** | rollup | `Count(Steps via ProcedureVersion)` |

| **Steps.PostconditionCount** | rollup | `Count(StepConditions via PostconditionStepKey)` |
| **Steps.InvariantCount** | rollup | `Count(StepConditions via InvariantStepKey)` |
| **Steps.SafetyCriticalConditionCount** | rollup | `Count(StepConditions via SafetyCriticalStepKey)` |
| **Steps.FailureModeCount** | rollup | `Count(FailureModes via Step)` |
| **Steps.CueCount** | rollup | `Count(StepCues via Step)` |
| **Steps.DangerCueCount** | rollup | `Count(StepCues via DangerCueStepKey)` |
| **Steps.DecisionPointCount** | rollup | `Count(DecisionPoints via Step)` |
| **Steps.KnowledgeFragmentCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeFragments via Step)` |
| **Steps.HasInstructionOnly** | formula | `And(PreconditionCount + PostconditionCount + InvariantCount = 0, CueCount = 0, FailureModeCount = 0, DecisionPointCount = 0, KnowledgeFragmentCount = 0)` |
| **Steps.InputVariableCount** | rollup | `Count(StepVariables via InputStepKey)` |
| **Steps.OutputVariableCount** | rollup | `Count(StepVariables via OutputStepKey)` |

| **Steps.ReferencedResourceCount** | rollup | `Count(StepResources via Step)` |

| **Steps.HasDownstreamSteps** | formula | `ReachableStepCount > 0` |
| **Steps.IncompletenessCueCount** | rollup | `Count(StepCues via IncompleteCueStepKey)` |

| **Steps.ElicitedExtensionCount** | rollup | `Count(KnowledgeTraces via Step)` |
